old: What do you think of the situation?
Not at this time. Live and drink.

Such interesting times we inhabit, =name=!

        Good to see you well. Is there anything you need?
new:
我们所处的时代多么有趣，=name=!
        见到你安然无恙真是太好了。你需要什么吗？

old: So they do. Live and drink, Mafeo.
new: 所以他们确实如此。活下来，畅饮吧，马费奥。

old:
What novelty, to shelter the mysterious Klanq! I have heard no stories of this tinker-fungus that could be described as dull, though ‘calamitous' could apply to more than one.

        My mind tells tales of what might be brewing in the basement, but I am quite relieved to be out here rather than down there.
new:
何等新奇，庇护神秘的Klanq！我从未听说过有关这种机械真菌的故事可以用‘乏味’来形容，尽管‘灾难性’倒是不止一次适用。
        我的思绪讲述着地下室里可能发生的事情，但我很高兴能在这里而不是在下面。

old: Bethesda Susa? Lovely, but a bit dangerous for a holiday destination. You'll want to bring bandages and warm clothing. Why not take a look at my stock in case something suits you?
new: Bethesda Susa？不错，但作为一个度假地点有点危险。你最好带上绷带和保暖衣物。不妨看看我的存货，说不定有什么适合你的？

old:
The Rainbow Wood is a fair bit too dangerous for a casual promenade, but nothing compares to its beauty. Once, I viewed it from above by means of a gyrocopter, and I will never forget the sights that I saw.

        Nor will I forget crashing to the ground because the gyrocopter broke, but every adventure has its complications, wouldn't you say?
new:
彩虹林对于闲逛来说确实危险了些，但没有什么能与它的美丽相提并论。曾经，我乘坐旋翼机从上方俯瞰过它，那些景象我永生难忘。
        我也不会忘记因为旋翼机坏了而摔到地上的事，但每次冒险都会有些波折，不是吗？

old: I thank you. Live and drink.

Coming from anyone else, I would ask that further japery be left to me.

        But from you? I wouldn't startle to see you return wearing a Sultan's burial mask, having destroyed half a dozen invincible cherubim in the doing. Fates be with you.
new:
如果换作其他人说，我会要求他们把进一步的玩笑留给我。
        但你？我不会对看到你戴着苏丹的葬礼面具归来感到惊讶，即使这意味着你在过程中摧毁了半打无敌的天使。命运与你同在。

old:
Nothing short of explosives or heavy equipment could have made such a sound.

        Be ready for the worst, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
new:
没有什么比爆炸物或重型设备更能发出这样的声音了。
        做好最坏的准备，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

old:
It's a lovely place, and the bananas are delicious.

        As for the so-called Earl, well. I'm loath to recognize nobility to begin with, and I cannot decide whether Asphodel claiming xyr own title is better or worse than if xe inherited it.
new:
这里是个美丽的地方，香蕉也非常美味。
        至于所谓的伯爵嘛。我本来就不愿意承认贵族身份，而且我无法判断阿斯福德尔自封爵位是否比继承爵位更好或更糟。

old:
We are called the Urshiib, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

        Our kind are smarter than the average bear. Sharper, too, and a bit more handy.
new:
我们被称为乌尔希布，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
        我们这种生物比一般的熊更聪明。也更敏锐，还稍微灵巧一些。

old:
Why, this place is Grit Gate! O the vaulted halls, the glint of chrome, the gentle hum of chain turret emplacements!

        There's nowhere like Grit Gate in the whole of Qud, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I've journeyed in my comparatively short time, but I always return here. The very air buzzes with knowledge, as well as quite a few other things.
new:
为什么，这里是砂门！啊，那拱顶的大厅，铬合金的光芒，链炮阵地的轻柔嗡鸣！
        整个奎德都没有像砂门这样的地方，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我在相对短暂的旅途中走遍了许多地方，但总是会回到这里。这里的空气充满了知识，以及其他许多东西。

old:
My condolences to your sense of smell, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

        Golgotha is an execrable place in more ways than one, and I would advise you not to visit without a healthy stock of yuckwheat and honey. If you can cook, a meal with yuckwheat may banish a disease before it comes into its own. Bring salves or urberries, too, and mind your feet in the Cloaca.
new:
对你的嗅觉表示同情，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
        戈耳哥塔是一个在多方面都令人厌恶的地方，我建议你不要没有足够的恶麦和蜂蜜就前往。如果你会做饭，一顿含有恶麦的餐食可能会在疾病恶化之前将其驱除。还要带上药膏或尿莓，并且在下水道里要小心你的脚步。

old:
Oh, I sell whatever sundries that meet my standards of quality, with some measure of curation. I try to ensure that my shelves carry a bit of many things, but you can count on finding more than enough ammunition and a few recoilers that can lead you back here in difficult times.

        If you have anything in need of identification or repair, I can take care of that for you for a few drams as well.
new:
哦，我出售各种符合我质量标准的小商品，带有一些精心挑选的成分。我尽量确保我的货架上能有一点点各种各样的东西，但你可以放心，这里会有足够的弹药和几把能在困难时刻带你回到这里的后坐力枪。
        如果你有任何需要鉴定或修理的东西，我也可以为你处理，只需几枚 dram。

old:
I always knew this part of our story would come. Our efforts today determine the genre of the tale we tell. Is this a triumphant epic, or a tale of woe?

        Fight well, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
new:
我始终知道我们故事的这一部分终将到来。我们今日的努力决定了我们讲述的故事类型。这会是一段凯旋的史诗，还是一曲哀歌？
        战斗出色，=player.formalAddressTerm=.

        糟糕透顶的天气。你想要什么？~
        出售肉。~
        山羊虽然不是旅行的好伙伴，但它们能提供不错的保护。~
        我没有要求过这样的生活，但我们现在就是这样。想买点什么吗？

old:
-mm, your luminous friends are settling in quite well.

				There is yet a pall of ennui among some, but such is the case for any party of brave migrants. Ah, they will find their ground or their path, all in time. Some farmers show some small discomfort but that will pass in time.
new:
-嗯，你那些光辉的朋友安顿得很好。
        仍有一些人感到厌倦，但这对于任何一群勇敢的移民来说都是常态。啊，他们会找到自己的立足之地或前进的道路，一切都会随着时间而解决。一些农民表现出些许不适，但那也会随着时间过去。

old: -mm, blessings upon your generous heart, =name=. I mean no slight to these slynth, but it is too great a favor you ask of the people of Joppa.
new: -mm, 愿祝福降临你慷慨的心灵，=name=。我对这些斯林斯并无恶意，但你向约帕人民请求的恩惠实在太过重大。

old: -mm, oh? You're wondering if they might come to Joppa, then?
new: -嗯，哦？你在想他们是否会来到约帕吗？

old:
-mm, there? Land slopes up and is toothed in chrome steeples, ageless things. Looming over the old-earth tunnels, pillowed in rotting jungle and fungus groves. And broken against the mounts of the north, they are, in the shadow of the Spindle...

				There are people, friends, communities. And friends-to-noone, too. History is thick as the high salt sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and where the past is ground up like matz meal, a mix of life sets in.

				-mm, adventurous ones set off for their own splinter of artifact. To both Fates, life and death...
new:
-嗯，那边？土地向上倾斜，布满了铬制尖塔，这些永恒的存在。它们高耸于古老的地道之上，被腐烂的丛林和菌类林地所环绕。而在北方的山脉阴影下，它们显得破碎不堪，位于纺锤之下...
        有人们，朋友，社区。也有无人问津的朋友，历史如同高盐烈日般厚重，=player.formalAddressTerm=，当过去被磨碎如大麦粉时，生活便交织成一片混杂。
        -嗯，冒险者们出发寻找属于自己的神器碎片。无论是命运之神，生与死...

old:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

				-mm, nephilim. Seventh plague. Girsh titans born on the Moon Stair, and quickened to life to eat our young. Sultan Resheph drove them back a chiliad ago, away to slumber. mm, do they rouse?
new:
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达德停顿了一下.*}}
        -嗯，尼非利姆。第七灾。吉尔什巨人在月亮阶梯上诞生，并被赋予生命，吞噬我们的幼崽。苏丹雷谢普在一个千年前将它们驱逐，让它们沉睡。嗯，它们苏醒了？

old: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.
new: 我与吉尔什林旁边的一个奇怪身影交谈了。

old: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...
new: 有一个奇怪的身影在那生物身后...

old: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.
new: 我注意到这个生物的獠牙已经被移除了。

old: I am sorry to cause pain, Elder.
new: 我对给你带来痛苦感到抱歉，长老。

old:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

				-mm, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Do not like to sour the air with a harsh word! But this tiding bites my liver like acid. mm, must ask Nima for an elixir of yuckwheat...
new:
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达德停顿了一下.*}}
        -嗯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。不喜欢用严厉的话语使气氛变得沉重！但这消息像酸一样刺痛我的肝脏。嗯，得向妮玛要一剂恶麦灵药...

old:
-mm, ah, =name=. Come see how the slynth have become a part of Joppa!

				Some cared not for the slow pace of our lives and struck out on their own, and with their thews and wits I have no doubt they will live to find purpose. mm, others are welcome to grow and flourish here in our marshes.
new:
-嗯，啊，=name=. 来看看斯林斯是如何成为约帕的一部分吧！
        有些人不耐烦于我们生活的缓慢节奏，独自踏上了自己的道路，凭借他们的体力和智慧，我毫不怀疑他们将会找到自己的目标。嗯，其他人则欢迎在这里的沼泽中成长和繁荣。

old:
-mm, work? The farmers are plagued by cave vermin. You might speak to Mehmet o' there, by the southern watervine patch.

				And Argyve, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.
new:
-嗯, 工作？农民们正受到洞穴害兽的困扰。你可以去南部的水藤田找梅赫梅特聊聊。
        还有阿尔吉夫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那个修补匠。总是寻找可以连接的小玩意儿，呵呵。穿过他西南方向的铁皮小屋。

old: -ahh, mm, such spectacle. The statues within, a revelation to the eyes. Chandlers enough to drain your skins dry 'twixt Shallows and Beetle Moon.
new: 啊，嗯，真是壮观。里面的雕像，让眼睛大开。从浅滩到甲虫之月，足够让你的皮肤干涸的灯芯草。

old: I'm back from Red Rock with the corpse of a pale spiderling. Elder, would you examine it?
new: 我从红岩回来了，带了一只苍白蜘蛛幼体的尸体。长老，你能检查一下吗？

old: Can you tell me about the Gyre and the Girsh nephilim again?
new: 你能再给我讲讲涡旋和吉尔什尼菲林吗？

old: What can you tell me about the Six Day Stilt?
new: 你能告诉我关于六日高跷的事吗？

old: Argyve wants me to meet the Barathrumites.
new: 阿尔吉夫希望我见见巴拉特鲁米特人。

old:
-mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=?

				{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}

				Live and drink. Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there. And welcome to Joppa.

				You may drink of our freshwater, too, and quench your thirst.
new:
-嗯。嗯？=player.FormalAddressTerm=？
        {{emote|*长老伊鲁达德微笑着。*}}
        活着并畅饮。进来吧——来坐在凉爽的树荫下，靠在那里的枕头上。欢迎来到约帕。
        你也可以饮用我们的淡水，解解渴。

old:
-mm? No, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Your finding is rich in value to us. We are poor farmers, and sharpen our vinereapers is all we can do. But others? Perhaps more.

				Take these prickly-boons as thanks. mm, I will not soon forget this, =name=. Leave me now to muse, kindly...
new:
-mm? 不，=player.formalAddressTerm=!
        你的发现对我们来说非常有价值。我们只是贫穷的农民，磨利我们的藤蔓收割机是我们唯一能做的。但其他人呢？也许他们能做更多。
        拿这些刺果作为感谢吧。嗯，我不会很快就忘记这件事的，=name=。现在请留我独自沉思，好心人...

old:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

				-mm, plagues. Of our great grandsires many-times-over. Salt, darkness, svardym-frog... Girshling.
new:
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达德停顿了一下.*}}
        -嗯，瘟疫。我们伟大祖先的许多后代。盐，黑暗，svardym-蛙... 吉尔什林。

old: -mm, work? Try Argyve, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.
new: -嗯，工作？试试阿吉夫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那个修补匠。他总是在寻找可以连接的小玩意，呵呵。穿过他的铁皮小屋，向西南走。

old: Have you spoken to the slynth, =name=? I am curious to hear what destination they choose.
new: 你和斯林斯 =name= 说过话吗？我很想知道他们选择的目的地。

old:
-mm, yes? Plagues, a chiliad old. Seven such: girshlings, darkness. mm, svardym-frog...

				Ah, nephilim, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Girsh titans who eat the young of kith and kin. Sultan Resheph drove them under the earth, but do they stir??
new:
-嗯，是吗？瘟疫，千年之久。七个这样的: 吉尔什林，黑暗。嗯，斯瓦迪姆蛙...
        啊，尼菲林，也是你吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=。吉尔什泰坦们吞噬着亲族的幼崽。苏丹雷谢夫将他们驱逐至地底，但他们是否已蠢蠢欲动？？

old: Can you tell me about Qud?

-this? The oasis-hamlet. 'Neath the shelf of the world. A million breaths of salt the wind heaves over the Great Salt Desert Moghra'yi. And to the east, the rotting jungles of Qud.

				Here in the crack between the two, watervine can grow, and we grow it. mmm, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
new:
-这？绿洲小村。位于世界的边缘之下。风将百万次的盐息吹过伟大的莫格拉伊盐漠。而在东方，是腐烂的库德丛林。
        在这里，在两者之间的裂缝中，水藤可以生长，我们也种植它。嗯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

old: -mm, oh? In dyed robes, flashing gestures of hand? And ranting about pipe milk? A gyre wight, must be. They about worship the Girsh nephilim as gods.
new: -嗯，哦？穿着染色长袍，挥舞着手势？还胡言乱语地谈论管道奶？一定是旋涡幽灵。他们崇拜吉尔什尼菲林族为神。

old: -mm, oh? A gyre wight, must be. They bind the teeth right up to their own gums, to make a show for the Girsh nephilim.
new: -嗯，哦？一个旋涡幽灵，一定是。他们把自己的牙齿绑到牙龈上，以取悦吉尔什尼非林。

old: mm, I am for you, =name=. Any friend of yours is too a friend of Joppa, and if those friends desire shelter I wouldn't dare turn them away. I only hope these lilypad-folk have the patience for a farmer's life. -mm, not as exciting here as it was in the Palladium Reef.
new:
mm,
        我为你而来，=name=。你的任何朋友也是约帕的朋友，如果这些朋友需要庇护，我绝不会拒绝他们。我只是希望这些睡莲族人能耐心适应农民的生活。-mm，在这里可没有帕拉迪乌姆礁那么刺激。

old: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.
new: 我与吉尔什林旁边的一个奇怪身影交谈了。

old: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...
new: 有一个奇怪的身影在那生物身后...

old: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.
new: 我注意到这个生物的獠牙已经被移除了。

old:
Creature of plague, =player.formalAddressTerm=. mmm. This one...

				{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

				This one covered in slick and muscled out the bilge hose of sleeping Agolgot, in the cave under the Cloaca...

				-mm, but here? Girshling this far west? There must be hundreds for one to reach... mm, does the Gyre widen again??
new:
瘟疫生物，=player.formalAddressTerm=。嗯。这个……
        {{emote|*长老伊鲁达德停顿了一下.*}}
        这个生物浑身滑腻，肌肉发达，从沉睡中的阿戈尔戈特的舱底水管中爬出，在克洛阿卡下方的洞穴里...
        -嗯，但是这里？吉什林竟然出现在这么西边？要有一百个才能有一个到达……嗯，涡流又变宽了吗？?

old:
-this? Oh? Oh...

				{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses for several minutes.*}}

				Warted leg? mm. Foul smell of sour gum? mmm. Moon and sun....

				A girshling? This is a girshling.
new:
-这？哦？哦...
        {{emote|*长者伊鲁达暂停了数分钟。*}}
        疣足？嗯。酸胶的恶臭？嗯嗯。月亮和太阳....
        一个吉尔什灵？这是个吉尔什灵。

old: -mm, Barathrumites. Strange draft o'those bearfolk. They, mm, hah. They care not overly for outsiders. I hope Argyve sold you not a better welcome than you'll have.
new: -嗯，Barathrumites。那些熊人的风俗真是奇怪。他们，嗯，哈哈。他们对外人并不怎么友好。我希望Argyve没有向你承诺过更好的欢迎。

old: -here? Speak to my daughter through the east door, for herbs. And sitting Tam in the southeast has all manner of trinket, against his chests o' drawers.
new: -这? 通过东门和我的女儿说话，她有草药。而坐在东南方向的Tam有各种各样的小玩意，就在他的抽屉柜里。

old: You are welcome. I yet have questions.
new: 你太客气了。我还有问题。

old: No parting is simple. I see you, fair -elser.
new: 没有离别是简单的。我看见你，远方的旅人。

old: Your chime is cracked and ribboned on inside with starless clouds. Why?
new: 你的钟声裂纹斑驳，内部布满了无星的云朵。为什么？
你受到螺旋梦的影响了吗？

old: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.
new: 我必须将陶的铃铛带给根茎，这样她就可以离开查瓦了。

old: Oh? A traveler? I see you, then. Live... and drink.
new: 哦？一名旅者？我看见你了。活着……然后畅饮吧。

old: You are welcome. I yet have questions.
new: 你太客气了。我还有问题。

old:
And the sole tether she reached for severed. I mourn for the future she built for herself, now, and worry for Tau herself.

        Thank you, all the same, for taking part in this. May you find your comfort.
new:
而她唯一能抓住的纽带也断开了。我为她所构建的未来哀悼，也为陶本身担忧。
        无论如何，感谢你参与此事。愿你能找到慰藉。
{{emote|*米里亚姆用痛苦的声调加入对话。*}}

old: No parting is simple. I see you, -elser.
new: 没有离别是简单的。我看见你了，-elser。

old:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in deep tones.*}}
				
				I am Miryam, friend.
new:
{{emote|*米里亚姆用低沉的音调加入对话.*}}
        我是米里亚姆，朋友。

old: Strange creatures can be so cruel and arbitrary, I say in greeting.
new: 奇怪的生物可以如此残忍和武断，我在问候时说道。

old:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in aching tones.*}}

				...but, too, someone close. Tau. Bright tau. She is gone.
new:
{{emote|*米里亚姆用痛苦的声调加入对话。*}}
        ...但，同样地，一个亲近的人。陶。光芒四射的陶。她已经不在了。

old:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in melodic tones.*}}

				Oh? You would finish the -elseing act?
				
				I am your debtor, =name=. The ritual is how we organize the anguished practice of being. Now my grieving can begin.
				
				Bright Tau shines always, here or there.
new:
{{emote|*米里亚姆用悦耳的声调附和。*}}
        哦？你打算完成这-异界-行为？
        我是你的债主，=name=。仪式是我们组织痛苦存在的实践方式。现在我的哀悼可以开始了。
        光明的陶星始终闪耀，无论此处还是彼方。

old: I am sorry, Miryam. Did you lose someone close to you?
new: 我很抱歉，米里亚姆。你失去了亲近的人吗？

old:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in long tones.*}}

				It's the kriah, traveler. I am in mourning, and I chime in low tones.
new:
{{emote|*米里亚姆发出悠长的音调。*}}
        这是哀悼之歌，旅人。我正在哀悼，因此我的声音低沉。

old:
I do not know how to remember beloved Tau, struggling like a minnow in Soft. In a place between death and living.

        Leave me, please.
new:
我不知如何缅怀心爱的Tau，在Soft中挣扎如同小鱼。在一个介于生死之间的地方。
        请离开我。

old:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned it loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead toward the beam on the abacus of Beauty...

        Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?
new:
是的！我的邻居们已经厌倦了这个故事。我当时正在收割藤蔓，刀刃的平面将它从土壤中松开。我以前看到铬时也曾心动，但亲自解放一小片碎片，将一颗珠子滑向美的算盘上的光束……
        你会去吗？然后把我的小玩意献给井？

old: I will exercise my best judgement. Live and drink.
new: 我将发挥我的最佳判断。活着并畅饮。

old: I am further relieved to know of another perspective looking upon this work. Klanq's presence here is vital, but it discomfits me: I cannot help but consider the introduction of chaos to an already chaotic endeavor to be a... conflagratory strategy.
new: 得知还有其他视角看待这项工作，我更加释怀了。克兰克的存在至关重要，但这也让我感到不安: 我无法不认为，在已经混乱的努力中引入更多的混乱是一种……火上浇油的策略。

old:
...  I do not like this.

        I know you will go. Please take care where you dig; mopango wanderers say the hot blood of Eater artifice yet runs in the guts of that place.
new:
... 我不喜欢这个。
        我知道你会去。请小心挖掘；莫潘戈流浪者说，那个地方的内部仍然流淌着食者造物的热血。

old: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.
new: 我必须通过食者之墓进入光明冥界。

old: Drink deeply of life, Hortensa. Let's talk.
new: 尽情享受生命吧，霍滕萨。我们来聊聊。

old: I drink in the sight of you, cub. Thank you for keeping safe.
new: 我贪婪地注视着你，幼崽。谢谢你保护好自己。

old: I'd like to ask about something else.
Fiery. Blustery. Like the stews he cooks. If you're going to chat with him, make sure you have your schedule cleared and a ewer of honeyed wine.
new: 热烈。狂风般。就像他煮的炖菜一样。如果你要和他聊天，确保你的时间表是空的，并准备一壶蜜酒。

old: How long have you lived in Grit Gate?
new: 你在砂门城住了多久了？

old: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?
new: 你能告诉我一些其他巴拉特鲁米特人的事情吗？

old:
{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}

        You are sharp, =name=. In a way that's what I am. But liquids are more willful than scrap. I can't solder them together; they would run away, hide in the shale cracks, slowly come apart and disappear. I moreso think of myself as a wisewoman in dialogue with them -- I manage their moods and phases. My notebooks are full of their quirks and caprices. It's a wonder, isn't it, how at just the right temperature and pressure the continuity of matter is smashed apart? How the gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm?
new:
{{emote|*霍滕萨轻笑。*}}
        你真敏锐，=name=。从某种意义上说，我也是这样的人。但液体比废铁更有意志。我无法将它们焊接在一起；它们会逃走，藏在页岩的裂缝中，逐渐分离并消失。我更倾向于把自己看作是一位与它们对话的智者——我管理着它们的情绪和状态。我的笔记本上记录了它们的怪癖和任性。真是令人惊叹，不是吗？在适当的温度和压力下，物质的连续性会被打破？气体蝴蝶如何从密集的虫子中翩翩飞出？

old: I'd like to ask about something else.

I won't denigrate them, =name=, or presume to speak for what's in their hearts. But I can direct you around the contours of the impressions they've left on me.

        Who would you like to hear about, =player.offspringTerm=?
new:
我不会诋毁他们，=name=，也不会自以为是地揣测他们的心思。但我可以向你描述他们给我留下的印象轮廓。
        你想了解谁的情况，=player.offspringTerm=？

old: I'd like to ask about something else.

After supper I like to retreat to the library, take a storybook off the shelves, flop down on the chairbear, and lose myself in another world. Many of these worlds feature palaces, markets, gardens, ships. Many of those places have bells. When they do, I always think of Mafeo. More than anyone else, Mafeo could be a character in the bright world of a story, where this dusty place is itself confined to a mere storybook.
new: 晚餐后我喜欢退到图书馆，从书架上取下一本故事书，倒在椅熊上，沉浸在另一个世界里。这些世界中有许多宫殿、市场、花园和船只。这些地方中很多都有钟声。每当这时，我总会想起马费奥。比起任何人，马费奥更像是一个故事中的角色，而这个尘土飞扬的地方本身则被限制在一本故事书中。

old: I'd like to ask about something else.

She's a sphinx! So enigmatic that one. It's not entirely clear if she was there, waiting, when Q Girl succeeded at retreading the mainframe's guts, or if she sparked into being that very moment. Or was it some synthesis of the two?
new: 她是一只狮身人面兽！如此神秘莫测。她究竟是不是在Q女孩成功重置主控系统的那一刻就已经在那里等待，还是在那一刻突然出现的？或者她是两者某种合成体？

old: I'd like to ask about something else.
Sharp as a tack, and living a life of deep meaning. Inventive and orderly. I can't say I understand his music, but I do love how expressive he is with it.
new: 敏锐如针，过着充满深刻意义的生活。富有创造力且井井有条。虽然我不敢说我能理解他的音乐，但我确实喜欢他在音乐中的表达方式。

old: I'd like to ask about something else.

I've instructed Neek since they were a lil' cub. What a strange one! Bouncey. Full of smiles. But brilliant in their own way. My favorite book in all the world is Neek's "Spiderwebs on Hoversleds". Who would have ever thought?
new: 我从尼克还是个小崽子的时候就开始教导他们了。真是个奇怪的孩子！活泼好动，满脸笑容。但他们有自己独特的才华。我最喜欢的书就是尼克写的《悬浮雪橇上的蜘蛛网》。谁会想到呢？

old: I'd like to ask about something else.

Oh, I have such a precious vantage point on my sweet neighbor! When he achieves a moment of perfection in his craft -- a flawlessly spiraled barrel, a mound of powder measured to the grain -- he beams like the high salt sun. What a lovely smile.
new: 哦，我对我的可爱邻居有着如此珍贵的视角！当他在他的工艺中达到完美的一刻——一个完美螺旋的枪管，一撮精确到颗粒的火药——他笑得像高盐的太阳。多么迷人的微笑。

old:
=name=, you are back! I feared we would lose you in the Tomb, but you look better than well. Perhaps I should have had greater faith, or at least less worry.

        Have you visited Barathrum's workshop, by the by? Klanq and Q Girl await you there.
new:
=name=，你回来了！我还担心你会在陵墓中迷失，但你现在看起来比以往任何时候都要好。也许我应该更加信任你，至少少一些担忧。
        你去过巴拉瑟伦的工作室吗？克兰克和Q女孩在那里等你。

old: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?
new: 你能告诉我一些其他巴拉特鲁米特人的事情吗？

old:
{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}

        Years. Decades on decades. Centuries, perhaps. Most of these wet-earred cubs were merely sketches in their mothers' dreambooks when I arrived to study under Barathrum. We knew so little then, know so little now.
new:
{{emote|*霍滕萨轻笑。*}}
        年复一年。数十年又数十年。或许还有几个世纪。当我和巴拉瑟姆学习时，这些长着湿耳朵的小崽子们还只是他们母亲梦书中的草图。那时我们所知甚少，如今亦然。

old: I'd like to ask about something else.
Precious Shem. They've such a wider view of the world than we do. What a momentous obligation we've created for ourselves, and how I wouldn't undo it!
new: 珍贵的谢姆。他们的世界观比我们宽广得多。我们为自己创造了多么重大的责任，而我是多么不愿意撤销这一切！

old: I'd like to ask about something else.
Our sleepy sage. So sweet. She calms me. I sit in her room and we muse on the nature of things.
new: 我们的睡眼惺忪的智者。如此甜美。她让我平静。我坐在她的房间里，我们思考着万物的本质。

old: Hie there now. Being tardy with Klanq carries risk, not so much from its offense as from its idle curiosity.
new: 嗨，你现在好。和Klanq迟到是有风险的，不过这风险不是来自它的冒犯，而是来自它的好奇心。

new: 畅饮生命的甘露，=player.offspringTerm=。你找到自己的道路了吗？

old: I'd like to ask about something else.
She explodes like gas and dust in a quiet corner of the galaxy. Radiant. Revolutionary. She's a good listener and companion for supper, which you mightn't expect.
new: 她像银河系一角的气体和尘埃般爆炸。光辉灿烂。革命性。她是个好听众，也是晚餐的好伴侣，这可能是你意想不到的。

old: I'd like to ask about something else.
I've shared my honey with that prickly troglodyte for more years than I can count. I can't help but like him, and while he won't admit it, he feels the same about me.
new: 我已经和那个多刺的穴居人分享我的蜂蜜很多年了，多到我都数不清。我忍不住喜欢他，虽然他不会承认，但他对我也有同样的感觉。

old:
There are pools of convalessence there. You see, when cryogenic mist condenses, it forms a cool, luminous liquid that's restorative if you're able to bathe in it.

        Oh! And in one of the ruined wards, the Alchemist keeps their shop. Who's the Alchemist, you ask? A sort of enigmatic figure -- amateur liquid-tinker, poet, merchant. Their methods aren't scientific, but they are useful if you're seeking a specific kind of liquid. Just be careful around them, =name=.
new:
那里有康复池。你看，当低温雾气凝结时，会形成一种清凉、发光的液体，如果你能够沐浴其中，就会具有恢复效果。
        哦！而在其中一个废墟病房里，炼金术士经营着他们的店铺。你问炼金术士是谁？一个神秘的人物——业余的液体改造者、诗人、商人。他们的方法并不科学，但如果你在寻找特定类型的液体，它们还是很有用的。只是要小心他们，=name=。

        Oh, I'd rather not talk about it.

哦，是的。你看，许多年前，我们在研究激光技术的过程中一直在学习光学。Barathrum 正在给一些来宾做演讲，而...

new: 是的！我的工作台液体对避难所周围的小振动非常敏感，所以我甚至得到了一个简短的预感。

old: I'd like to ask about something else.
Larger than life. Paternal. Concerned. The lenses of his eyes are focused on the far points of the world.
new: 比生活更伟大。父亲般的。关心的。他的眼睛聚焦在世界的远方。

old: Nothing other than a pet theory of mine that the Spindle is a liquid in laminar flow.
new: 这只是我的一个猜测，即纺锤是一种处于层流状态的液体。

old: I'd like to ask about something else.
Brassy. If you bent him he might snap. The way I treat liquids on my burner, Otho treats the units of the enclave.
new: Brassy. 如果你让他弯下腰，他可能会折断。Otho 对待聚落单位的方式就像我对待燃烧器上的液体一样。

old: You are kind, Earl Asphodel. You have my thanks.
new: 你真仁慈，阿斯福德尔伯爵。我感激不尽。

old: Oh... oh! It's you! You are a dear friend, indeed. Of course, of course! You and your bear friends are most welcome to my Spindle.
new: 哦... 哦！是你啊！你确实是一位亲爱的朋友。当然，当然！你和你的熊朋友非常欢迎来到我的纺锤城。

old: So you say. How can I appease you?
new: 你说是这样。我该怎样让你满意？

old: Lease control of my Spindle, you say? Well, well... That's a colossal request. There's no simple price I can assign to such a thing. Were I to grant such a request, you would owe me a great debt. You and several of your allies.
new: 将我的纺锤控制权租借给你？嗯，嗯……这可是一个巨大的请求。这样的事情，我无法简单地定价。如果我答应了这个请求，你将会欠我一个巨大的人情。你和你的一些盟友都会如此。

old: Indubitably, for I've proclaimed it so! There was no Earl to tell me otherwise.
new: 毋庸置疑，因为我已经宣布了！没有伯爵能告诉我相反的话。

old:
That's right. I've leased your friends the Spindlegrounds and appointed you viceroy to oversee their operation.

        Welcome to court, asphodelyte. You serve at my pleasure.
new:
没错。我已经把Spindlegrounds租给了你的朋友们，并任命你为总督监督他们的运营。
        欢迎来到法庭，阿斯福黛莱石。你服务于我的欢愉。

old: Hear me, Asphodel. I am a dear friend to the Consortium. I ask that you reconsider.
new: 听我说，阿斯福德尔。我是联盟的挚友，恳请你三思。

old: Convene the council, then. I am willing.
Not today, Asphodel. Live and drink.
new: 今天不行，阿斯福德尔。活着，然后畅饮。

old: I will convene a council. The First Council of Omonporch. Send word to four of your allied factions. Have them send delegates. Together, perhaps, you can appease me.
new: 我将召开议会。奥蒙波奇的第一议会。通知你四个盟友派系。让他们派遣代表。或许，你们可以平息我的怒火。

old: Earl Asphodel, the Barathrumites request your permission to lease control of the Spindle. Their inquiries into the past have led them here.
new:
Earl Asphodel，Barathrumites
        请求你的许可，希望租赁控制 Spindle。他们对过去的探究已经将他们带到了这里。

old: Are you truly the Earl of Omonporch?
new: 你真的是奥蒙波奇伯爵吗？

old: Welcome to Omonporch, traveler. Enjoy your visit to my earldom. Feast your eyes upon my tall and glorious Spindle. Take in the scent of roasted musa.
new: 欢迎来到奥蒙波奇，旅人。希望你在我这领地里过得愉快。欣赏我的高大宏伟的纺锤塔吧。享受烤木萨的香气。

old: Greetings, my viceroy. Sit your rump on a cushion or lie your long back on a kline. Soak in the natural light.
new: 问候，我的总督。坐到垫子上或是躺在长椅上。享受自然光吧。

old:
By the Eaters, I'm exhausted. May I help you?~
        Please don't open the gate.~
        I beg you. Do not release the cats.~
        I'll buy your shiniest things, if you'll sell them.~
        I'm a cat herder. My parents were cat herders. Their parents were cat herders, and their parents. I don't understand why we do what we do but it is all I know.~
        I've a glimmer of light for sale if you need one, wanderer.~
        The cats are not for sale.~
        I'm like to faint from this heat.
new:
被食者所累，我已精疲力尽。我能帮到你吗？~
        请不要打开大门。~
        我求求你了。千万不要放猫。~
        我愿意购买你最闪亮的东西，如果你愿意出售的话。~
        我是一位猫群管理者。我的父母也是猫群管理者。他们的父母，以及他们的父母都是如此。我不明白我们为何这样做，但这却是我唯一了解的生活。~
        如果你需要的话，我可以卖给你一缕光明，流浪者。~
        猫不是用来出售的。~
        我感觉要被这热浪熏倒了。

old:
Is okay?~
        Ahh... nervous ... excited.~
        Happy do not fight here.~
        Ah ha ha... nervous!~
        Stay here?~
        =player.FormalAddressTerm= stay also?~
        Strange new.~
        Live and drink.
new:
还好吗？~
        啊……紧张……兴奋。~
        不要在这里打架。~
        啊哈哈……紧张了！~
        留在这里？~
        =player.FormalAddressTerm= 也留下吗？~
        奇怪的新事物。~
        活着并饮酒。

This is home.~

        欢迎来到这里。~

        哈哈哈哈哈！快乐！~

old: I am not offended, simply making =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= aware of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= foolishness.
new: 我不生气，只是想让=ifplayerplural:ye:thee=知道=ifplayerplural:your:thy=的愚蠢。

old:
Ahh.

        Stranger, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= cruel to withhold this experience, but I shall abide.
new:
啊。
        陌生人，=ifplayerplural:你们是:你很=残忍地拒绝了这次体验，但我将会遵守。

old: =name=. Greetings. I am called Yona. =ifplayerplural:Ye seem:Thou seemest= unlike most other climbers. I wonder why.
new: =name=. 你好。我叫尤娜。=ifplayerplural:你们看起来:你看起来= 不像大多数其他攀爬者。我很好奇为什么。

old: Yes. "Anyone may strike a slumberling once."
new: 是的。"任何人都可以对沉睡者发动一次攻击。"

old:
=ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= seen it, out there? The spiny, eel-like creature. That is Dagasha, angry one, lost child. =ifplayerplural:Ye can:Thou canst= feel the hostility pour from it in waves.

        Yet, it attacketh not.
new:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=见过吗，在外面？那个长满刺的、像鳗鱼一样的生物。那是愤怒之子，迷途的孩子达加沙。=ifplayerplural:你们可以:你可以=感受到它散发出的敌意如波涛般涌来。
        然而，它并未攻击。

old:
I am consumed by curiosity. How it resembleth the children in make!

        May I hold the device in communion?
new:
我被好奇心驱使。它在外形上多么像孩子们啊！
        我可以手持这装置进行共通吗？

old: Only a fool asketh after the meaning of a credo.
new: 只有傻瓜才会追问信条的意义。

old: Thank you, Yona. Live and drink.

=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= done a momentous thing.

        I feel the stored energy of Her Light. Dagasha shall shepherd us to our uplifting. =ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= be proud.
new:
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= 做了一件大事。
        我感受到她光芒中储藏的能量。达加沙将引领我们走向升华。=ifplayerplural:你们应该:你应该=感到自豪。

old:
Ah, =factionaddress:Mopango=, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= a bittersweet sight. Would fain =ifplayerplural:ye had:thou hadst= chosen Dagasha, but my Light shineth elsewhere.

        Still, I hope to see more of =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= in my future. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome back, an =ifplayerplural:ye survive:thou surviveth=.
new:
啊，=factionaddress:Mopango=，=ifplayerplural:你们是:你是=苦乐参半的景象。真希望=ifplayerplural:你们:你=选择了Dagasha，但我的光芒照耀在别处。
        不过，我还是希望能在未来的日子里再次见到=ifplayerplural:ye:thee=。=ifplayerplural:Ye
        are:Thou'rt=随时欢迎回来，只要=ifplayerplural:ye survive:thou surviveth=。

old: I seek a use for this repulsive device.
new: 我正在寻找这种令人厌恶的装置的用途。

old: What have we here? Approach, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and be known.
new: 我们这是发现了什么？走近一些，=player.formalAddressTerm=，让我认识你。

old: Who am I? Mak. That's all you get. I'll not waste the honey of my mouth on idle inquiries.
new: 我是谁？我是Mak。仅此而已。我不会浪费口舌在无关紧要的询问上。

old:
...

        And? Is that the whole of your fool statement?
new:
...
        那么？这就是你那愚蠢言论的全部吗？

old: Whelp, affix your eyes to that clam right yonder. Go step inside and find your answers.
new: 嘿，把目光投向那边的贝壳。走进去，找到你的答案吧。

old: You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?
new: 你是这个自由领地的创始人之一，对吧？

old: I've never seen a frog of your stature.
new: 我从未见过像你这般体型的青蛙。

old: What can you tell me about the Freehold?
new: 你能告诉我关于自由之地的事情吗？

old: What indignity have you come to heap upon the mound, whelp? Out with it.
new: 你这小子，又来给这堆土添什么羞辱？说吧。

old: This seems a joyful place. Why are you angry?
new: 这里看起来是个充满欢乐的地方。你为什么生气？

old: What of it? Scurry on and leave me to brood.
new: 有何不可？快滚吧，别打扰我发呆。

old:
Why? A lifetime of vexation. Born to a cacophony of static ringing the ears raw. Thousands of my kinfolk cut down by that porphyric wasp fools called Lamb. A millenium of hot stinking sun and disgusting brine lice for supper.

        Misery obtains on this pond, whelp. By Chavvah if you start beaming like a sunray and yodeling at the Beetle Moon, I'll eat you where you stand.
new:
为什么？一生的烦恼。出生时耳畔充斥着刺耳的噪音，令耳朵生疼。我的数千族人被那些被称为羔羊的愚蠢紫杉蜂所屠杀。千年来的炎热、恶臭的太阳和令人作呕的盐水虱作为晚餐。
        这片池塘充满了苦难，小子。我以查瓦之名发誓，如果你像阳光一样灿烂微笑并对甲虫之月吟唱约德尔歌，我会当场吃了你。

old: Trust what you hear of the svardym, whelp. The sky blackens at our accession and we are like to eat you.
new: 信任你所听到的关于斯瓦迪姆的话，小子。天空在我们登基时变黑，而我们很可能会吃了你。

old: Have the adiyy chewed the hue from your eyes? See for yourself. Free folk make a gathering here and their racket rings through the reef. One can hardly steep in his greens without being mewled to by a salt-stung baby.
new: 阿迪伊是否已经从你的眼中啃食了色彩？自己看看吧。自由民在这里聚集，他们的喧嚣声穿透了珊瑚礁。一个人几乎无法在绿意中沉浸，而不被一个被盐水刺痛的婴儿哀求。

old: I will give you a moment.

{{emote|*Tammuz quiets, then chimes in tottering, unsure tones.*}}

				You beast! You m-moon king! You... Our roars are beastial! Would you say so?
new:
{{emote|*塔姆兹安静下来，然后用颤抖且不确定的语气加入对话。*}}
        你这野兽！你这月之王！你... 我们的咆哮是野兽般的！你觉得呢？

old:
{{emote|*the chime is louder this time, but just as querulous*}}

        Sh-sh-she, th-this fate, it. It is a d-deep dark. Will Tau f-fold herself, I wonder?
new:
{{emote|*这次铃声更大了，但同样不耐烦*}}
        她，这，这命运，它是如此深沉黑暗。我想知道，Tau 是否会屈服于它？

old: How does Tau's departure find you?
new: 陶的离开对你有何影响？

old:
{{emote|*Tammuz rings a wavering chime*}}

        Y-you are here. Elseing h... hand.
new:
{{emote|*塔姆兹摇响了一个颤抖的铃铛*}}
        你…你在这里。伊尔辛格…手。

old:
{{emote|*Tammuz quivers and chimes a jarring tone.*}}

				O-Oh. Oh u-uh oh oh. By contrasts, a q-quake stills even the most anxious trembling...
				
				The world... the world becomes and unbecomes. All the nervous, volcanic energy of being. Who becomes who? Three became one, but what of them now? 
				
				And w-what becomes of Tau? Of me? Of y-you?
new:
{{emote|*塔姆兹颤抖并发出刺耳的声音。*}}
        哦——哦。哦呃呃哦。相比之下，一场地震甚至能让最焦虑的颤抖都平息下来...
        世界……世界在成为与非成为之间徘徊。所有存在的紧张、火山般的能量。谁成为了谁？三个合而为一，但现在他们又如何？
        那 T-Tau 会怎么样？我呢？你呢？
{{emote|*塔穆兹轻敲出一个安静的音调。*}}

old:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a broad and booming tone.*}}

				You! Purpose-driven mad... madhand. You've come here, right? Then you must know power is our... the domain of being is one of power, wouldn't you say? W-Would you please agree with that?
new:
{{emote|*塔穆兹发出宏亮而洪亮的音调。*}}
        你！目的明确的疯子... 疯手。你来到这里，对吧？那你肯定知道力量是我们... 存在的领域是力量，不是吗？你... 你会同意这一点吧？

old:
{{emote|*Tammuz's chime rings even quieter and more tremulous*}}

        Un, un-uncertain. Tau l-leaves unfolded but the g-g-g-gyre yet s-spins. The s-spinning leaves me dizzy.
new:
{{emote|*塔姆兹的铃声更加微弱和颤抖*}}
        不，不确定。陶叶展开，但旋涡仍在旋转。旋转让我头晕。

old: If y-y, th-that... yes. Ask if, if asking.
new: 如果，嗯，那... 是的。问吧，如果要问的话。

old: You sound very unsure of yourself.
new: 你听起来对自己非常不确定。

old: How does Tau's departure find you?
new: 陶的离开对你有何影响？

old:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a querulous tone*}}

        O-oh. Elsefolder... th-this path you have l-laid upon Tau, it-it is best. It is good? P-please be good.
new:
{{emote|*塔穆兹发出抱怨的音调*}}
        哦哦。异界... 你为Tau铺设的这条道路... 是最好的。这是好的吗？请一定要好。

old: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.
new: 我必须将陶的铃铛带给根茎，这样她就可以离开查瓦了。

old: Be uncertain, friend. You have my permission.
new: 不确定吧，朋友。我允许你这样做。

old:
{{emote|*Tammuz is nearly silent but for a soft, shaky resonance*}}

        ...
new:

        ...

old:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a small and bright noise.*}}
				
				Ta- Tammuz. Who becomes. Who is Twofirm even in -then.
new:
{{emote|*塔姆兹发出轻微而清脆的声音。*}}
        塔- 塔穆兹。成为者。即使在那时也坚定不移的双坚者。

old:
{{emote|*the chime rings shaky and loud*}}

          Wh-what is this? H-how is it meant? This outcome j-judders within and w-without us.
new:
{{emote|*钟声颤抖而响亮*}}
          这…这是什么？它…它是什么意思？这种结果在我们内心和外在都引起了震动。

old: Wh-what will Tau b-be after soft? You, did, did you mean... wh-what c-could you say? Tau spins within, the g-gyre spins without.
new:
Wh-what will Tau b-be after soft? You, did, did you mean... wh-what c-could you say?
          Tau 旋绕于内，the g-gyre 旋绕于外。

old:
The t-two sephirots. -then and -else. I cannot be -else. *I* cannot, of course. But -then? It does not seem so.
				  
				Their chimes ring at the right frequencies, others. But not so, mine.
new:
两个赛菲罗特。-然后和-其他。我不能成为-其他。*我*当然不能。但-然后呢？似乎也不行。

        他们的铃声以正确的频率响起，其他人。但我的不是这样。

old: Materials ready? Circuits to solder. Klanq stir the soup?
new: 材料准备好了吗？电路需要焊接。Klanq 搅拌汤了吗？

new: 生物朋友的身体将在之后形成生物。它必须跟随你并获得经验。不用担心，朋友不会在创造过程中被消耗。

old: Interact with scrap-clay mound. Then chat Klanq to solder circuits and stir the soup.

old:
You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed. Take this as thanks.

        That said, the exile must answer for her crimes. There is further reward for you if you see this case through to the end.
new:
你找到了我们的宝藏？我得承认，肯德伦，我非常佩服。把这个当作感谢吧。
        话虽如此，流放者必须为其罪行负责。如果你能将此案追查到底，你还将获得额外的奖励。

old: Then I overestimated your intellect further than I realized. Get out.
new: 然后我高估了你的智力，超出我的想象。滚出去。

old:
Warden Neelahind attends to her duties admirably. She is not terribly assertive, but she need not be.

        I'm surprised she's going along with this outsider-led investigation, but she always had a soft spot for the exile.
new:
守卫尼拉欣德尽职尽责。她并不特别强势，但也不需要如此。
        我对她参与这次由外来者主导的调查感到惊讶，但她一直对流放者情有独钟。

old: Don't be coy, =name=. Emboldened by your incursions into our village, you wish to fill it with your indigent foundlings on the weight of your reputation alone. Am I correct?
new: 别装模作样了，=name=。你入侵我们的村庄，还打算凭借你的名声把这里塞满你收留的穷困潦倒之人。我说得对吗？

old: There is no proof that she is lying.
new: 没有证据表明她在撒谎。

old:
The pariah claims to be wrongfully accused, and you believe her?

        She is obviously lying. Are all kendren so gullible?
new:
这个被放逐者声称自己遭到诬告，而你相信她？
        她显然在撒谎。所有肯德伦人都这么容易上当吗？

old:
Fine! Go to the Warden, then, and have her solve this mystery.

        But know this: until a thief is found and Kindrish is recovered, I cannot reward you. You get nothing. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
new:
好的！去找典狱长吧，让她来解决这个谜团。
        但是你要知道: 在找到盗贼并夺回金德里什之前，我无法奖励你。你什么都得不到。活下去，喝吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
不可接受。准备好去死吧。

old: Ayvah. She must have sold it. Tell no one about this. Please understand that I cannot reward you, as you did not complete the task I asked of you.
new: 艾娃。她一定是卖掉了。请不要告诉任何人。请理解我无法奖励你，因为你没有完成我交给你的任务。

old:
Poem? I detest poetry. Why would one go about learning to write only to use purposefully unclear language, choosing rhyme scheme over clarity?

        Of course it's not mine. Take it back.
new:
诗？我厌恶诗歌。为什么有人要学习写作，却故意使用晦涩难懂的语言，选择押韵而非清晰表达？
        当然不是我的。拿回去吧。

old:
She exiled herself by leaving Bey Lah. Our codes demand that no hindren who leaves us ever return.

        She knew this, and still she chose to leave.
new:
她因离开贝拉赫而被流放。我们的准则要求任何离开我们的后裔都不得再回来。
        她知道这一点，却仍然选择离开。

old:
Kesehind is a good boy. He lost his parents long ago, but has been like a son to me.

        Now his axe-arm is strong where mine is not, and so he lends it.
new:
Kesehind 是个好孩子。他很久以前就失去了父母，但一直像我的儿子一样。
        现在他的斧臂比我强壮，所以他借给了我。
我... 明白了。活着并饮酒。

old:
If you ask the exile, I'm sure she'll spin some kind of accusation that I believe gender to be an immutable prison, that I impose it on others.

        She's lying. Our people have a long history of two-gender hindren called {{w|hartind}}, respected and consecrated. There is a proper path to gender variance in our society, of which the male exile could have availed himself years ago.

        He never did, so I do not recognize him.
new:
如果你问那位流放者，我敢肯定她会编出一些指责，说我把性别视为不可改变的牢笼，并强加于他人。
        她在撒谎。我们的人民有着悠久的历史，存在着被称为{{w|hartind}}的双性后代，受到尊重和神圣化。在我们的社会中，性别变异有一条正确的道路，这位男性流放者本可以在多年前选择这条路。
        他从未这样做过，所以我并不认识他。

old: All right. I'll find your treasure.
new: 好的。我会找到你的宝藏。

old: No thank you. I don't care for this job.
new: 不，谢谢。我对这份工作没兴趣。

old:
Good.

        We hindren are a close-knit and staid people, and our safety depends on our solidarity. In order to preserve our safety and culture, we ask that any of our number who leave us never come back. Recently, one such exile took the treasure of our village, a bracelet named Kindrish, with her when she left. None of our number can leave to get it back, or it will be a violation of the values that I have guarded, and the Hindriarchs before me, for countless generations.

        Will you help us recover our treasure? We have a small cache of valuables we can offer as a reward.
new:
好的。
        我们hindren是一个紧密团结且稳重的民族，我们的安全依赖于团结一致。为了保护我们的安全和文化，我们要求任何离开我们的人永远不要再回来。最近，一名被放逐者在离开时带走了我们村庄的宝藏——一只名为Kindrish的手镯。我们中没有人可以离开去取回它，否则将违背我以及无数代前任Hindriarchs所守护的价值观。
        你愿意帮助我们找回财宝吗？我们可以提供一小部分贵重物品作为报酬。

old: As you say. Live and drink.
Perhaps you should get back to it rather than hanging around my village. Warden Neelahind may be able to help you.
new: 也许你应该回去，而不是在我村子里闲逛。守卫尼拉辛德可能会帮助你。

old: As you say. Live and drink.
Then I will thank you to leave as quickly as possible. I don't want the faundren to become used to our borders being permeable.
new: 然后我会感谢你尽快离开。我不想让福恩德伦习惯我们的边界变得如此脆弱。

old:
You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed.

        Take this as thanks, and... well. I suppose you've earned your stay for a while. Just try not to give the faundren any ideas.
new:
你找到了我们的宝藏？我承认，肯德伦，我非常 impressed。
        把这个当作感谢，还有……嗯。我想你已经赢得了暂时留下的权利。只是尽量不要让那些地底人产生什么想法。

old:
Excellent. I will do my best to reward you to your satisfaction.

new: {{emote|*莱巴赫看到装置后尖声叫唤，蜷缩成一个装甲球。*}}

This sucks.

{{emote|*Liihart stares at you for several quiet seconds.*}}

old: The sultanate is dissolved. Resheph rules no longer.

old:
...oh..... I am Herododicus, lapidary, lithographer, sculptor, calciminer, and biographer to the Coiled Lamb. I will tarry here until the Godhead passes on, and then I will canonize his deeds in high relief.

        I've tarried for quite some time, now.... What a prodigious reign! Bless that Coiled Lamb!
new:
...哦.....我是赫罗多迪库斯，宝石匠，石刻师，雕塑家，石灰矿工，以及盘绕羔羊的传记作者。我将在此逗留，直到神灵离去，然后我会用高浮雕将他的事迹铭记。
        我已经逗留了相当长的时间，现在.... 多么辉煌的统治！祝福那盘旋的羔羊！

old: But Resheph is dead. The sultanate is dissolved.
new: 但雷谢夫已经死了。苏丹国已经瓦解。

old:
'Tis a saying among the stonemasons, "Never finish a job too early." By the decretum of Sagittar, old as it is, they have until the Coiled Lamb is... is decom-.. passed... decompassed.... dead, deadlike... to complete their work on the Tomb.

        Bless the Coiled Lamb, peace to those who canter in his house, and let us pray the day never comes!
new:
石匠们常说，‘永远不要过早完成工作。’根据萨吉塔尔的法令，尽管它很古老，他们直到盘绕的羔羊……解体……逝去……消逝……死去，死一般……才能完成他们在陵墓上的工作。
        祝福盘绕的羔羊，愿那些在他府邸中疾驰者得享和平，让我们祈祷那一天永远不会到来！

{{emote|赫罗多迪库斯恐惧地嗡嗡作响。}}
        印记是=MarkOfDeath=。

old:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled, Moloch. Now to go engrave it.

        Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled... in Your House, Moloch.
new:
交叉检查完成。你的叙述已经编纂好了，摩洛克。现在去刻录它吧。
        和平……愿所有在盘绕之屋中漫步者都能得到和平……在你的居所，摩洛克。

old:
.....oh.... oh.... Poor friend. The ironshank must be upsetting your digestion. The darkness must be blooming in your brain, making you slow and doltish.

        The sultanate dissolved? Tidings would have reached me.... someone would have said so....

        Oh... poor, doltish friend. You cantered too long outside the House of the Coiled Lamb, and now you are a dolt.
new:
.....哦.... 哦.... 可怜的朋友。铁踵一定让你消化不良了。黑暗一定在你脑中盛开，让你变得迟钝和愚蠢。
        苏丹国解散了？这消息应该会传到我这里……应该会有人告诉我……
        哦……可怜的傻朋友。你在盘羊之屋外徘徊得太久，现在你成了个傻子。

old: It is a test. Tell me the answer now.
new: 这是一次测试。现在告诉我答案。

old: I want to ask you something else.
Wrong on both counts. Resheph stands before you. Entomb me.
new: 两个都不对。雷谢夫站在你面前。将我埋葬。

old: Resheph is gone, biographer. I am here, and I have need to travel to Brightsheol. Entomb me.
new: Resheph 已经走了，传记作者。我现在在这里，我需要前往 Brightsheol。将我安葬吧。

old: Of course not. Let's back up.
You must be dead? Is that truly the only way?
new: 你必须得死？这真的是唯一的办法吗？

old: I bear the Mark. Entomb me.
new: 我带着印记。将我安葬吧。

old:
Oh! Brightsheol? The forever braid of life? The Garden Behind the High Gate? Why, you must rank among the crown echelon of machine and folk, and you must... well, you must...

        Start to decompose. You must... You must be dead. Dead and entombed. The body remains, but the mind wanders...
new:
哦！光明谢奥？生命的永恒辫子？高门之后的花园？你一定是机器和人民中的精英阶层，你一定...嗯，你一定...
        开始分解。你必须... 你必须已经死了。死了并被埋葬。身体还在，但心智已游荡...

old: Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............
new: 开始与薄界编年史进行交叉核对............

        Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.
new:
交叉检查已完成。你的叙述已编纂。现在开始镌刻。
        和平……愿所有在盘羊之屋翩翩起舞者都能享有和平。

old: Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm finished, the sarcophagus will open, and you can lay =player.reflexive= to rest!
new: 然后我... 美化... 故事，并将其镌刻在墙上。一旦完成，石棺就会打开，你就可以让=player.reflexive=安息了！

That's not even how it works!

        First, I image your head, read your self's narrative from the folds of your brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of your life's deeds...

        Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm done... then you can entomb =player.reflexive=.
new:
这根本不是这么运作的！
        首先，我想象你的头颅，从你大脑的褶皱中读取你自己的叙述，将其与薄世界对你生平事迹的记录进行核对...
        然后我... 美化... 故事，并将其雕刻在墙上。一旦完成... 你就可以将 =player.reflexive= 安葬。

old:
{{emote|Herododicus pauses.}}

        Ye... yes? Is this a test? I suppose you... could we... could we have been in Brightsheol all along? Is that the answer?

        嗯... 是的？这是个测试吗？我想你... 我们... 我们一直都在光明地狱吗？这是答案吗？

old:

雕刻完成了，摩洛！我希望你会满意。你的事迹将永远铭刻于此。

        Though I have no single sentiment to express, we nonetheless approach -then with our new companions.
new:
这凯特尔真让人激动！斯林斯就在我们中间，我们随之适应，内心充满了兴奋、不安和好奇的混合情感。

        尽管我并无特定的情感可表达，但我们仍带着新伙伴一同前行。

old: This keter roams above my trunk at Eyn Roj, traveler =name=, and across the Stair I dream. You found me, this keter where I chime in dozens.
new: 这棵凯特尔树在我位于艾恩罗伊的树干上方徘徊，旅者=name=，并在楼梯上我做着梦。你找到了我，这棵凯特尔树，在这里我发出数十种声音。

old: I startle, and the roiling is felt before the calm. I cannot find a consensus for the housing of these beings, =name=. I am sorry.
new: 我惊愕不已，动荡先于平静而来。我无法为这些生物的安置达成共识，=name=! 我很抱歉。

old: Again I must be calmed, but the startling gives way to a curiosity. You speak of the glowfolk, belimbed and free. You asking that they join us, like our Sant?
new: 再次需要平复心情，但惊讶逐渐转化为好奇。你提到发光族人，自由而四肢健全。你是想让他们加入我们，像我们的桑特一样？

old: oh. This. Was this felt in gyredream? Your coming to keter? I ask, do not answer.
new: 哦。这样。这是在螺旋梦中感受到的吗？你来到凯特尔了？我问，不需要回答。

old: I will do as you ask.
I have more to ask, first.
new: 我还有更多问题要问，先别急。

old:
Take Tau's chime, silent and still. Carry it to the bottom of Taproot, deep under my trunk, where she will make the chime her transit-body and walk away forever. Finish the ritual of -elseing.

				At the bottom of Taproot, Tau manifests. She tells us, too, that another waits for her there.
new:
取下Tau的铃铛，静默无声。将它带到Taproot的最深处，我的树干之下，她将在那里让铃铛成为她的过渡之身，永远离去。完成-elseing仪式。
        在Taproot的底部，Tau显现了。她还告诉我们，另一个人正在那里等待她。
一起生活，一起饮酒，查瓦。

old: You are well-found, =name=. Though several have chosen their -else, the first of the slynth have joined to us like our Sant, mobile and apart but shared and together. This is a strange -then, but what branches may spill forth from it? I anticipate the witnessing.
new: 你发现得很好，=name=。虽然有些人选择了他们的-else，但第一个斯林斯已经像我们的桑特一样加入了我们，移动且独立，但又共享并团结。这是一个奇怪的-then，但从它可能会生发出怎样的分支呢？我期待见证这一切。

old:
My chimeling Tau leaves Chavvah, leaves me. It is her choice.

				Her transit-psyche manifests at the bottom of Taproot, where we cannot consciously go. To finish the ritual of -elseing, to let Tau become -else, I need a traveler such as you, =name=.
new:
我的小妖精Tau离开了Chavvah，也离开了我。这是她的选择。
        她的传输心灵在Taproot的底部显现，我们无法有意识地到达那里。为了完成-elseing仪式，让Tau成为-else，我需要像你这样的旅行者，=name=。

old: Ah, I am in need, and so I turned my chimes trunkward to tune. You struck the chime and now you are here. Are you a waterhand, and free?
new: 啊，我有所需求，因此我将风铃转向树干调音。你敲响了风铃，于是你来到了这里。你是水手，且自由吗？

old: We await the decision of the glowfolk. Our imaginations run with the possibilities.
new: 我们等待光民的决定。我们的想象充满了各种可能性。

old:
Take Tau's chime, silent and still. Carry it to the bottom of Taproot, deep under my trunk, where she will make the chime her transit-body and walk away forever. Finish the ritual of -elseing.

				At the bottom of Taproot, Tau manifests. She tells us, too, that another waits for her there.
new:
取下Tau的铃铛，静默无声。将它带到Taproot的最深处，我的树干之下，她将在那里让铃铛成为她的过渡之身，永远离去。完成-elseing仪式。
        在Taproot的底部，Tau显现了。她还告诉我们，另一个人正在那里等待她。

old:
So you have, and what proceeds, proceeds.

				I felt your coming here, =name=, in Gyredream. I've felt this moment. I feel it now.

				The ritual of -elseing is complete, waterhand. You are done, and with our thanks.
new:
所以你已经做出了决定，接下来的事情，就顺其自然吧。
        我在旋梦中感受到了你的到来，=name=。我预感到了这一刻。现在我依然能感受到。
        仪式已经完成，水手。你已经完成了任务，我们对你表示感谢。

old:
A future shock. My chimeling _ is vision-gifted, a lichen who clings to shorerock on the straits of Tomorrow. Just a short time ago a sea wave crested and broke beneath her, and she saw in its recession all the bright and violent channel paths.

				We all felt it. A recoming, and the gyre in final tension. I felt...
new:
未来的震撼。我的奇美灵 _ 拥有预知之眼，她是依附在明日海峡岸边岩石上的地衣。就在不久前，一股海浪在她脚下涌起又消退，在那退潮之际，她看到了所有明亮而激烈的航道。
        我们都感受到了。一种回归，以及最终紧张的漩涡。我感到...

old: Many selves? What does this mean?

A sophist of the Self spilled ink and called me, long ago, the Tree of Life. To me, I am the many Selves pinched up my taproot from the permeating Soft.

				I am Chavvah, and I am dyvvrach.
new:
一位自我学派的学者很久以前洒下了墨水，称我为生命之树。对我而言，我是众多自我，从渗透的软土中汲取根须。
        我是查瓦，我是迪夫拉克。

old: As Chavvah I am many. As dyvvrach I am one. I am one and many. One-selves have called me tree city, the sentient place. You may think of the Selves this way, sprouted in keter from Twofirm.
new: 作为查瓦，我是众多。作为迪夫拉奇，我是唯一。我是唯一也是众多。有些人称我为树城，有意识之地。你可以这样理解自我，从双固中萌发于凯特尔。

old: Deep under earth and permeating our roots is Soft, our feeling substance. Ground pressure pushes it up the taproot to our trunk, where it condenses into Twofirm: the biformal phase that contains the two sefirots, -then and -else.
new: 在地底深处，渗透我们的根须的是软物质——我们的感知之源。地压将其推送到主根，直至树干，在那里凝结成双固态: 这一双形态阶段包含了两个位相，-then 和 -else。

old: We find no precedent for this, yet is there space upon our crystal arms and an openness within us. It is agreed: if these slynth will be of us, we will have them here.
new: 我们找不到先例，但我们的心灵开放，水晶之臂上也有空间。一致同意: 如果这些斯林斯愿意成为我们的一员，我们将接纳他们。

old: I will power his starclimb. If you take Tau's chime to taproot, for her to walk away. If you finish the ritual of -elseing.
new: 我将赋予他星辰之升的力量。如果你将陶的铃铛带至根茎，她便能离开。如果你完成了-elseing仪式。

old: This is the genesis my distinct Self, an awareness that contains both -then, what I will become, and -else, what I will not. Twofirm flows up my sapwood to the keter, where -then manifests as an entity and I chime: I speak and hear the world.
new:
这是我的独特自我之起源，一种包含了两面的意识——一面是我将成为的，另一面是我不会成为的。两股力量沿着我的木质部向上流淌至凯特尔，在那里，-then 化身为一个实体，我随之共鸣:
        我发声，聆听世界。

old: Thank you, Dyvvrach. Live and drink.
new: 谢谢你，迪夫拉克。活着并畅饮。

old:
You have completed the ritual of -elseing. You have set bright Tau free.

				Yes, =name=. I will turn my chimes Spindleward to tune, then vibrate at our verve frequency. I will power your starclimb.

				Be vested to tell whoever you must that Chavvah has made this commitment.
new:
你已经完成了-elseing仪式。你已经解放了光明的Tau。
        是的，=name=。我会将我的风铃转向纺锤方向调音，然后以我们的活力频率振动。我会为你的星界攀登提供动力。
        务必告诉必须知道的人，Chavvah 已经做出了这个承诺。

old: Barathrum intends to ascend the Spindle to discover the source of the Signal, yes. He needs a power source for the climber, one shielded from electromagnetic disturbance.
new: Barathrum 打算攀登纺锤以发现信号源，是的。他需要一个能屏蔽电磁干扰的攀爬器电源。

old: I start at this but Tikva settles me. I remember now: from a cub I've known Barathrum to be weak in telling but bold in asking. A starclimb? You mean, an ascent to the long chiming rock?
new: 我开始这样做，但提克瓦让我平静下来。我现在想起来了: 从小我就知道巴拉瑟鲁姆在讲述时显得软弱，但在提问时却很大胆。你是说星爬？你是说要攀登那块长鸣的岩石吗？

old: I am sorry. But will you help Barathrum do as he asks?
new: 我很抱歉。但你会帮助巴拉瑟伦做他所要求的事吗？

old: I am sorry. But will you help Barathrum do as he asks?
new: 我很抱歉。但你会帮助巴拉瑟伦做他所要求的事吗？

old: It was too much for my chimeling Tau. She gasped for air and her chime stilled. She leaves us now, to become -else. It is her choice.
new: 对我的小妖精Tau来说，这太过沉重了。她喘息着，她的铃声静止了。她现在离开了我们，去成为-else。这是她的选择。

old: The entity I spoke with at Eyn Roj mentioned a chiming rock...
new: 我在艾恩罗什交谈过的实体提到了一块鸣响的石头...

old: Explain once more what I must do with Tau's chime.
new: 请再次解释我应该如何使用陶的钟声。

Bethesda Susa 是一个充满活力且繁荣的生态系统，我们在这里没有立足之地。不过，如果有人能清除那里的机械师侵扰，我当然不会抱怨。

old: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

埃RESH基伽尔是格里特之门的主计算机。她会说，她通过薄世界进行监视，而我们则维护她在厚世界的存在。

old: Good. Shut the sarcophagus door behind you.
Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.
new: 平安地生活和饮酒，阿洛伊修斯。

与其他有机体交谈对我来说就像任何体力活动一样费力。

old: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

        Tallfolk.~
        You wandering? Be nimble.~
        Branches part for you.~
        Be nimble, broadfinger.~
        Need aught?~
        Hm hm hm.~
        Oeh?~
        Trees shield you.~
        Sower's eye pass over you.~
        Forage fruitfully.~
        Danger, a-ye?
new:
啊呀？~
        高个子。~
        你在游荡吗？要机敏。~
        树枝为你分开。~
        动作敏捷点，宽指头。~
        需要什么吗？~
        嗯嗯嗯。~
        哦？~
        树木保护了你。~
        播种者之眼注视着你。~
        采集丰收。~
        危险，嗯？

old:
{{emote|*Gyamyo moves little during communion, but shivers and twitches from time to time. After a minute or so, ey returns the device to you.*}}

        I am shaken. No doubt my journey wast shallow compared to Lebah's dive. But now, by my troth I say: Kah hath ever been a being of motion. Swift, kinetic, and elegant. No doubt 'twould be so if freed by yon device.
new:
{{emote|*Gyamyo 在共融期间几乎不动，但时不时颤抖和抽搐。大约一分钟后，ey 把装置还给了你。*}}
        我感到震撼。毫无疑问，我的旅程与Lebah的深潜相比微不足道。但现在，我发誓说: Kah一直是一个充满动感的存在。迅捷、灵动而优雅。毫无疑问，如果被那个装置解放，他也会如此。

old:
My name is Gyamyo. I am pleased to meet =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=. =ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= spoken to the other watchers? How fare they?

        Well, I hope.
new:
我的名字是Gyamyo。很高兴见到=ifplayerplural:ye:thee=，=name=。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=和其他守望者交谈过吗？他们怎么样？
        好吧，我希望如此。

old:
I do, and I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for asking after it.

        My credo is "Reconciliation without understanding is a salt poultice."
new:
我确实如此，我感谢=ifplayerplural:ye:thee=对它的关心。
        我的信条是“没有理解的和解就像盐敷料。”

old:
I have volunteered to monitor an ancient machine-creature called Kah. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= seen it, skipping hither and yon on strange limbs.

        Often I wonder if Kah knoweth aught else but fear.
new:
我志愿监视一个名为Kah的古老机械生物。也许=ifplayerplural:你们见过:你见过=它，用奇怪的四肢跳来跳去。
        常常我在想，卡是否除了恐惧之外一无所知。

old:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= an object of great interest.

        An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= allow, I'd fain commune with it.
new:
=ifplayerplural:你们有:你有=一件非常有趣的物品。
        若蒙=ifplayerplural:诸位允许:阁下允许=，吾愿与之交流。

old:
Oh dear.

        This is the credo by which I live my life, and =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= "what does that mean?"

        I cannot summarize such a thing for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. It is too great, too multifaceted.
new:
哦，天哪。
        这是我的生活准则，=ifplayerplural:你们问:你问=“那是什么意思？”
        我无法为=ifplayerplural:ye:thee=概括这样的事情。这太宏大，太复杂了。

old: You're welcome, Gyamyo. Live and drink.
new: 不客气，吉亚米奥。活着并畅饮吧。

old:
=ifplayerplural:Did ye:Didst thou= truly free one of the children? I see =ifplayerplural:ye did:thou didst=. Congratulations.

        Wouldst fain see Kah free, one day. I shall have to live a while and find a way.
new:
=ifplayerplural:你们确实:你确实=释放了一个孩子？我看到=ifplayerplural:你们做到了:你做到了=。恭喜。
        有朝一日，我希望能见到卡自由。我得先活下来，找到方法。

old: I seek a use for this repulsive device.
new: 我正在寻找这种令人厌恶的装置的用途。

old: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, welcome. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done well to survive so long in this peculiar place.
new: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, 欢迎。=ifplayerplural:你们已经:你已经= 在这个奇特的地方存活了这么久，做得很好。

old: Take this, too. A chute of morphing gel from my personal collection. You've arrayed yourself in the artifacts of time, and so we have little left to give you. But still, this may be useful.
new: 拿上这个。这是我私人收藏的一管变形凝胶。你已经装备了时间的遗物，所以我们能给你的已经不多了。但即便如此，这也许会有用。

old: Now, matters have... evolved... in your absence. Do you choose now to learn more?
new: 现在，事情已经……发展了……在你不在的时候。你现在选择了解更多吗？

old: I will, Barathrum. Live and drink.

Now, our operators at Omonporch confirm that a clash with the Templar is inevitable.
				
				This is a grim fact, but it does give space for your bond to flower. Go, become familiar with leading and piloting your creature. Return when you are ready, and we will finally go starward.
new:
现在，我们在奥蒙波奇的操作员确认与圣堂武士的冲突已不可避免。
        这是一则严峻的事实，但它确实为你们之间的羁绊提供了发展空间。去吧，熟悉如何领导和驾驭你的生物。当你准备好了，回来找我，我们将一同前往星辰大海。

old: Outside of time I found myself in a place of light. I chose to return and was made new.
new: 在时间之外，我发现自己身处光明之地。我选择了回归，并被重塑一新。

old: I found Brightsheol, where it lies beyond the Tomb. I spoke to the Shomer there and arranged for the disablement of the Spindle's magnets.
new: 我找到了光明舍奥尔，它位于墓地之外。我与那里的守望者交谈，并安排关闭了纺锤的磁铁。

old: Over there, by your workbench. Is that... Pax Klanq?
new: 那边，你的工作台旁。那是……帕克斯·克兰克？

old: You appear... refreshed. My old eyes spy the swim lines of the waking world and to you they cede precedence. A newness obtains.
new: 你看起来……精神焕发。我的老眼看到了觉醒世界的泳道线，而它们向你让出了优先。一种新的状态出现了。

old: These entrails, what are they? Where do I find them?
new: 这些内脏，它们是什么？我在哪里可以找到它们？

old: These entrails, what are they? Where do I find them?
new: 这些内脏，它们是什么？我在哪里可以找到它们？

old: I'm to pilot the creature? And bond with it?
new: 我要驾驶这生物？并与它建立联系？

old: I need time and space from this.
new: 我需要时间和空间远离这一切。

old: I wish to ask about something else.

Pax Klanq will mold the creature from raw bioelectrical materials. You must gather these entrails: the body as a model, the catalyst to charge the sanguine fluid, the atzmus as deistic direction, the armament for protection, and the hamsa for personality. You will bond with the creature, too, and act as its pilot. So you must speak an incantation to inscribe the connection.
				
				You'll also need to procure the sanguine fluid itself. And, too, a power source shielded from electromagnetic attacks.
new:
Pax Klanq 将使用原始生物电气材料塑造这个生物。你必须收集这些内脏: 身体作为模型，催化剂为血液充能，atzmus 作为神学方向，武器用于保护，以及 hamsa
        用于个性。你也将与这个生物结合，成为它的驾驶员。因此，你必须念诵咒语以铭刻这种联系。
        你还需要获取猩红体液本身。同时，也需要一个能够抵御电磁攻击的电源。

old:
Strange, this, and imprecise, but as tinkers we know: a crude blueprint is better than no blueprint. You must return to Omonporch and enter the Tomb of the Eaters. Once inside, trace the errant paths cut into the mausoleum by robbers and vandals, and ascend to Resheph's burial chamber.

				As for gaining entrance to the Tomb, Resheph sealed the gates a thousand years ago, but there's a flaw in the seal. The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.

				You're to recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol.
new:
奇怪，这，不够精确，但我们作为修补匠知道:
        一个粗糙的蓝图总比没有好。你必须回到奥蒙波奇并进入食者之墓。进入后，沿着盗墓者和破坏者在陵墓中切割出的错误路径前行，然后上到雷斯赫夫的埋葬室。
        至于进入陵墓，雷谢夫在一千年前封印了大门，但封印有一个缺陷。古老的死亡印记已经随着时间的流逝而遗失，但如果你能找到它并在身上刻下印记，死亡之门就会为你打开，就像过去无数食尸鬼尸体一样。
        你必须找回死亡印记，=name=，进入陵墓，并穿越到光明谢奥尔。

old:
Pax Klanq is an eccentric mushroom prodigy. All their faults aside, they are a brilliant scientist and engineer, and I have little doubt that they could build the climber faster than we could. Several years have passed since we were last in contact, but they owe us a debt, and we must now collect.

				Unfortunately, no one knows Pax Klanq's whereabouts. Through contacts I made over the years, I inquired as to their location. The most I was able to garner were these enigmatic instructions:

				"Seek the heart of the rainbow, eat the god's flesh, and follow the Coral Path."
new:
Pax Klanq
        是一位古怪的蘑菇天才。尽管他们有许多缺点，但他们是一位杰出的科学家和工程师，我毫不怀疑他们能比我们更快地建造出攀爬器。自从我们上次联系以来已经过去了几年，但他们欠我们一个人情，现在我们必须去讨回。
        不幸的是，没有人知道Pax Klanq的下落。通过多年来建立的联系，我询问了他们的位置。我所能得到的最多就是这些神秘的指示:
        寻找彩虹之心，食神之肉，追随珊瑚之道。

old:
They are the components that we will grow, shape, and solder into the ascendant being. We can delve into specifics once you begin, at which point Pax Klanq can also serve as a source of knowledge.

				As you acquire components, bring them to the mound of scrap and clay over by Klanq.
new:
它们是我们将要培育、塑形并焊接成升灵体的组件。一旦你开始，我们可以深入具体细节，那时Pax Klanq也可以作为知识的来源。
        当你获得组件后，把它们带到克拉克旁边的废料和黏土堆那里。

old: Otho said you wished to speak with me.
new: Otho 说你希望与我交谈。

old: What's with the houseplant over there?
new: 那边的室内植物怎么了？

old: Please tell me about the signal again.
new: 请再告诉我关于信号的事。

old: Please tell me about the signal again.
new: 请再告诉我关于信号的事。

old: I convinced Pax Klanq to construct the climber.
new: 我说服了Pax Klanq建造了攀爬者。

old: Pax Klanq has agreed to build the climber. What now?
new: 帕克斯·克兰克同意建造攀爬者。接下来怎么办？

old: Could you tell me again about the Tomb of the Eaters?
new: 你能再告诉我一次关于食者之墓的事情吗？

old: The magnetic field has been disable and the Spindle is free to ascend. What now?
new: 磁力场已经失效，纺锤可以自由上升了。接下来怎么办？

old: Tell me again of the plan to mold a giant creature to ascend the Spindle.
new: 再次告诉我关于塑造一只巨大生物以攀登纺锤的计划。

old: The creature has been made. What now?
new: 生物已经被创造。接下来呢？

old: Tell me again how the giant creature functions.
new: 再告诉我一次那个巨大生物是如何运作的。

old: I am ready to ascend the Spindle, Barathrum.

new: 活着并畅饮吧，最年长的Barathrum。

old: Come closer, nestling. Let me look upon your countenance.
new: 靠近一些，雏儿。让我看看你的面容。
我能为你提供什么，雏儿？

old:
Yes, the question of power is a trickier one. Our standard power sources might suffice, but they would be vulnerable to electromagnetic attacks on the ascent, and we believe it within the competency of the Putus Templar to execute such an attack.
				
				This leaves us two options. Klanq and Q Girl have worked out a design for a neutronic battery, free from vulnerabilities on the EM spectrum. But it requires 3 drams of neutron flux. The alternative is remote power, but to carry us across the Spindle's length the source would have to be extraordinary. I would look to Chavvah, the Tree of Life, for a psychic quickening. Reports tell of the resumption of their roaming across the Moon Stair. Seek the trunk at Eyn Roj to begin your investigation, if that's the path you choose.
new:
是的，关于能源的问题更加复杂。我们的标准能源可能足够，但在上升过程中它们容易受到电磁攻击的影响，而我们相信普图斯圣殿骑士有能力执行这样的攻击。
        这给我们留下了两种选择。Klanq 和 Q 女孩已经设计出一种中子电池，不受电磁频谱的影响。但这需要 3
        盎司的中子流。另一种选择是远程供电，但要支撑我们穿越纺锤的全长，电源必须是非凡的。我会寻找夏娃，生命之树，寻求心灵的激励。据报告，它们已经恢复了在月梯上的漫游。如果你选择这条路径，请前往
        Eyn Roj 寻找树干开始调查。

old: What welcome news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=! Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.
new: 多么令人欢迎的消息，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=! 请收下这作为我的感激之情。

old: O! What is it? I heave... I heave the weight of ass across my crutch, but the bones are pullproof. My bones inosculate to this grotto, or rather- this grotto, this world is what my bones *are*. Can an old bear divest of his spine, leave it to mosses and the sunstrung birds?
new: 哦！这是什么？我费力地……费力地把臀部的重量移到我的胯下，但骨头是拉不断的。我的骨头与这洞穴相连，或者说——这洞穴，这个世界就是我的骨头*本身*。一只老熊能卸下他的脊椎，任其被苔藓和阳光下的鸟儿所覆盖吗？

old: And what is the Spindle, truly?
new: 而真正的纺锤是什么呢？

old: The signal is a beacon of welcoming, and it originates from the top of the Spindle.
new: 信号是一道欢迎的灯塔，它源自纺锤的顶端。

old:
Yes, =name=! Begin the gathering, and the molding will follow. The materials you choose will influence the being we create, but any such being will be suitable for ascent.
				
				This is our last task before we make our historic climb, =name=. Be safe and well in doing it. If you have more questions, return here. Klanq and I will be available.
new:
是的，=name=! 开始收集吧，随后便是塑造。你选择的材料将会影响我们创造的生命体，但任何这样的生命体都适合升华。
        这是我们进行历史性攀登之前的最后一个任务，=name=。执行任务时务必小心。如果你还有更多问题，可以回来这里找我们。Klanq 和我会在这里等你。

old: Little do I remember now, for I was but a cub, a nestling, when my kin and I crossed the Homs Delta into Qud. We were urged on by the flooding of a glacial river that flowed through our hearth-cave. The world was just unthawing then, and I recall the roar of the freezing water as it rushed through the grotto, and the frigid spray on my face as I watched in awe.
new: 如今我已记不清太多，因为那时我还是个幼崽，一个雏儿，当我和我的族人穿过霍姆斯三角洲进入库德时。我们被一条流经我们洞穴的冰川河的洪水驱赶着。当时世界刚刚解冻，我还记得那冰冷的河水奔腾穿过岩洞的轰鸣声，以及当我满怀敬畏地注视时，冰冷的水花溅在我的脸上。

old: Is that you, nestling =name=? Are you returned from gate and Tomb? Come closer, I say.
new: 那是你吗，幼雏 =name=? 你是从大门和墓地回来了吗？过来点，我说。

old: You look... refreshed. Thank you, =name=. Take this polygel we recently recovered from the Palladium Reef.
new: 你看起来……精神焕发。谢谢你，=name=! 拿上这瓶我们最近从钯礁回收的多聚胶。

old:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

				Unusual circumstances have put my study in disarray. Lamentable, this is, but necessary.
new:
{{emote|*Barathrum 暂停.*}}
        不同寻常的情况让我的研究陷入了混乱。这确实令人遗憾，但却是必要的。

old:
The climber design relies on the use of electromagnets to interface with the planet's magnetic field and generate torque. Unfortunately, the Spindle generates its own interfering field, perhaps as a mechanism to prevent unwanted ascension.

				Our aim is to access the Spindle's control unit and disable the field. How we accomplish this, however, is an enigma. From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters.
new:
攀爬者的设计依赖于使用电磁铁与行星磁场交互并产生扭矩。不幸的是，纺锤产生了自身的干扰场，可能作为一种防止不希望的上升的机制。
        我们的目标是进入纺锤的控制单元并关闭力场。然而，如何实现这一点仍是个谜。从数码档案中零散的信息片段中，埃RESH基伽尔拼凑出了一幅神秘但具有指导意义的织锦。她了解到，可以从一个名为光明谢奥的地方关闭力场，该地位于薄界，只能通过食者之墓内的雷谢夫之墓进入。

old: That's my dear friend, Euclid. It's a prattleplant. It stores every phrase it hears in its neuroot network, and it mimics speech by flicking its leaves against one another. What comes out is gibberish as often as not, but even so, it's agreeable company for my nights spent tinkering. It is old, perhaps older than I am, and it hasn't yet run out of things to say.
new: 那是我亲爱的朋友，欧几里得。它是一棵喋喋不休的植物。它会在神经根网络中存储它听到的每一句话，并通过摇动叶子来模仿说话。出来的声音往往都是胡言乱语，但即便如此，它仍然是我在夜晚摆弄机械时愉快的伴侣。它很老了，也许比我还要老，但它还没有说完所有的话。

old: The creature is born, and you are bonded? What work! You are a sterling shaper of world, =name=, and I've nothing left to give you but my praise.
new: 这生物诞生了，而你与它结缘？真是了不起！你是世界塑造的佼佼者，=name=，除了赞美之外我已无物可赠。

old: Are you sure, Meyvn =name=? Our fates are not reversible past the next event horizon.
new: 你确定吗，=name=? 我们的命运在下一个事件视界之后就无法逆转了。

old:
I intend to ascend the Spindle and answer the call, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

				My protege &mQ Girl&y has designed a climber for the ascent. We intended to construct it piecewise at the enclave and the site itself, but the engineering feat exceeds even our capacity. With time, I am confident we could accomplish it, but the Putus Templar rob us of our patience. We need to act now, and so as loath as I am to admit it, we need Pax Klanq.
new:
我打算登上纺锤，响应召唤，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。
        我的门徒 &mQ Girl&y
        设计了一种攀登装置用于攀爬。我们原计划在避难所和现场分段建造，但这项工程超出了我们的能力范围。随着时间的推移，我相信我们能够完成，但普图斯圣殿骑士夺走了我们的耐心。我们需要立即行动，因此尽管我不情愿承认，但我们需要帕克斯·克兰克。

old: What is it? Where does the signal come from, and what does it say?
new: 这是什么？信号来自哪里，又说了些什么？

old:
I do. Your service to the guild has been laudable, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. You braved the vaporous depths of Bethesda Susa and decoded the signal, you secured the Spindlegrounds and handled the self-appointed Earl, and perhaps most materially, you defended our enclave from the Putus Templar.

				Since you returned from Bethesda, you've no doubt wondered at the signal's contents. Verily, I hid them to shield you from the weight of the truth. Only Otho, Q Girl, and I bear that burden, but circumstances have changed. The river of Time powers the gear train of our schemes and devices, and it rushes forth. From here, I must share the burden. You must know.
new:
我确实如此。你对公会的服务令人称道，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。你勇敢地深入了Bethesda
        Susa的雾气深处并解码了信号，你确保了Spindlegrounds的安全并处理了自封的伯爵，也许最重要的是，你保卫了我们的驻地免受Putus Templar的侵袭。
        自从你从贝塞斯达归来后，你无疑对信号的内容感到困惑。确实，我隐藏了它们，以免真相的重负压垮你。只有奥托、Q少女和我承担着这份重担，但情况已经改变。时间之河驱动着我们计划和装置的齿轮，它正急速向前。从现在起，我必须分担这份重担。你必须知道。
