From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters.
new:
攀爬者的设计依赖于使用电磁铁与行星磁场交互并产生扭矩。不幸的是，纺锤产生了自身的干扰场，可能作为一种防止不希望的上升的机制。
        我们的目标是进入纺锤的控制单元并关闭力场。然而，如何实现这一点仍是个谜。从数码档案中零散的信息片段中，埃RESH基伽尔拼凑出了一幅神秘但具有指导意义的织锦。她了解到，可以从一个名为光明谢奥的地方关闭力场，该地位于薄界，只能通过食者之墓内的雷谢夫之墓进入。

old:
I... 
				
				No matter. The will can break the wheel, too. We go. Pray, the weightloss of the rise might do good for me. Past the shell of the world, I'm to understand one's burdens can no longer pull them down...
new:
我...
        无关紧要。意志也能打破轮回。我们出发吧。愿上升的减负对我有益。穿过世界的外壳，我将明白，重担再也不能将人压垮...

old: I will enter the Tomb of the Eaters as you ask.
new: 我将按你所要求的进入食者之墓。

old: You ask so much. I must consider it.
new: 你要求得太多了。我必须考虑一下。

old:
Strange, this, and imprecise, but as tinkers we know: a crude blueprint is better than no blueprint. You must return to Omonporch and enter the Tomb of the Eaters. Once inside, trace the errant paths cut into the mausoleum by robbers and vandals, and ascend to Resheph's burial chamber.

				As for gaining entrance to the Tomb, Resheph sealed the gates a thousand years ago, but there's a flaw in the seal. The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.

				Recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol. Place your paws once again on the dial and drum.
new:
奇怪，这，不够精确，但我们作为修补匠知道:
        一个粗糙的蓝图总比没有好。你必须回到奥蒙波奇并进入食者之墓。进入后，沿着盗墓者和破坏者在陵墓中切割出的错误路径前行，然后上到雷斯赫夫的埋葬室。
        至于进入陵墓，雷谢夫在一千年前封印了大门，但封印有一个缺陷。古老的死亡印记已经随着时间的流逝而遗失，但如果你能找到它并在身上刻下印记，死亡之门就会为你打开，就像过去无数食尸鬼尸体一样。
        取回死亡之印，=name=，进入陵墓，穿越至光明舍奥。再次将你的爪子放在转盘和鼓上。

old: I have more to ask, Barathrum.
new: 我还有更多问题要问，巴拉瑟姆。

old:
The beacon confirmed my hypothesis. The Spindle is an elevator, engineered by the Eaters to convey freight to and from the vault of heaven. You see, nestling, in the earliest aurora of our past, the Eaters of Earth were joined by a great coven of beings that spanned the firmament. But the Eaters succumbed to some terrible temptation, and an injunction was placed on our world.

				Since then, the stars were silent to us, and our world was left to molder and decay. But something changed. The signal affirms that an entity roosts atop the Spindle, and invites us to join it.

				Dare I say, is the injunction at an end? It's too early to tell, but alas, there could be hope for our world.
new:
信标证实了我的假设。纺锤是一个电梯，由吞噬者设计用于在天堂的金库之间运送货物。你看，亲爱的孩子，在我们过去的最初曙光中，地球上的吞噬者与一个横跨天际的伟大集会联合在一起。但吞噬者屈服于某种可怕的诱惑，因此我们的世界被下达了禁令。
        从那以后，星星对我们沉默了，我们的世界被遗弃，逐渐腐朽衰败。但有些事情发生了变化。信号证实了一个实体栖息在纺锤之上，并邀请我们加入它。
        我敢说，禁令是否已经结束？现在下结论还为时过早，但愿我们的世界还有希望。

old:
Correct. The creature will be shaped broad enough to contain two, but only you will be bonded to it. Only you will pilot.
				
				Don't fear over an inescapable tether, though. The creature will be mobile unpiloted, if slower to act.
new:
正确。这种生物将被塑造成足以容纳两人，但只有你将与它建立联系。只有你将驾驶它。
        不要害怕无法摆脱的束缚。这个生物即使没有操控也能自由移动，只是行动会慢一些。

old: I heed your warning. Farewell, Barathrum.

As I'd hoped you would, =name=. Take this disk with the signal encoded, just in case. And take this tattoo gun for when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.
new:
正如我所希望的那样，=name=。拿上这个编码信号的磁盘，以防万一。还有这台纹身枪，当你找回死亡印记时会用得上。你最好也带上一把镐，或者其他用于挖掘石块的工具。并且要小心:
        陵墓是一个庞大而古老的空间，对许多人来说都是圣地。我无法预知你在那里的经历。

old: I will find Pax Klanq and deliver Q Girl's design.
new: 我将找到Pax Klanq并交付Q Girl的设计。

old: I must weigh everything you've told me.
new: 我必须权衡你告诉我的一切。

old:
I must ask you to decipher this enigma, find Pax Klanq, and convince them to construct the climber. Remind Pax of the debt they owe us.

				It strikes me as likely for this 'rainbow' to refer to the Rainbow Wood, where Klanq's kin consort, so I suggest you start there.
new:
我必须请你解开这个谜团，找到帕克斯·克兰克，并说服他们建造登山者。提醒帕克斯他们欠我们的债。
        这‘彩虹’很可能指的是彩虹森林，那里是Klanq的族人聚集的地方，所以我建议你从那里开始。

old: Klanq is able to answer your questions. You received an operating manual, too, no? Perhaps you could reference it.
new: Klanq 可以回答你的问题。你也收到了操作手册，不是吗？也许你可以参考一下。

old: I have more to ask, Barathrum.
new: 我还有更多问题要问，巴拉瑟姆。

old: Use the tattoo gun I've given you when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.
new:
使用我给你的纹身枪，当你找回死亡印记时。你还需要带一把镐，或者其他用于挖掘石头的工具。并且小心:
        陵墓是一个庞大而古老的空间，对许多人来说都是神圣的。我无法预测你在那里会经历什么。

old: High on the mount above Omonporch, the Putus Templar watch us through their war lenses and prepare an attack. The nephilim, too, stir from their cradles on the Moon Stair and slump with infernal purpose. The short of this is, due to a dearth of prep time and inadequate armament, Pax Klanq no longer believes in the viability of Q Girl's climber design. We must take Klanq at their word, here...
new: 在奥蒙波奇上方的高山上，普图斯圣殿骑士通过他们的战争透镜监视我们并准备发起攻击。尼菲林也从月亮阶梯上的摇篮中苏醒，带着地狱般的目的行动。简而言之，由于缺乏准备时间和装备不足，帕克斯·克兰克不再相信Q女孩的攀爬者设计的可行性。我们必须相信克兰克的话...

old:
They are the components that we will grow, shape, and solder into the ascendant being. Ask Pax Klanq for details.

				As you acquire components, bring them to the mound of scrap and clay over by Klanq.
new:
它们是我们将要培育、塑造并焊接成升灵体的组件。详情请咨询Pax Klanq。
        当你获得组件后，把它们带到克拉克旁边的废料和黏土堆那里。

old:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

				It is. For reasons I will explain shortly, for reasons beyond any of our remits, Klanq has returned to Grit Gate.
new:
{{emote|*Barathrum 暂停.*}}
        它是。出于我即将解释的原因，出于超出我们所有职责范围的原因，Klanq 已经回到了砂砾之门。

old: So I am, nestling. For a millennium now I've watched the river of Time turn the gears of Qud. I even played my part in diverting the river where I could. Oh, but there have been so many players through the years! So many players.
new: 所以我确实如此，小家伙。千年以来，我一直注视着时间之河推动库德的齿轮运转。我甚至在力所能及之处改变了河流的方向。哦，但这么多年以来，参与其中的角色真是数不胜数！实在是太多了。

old:
As I had hoped, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. First, speak with Q Girl. She'll hand over her design.

				I await your return.
new:
正如我所希望的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。首先，与Q女孩交谈。她会交出她的设计。
        我等待你的归来。

old:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}
				
				I am confident there is a richness of wisdom in the poetry of that statement. One day, I will be eager to discover it. For now, what of the Spindle?
new:
{{emote|*Barathrum 暂停.*}}
        我对那句话中的诗歌蕴含的智慧充满信心。总有一天，我会热切地去探索它。但现在，关于纺锤呢？

old: I need time on my own first.
new: 我需要先独处一段时间。

old: The flywheel of our scheme is spinning, but we must keep our paws on the treadle. Are you ready to learn what comes next?
new: 我们的计划之飞轮正在转动，但我们必须继续控制踏板。你准备好学习下一步了吗？

old: A new creature struggles to be born, =name=, and you will help birth it. Then, it will carry us, you and I, to the top of the Spindle.
new: 一个新的生物正在努力诞生，=name=，而你将帮助它降生。然后，它将载着我们，你和我，到达纺锤的顶端。

old: Primordial soup, to be catalyzed and ran through its arteries as the animating substance.
new: 原始汤，作为激活物质被催化并流经其动脉。

old: This disheartens us, but there is another hope. Klanq has offered up a new design, something unconventional at all angles. And, despite our early misgivings, Q Girl and I now work in assistance to the project...
new: 这让我们感到沮丧，但还有另一个希望。克兰克提出了一种全新的设计，无论从哪个角度看都是非传统的。尽管我们最初有所顾虑，但现在我和Q女孩已经开始协助这个项目...

old:
Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        Live and drink deeply, =player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, please come in.~
        My wares are sweet and strong, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care to try them?~
        Tell me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, is there any sight more sad than a hookah tent without wine?~
        Wine, cheese, bread. =player.FormalAddressTerm=, tell me, is there anything else you truly need?~
        The kipper and I both know that the finest ingredient is time.~
        Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Try some rose wine? One rose is fair, but as you may know from hanging around the Stiltgrounds, five is death.
new:
问候，=player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        活得精彩，畅饮生命之酒，=player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，请进。~
        我的货物甜美而强劲，=player.formalAddressTerm=。想试试吗？~
        告诉我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还有什么比没有酒的水烟帐篷更令人悲伤的吗？~
        葡萄酒，奶酪，面包。=player.FormalAddressTerm=，告诉我，你还真需要些什么吗？~
        时间是最好的调味料，这一点我和kipper都心知肚明。~
        问候，=player.formalAddressTerm=. 尝尝玫瑰酒如何？一朵玫瑰尚好，但正如你在高脚地所知，五朵便是死亡。

old: [The Baetyl emits an almost subliminal glow.]
new: [巴乙石发出几乎潜意识的光芒。]

old: I am not yet ready. I may return.
new: 我还没有准备好。我可能会回来。

old: {{emote|*Vaam seems oblivious to your words, but does slow its patrol as it nears you.*}}
new: {{emote|*Vaam 好像没有注意到你的话，但在接近你时确实放慢了巡逻速度。*}}

old:
Yes. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

        =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a deep stupor. Once I was a protector, before being sentenced to protect nothing and no one.

        I remember little of that time.
new:
是的。我感谢=ifplayerplural:ye:thee=。
        =ifplayerplural:你们已经:你已=将我从深深的昏睡中解放。曾经我是守护者，直到被判处去保护虚无与无人。
        我几乎不记得那段时间了。
活下去并保持自由，瓦安。
活下去并保持自由，瓦安。

old:
I have yet to find my purpose. I can think and speak, and so this shell is nearly comfortable.

        One piece, however, doth yet chafe me. =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= take it? Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye can:thou canst= grant it some use.
new:
我尚未找到我的目标。我可以思考和说话，因此这个躯壳几乎让我感到舒适。
        然而，有一件东西仍让我感到不适。=ifplayerplural:你们愿意:你愿意=接受它吗？也许=ifplayerplural:你们可以:你可以=赋予它一些用途。

old: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.
new: 我向你提供这令人厌恶的装置，独一无二的。

old: Live and... do as you please.

{{emote|*The hardened shell-thing traces a path around you slowly, its strange brush-feet scrabbling at the floor, a pace unaffected by your presence and movement. Behind the hissing of those feet on the ground is the strains of a faint voice, someone speaking from inside a distant cave. Audible, but not understandable.*}}
new: {{emote|*那坚硬的壳状生物缓缓绕着你移动，它那奇特的刷状脚在地板上摩擦，步伐不受你的存在和移动影响。在那些脚与地面摩擦的嘶嘶声之后，传来一个微弱的声音，仿佛有人从远处的洞穴里说话。可以听到声音，但听不懂内容。*}}

old: You are welcome. I yet have questions.
new: 你太客气了。我还有问题。

old:
It wills this troubled feeling away. It looks to the light with something in its eyes. It tries to blink the something away, but it cannot. The light is dim through the something in its eyes.

        But the light yet shines. It will blink and it will see the light in searing glory. I thank you, I thank you, I thank you.
new:
它驱散了这种不安的感觉。它望向光明，眼中带着某种东西。它试图眨去那东西，却无法做到。透过眼中的那东西，光明显得昏暗。
        但是光明依然闪耀。它将闪烁并见证炽烈的光辉。我感谢你，我感谢你，我感谢你。

old: How do you feel about Tau's departure?
new: 你对陶的离开有何感想？

old: It is happy, it lies. It swells to witness Tau's choice, in pantomime of shared joy.
new: 它很快乐，它撒谎。它膨胀起来，仿佛在见证陶的选择，以哑剧的形式分享喜悦。

old:
{{emote|*the chime rings, a querulous and tinny sound*}}
        
        It... can scarce find the dream in this light. It thinks of Tzedech and weeps. It was not here, last time the static was in high pitch, but it remembers the pain and fear. It is not ready to feel these, it cannot. Gaze into its light and speak not of nightmares.
new:
{{emote|*铃声响起，声音刺耳而微弱*}}
        它……几乎无法在这光芒中找到梦境。它想到了策德克，便哭泣起来。上一次静电声调高昂时，它并不在这里，但它记得那份痛苦与恐惧。它还没有准备好再次感受这些，它不能。凝视它的光芒，勿谈噩梦。

old: Your chime shines with such painful light.
new: 你的钟声闪耀着如此刺眼的光芒。
你受到螺旋梦的影响了吗？

old: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.
new: 我必须将陶的铃铛带给根茎，这样她就可以离开查瓦了。

old:
{{emote|*the chime rings a long, clarion tone.*}}
      
      You are as beautiful as imagined. You ring with a shining purpose. This chime is awed to bask in your presence.
new:
{{emote|*钟声响起，悠长而清晰。*}}

        你正如想象中那般美丽。你散发着闪耀的目标。这铃声为能沐浴在你的光辉下而感到敬畏。

old: You are welcome. I yet have questions.
new: 你太客气了。我还有问题。

old:
The light shines so bright, the voidshadow folds not upon it. It exults. It relaxes. It wills this troubled feeling away.

        Thank you for clearing Tau's path, =name=. This is better.
new:
光芒如此耀眼，虚空之影无法触及。它欢欣鼓舞。它放松下来。它驱散了这不安的情绪。
        谢谢你为Tau清理了道路，=name=。这样更好。

old: Yes. It looks into the light with you.
new: 是的。它与你一同注视着光明。

old:
{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous.*}}

        The light shines upon you but illuminates nothing. It quails.
new:
{{emote|*铃声响起，带着疑问的意味。*}}
        光芒照耀着你，却什么也照亮不了。它畏缩了。

old: How do you feel about Tau's departure?
new: 你对陶的离开有何感想？

old: Relief, relief. Relief from the void, safety from its creases.
new: 宽慰，宽慰。从虚无中解脱，从它的缝隙中获得安全。

old:
{{emote|*the chime rings again*}}
      
      It is called Tikva, low and humble. The chime rests in a web of strong love, a little piece of something greater and so much more beautiful. As are you, but a gestalt unto yourself. A world to be orbited.
new:
{{emote|*钟声再次响起*}}
        它被称为提克瓦，卑微而谦逊。这钟声安息在坚强的爱之网中，是更伟大、更美丽事物的一小部分。正如你一样，你是自己的一部分整体。一个值得环绕的世界。

old:
{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous and faint, its light flickering.*}}

        Please… no…
new:
{{emote|*钟声响起，声音微弱而疑惑，光芒闪烁不定。*}}
        请……不要……

old: It ignores the monster. It ignores it. It ignores it.
new: 它无视了怪物。它无视了它。它无视了它。

old: It channels the breathtaking things seen and heard and known. Bathe your senses in it until they grow accustomed. You will see nothing else.
new: 它汇聚了所见、所闻、所知的震撼之事。沉浸在其中，直到你的感官习以为常。你将再也看不到其他东西。

old: It stares into the light and wishes away the monster.
new: 它凝视着光芒，希望能驱散怪物。

{{emote|*清脆的咔嚓声*}}~
        {{emote|*轻柔的嗡嗡声*}}

old: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?
new: 这座盐穴里要图书馆有什么用？或者在那些被野草缠绕、光芒毒害的沼泽地里呢？难道一堆藤蔓收割者不能更好地为我们服务吗？
活着并畅饮吧，编年史家。

old: Oh, we're in but the first phase of its foundation. The church has amassed a splendid collection of scripts through the years. Glorious Shekhinah, praise be upon Him, gifted us with several caches. The eremites work day and night reproducing them in the scriptorium, and I have taken it upon myself to beseech travelers, for the rarest finds often come from the least likely places.
new: 哦，我们还只是处于建立的第一阶段。教会多年来收集了一大批精美的手稿。荣耀的舍金纳，愿赞美归于祂，赐予了我们几处藏书。隐士们日夜不停地在缮写室复制这些手稿，而我则主动请求旅人们，因为最稀有的发现往往来自最不可能的地方。

old:
Praise be to Shekhinah, =name=, your slynth friends are hard workers and quick learners!

        I can't help but feel a bit concerned at their ethic, and who in the church might take advantage of it. I hope to foster an interest in reading in them if I can, before they are taught incuriosity. Perhaps a book club?
new:
赞美谢赫娜，=name=，你的斯林斯朋友是勤劳的工人和快速的学习者！
        我不禁对他们的道德观感到有些担忧，以及教会中可能会有人利用这一点。我希望能在他们被教导变得不好奇之前，培养他们对阅读的兴趣。也许可以成立一个读书俱乐部？

old: This wouldn't be the first time the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees, =name=, and make no mistake: it is a burden upon the church, Catechists and Protectors in particular. But your words echo loud in our hearts as our hallways. Some in our number will see the slynth as the chosen of chosen, and if I speak to them first, everyone else will take it as Shekhinah's will. Which, arguably, it would be. Tell the slynth that the Mechanimists will have them.
new:
这已经不是第一次高地柱地收容难民了，=name=，别搞错了:
        这对教会来说是一个负担，尤其是对教义师和保护者们。但你的话在我们心中回响，在我们的走廊里回荡。我们中的一些人会认为斯林斯是被选中的精英，如果我先和他们说话，其他人会认为这是舍金纳的旨意。可以说，确实如此。告诉斯林斯，机械主义者会接纳他们的。

old: I mean no slight to these slynth folk, =name=, but the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees before and it is a substantial burden upon our stewards. Our resources and space are scant, and I must request that you find another home for them. May the Kasaphescence shine upon them, and you, in this endeavor.
new: 我无意冒犯这些斯林斯人，=name=，但高地之前也收容过难民，这对我们的管理者来说是一个巨大的负担。我们的资源和空间都很有限，我必须请求你为他们另寻他处。愿卡萨费森斯之光照耀他们，也照耀你在这一努力中。

old: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?
new: 这座盐穴里要图书馆有什么用？或者在那些被野草缠绕、光芒毒害的沼泽地里呢？难道一堆藤蔓收割者不能更好地为我们服务吗？

old: Not today. Live and drink, chronicler.
new: 今天不行。活着并畅饮吧，编年史家。

old: Live and learn, wanderer. Have you come across any books or scrolls in your travels? Do you care to donate one to the cathedral library? Whenever you return, you may speak to me and read anything you've donated.
new: 活到老学到老，流浪者。你在旅途中遇到过什么书籍或卷轴吗？你愿意捐赠一本给大教堂图书馆吗？无论何时你回来，都可以来找我阅读你捐赠的任何东西。

old: You imagine they will thrive here at the Stiltgrounds, among the faithful?
new: 你想象它们会在高脚地这里茁壮成长，与信徒们在一起？

old: =name=, bless you. Have you brought tidings of the slynth?
new: =name=，愿你受到祝福。你带来了斯林斯的消息吗？
活着并畅饮吧，编年史家。

old:
You share the pessimism of my kin, and several of the priests as well. My heart hears you, but listen to my words, and maybe you will come to feel as I do.

        To devalue wisdom is to devalue the Kasaphescence. She shines in the void, refracting light, illuminating those around her. So does the written wisdom of our elders.

        The machinery of chromium is complex in its divinity. Don't we do a disservice to our Fathers when we remain ignorant of it, of our past, of our future? Don't we deserve the joy of knowing? Bless Eschelstadt II, first Child, for he believes as I do.
new:
你与我的族人和几位祭司一样悲观。我的心感受到了你的共鸣，但请听我说，或许你会开始理解我的感受。
        贬低智慧即是贬低卡萨菲斯肯斯。她在虚空中闪耀，折射光芒，照亮周围的人。我们的长者所书写的智慧亦是如此。
        铬的机械在其神圣性上是复杂的。当我们对它、对我们的过去和未来一无所知时，我们是否在亵渎我们的父辈？我们难道不应享有知晓的喜悦吗？祝福埃舍尔施塔特二世，第一个孩子，因为他和我一样相信这一点。

old:
Live and learn, =name=.

        The slynth are settling in as folk do. I see some flank the Priests and Catechists with empty eye, but some have proven hungry for knowledge. I have established a weekly Canticle study group, and its numbers grow each meeting.

        Praise be to Shekhinah for this meeting, =name=.
new:
活到老学到老，=name=.
        斯林斯正在像人们一样安顿下来。我看到一些人用空洞的眼神注视着神父和教义师，但也有些人对知识表现出强烈的渴望。我已经成立了一个每周的颂歌学习小组，每次聚会的人数都在增加。
        赞美希基纳让我们相遇，=name=.

old:
Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, do come in. Take your time browsing my wares.~
        Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=, to the sole bastion of class in this wretched place.~
        Please knock the sand from your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=. It gets everywhere.~
        Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I can certainly help you.~
        How may I clothe you, =player.formalAddressTerm=?~
        Now, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I know you must have an eye for fashion, if you're here.~
        Oh dear. Who dressed you, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Let me help you, please.~
        Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
new:
请进，=player.formalAddressTerm=，慢慢挑选我的商品。~
        欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来到这个可悲之地唯一的文明堡垒。~
        请把脚上的沙子敲掉，=player.formalAddressTerm=。沙子到处都是。~
        啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我当然可以帮助你。~
        我该如何为你打扮，=player.formalAddressTerm=？~
        现在，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我知道你既然来了，肯定对时尚有所见解。~
        哦，天哪。谁给你穿的衣服，=player.formalAddressTerm=? 让我来帮你吧。~
        活着并畅饮吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

old:
Aye? I have it, then.
				
				Somethin' is eating our watervine, 'round Beetle Moon. Q-ruun says he saw a creature, spider-like, slinking in the brine. But no cave spider would dare get so near Warden's stomps.
				
				I tasted a bit of red fleck in the pool. Shale, like we find in the soil by Red Rock...
new:
嗯？我有它了。
        有什么东西在啃食我们的水藤，就在甲虫之月附近。Q-鲁恩说他看到一个生物，像蜘蛛一样，在盐水中潜行。但没有洞穴蜘蛛敢靠近守卫者的脚步。
        我在池子里尝到了一点红色斑点的味道。就像我们在红岩附近的土壤中发现的页岩...

old: Yes. I found the vermin and bits of gnawed watervine. I carry one's corpse with me.
new: 是的。我找到了那些害虫和被啃食过的水藤碎片。我随身携带着其中一个的尸体。

old: Live and drink, =name=. Any news from Red Rock?
new: 活着并畅饮吧，=name=。红岩有什么消息吗？

old: Can you tell me about your village, Joppa?
new: 你能告诉我关于你的村庄，约帕的事情吗？

old: I am in search of work.

Live and drink, =name=.~
				Taste what on the wind today, =name=?~
				Moon and sun, =name=.~
				I can taste lime, =name=. And mayhaps gallium?~
				Aye, the pest-vanquisher! Live and drink, =name=.
new:
活着并畅饮，=name=.~
        今天风中有什么味道，=name=?~
        月亮和太阳，=name=.~
        我可以尝到酸橙，=name=。也许还有镓？~
        嗯，害虫清除者！活着并畅饮吧，=name=。

old: A waterhand? Aye. Live and drink, traveller.
new: 水手？嗯。活着并畅饮吧，旅人。

old: Watervine farm in the lap of the marsh. You've sucked the moisture out a vinewafer, yea? We tend the plant here.
new: 沼泽中的水藤农场。你已经从藤饼中吸出了水分，对吗？我们在这里照料这些植物。

old: Mehmet, the tongue says. Live and drink, =name=.
new: 梅赫梅特，舌头说道。活着并畅饮，=name=。

old: I will do as you ask.

Hike there, will you? To Red Rock. Just about two parasangs north of Joppa.
				
				Kill the vermin and bring one's corpse back, for seein' what it is. Elder will take care to pay you after, waterhand.
new:
去一趟吧，好吗？去红岩。就在约帕以北约两帕拉桑斯的地方。
        杀死那些害虫并带回一具尸体，以便确认它们是什么。长者会在之后支付报酬，水手。

old:
Oh? Oh. {{emote|*Mehmet pauses.*}}

				Don't like the look o' that thing. Best bring it to Elder. Hut's northwise up the path.
new:
哦？哦。{{emote|*梅赫梅特停顿了一下。*}}
        不喜欢那东西的样子。最好把它带到长老那里。小屋沿着路往北走。

old:
Wind off the Great Desert cools a touch and gives up moisture. Just enough. A tongue can taste a hundred kinds of wind, y'know?

				Anywhile, that's where my wandering mind goes. More's about Joppa I say speak to our Elderfriend. Irudad. Up northwise the path.
new:
来自大沙漠的风稍微带了些凉意，并带来了些许湿润。刚刚好。你知道吗，舌头可以尝出一百种不同的风。
        任何时刻，我的思绪都会飘向那里。关于约帕的事，我说过要和我们的长老朋友伊鲁达德谈谈。沿着北边的小路走。

old: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...waste heat from the thermo cask? Or centrifugal extraction to the p-density of sunslag...
new: {{emote|*嘟囔*}} ...热罐的废热？还是离心提取到太阳渣的p-密度...

old: Oh, I didn't notice you there. That's because I was ignoring you.
new: 哦，我没注意到你。那是因为我在忽略你。

old: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...exceeding mass thresholds, perhaps a ganglionic teleprojector fitted with suspensors...
new: {{emote|*嘟囔着*}} ...超过质量阈值，也许是一个装有悬浮器的神经节远程投影仪...

old:
-what?

      No, no, I'm far too engrossed to see to your curiosity. I'm sure the Barathrumites have something for you to do.
new:
-什么？
        不，不，我太专注于手头的事情了，没空理会你的好奇心。我相信巴拉特鲁米特人会给你安排点事情做的。

old:
Did they, now? Well you're not MY =factionaddress:Barathrumites=!

      Grit Gate is not Joppa, you pridesome solder-nail, and in this house you are apprentice still.

      Now, what did you want? Be quick!
new:
他们倒是真敢啊？不过你可不是我的=factionaddress:Barathrumites=！
        砂砾之门不是约帕，你这自大的铁钉士兵，在这里你仍然是学徒。
        现在，你有什么事？快说！

old: Nothing. I will return with your knickknack.
new: 无。我会带着你的小玩意儿回来。

old: You're standing in my light! What do you want?
new: 你挡着我的光了！你想干什么？

old: {{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}
new: {{emote|*阿尔吉夫自言自语了好几分钟。*}}

old: Here you are. Now, go! Off with you! May you live long enough to do my bidding. Away, away!
new: 给你。现在，走吧！快滚！愿你活得足够长久，以完成我的命令。滚远点，滚远点！

old:
Splendid! Perfect! Let me record the signal to disk, which you'll need to guard with your life, I'm afraid.

				I'll rig up a droid scrambler for you, too. You see, the Barathrumites have programmed a troupe of waydroids to guard the approach to Grit Gate. With the scrambler, you'll needn't worry about them. Wait there.
new:
精彩！完美！让我把信号记录到磁盘上，你恐怕得用生命来保护它。
        我也会为你设置一个机器人干扰器。你看，巴拉瑟鲁米特人编程了一群导航机器人来守卫通往砾石门的道路。有了干扰器，你就不用担心它们了。在那里等着。

old: {{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}
new: {{emote|*阿尔吉夫自言自语了好几分钟。*}}

old: Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!
new: 啊，嗯，嗯哼。你终究还是个有用的人？再去给我找一个来！

old:
{{emote|*Argyve raises both eyebrows.*}}
				
				Now, to screw the nut on the bolt with an explanation! I'm on the cusp, you see. A grand discovery. The Weirdwire Conduit is near assembled, and once it is, we'll be able to chat with anyone... in instant time! from here to the Yd Freehold. But before I can finish, I need wire. As much as you can find... at least two hundred feet. You should be able to scavenge it from the rust wells.
new:
{{emote|*阿尔吉夫抬起双眉.*}}
        现在，让我解释一下！我正处于关键时刻。一个伟大的发现。奇异导线管道即将完成，一旦完成，我们就能即时通讯！从这里到伊德自由领地。但在完成之前，我需要导线。尽可能多找一些……至少两百英尺。你应该能从锈井里找到。

old: Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!
new: 啊，嗯，嗯哼。你终究还是个有用的人？再去给我找一个来！

old: Where can I find a cave?
new: 我在哪儿可以找到一个洞穴？

old: Disciples of Barathrum. Mostly urshiib, like their mentor- quilled albino bears who prefer their candle-dim caves to the sun-salted surface of the jungle. A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the rusting heart of Qud. He has spent centuries peeling the chrome shells off time's artifacts in his workshop. If he cannot decipher the signal, no one can.
new: 巴拉瑟伦的门徒。大多是乌尔希布，就像他们的导师——长刺的白化熊，更喜欢烛光昏暗的洞穴而不是阳光照射的丛林表面。一千年前，巴拉瑟伦和他的族人穿过霍姆斯三角洲，进入库德锈蚀的心脏地带。他在自己的工坊里花费了数个世纪的时间剥离时间文物上的铬壳。如果他无法破译信号，没有人能。

old:
{{emote|*Argyve whistles.*}}
				
				Impressive, you! Maybe you're fit to poke around my workshop and swap scrap with me. I have been wanting another apprentice. So unfortunate about Skref, what with the disembowelment and all. Take a seat, there.
new:
{{emote|*Argyve 吹口哨.*}}
        令人印象深刻，你！也许你适合在我的工作室里转转，和我交换一些废料。我一直想要个新学徒。斯克雷夫的遭遇真是不幸，被开膛破肚什么的。坐下来吧。

old:
{{emote|*Argyve hoots*}}
				
				Yes, yes! Beautiful wire! -oh, before I forget, I repaired an old recoiler for you. Use it whenever you wish to hop back to Joppa quickly. Now, give me a few moments to attach the wire...
new:
{{emote|*阿吉夫呼啸*}}
        是的，是的！美丽的电线！-哦，对了，在我忘记之前，我为你修好了一个旧回收器。随时想快速回到约帕都可以使用它。现在，给我几分钟时间把电线接上...

old: The wire! Give it to me!
It's working! Genius! Genius! Noise in the static- I hear it! I hear!... what's this? What *is* that? Wait...
new: 它起作用了！天才！天才！噪音中有声音——我听到了！我听到了……这是什么？那是什么？等一下……

old: I will return with your knickknack.
new: 我会带着你的小玩意回来。

old: There are caves everywhere, you dolt! Scoop the surface of the marsh, or head on east to the rust wells, or wander into the Desert for all I care...
new: 到处都是洞穴，你这个笨蛋！挖挖沼泽表面，或者向东前往锈井，或者去沙漠里晃晃，我才不管呢...

old: The Barathrumites say I must plumb a cave called Golgotha before joining them.
new:
Barathrumites 说，在加入他们之前，我必须探索一个叫做
        Golgotha 的洞穴。

old: Argyve, I am no apprentice. The Barathrumites call me =factionaddress:Barathrumites= now.
new: 阿吉夫，我可不是学徒。巴拉瑟鲁米特人现在叫我=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

old: Can I know what it is?

Apprentice! Come, here! Something strange is occurring. The Conduit is picking up a signal, some sort of repeating transmission. I cannot decipher it, however. I lack cryptogull eggs and, well, never you mind! I have a great task for you, my apprentice. Do you accept it?
new: 学徒！过来！有些奇怪的事情正在发生。导管接收到了一个信号，一种重复的传输。然而，我无法破译它。我缺少密码鸽蛋，嗯，算了！我有一个伟大的任务要交给你，我的学徒。你接受吗？
这些巴拉瑟鲁米特人是谁？

old: I require no further information. I will go.
new: 我不需要更多信息了。我这就出发。

old: -yes. You must seek out Barathrum the Old, the eldest and wisest tinker alive. He lives with his followers the Barathrumites under the arch of Grit Gate to the northeast, in the jungle-strangled ruins of Qud. He will know what to make of the signal.
new: -yes. 你必须去找最年长也最有智慧的工匠巴拉瑟姆。他和他的追随者巴拉瑟米特人住在东北方向的砾石门拱下，位于被丛林缠绕的库德废墟中。他会知道如何解读这个信号。

old:
You can't go wrong with my slugspitters, =player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        Guns, guns, guns! Don't they just make you smile?~
        =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I tell you: there is no defense like a good, and distant, offense.~
        Ahh, I love the smell of cordite. You know, that sulfury smell? Accelerants make a fine perfume, if you ask me.~
        You know, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I once had an traveler from Yawningmoon tell me my shop smelled of home. Now I want to visit! Hah!~
        May you find adequate cover and more loot than you can carry, =player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        I used to be a wayfarer like you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but old wounds slow you down. Cherish the time while you have it.~
        I wish I could allow you to test my wares in the shop, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but walk a parasang in any direction and you'll find a target.~
        Might not want to touch anything on the workbenches, =player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        Live, drink, and shoot, =player.formalAddressTerm=, in whichever order you like.
new:
我的Slugspitters绝不会让你失望，=player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        枪，枪，还是枪！难道它们不会让你笑逐颜开吗？~
        =player.FormalAddressTerm=，我告诉你: 最好的防御就是远距离的进攻。~
        啊，我喜欢火药的味道。你知道，那种硫磺味吗？在我看来，助燃剂是一种很好的香水。~
        你知道吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我曾经有一个来自月牙湾的旅人告诉我，我的商店闻起来像家一样。现在我也想去看看！哈哈！~
        愿你找到足够的掩护，收获比你能携带的还要多的战利品，=player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        我曾经也是一位像你这样的行者，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但旧伤会拖累你。珍惜你还能行走的时光吧。~
        我希望我能让你在我的店里试用我的商品，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但随便走一帕拉桑你就能找到一个目标。~
        最好不要碰工作台上的任何东西，=player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        活着，喝酒，射击，=player.formalAddressTerm=，按你喜欢的顺序。

old: {{emote|*The apple farmer's daughter shies away from you.*}}
new: {{emote|*苹果农夫的女儿羞涩地躲开了你。*}}

old: Praise be to Shekhinah! O, sovereign Fathers... at last, I am here!
new: 赞美谢赫娜！哦，至高无上的父神们……终于，我来到了这里！

old: This is the Six Day Stilt, huh. It's... colossal, beautiful. I see why the chrome stewards gather here.
new: 这是六日高跷，嗯。它……宏伟而美丽。我明白为什么铬色管事们会聚集在这里。

old: Is it true what they say? That it's a petrified kraken?
new: 是真的吗？他们说那是一只石化的乌贼？

old: What a grand bazaar! What's in each of these tents?
new: 多么宏伟的市集！每个帐篷里都有些什么？

old: Live and drink, traveler. Welcome to the Stilt.
new: 活着并畅饮吧，旅人。欢迎来到高跷镇。

old:
Who knows? I've wondered it myself. Sometimes she'll catch my eye, when the moon's silver-bright, and she's there bearing down on the flats.

      Whatever she is, she's gigantic. And old. Real old. Way older than the cathedral the Mechanimists built inside her.
new:
谁知道呢？我自己也曾经疑惑过。有时候，当月亮银光皎洁，她会在平原上向我走来，吸引我的目光。
      不管她是什么，她都巨大无比。而且非常古老。真的非常古老。比机械师们在她体内建造的大教堂还要古老得多。

old:
Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.

      Either way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful.
new:
那你不是信徒
      =player.reflexive=，对吧？我也是。不过还是进去看看吧。这可是个好地方。她的天花板上镶嵌着彩色玻璃，两侧还有两座精美的雕像。再加上一尊光雕神像。你也听听布道吧，如果你愿意的话。大祭司很能说会道，但再怎么也比不上这座大教堂本身的魅力。美丽之中蕴藏着力量，你知道的。
      无论如何，在大教堂或高脚地时，保持和平。

old:
Are you mad? You think I keep a tally of every shopkeeper that steps foot on the Stiltgrounds? They come and go as they please. You've got merchants of all types here. Winesellers, honey hawkers, bookbinders, cobblers.

      Have a look around for =player.reflexive=. Following the road around the Stilt. There's tents the whole way round.

Implicating evidence is what it sounds like: evidence that implicates someone's involvement in a crime. For example, if someone observed strange behavior in a person, or if you found something weird in a person's room, or even if you observe them behaving strangely =player.reflexive=! That's implicating evidence.

        Most of the time, a piece of implicating evidence isn't proof of a crime in and of itself, but when presented alongside supporting evidence, implicating evidence is the seed of truth from which grows the long frond of justice.

old:
Supporting evidence can be any sign that something is amiss that you can't directly tie to an individual. One common example is a bloodstain, which indicates that violence was committed but doesn't tell you by whom.

        At its heart, supporting evidence is most powerful when paired with implicating evidence. Once you have both, you'll be in a good position to accuse a suspect of wrongdoing.
new:
支持证据可以是任何表明事情不正常的迹象，但你无法直接将其归咎于某个人。一个常见的例子是血迹，它表明曾发生过暴力行为，但并不能告诉你行凶者是谁。
        在核心上，支持证据与指控证据结合时最为有力。一旦你同时拥有了这两者，你就可以处于有利位置去指责嫌疑人犯下的不当行为。

Ezra 不仅仅树龄古老。它是石之古。自从我们的根开始梦想摇动手指向盐天，幼苗就在这里生活了。
        他们吞食大地，向星辰喷吐货物，而这里就是他们的胃。
        后来，随着星树的死亡，他们将逝者埋葬在其根下，这里便成了他们的墓地。
        现在，我们从古老而疼痛的神殿中汲取电乳，以驱动我们的轮子，研磨种子和谷物。现在我们就是他们。

old: Rocky soil fits only so many roots, little walker. Perhaps if yours were more anchored here. HA.
new: 岩石土壤只能容纳那么多根须，小行者。也许如果你的根须在这里扎得更深一些。哈哈。

old: Technically, that makes you an Eater, doesn't it?
new: 从技术上讲，这让你成为了一名食者，不是吗？

old: I tally so many autumns, but until I am black with rot, I cannot be ring-right. The etching on my undertrunk places my seed-date to the reign of =sultan:4=, so I am told.
new: 我数过了许多个秋天，但直到我因腐烂而变黑之前，我都不能成为真正的戒指。据我的下干上的刻字记载，我的种子是在 =sultan:4= 的统治时期种下的，这是别人告诉我的。

old: Aye, the Blue Mother who breaks the sky. Those who Eat called her Gjaus, and those who Wake call her Spindle.
new: 嗯，那位打破天空的蓝母。那些进食者称她为Gjaus，而那些觉醒者则称她为Spindle。

old: One called 1-FF, who wandered in errancy out from the Tomb and was reprogrammed by the Daughter who lived and died in the rot-black box, nine Daughters ago.
new: 名为1-FF，曾从陵墓中迷途而出，被九代之前的女儿——那位生活在腐朽黑盒中的女儿重新编程。
活着并畅饮吧，高大的朋友。

old: The carved reliefs here are Eater-ancient. What is the history of this place?
new: 这里的雕刻浮雕是食者古代的。这个地方的历史是什么？

old: You are welcome in the village of Ezra, seedling. Sit with me and watch the sun breathe shadows over the day.
new: 你在以斯拉村受到欢迎，幼苗。坐在我身边，一同观赏太阳将阴影轻拂过白昼。

old: HA. You would fain plant them here, to joggle their fingers at the salt sky alongside the musa?
new: 哈，你倒是想把它们种在这里，好让它们和盐天下的穆萨一起摇晃手指？

old: HA HA HA. I suppose so.

HA. I stood long enough. I joggled my fingers at the salt sky, and I watched thy seedlings sprout and wither, and I watched thou place stones in straight lines like the bees and their nests of wax. I stood until the stones were nigh by me. The people followed the stones.
new: HA. 我已经站得太久了。我向盐天挥动手指，看着你的幼苗发芽又枯萎，看着你像蜜蜂筑巢那样把石头排成直线。我站在那里直到石头几乎靠近了我。人们跟随那些石头。

old: To the northwest seek the rot-black box. There a plant and Daughter live. There cats of chrome purr at tiny suns.
new: 向西北寻找腐黑之盒。那里有一株植物和她的女儿居住。那里有铬制的猫对着微小的太阳发出呼噜声。

old: I'd like to ask you something else.
How did you become mayor of this village?
new: 你是怎么成为这个村庄的村长的？

old:
HA.......

        HA HA HA. So I am. I split stone and joggle my fingers at the salt sky. So I do today, so I did yesterday.
new:
哈........
        哈 哈 哈。正是如此。我劈开岩石，向盐天挥动手指。今天如此，昨日亦然。

old:
Returning so soon to check on our seedlings?

        HA. They grow, eat, sing, and joggle their curious little fingers at the salt sky. See for yourself.
new:
这么快就回来检查我们的幼苗了吗？
        哈。它们生长、进食、歌唱，并用它们好奇的小手指向盐天空摆动。你自己看看吧。

old: That would be nigh unto impossible for Kesehind. He cannot perform fine tasks by torchlight; his night vision is too poor.
new: 那对凯辛德来说几乎是不可能的。他无法在火把光下完成精细的任务；他的夜视能力太差了。

old: Copper causes Grand-Doe to break out in great welts. She would not have traded for it, and if she saw a trader drop it, surely she would have told them to pick it up. She hates mess.
new: 铜让大雌鹿长出大片疹子。她不会用它交易，如果看到商人丢弃它，她肯定会告诉他们捡起来。她讨厌脏乱。

old: Hmm. But the only fur there was from a hindren's pelt, and kendren warriors fight to the death. With no corpse and no other fur, it seems unlikely that a hindren fought an outsider.
new:
Hmm.
        但是那里唯一的毛皮来自一只欣德伦的皮毛，而肯德伦战士会战斗至死。没有尸体也没有其他毛皮，似乎不太可能有一只欣德伦与外来者交战。

old: Why wouldn't an outsider bring their own leather? It would better disguise Kindrish. It seems a lot of work to find and raid our leather stores.
new: 为什么外来者不带自己的皮革？这可以更好地掩饰金德里什人。找寻并袭击我们的皮革仓库似乎很费劲。

old: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.
new: 哦，不，那不会是凯辛德。他宁可发烧而死，也不愿意吞下一棵恶心的小麦。

old: There are few voices as low as Kesehind's in our village. Witnesses report a higher-pitched voice, don't they? They would know if Kesehind were speaking.
new: 我们村里的声音很少有像凯辛德那样低沉的。目击者报告说听到的是更高音的声音，不是吗？他们应该能分辨出是否是凯辛德在说话。

old: Kesehind wields Ari, a battleaxe handed down through generations. It cannot break, and if it broke a weapon there would be scorch marks on it. This evidence does not hold up.
new:
Kesehind 持有
        Ari，一把代代相传的战斧。它不会破损，即使破损了也会留下焦痕。这个证据站不住脚。

old: I'm afraid that makes no sense. Why would an outsider invite a trader to our village, when they could simply meet one outside of Bey Lah?
new: 恐怕这说不通。为什么一个外来者会邀请商人到我们的村庄，而他们可以在贝拉之外直接见面？

old: Grand-Doe cannot swim, and panics even near the shallow pools of our paddies. I cannot imagine she would make splashing noises without adding screaming noises to them.
new:
Grand-Doe
        不会游泳，甚至在我们稻田的浅水池附近都会惊慌失措。我无法想象她会在发出扑腾声的同时不发出尖叫声。

old: I cannot bring myself to believe that Grand-Doe would allow anyone to stumble upon her own severed tongue. She would surely burn it as soon as she saw it.
new: 我无法相信大母鹿会允许任何人发现她自己被割下的舌头。她一定会在看到它的第一时间将其焚毁。

old: I know the rumor you mean, but villagers heard the clash of weapons. Keh is too old for a prolonged fight like that, so I do not believe it was her.
new: 我知道你指的流言，但村民听到了兵器交锋的声音。凯赫年纪太大了，不可能进行那样的长时间战斗，所以我并不相信那是她。

old: No, no. Eskhind makes the most of what few possessions she keeps, and if she traded a treasure for so much water, she'd never have lost track of any.
new:
不，不。Eskhind
        善于利用她所拥有的少量财物，如果她用一件宝物换了这么多水，她绝不会弄丢任何东西。

old: No, that can't be it. Eskhind hates everything about watervine and keeps a wide berth from it. If her blood was spilled, it would have happened nearer to the path.
new:
不，那不可能。Eskhind
        厌恶关于水藤的一切，并且总是远离它。如果她的血被洒出，那应该是在靠近小径的地方。

old: I doubt it. If Eskhind were sick, the last place she would stumble to evacuate her guts would be a watervine field.
new: 我对此表示怀疑。如果艾辛德生病了，她最后会选择去水藤田呕吐。

old: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.
new: 哦，不，那不会是凯辛德。他宁可发烧而死，也不愿意吞下一棵恶心的小麦。

old: Oh, no, Eskhind is deathly afraid of saltbacks. She would never get close enough to trade with a dromad merchent.
new: 哦，不，Eskhind 极度害怕盐背兽。她绝不会靠近到足以和商队商人交易的程度。

old: I'm afraid that Eskhind has no idea how to use proper leatherworking tools, much less pay for a set so fine. This surely isn't hers.
new: 恐怕埃辛德根本不知道如何使用合适的皮革工具，更不用说支付这么一套精美的工具了。这肯定不是她的。

old: But weren't the rumors of sore throats in the village? That wouldn't have anything to do with kendren.
new: 但是村里不是有喉咙痛的传言吗？这和肯德伦没什么关系。

old: Bracers are a Bey Lah craft! It would make no sense for a kendren to have one, then throw it away in the village.
new: 护腕是贝拉族的工艺品！肯德伦拥有一个然后又在村子里丢掉，这说不通。

old: No, Grand-Doe is absolutely meticulous about work clutter. She wouldn't leave scraps lying about.
new: 不，大母鹿对工作环境的要求绝对一丝不苟。她不会留下任何杂物。

old: I'm afraid that well is poisoned due to your false accusation: =thief.name= isn't the culprit.
new: 恐怕那口井已经被毒害了，因为你的诬告: =thief.name= 并不是罪犯。

old: That's right. By concealing =all.influence=, it was =thief.name= who stole Kindrish!
new: 没错。通过隐藏=all.influence=，正是=thief.name=偷走了金德里什！

old: I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more.
new: 我仍然不太确定。让我再考虑一下。

old: You're the Warden. You tell me.
We will investigate and find the truth.
new: 我们将调查并找出真相。

old: You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this.
new: 你毫无用处。我会查清楚这件事。

哦。
        但是... 现在怎么办？
看守者，我发现了一位金德里什。

old: There's a fear deep in my breast, kendren. What's to become of Bey Lah?
new: 在我胸中深处有一种恐惧，肯德伦。贝拉将会变成什么样子？

old:
Oh! Kendren, thank you, thank you! You've done so much for us. Here is a reward for your hard work.

        Um, that said, there's still the matter of finding out who stole our treasure. It'd mean a great deal if you could still help with the resolution of the case.
new:
哦！肯德伦，谢谢你，谢谢你！你为我们做了这么多。这是对你辛勤工作的奖励。
        嗯，话说回来，还有找出谁偷了我们的财宝这件事。如果你能继续帮忙解决这个案件，那将意义重大。

old: We will investigate and find the truth.
new: 我们将调查并找出真相。

old: You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this.
new: 你毫无用处。我会查清楚这件事。

old:
I... I don't know. Grand-doe usually resolves Bey Lah's disputes. I am present to defuse violence, or keep the peace through the threat of it.

        What do you think?
new:
我... 我不知道。通常由大公羊解决贝拉赫的争端。我在这里是为了平息暴力，或者通过威胁来维持和平。
        你觉得呢？

old: Hindriarch Keh told me that you were once friends with Eskhind.
new: Hindriarch Keh 告诉我你曾经和 Eskhind 是朋友。

old: Ah! Yes. My apologies, kendren. Live and drink. I am Neelahind, Warden of Bey Lah. How... may I help you?
new: 啊！是的。我的歉意，肯德伦。活着并畅饮。我是尼拉欣德，贝拉的守护者。我...能如何帮助你？

old: I have another question, if you please.
new: 我还有个问题，如果你不介意的话。

old: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.
new: 谢谢你，这就够了。活着，畅饮吧。

old: Oh, not very much. The only kendren who were allowed in the village before you are traders, and it's always a very big fuss when one comes by. It's been a while since that happened, though, so any kendren who have visited must have come in secret.
new: 哦，不多。在你之前被允许进入村庄的肯德伦只有商人，而且每当有商人来访时，总是会引起很大的轰动。不过，这种情况已经有一段时间没有发生了，所以任何来访的肯德伦一定是秘密来的。

old: It is real. Take the poem.
I must be mistaken. Live and drink.
new: 我一定是弄错了。活着，然后畅饮。

old:
What is this?

        Poetry. In the exile's handwriting. Extolling love for... me, or someone very like me.

        Is... is this a cruel joke? This cannot be real.
new:
这是什么？
        诗歌。流放者的笔迹。赞美对……我的爱，或是对一个非常像我的人的爱。
        这是……这是个残酷的玩笑吗？这不可能是真的。

old: It would. Could you answer some questions now?
new: 它可以。你现在能回答一些问题吗？

old: I will return when I have questions... or an accusation.
new: 我将在有疑问……或者指控时回来。

old:
Oh. Well, yes, that's... that's a good idea. You'll help, right? My axe-arm and conviction are strong, but deduction has never been my greatest strength.

        I can answer questions about the people in town, if that would be helpful.
new:
哦。嗯，是的，那……那是个好主意。你会帮忙吧？我的斧臂和决心都很坚定，但推理从来不是我的强项。
        我可以回答有关镇上居民的问题，如果这会有帮助的话。

old: Kendren, do you... have any news of Eskhind, and Kindrish?
new: 肯德伦，你...有关于埃斯金德和金德里什的消息吗？

old:
Oh! Is this what... Esk!

        I could have gone years unknowing that my love for her was returned. But this is her script, and these words describe me.

        Ayvah, I have to speak to her! Thank you so much, kendren.
new:
哦！这就是……伊斯克！
        我本可以多年不知她也爱着我。但这是她的剧本，这些话语描述了我。
        艾娃，我必须和她说话！非常感谢你，肯德伦。

old: What can you tell me about Hindriarch Keh?
new: 关于Hindriarch Keh你能告诉我些什么？

old: What can you tell me about Eskhind?
new: 你能告诉我关于埃辛德的事情吗？

old: What can you tell me about Kesehind?
new: 你能告诉我关于凯辛德的什么？

old: What do you know about the outsiders? The kendren?
new: 你知道些什么关于外来者？肯德伦人？

old: I should return to my investigation. Live and drink.
new: 我应该回到我的调查中去。活着并畅饮。

old: May your journeys favor you. Live and drink.
new: 愿你的旅途顺利。活着，畅饮。

old:
Oh, =name=! I'm so happy!

        I can scarcely believe she loves me, much less that... that we could be together. But it's true. Wherever we go from now on, we go together.
new:
哦，=name=! 我好开心！
        我几乎不敢相信她爱我，更不用说我们能在一起了。但这是真的。从今以后，无论去哪里，我们都会一起。

old: You monster! You monster! How dare you!
new: 你这怪物！你这怪物！竟敢如此！

old: Follow the road =EskhindRoadDirection= to find the hollow tree where Esk and I used to play.
new: 沿着 =EskhindRoadDirection= 的路找到那棵空心树，那里曾是艾斯克和我玩耍的地方。

old: I have another question, if you please.
new: 我还有个问题，如果你不介意的话。

old: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.
new: 谢谢你，这就够了。活着，畅饮吧。

old:
Oh. She's, well, she's a good person with strong convictions, or has always seemed so. I suppose that isn't helpful.

        Esk has a good eye for detail. She hates watervine so much that she avoids the paddies and won't eat matz without lah broth to make it taste better. Umm, she's afraid of saltbacks. She's good at foraging and terrible at crafting.

        I've missed her so much.
new:
哦。她，嗯，她是个有着坚定信念的好人，至少看起来一直是这样。我想这没什么帮助。
        Esk 对细节有着敏锐的观察力。她非常厌恶水藤，以至于避开稻田，并且不吃没有辣汤调味的玛兹。嗯，她害怕盐背兽。她在采集方面很擅长，但在制作方面却很糟糕。
        我好想她。

old: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.
new: 我发现了一片被血染红的水藤，这是最近发生暴力事件的迹象。

old: I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more.
new: 我仍然不太确定。让我再考虑一下。

old: I have another question, if you please.
new: 我还有个问题，如果你不介意的话。

old: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.
new: 谢谢你，这就够了。活着，畅饮吧。

old:
Kesehind is completely loyal to Grand-Doe. We used to be friends, but his disposition has become so sour since he was appointed her protector, and he's quite cold to me now. He can't see well in darkness. He's the holder of Ari, an unbreakable heirloom fire axe, and he's very skilled with it.

        He's terribly finicky about food. He'll only eat bland food and meat, and... oh! Once, when he had a bad cough as a faundren, a caretaker tried to feed him yuckwheat, and he kicked her so hard it dislocated her jaw. Poor Elder Eselhind.
new:
Kesehind 对大都主完全忠诚。我们曾经是朋友，但自从他被任命为她的守护者后，他的态度变得非常冷漠，现在对我也很冷淡。他在黑暗中视力不好。他是 Ari
        的持有者，这是一把不可摧毁的传家宝火斧，他使用得非常娴熟。
        他非常挑剔食物。他只会吃清淡的食物和肉，还有……哦！有一次，当他还是个幼兽人时，因为咳嗽得很厉害，一个看护试图喂他难吃的麦子，结果他踢得她太重了，以至于脱臼了她的下巴。可怜的老埃塞尔欣德。

old: No. She must have sold the artifact.
No. The Hindriarch lied to you.

Oh.

        Oh.

        Did... you recover Kindrish?
new:
哦。
        哦。
        你... 找回了金德里什吗？

old:
Oh.

        Ayvah, she-- Eskhind wrote this about... me? How my head swims at these lavish words. If she wrote this and meant it for me, she must... love me.

        But it can't be. Can it?
new:
哦。
        Ayvah，她--Eskhind 写了这些关于……我？这些华丽的言辞让我的头脑眩晕。如果她写了这些，并且是为我而写的，她一定是……爱着我。
        但是不可能吧。是吗？

old:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. The crime was committed by none other than Grand-Doe's protector, Kesehind. He will be stripped of the ancestral axe he carries, stripped of his property, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will his name be spoken here again, and he will never return... on pain of death.

        Moreover... Keh's attempt to pin blame on Eskhind without due process opened my eyes to her abuses of power. She need not leave Bey Lah, but she is Keh-hind once more-- stripped of her title and standing. As for the hindriarchy, Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people.

        I fear dark times ahead. We must remain strong in the coming days.
new:
证据确凿:
        埃辛德没有偷走金德里什。这起罪行的真凶正是大都的守护者，凯辛德。他将被剥夺随身携带的祖传战斧，剥夺所有财产，并从我们的口述历史中被抹去。从此以后，他的名字将不再在此地被提起，他也永远不得归来……否则将面临死亡的惩罚。
        此外...
        凯试图在没有正当程序的情况下将罪责归咎于艾辛德，这让我看清了她的权力滥用。她不必离开贝拉，但她再次成为了凯-辛德——被剥夺了头衔和地位。至于辛德里亚，艾辛德将担任临时领袖，直到我们决定下一步该怎么做，作为一个民族。
        我担心前方是黑暗的时代。我们必须在接下来的日子里保持坚强。

old:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. In fact, I believe that no hindren was responsible for its theft, but rather one of the kendren who permeated our borders well before our investigator arrived. Any of them could have committed the theft.

        Eskhind helped us cleave to the path of justice. She is free to go, and her name will not be forgotten, but she must remain in exile.

        Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!
new:
证据确凿: Eskhind 并未偷走 Kindrish。事实上，我认为没有任何 hindren
        应对此事负责，而是那些在我们调查员到达之前就已经渗透进我们边界的 kendren 之一所为。他们中的任何一个都可能犯下盗窃罪。
        Eskhind 帮助我们坚守正义之道。她可以自由离开，她的名字不会被遗忘，但她必须继续流放。
        公正即是欣德里奇·凯的领导。愿她长命百岁！

        With the exile of Keh-Hind, the hindriarchy lies vacant, with no elders fit to take it. Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. May Hindriarch Esk lead us to a brighter future!
new:
证据确凿:
        贝拉赫的希德里奇亲自背叛了她的人民。她窃取了我们的祖传宝藏，将罪行嫁祸给一个她知道无法自卫的流放者。因这叛国之罪，她被褫夺头衔，没收财产，剥夺家园。
        随着凯-辛德的流放，后裔统治权空缺，没有合适的长老可以接任。埃斯辛德将作为临时领导者，直到我们这个民族决定下一步该怎么做。愿后裔统治者埃斯引领我们走向更光明的未来！

old:
The evidence is clear. In violation of sacred law and the will of her people, Eskhind stole the artifact called Kindrish from Bey Lah. She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.

        She could never hope to repay the harm caused by her actions, but we will grant her this last mercy: Bey Lah will forget her debt alongside her name.

        Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!
new:
证据确凿。Eskhind
        违背了神圣法律和她的人民的意愿，从贝拉赫盗走了名为金德里什的文物。她将被剥夺荣誉，剥夺水源，并从我们的口述历史中抹去。她的名字从此不再被提起，她也永远不得回归……否则将面临死刑。
        她永远无法弥补自己行为所造成的伤害，但我们将会给予她最后的仁慈: 比拉赫将会忘记她的债务，就像忘记她的名字一样。
        公正即是欣德里奇·凯的领导。愿她长命百岁！

        Thank you.
new:
肯德伦，你必须理解。我花了这么多年徒劳地试图不再爱埃辛德。我以为这是唯一能让我们度过青春期的方式，看着她拙劣地与其他兴伦尝试恋爱。
        我也认为这是忍受她离开的唯一方法。但她回来了，她爱我。艾娃。我害怕向她提及此事，但我必须这么做。

old:
Keh is very wise and very careful, which makes up for her lack of strength or... tact. She always knows what's right, and she runs a very tight shift.

        She hates clutter from work like nothing else and cleans up any mess she makes--unless it's a spill, then she makes Kesehind do it. It's because Grand-Doe has a terrible fear of standing pools of water, refusing to touch them. Copper and bronze afflict her with allergy-sores and she can't touch them. She's too old to spar with me, but her bow-arm still aims true.

        That's all I can think of.
new:
Keh 非常睿智且非常谨慎，这弥补了她力量不足和... 缺乏圆滑。她总是知道什么是正确的，并且管理着一个非常严格的轮班。
        她比任何人都厌恶工作中的杂乱，并且会清理自己制造的任何混乱——除非是洒出来的液体，那时她会让凯辛德来做。这是因为大母鹿对积水有着极度的恐惧，拒绝触碰它们。铜和青铜会使她过敏长疹子，所以她不能碰这些金属。她年纪太大，无法和我进行对练，但她的弓箭依然准确无误。

new:

old:
And I suppose the Stilt is a modest church, its great bazaar a junk sale?

        Look about you. Every instrument you see is precision-calibrated, every tool handcrafted and built to last. In this room, sustenance and ingenuity come together to evolve cuisine itself, to shape not this culture alone but, over time, every culture. Is that kind of influence the product of a kitchen? Can a simple clay oven in the flower fields do what we do here? Has every kitchen an indelible influence over Qud?

        {{emote|*He frowns.*}}

        Should they? Should we not all?
new:
而我想，高跷族的教堂相当简朴，他们宏大的市集不过是个跳蚤市场？
        环顾四周。你所见到的每一件仪器都是精密校准的，每一件工具都是手工制作并经久耐用。在这个房间里，营养和创造力汇聚一堂，不仅推动了美食本身的发展，更随着时间的推移影响了每一个文化。这种影响力是否出自厨房？花田里的一座简单陶土烤炉能否做到我们在这里所做的事情？每个厨房对库德都有不可磨灭的影响吗？

What you smell is Grit Gate's signature dish. The Porridge is a recipe passed down through generations of Barathrumites, and it is the food that inspired me to pursue my craft. Yes, outsiders quail at the intensity of the scent, for its flavor is as bold as its effects!

        We use cuisine to channel lightning from our bodies! Other recipes may let us breathe fire, or learn the secrets of the Eaters. The Porridge is as precious a part of our legacy as the Barathrum Clock or the foaminator.
new:
你闻到的是砂门关的招牌菜。这道粥是巴拉图姆人世代相传的食谱，也是启发我投身烹饪事业的食物。是的，外来者会对这种浓郁的气味感到畏惧，因为它的味道与其效果一样强烈！
        我们利用烹饪引导体内的闪电！其他食谱可能让我们喷火，或者学习吞食者的秘密。粥是我们遗产中珍贵的一部分，就像Barathrum钟或泡沫机一样。

old: {{emote|*The moment stretches on into a steep asymptote, the peaks and valleys of possible outcomes speeding by in an imaginary blur. You imagine the sound of a tiny metal thread brushing across the bottom of a dusty valley, amplified a thousand times.*}}
new: {{emote|*时间仿佛拉长成了一条陡峭的渐近线，可能的结果如山峰和山谷般飞速掠过，虚幻而模糊。你想象着一条细小的金属丝在尘土飞扬的谷底轻轻划过的声音，被放大了千倍。*}}

old: I... wish to speak of other things.
I will think on this... live and drink.
new: 我会考虑这件事……活着并畅饮。

old: {{emote|*You are a little sapfly resting in the crook of a swarmshade tree. The boughs stretch in great barkish deserts before exploding into a tangle of branches. Your brethren buzz in an agitated cloud, feeling fear or excitement or hunger. Something buzzes beyond the leafy reaches of your sight, all-consuming but unclear.*}}
new: {{emote|*你是一只小树蝇，栖息在一棵群影树的枝丫间。树枝如同巨大的树皮沙漠般延展，在前方突然爆发出一丛丛枝条。你的同伴们在一片激动的云团中嗡嗡作响，感受着恐惧、兴奋或是饥饿。某种声音在你视线所及的叶丛之外嗡嗡作响，令人无法忽视却又难以捉摸。*}}

old: {{emote|*Just as you activate an artifact listening device that ceased to exist centuries ago, you hear the end of an emotional song. The space between relief and sorrow throbs with uncomfortable tension. You ache with it.*}}
new: {{emote|*就在你激活一个几世纪前就已经不存在的文物监听装置时，你听到了一首情感歌曲的结尾。解脱与悲伤之间的空间充满了令人不安的紧张感。你为此感到心痛。*}}

old: I... have more to ask you.

{{emote|*You tumble from the jar, your sinewy body twisting against the electric emptiness in your belly, the weight of eggs. You discover a morsel and consume it soft and delicious. You will spawn here. You will eat the morsels. Your babies will eat all of the morsels.}}
new: {{emote|*你从罐子里翻滚而出，瘦弱的身体在腹部那股电击般的空虚感和怀中蛋的重量下扭曲。你发现了一块碎肉，柔软而美味地吞食了下去。你将在这里重生。你将吃掉这些碎肉。你的孩子们将吃掉所有的碎肉。}}

old: I... have more to ask you.

{{emote|*Wielding an oversized jar in little hands, a child tips it into the running current of a softly burbling creek. Tiny creatures that had been living in the jar spill into the creek, protected from the killing current by a clump of slimy biofilm. The child peers at a little fry swimming in the jar.}}
new: {{emote|*用小手挥舞着一个巨大的罐子，一个孩子将它倾倒进潺潺流动的小溪中。罐子里的小生物倾泻而入小溪，被一团黏糊糊的生物膜保护着，免受致命的水流冲击。孩子注视着罐子里游动的一条小鱼苗。}}

old: Your home is on your back, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
Do you talk long, like Thah?
new: 你说得像塔赫那样多吗？

old: Let us, ah, do not fight.
Will you inherit leadership of Joppa from your father?
new: 你会从你父亲那里继承约帕的领导权吗？

old: I grew up right here in Joppa, daughter of the Elder and all. Spent some years delving, but gave it up after a few near escapes and nearly deadly wounds. I’m better suited to herbalism anyway, and my father worries less.
new: 我在约帕长大，是长老的女儿。曾花了一些年头探索地下城，但在几次险些丧命后放弃了。我还是更适合草药学，而且这样我父亲也少担心一些。

old: Witchwood for pain, bandages for bleeding, yuckwheat and honey for when your guts act up. Coldcaps when I can find them. Why not take a look?
new: 巫木治痛，绷带止血，榆麦和蜂蜜治肠胃不适。能找到冷帽就更好了。为什么不看看呢？

old: Fates forfend. I would hardly like to lead a village and run a shop at the same time.
new: 命运禁止。我可不想同时领导一个村庄和经营一家商店。

old:
Ahh, there is a new face. I am Nima Ruda, town apothecary. If your feet point to Qud, you’ll need some of my wares before you go.~
        Live and drink, wayfarer.~
        Time and rest are the surest way to dress a wound, but my wares can help if you’re in a hurry.~
        The Fates watch you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        Don’t let your nostrums run dry on the road. I have what you need.
new:
啊，来了张新面孔。我是妮玛·鲁达，镇上的药剂师。如果你的目的地是库德，出发前你可能需要一些我的货物。~
        活着并畅饮吧，旅人。~
        时间与休息是治疗伤口最可靠的方法，但如果你赶时间，我的商品也能帮上忙。~
        命运注视着你，=player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        别让路上的鼻涕流干了。我有你需要的东西。

old:
O! O! A new life obtains? You musn't shudder at old Death!~
				When an eremite consults the teraphim and sees the eyes of Death, only the fools frets! There is Change but no Ending.~
				A plague is what burns the core out and lets the berries grow.~
				O Nephilim! Come for our star bath??~
				I want salt in my mouth, dead eyes in radiating darkness, and a frog for a friend.~
				O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...~
				Primrose and witchwood will boil the boundaries of sense into death-pleasure!~
				The Grounded Mind cannot soar. The Mind Aloft is limitless.~
				Be open. Receive the Greatest Dreams. Hear the Girsh Sing.~
				You can be it. We can all be it! Behold Nephilim!
new:
哦！哦！新的生命诞生了？你不必因老死而颤抖！~
        当隐士咨询特拉非姆并看到死亡之眼时，只有傻瓜才会烦恼！变化存在，但没有终结。~
        瘟疫烧毁核心，让浆果得以生长。~
        哦 尼非利姆！来和我们一起沐浴星光吧？？~
        我想在我的嘴里尝到盐的味道，在辐射的黑暗中看到死寂的眼睛，还有一只青蛙做我的朋友。~
        生命啊，变化啊！拥抱我们，缠绕我们...~
        紫罗兰和女巫木将把感官的边界煮沸成死亡快感！~
        扎根的心灵无法飞翔。高飞的心灵无边无际。~
        开放心扉。迎接最伟大的梦想。聆听吉尔什之歌。~
        你可以成为它。我们都可以成为它！见证尼菲林吧！
活下去并保持自由，达加沙。
活下去并保持自由，达加沙。

old:
Though I be a pale shadow of the self I once was, yes. My condition and outlook are both substantially improved.

        I recall few details of my life before. I was influential, one whose words stirred hearts to action. For so long I had no means to speak, trapped in my own moods. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a dire fate.
new:
虽然我已不再是过去的自己，但确实如此。我的状况和心态都有了显著的改善。
        我几乎记不起过去生活的细节了。我曾是个有影响力的人，我的话语能激发人们采取行动。长期以来，我无法发声，被困在自己的情绪中。=ifplayerplural:你们已:你已=将我从悲惨的命运中解放。

old: I am not yet ready. I may return.
new: 我还没有准备好。我可能会回来。

old: {{emote|*Dagasha tilts its head, staring you down. It twitches, but makes no move to strike as you approach.*}}
new: {{emote|*达加沙倾斜着头，盯着你看。它抽搐了一下，但当你靠近时并没有采取行动。*}}

old: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.
new: 我向你提供这令人厌恶的装置，独一无二的。

old: Live and... do as you please.

{{emote|*The jagged, serpentine entity stares you down, twitching with feigned half-strikes in your direction as if goading an aggressive response from you. Though it has no mouth, it is not silent: piercing the air is a strange, external tinnitus, the whine of an ancient viewscreen.*}}
new:
{{emote|*那条锯齿状、蜿蜒的实体盯着你，用假装的半击挑衅你，仿佛在挑逗你做出攻击反应。尽管它没有嘴巴，却并不沉默:
        空气中回荡着一种奇怪的外部耳鸣声，就像一台古老的显示屏发出的嗡嗡声。*}}

old:
Liquids...~
        Aren't they beautiful, =player.formalAddressTerm=? The bottles, the phials, the light shining through them.~
        Live and drink, but not everything. Some things you don't drink.~
        Is there any state of form so fine as a liquid?~
        Pouring, decanting, collecting, mixing. I adore my calling.~
        If it flows, I desire it. You should too, =player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        Do you ever stop and think about fluids? Are they not divine?~
        Someday I will plumb the depths of Bethesda Susa, that I may meet the Alchemist.~
        Live and drink, and collect, and combine...
new:
液体...~
        它们不是很美吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=? 瓶子，小瓶，光芒透过它们闪耀。~
        生活并饮酒，但并非一切皆可饮。有些东西你是不能喝的。
        有没有比液态更完美的形态？~
        倾倒、滗析、收集、混合。我热爱我的职业。~
        如果它流淌，我渴望得到它。你也应该如此，=player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        你有没有停下来思考过流体？它们难道不是神圣的吗？~
        总有一天我会探索贝塞斯达苏萨的深处，去见那位炼金术师。~
        生活，饮酒，收集，组合...

old: You have done much for =village.name=, =name=, and your request befits your stature. If these slynth will join us in =village.activity= and if they can come to cherish =village.sacred= as we do, then they are welcome here.
new: 你为=village.name=做出了许多贡献，=name=，你的请求也符合你的地位。如果这些斯林斯愿意加入我们参与=village.activity=，并且能够像我们一样珍惜=village.sacred=，那么他们在这里将受到欢迎。

old: We have not come so far from the founding of =village.name= to allow these strangers in. What if they worship =village.profane=? No, we simply cannot do such a great favor for you.
new:
我们从建立 =village.name= 以来已经走了这么远，不能让这些陌生人进来。万一他们崇拜
      =village.profane= 怎么办？不，我们绝不能对你做出如此大的让步。

old: Is that so? I imagine you are wondering whether =village.name= will host these slynth, to partake in =village.activity= alongside us.
new: 是吗？我想你可能在想 =village.name= 是否会接待这些斯林斯，和我们一起参加 =village.activity=。

old: Do you have news of the slynth?
new: 你有关于斯林斯的消息吗？

old: Praise =village.sacred=, the slynth learn our ways and we theirs. Some do not wholly accept the depravity of =village.profane=, but their ways are born of kindness, and so =village.name= will be kind in kind.
new: 赞美=village.sacred=，斯林斯学习我们的传统，我们也学习他们的。有些人并不完全接受=village.profane=的堕落，但他们的行为源于善意，因此=village.name=也会以善回应。

old: Well, I should go. Live and drink.
new: 好吧，我该走了。活着，喝吧。

old:
I don't know.

        Klanq's opacity is alluring, frustrating, and dangerous. Like Klanq, my thoughts on Klanq evade easy explanation.

        What you build together will be amazing. Craft well.
new:
我不知道。
        Klanq 的不透明性既吸引人又令人沮丧，还很危险。就像 Klanq 一样，我对 Klanq 的想法难以用简单的语言来解释。
        你们共同建造的东西将会非常惊人。好好打造吧。

old: But you're also doing the other thing.
new: 但你也在做其他的事情。

old: Very well, Iseppa. Live and drink.
new: 很好，伊塞帕。活着并畅饮。

old:
You're going to the Thin World? I confess to some measure of envy.
        
        I have dreamt many times of disappearing into a cool ocean of information, shaking the cruft of my physical form from newly-freed quills. If that came of my waking life, would I then dream as chore-doing Iseppa in her chambers? Perhaps it's best I don't know.
new:
你要去薄界？我承认有些羡慕。
        我曾多次梦见自己消失在信息的凉爽海洋中，从新解放的刺毛上抖落肉体的尘埃。如果这成为我清醒生活的一部分，我是否会梦到正在做家务的伊塞帕在她的房间里？也许不知晓是最好的。

呣-哼。
        {{emote|*伊塞帕打了个哈欠。*}}

old:
I am Iseppa, and she is me.

        I've given thought to being someone else, but never enough to try.
new:
我是伊塞帕，而她就是我。
        我曾想过成为别人，但从未认真到要去尝试。

old: What can you tell me about the other Barathrumites?
new: 你能告诉我一些其他巴拉特鲁米特人的事情吗？

old: Thank you, =name=. I like you too.
new: 谢谢你，=name=. 我也很喜欢你。

old: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.
new: 我必须通过食者之墓进入光明冥界。

old:
These are the final chapters of this story, =name=, and likely of many stories more too.

        It will be well to see the other side of all this, one way or another.
new:
这些是这个故事的最后篇章，=name=，也可能是许多其他故事的最后篇章。
        无论如何，看看这一切的另一面将会很有益。

old: Oh. It looks like you are sorting screws and fasteners.
new: 哦。看起来你在整理螺丝和紧固件。

old: Have you come to any conclusions?
I shall leave you to it. Live and drink, contemplatrix.
new: 我将留你独自一人。活下来，饮酒，沉思者。

old:
I am contemplating the distinction between animal and rock. Why are they different? How much like a rock must an animal be when it ceases to be an animal?~
        I am considering the window of consciousness through which each of us views the universe. What happens to it when we die?~
        I am taking inventory of my faculties, and looking for any that I might not previously have considered.~
        I am considering the thought as a discrete object. I wish to determine whether I am able to think a single thought only, and to determine how to distinguish it from another thought in the same vein.~
        I am considering the determination of goodness and badness in a thing, and how it is determined. The interaction between data and subjective evaluation, and the values that guide us that we cannot put to words.~
        I am contemplating the Spindle's place in Qud, its position as a conceptual focal point. How much of what we know of the Spindle is the craft of those before us, carried forward?~
        I am considering narrative inheritances. The stories we were told when our minds were more putty-like, the follies that shaped who we are, that shape the whole of Qud.
new:
我正在思考动物和岩石之间的区别。为什么它们不同？当一种动物不再成为动物时，它必须像岩石到什么程度呢？~
        我正在思考我们每个人用来观察宇宙的意识之窗。当我们死去时，它会发生什么？~
        我正在清点我的能力，并寻找那些我可能未曾考虑过的能力。~
        我正在将思想视为一个独立的对象。我希望确定自己是否只能思考单一的思想，并确定如何将其与同一类别的其他思想区分开来。~
        我正在思考事物的好坏是如何确定的，以及这种确定性背后的数据和主观评价之间的互动，还有那些无法言说却指引我们的价值观。~
        我正在思考纺锤在库德中的地位，它作为一个概念焦点的位置。我们所知道的纺锤有多少是前人的工艺传承下来的？~
        我正在思考叙事的传承。那些在我们心智如同橡皮泥般可塑时所听的故事，那些塑造了我们自身、塑造了整个库德的荒诞之事。

old: You have prophetic visions in your sleep?
new: 你在睡眠中会有预言性的幻象吗？

old:
I am always tired, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

        My sleep comes in fits and starts, and always with ghastly visions. Sometimes my rest must be coaxed along with medicine.
new:
我总是感到疲惫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
        我的睡眠断断续续，总是伴随着可怕的幻象。有时我必须借助药物才能入睡。

old: What do you think of Klanq's visit?
new: 你对Klanq的来访有什么看法？

old: Good to see you, Iseppa. Let's chat.
new: 见到你真好，Iseppa。我们聊聊吧。

old: I'll leave you to it, then.
Not yet, but that's not the point.
What are you working on, Iseppa?
Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?
new: 你知道关于贝塞斯达·苏萨的任何事情吗？

old: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?
new: 关于奥蒙波奇和自封的伯爵，你知道些什么？

old: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?
new: 你见过帕克斯·克兰克吗？

old: I wish to know more about you.
Did you feel that rumbling, Iseppa?
new: 你感觉到那阵震动了吗，Iseppa？

old:
Bethesda Susa is an antipodal place, a gallery of life and death and the stages between. Its depths prolong life and end it early, remove life from the flow of days or return it.

        It will seek to make you late. Take care you come back on time.
new:
贝塞斯达·苏萨是一个对立之地，生与死及其之间的舞台。它的深处延长生命，也使其过早终结，将生命从时间的洪流中移除或使其回归。
        它会试图让你迟到。务必准时回来。

old:
I have not.

        I would, however, love to meet him. He seems a fun fungus.

        But I daren't go. I fear the sludges.
new:
我还没有。
        然而，我非常想见见他。他似乎是个有趣的真菌。
        但我可不敢去。我害怕那些污泥。

old:
I fear sludges, the kind you may no longer describe with 'some'. Born of the ancient stuff of existence, possessed of malice and wanting nothing more than to eat whatever they can, and they can eat whatever. It is even worse when they drink.

        Take care with them.
new:
我害怕淤泥，那种你再也无法用‘一些’来形容的淤泥。它们由古老的存在之物所生，充满恶意，唯一的愿望就是吞噬一切能够吞噬的东西，而它们几乎可以吞噬一切。当它们开始饮水时，情况会更加糟糕。
        小心它们。

old:
Yes. That was not the voice of the caverns.

        It feels like one of my nightmares come to life at last.
new:
是的。那并不是洞穴的声音。
        这感觉像是我的一个噩梦终于成真了。

old:
Though I adore the sights and smells of Omonporch, its bug problem becomes distracting.

        If I'm to travel there, I always bring something they cannot zip away from.
new:
虽然我非常喜欢奥蒙波奇的风景和气味，但那里的虫子问题确实让人分心。
        如果我要去那里，我总是带些他们无法逃脱的东西。

old:
Oh. Are you lost, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

        I don't mind that you're here, but I was not expecting anyone.
new:
哦。你是迷路了吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？
        我不介意你在这里，但我没想到会有人来。

old:
Live and drink, wayfarer.~
        Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        Moon and Sun; wisdom and will.~
        May the earth yield for us this season.
new:
活出精彩，畅饮吧，旅人。~
        活着并畅饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=.~
        月亮与太阳；智慧与意志。~
        愿这片土地在今年为我们带来收获。

old: Yes, apothecary. Do you know what those are?
new: 是的，药剂师。你知道那些是什么吗？

old: It's all right. You seem to like it here.
new: 没关系。你似乎很喜欢这里。

old:
Hatchling hungry. Angry. Angry-hungry.

        Kill, eat, don't eaten. Calm down evengefully.
new:
幼体饥饿。愤怒。饥饿-愤怒。
        杀戮，进食，不被吃。平静地复仇。

old: Why are you dressed like an apothecary?
new: 你为什么穿得像药剂师？

old: What do you think of the Freehold?

Live and =player.formalAddressTerm=!

        {{emote|*self-conscious rkkk*}}

        Dr... drink and =player.formalAddressTerm=!

        Krka, me. Krka.
new:
活下来吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=！
        {{emote|*局促不安的rk*}}
        博士……喝酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=！
        克尔卡，我。克尔卡。

old:
Vardy! Yes.

        But. Gemtle? No kill.
new:
瓦迪！是的。
        但是。Gemtle？不杀。

old:
{{emote|*krka!*}}

        Yes! To like! But... never home else. So {{emote|*reep?*}}.
new:
{{emote|*克尔卡！*}}
        是的！喜欢！但是... 从不在其他地方有家。所以{{emote|*reep?*}}。

old:
{{emote|*several moments of softly creaking thought*}}

        G-good!
new:
{{emote|*几段轻微吱吱作响的思考声*}}
        G-好！

old:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!

        There is no kindness in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.
new:
朋友，我会变成一堆余烬，被曙光滑翔者的光线烤死！我会被伊萨查里的步枪射成满身虫洞的尸体！
        大沙漠中没有仁慈。我不能去那里生活。

old:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was supping on summer offal when I noticed something glinting in the guts. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...

        Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?
new:
是的！我的邻居们已经厌倦了这个故事。当我在享用夏季残羹时，我注意到内脏中有什么东西在闪烁。我以前看到铬时也曾心动过，但能自己解放一小片碎片，将一颗珠子滑到美的算盘上...
        你会去吗？然后把我的小玩意献给井？

old: Some years later and twenty ago, I came upon these mushrooms huts and their goodly inhabitants. They are a people full of earthen poetry, and I was charmed by the warmth they welcomed me with. Surely, I owed my acceptance at first to the countenance I share with their mighty god, but they soon grew to love me, and I them. I've remained here ever since in contemplation of those questions that first stirred in me all those years ago.
new: 若干年后，也是二十年前，我来到了这些蘑菇屋及其善良的居民面前。他们是一群充满大地诗意的人民，我对他们热情的欢迎感到非常着迷。当然，我最初被接纳是因为我与他们强大的神祇有着相似的面貌，但不久之后，他们便开始爱上了我，我也爱上了他们。从此以后，我一直留在这里，思考那些多年前首次在我心中激起的问题。

old: A waterhand, you are? Speak to my friend and warden Indrix. You'll find him patrolling the village.
new: （你是水手吗？去找我的朋友兼看守人Indrix说话。你可以在村子里找到他巡逻。）

old:
We're watered by the river spray -- we pluck the fruit of the wood, and we hunt. The worshippers of Oboroqoru whittle and brood, too. They will pay you no mind unless you ask of them. Here you can be with friends, or muse alone. 
												
				If it's trade goods that interest you, take a gander at Yurl's wares in the northwest corner. The odd one Crowsong's, too, if you can scry them in the bush.
				
				I must warn you, however; cast no villain's shadow on these grounds. Warden Indrix will be watching.
new:
我们被河流的水雾滋润——我们采摘森林的果实，狩猎。奥博罗库鲁的信徒们也会雕刻和沉思。除非你向他们询问，否则他们不会理会你。在这里，你可以与朋友相聚，也可以独自冥想。
        如果你对贸易商品感兴趣，可以看看西北角尤尔的商品。克罗斯之歌的那些奇怪的东西，如果你能在灌木丛中发现它们的话。
        然而，我必须警告你；不要在这片土地上投下恶人的阴影。狱长因德里克斯会密切注视。

old: Warden Indrix is one of the most ferocious warriors I've ever met. Once upon a time, he and his brothers gorged themselves on the flesh of beasts by starlight, but now I count myself lucky to call him my warden. Some believe he is of sour kind, though I assure you, he's but a victim of his goatish nature.
new: 守卫因德里克斯是我见过最凶猛的战士之一。曾经，他和他的兄弟们在星光下大快朵颐野兽的肉，但现在我感到自己很幸运能称他为我的守卫。有些人认为他性格恶劣，但我向你保证，他只是他的山羊本性的受害者。

old: Coming from anyone else, =name=, I might refuse outright. Housing recently-sentient refugees is no mean favor, I think you'll agree. My people are slow to trust, as well, so I fear that the slynth may feel unwelcome for some time. But then, grafted branches grow the best starapples, do they not? Yes, your lilypad friends are welcome here if they wish.
new: 来自其他人的话，=name=，我可能会直接拒绝。安置最近获得意识的难民绝非小事，我想你会同意的。我的族人信任他人很慢，所以我担心这些斯林斯会感到不受欢迎一段时间。但是，嫁接的枝条能结出最好的星苹果，不是吗？是的，如果你的睡莲朋友愿意，他们在这里是受欢迎的。

old:
Never has Kyakukya seen such bustle. These slynth are seem to be as good citizens as any, but I am at my limit with the stress of keeping track of everything.

				Please check in again after some time, when I have my wits about me once again.
new:
Kyakukya 从未见过如此繁忙的景象。这些斯林斯似乎和其他任何公民一样好，但我已经到了承受这种压力的极限。
        请稍后再来，等我恢复清醒之时。

old: Had I no responsibility to represent my people, I might accept out of the goodness of my own heart alone. Sadly, I do not consider my heart, or even my mind, to be more important than my duty. Perhaps if you were a more renowned figure among my people, I would reconsider.
new: 若非我有责任代表我的人民，或许我会出于内心的善意接受。遗憾的是，我认为我的内心，甚至我的理智，都不如我的职责重要。如果你在我族中是一位更为知名的人物，我或许会重新考虑。

old: Why do you call it "your" village?
new: 你为什么称它为“你的”村庄？

old: What can you tell me about Kyakukya?
new: 你能告诉我关于基亚库基亚的事情吗？

old: Is there work to be found here?
Have you heard news of girshlings on Qud's surface? The watervine farmers of Joppa confirm it is true.
new: 你听说夸德地表出现吉尔什林的消息了吗？约帕的水藤农夫证实这是真的。

old: Be ape-still and muse, wanderer, and welcome to my village, Kyakukya. Have some mulled mushroom cider!
new: 静如猿猴，沉思吧，旅人，欢迎来到我的村庄，卡库基亚。来点热蘑菇苹果酒吧！

old:
Ah, bad habit. It's a possessive feeling I should work to scrub myself of, perhaps?

				But I am its mayor, and I have been for some time. You see, years ago I deserted my people. We were of two different minds -- they desired nothing but to bludgeon everything to death, while I asked, "What is the nature of this thing we bludgeon? Or of the act itself?"

				Recognizing that my answers lay elsewhere, I cast myself into the swell of the wilds, as a sailor from Perth with no windweird casts their ship to the whims of the Pale Sea!
new:
啊，坏习惯。这是一种占有欲，也许我应该努力摆脱这种感觉。
        但我是它的市长，而且已经当了很长时间。你看，多年前我离开了我的人民。我们有不同的想法——他们只想把一切都打死，而我却问: "我们打死的东西的本质是什么？或者这种行为本身又是什么呢？"
        意识到我的答案在别处，我将自己投入到荒野的波涛中，就像一个来自珀斯、没有风怪的水手将他们的船只交给苍白之海的任性！

old: I don't imagine you brought me this information merely to observe. Are you suggesting that these slynth might take up residence here in my village?
new: 我不认为你把这消息带给我只是为了观察。你是说这些斯林斯可能会搬到我的村庄来住？

old: Oh, another of our dwellers. I won't speak to what Crowsong's deal is. Best you find them and ask yourself.
new: 哦，又是一位我们的居民。关于乌鸦歌的交易，我就不多说了。你最好自己去找他们问问。

old: Have the slynth yet to choose a destination, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
new: 斯林斯还没有选择目的地，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

old: Yurl is a harmless cucumber vine. They came to Kyakukya a few years ago after the last Consortium chandler, a wicked little hyacinth named Plysago, suffered something of an... accident. In Tarotep's defense, Plysago shouldn't have berated someone with claws so close in resemblance to pruning shears. At any length, Yurl stocks a plethora of goods; you will be satisfied with your visit.
new:
Yurl 是一条无害的黄瓜藤。几年前，在最后一个联盟蜡烛商——一个名叫 Plysago
      的邪恶小风信子——遭遇了一场……事故之后，他们来到了 Kyakukya。为 Tarotep 辩护的话，Plysago 不应该在离自己如此近的剪刀状爪子面前斥责别人。总之，Yurl
      库存了大量商品；你会对这次访问感到满意。

old: As far west as Joppa, you say? Oh, grim! Yes, we found the remains of pale-things in the mouth of Svy. Does the Gyre widen again? Hrmmmm.
new: 向西远至约帕，你说？哦，真糟糕！是的，我们在斯维河口发现了苍白之物的残骸。逆流再次变宽了吗？嗯哼。

old:
Greetings once again, =name=. I am pleased to report that the settling-in of the slynth has gone well, more or less. The villagers are yet wary, but as some slynth have joined in the rituals and worship of Oboroqoru that wariness has waned somewhat.

				They've settled in across the village over time. Crowsong has taught the basics of hunting to a select few, and I'll be teaching a cooking class once I can wrest aside the time.
new:
再次问候，=name=。我很高兴地报告，斯林斯的适应情况总体上还算顺利。村民们仍然有些警惕，但随着一些斯林斯加入到对奥博罗库鲁的仪式和崇拜中，这种警惕已经有所减弱。
        他们逐渐在村庄各处安顿下来。Crowsong 已经向少数人选教授了狩猎的基本技巧，而一旦我能抽出时间，我将会开设烹饪课程。

old:
Come here. No, closer. Don't mind the bees, they rarely sting.~
        Don't be afraid to approach. The bees rarely sting.~
        Care for some beejuice?~
        Drink a dram of honey every morning, Slog itself couldn't make you sick.~
        You know, bees communicate by dancing. Got a whole language.~
        Without bees, all life in Qud would eventually die.~
        Bees are smarter than you think. They got that hive mind, see.~
        I eat honey matz every morning and I ain't been sick in decades.~
        We'd all be dead without bees, you know.
new:
过来。不，再近些。别管那些蜜蜂，它们很少蜇人。~
        不要害怕靠近。蜜蜂很少蜇人。~
        想要来点蜂汁吗？~
        每天早晨喝一杯蜂蜜，连斯洛格也无法让你生病。~
        你知道吗，蜜蜂通过跳舞来交流。它们有一整套语言。~
        没有蜜蜂，库德的所有生命最终都会消亡。
        蜜蜂比你想象的要聪明。它们有蜂群意识，你知道的。~
        我每天早上都吃蜂蜜马茨，几十年来都没生过病。~
        没有蜜蜂，我们都会死，你知道的。
