				All others have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it, waiting for the next great history.
new:
数世纪以来，我们这些善于倾听的人一直警觉地等待着=name=重返星空的迹象。那些倾向于宣讲的人则宣告星行者的即将归来，带着来自遗忘秒差距的消息和垂死恒星的最后一缕光芒。
        所有其他的生物都在日益减少的土地上和地下勉强维持着和谐，等待着下一个伟大的历史。

old:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud’s leaders, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.

        At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to quiet the ghosts of the Sultanate and take to the stars.
new:
当一切开始时，=name=与Qud的领导者们没有任何共享的螺旋体，仅凭作品和联盟便成就了他们的名声。=name=所夺去和拯救的生命不计其数，且仅有部分被记录在案。即使是曾经作为Qud祸患的尼菲利姆，也倒在了=name=的手下。
        在其统治末期，=name=呼吁与幸存的尼菲林姆和平共处，并攀上了尖塔之巅，在那里平息苏丹国的幽灵，飞向星辰。

old:
Upon their return, =name= participated in the dissolution and federation of all power-concentrate. Allies of the new equalizer gathered and rose, forming the Quetzal Council and other, shorter-lived managing bodies.

        Since then, we have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it.
new:
在他们归来后，=name=参与了所有权力集中的解散与联邦建立。新均衡者的盟友们聚集起来，成立了奎扎尔议会及其他寿命较短的管理机构。
        从那时起，我们便在日渐减少的土地上及其下方，过着脆弱的和谐生活。

old:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.

        At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.
new:
当一切开始时，=name=与之前的雷斯夫家族没有任何共享的螺旋结构，仅凭功绩和联盟便成就了他们的名声。=name=所夺去和拯救的生命不计其数，且仅有部分被记录下来。即使是曾经作为库德祸患的尼菲利姆，也倒在了=name=的手下。
        在其统治末期，=name=呼吁与幸存的尼菲Lim达成和平，并攀登至尖塔之巅，在那里彻底终结了雷斯夫王朝，从此再也没有人听到过他的消息。

old: Their descendants, at least, persist. No sign of the progenitors has been recorded in some time, but they may yet live.
new: 至少他们的后代仍然存在。已经很久没有记录到先驱者的迹象了，但他们可能还活着。

old: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.
new: 谁？在命运和意志使他们变得重要之前，无足轻重。现在？无人知晓。

old:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.

        Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.
new:
我被称作余烬、神灵、深裔和尼菲利之子。但这些都不是真正的我。
        我是谁在于我说了什么，做了什么。如果你仔细聆听，你会在我的话语间听到我的名字。

old: I am a smear of remnant material. I am drying blood. I am the last breath. Concern yourself no further with me.
new: 我是残留物质的污迹。我是正在干涸的血迹。我是最后一口气。不用再为我费心了。

old: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?
new: 确实是谁？谁又是=name=？我们怎敢将如此沉重的希望与恐惧寄托于如此渺小而遥远的身影？它能承受得住吗？

old: Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. Perhaps in this very moment, a moss piglet drinks of its first water in an eon.
new: 每一个可能性都潜藏在最深的蜂巢洞穴和迷宫之中，即使是紧张的生命也顽强不屈。或许就在这一刻，一只苔藓小猪在一亿年中首次饮水。

old: I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.
new: 我以为神经者已经灭绝了。

old:
In time, animal and even plant rule waned as their numbers fell to disease, slaughter, and wasting. More resilient, simple life took up the complexity left behind by the former rulers of Qud.

				What few Nervous Ones remained passed our stories on to the new life that saw fit to seek our counsel, that you remember the collective fate of those gone. Will you have your own =name=, or have you evolved truly past those before?
new:
随着时间的推移，动物甚至植物的统治因疾病、屠杀和消耗而减弱。更加坚韧的简单生命形式接手了Qud前统治者留下的复杂性。
        为数不多的幸存紧张者将我们的故事传递给了那些认为有必要寻求我们建议的新生命，让你记住那些逝去者的集体命运。你是否会有自己的=name=，还是你真的已经进化得超越了前人？

old: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.
new: 谁？在命运和意志使他们变得重要之前，无足轻重。现在？无人知晓。

old: They dwindled and died with the rest of the Nervous Ones. Their remnants wriggle in the cracks.
new: 他们与其他紧张者一同凋零消逝。他们的残余在裂缝中蠕动。

old:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.

        Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.
new:
我被称作余烬、神灵、深裔和尼菲利之子。但这些都不是真正的我。
        我是谁在于我说了什么，做了什么。如果你仔细聆听，你会在我的话语间听到我的名字。

old:
To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.

				Mayhap someone ought seek them.
new:
对我来说，它们只是故事。我并未试图去侵犯他们在仪式中如此珍视的边界。有些人说它们和其他凡人生物一样，是由一个外部的巫师集会所控制的。其他人则不相信它们是凡人，甚至有人认为那些神秘的陌生人与边境祭司完全没有关系。
        或许有人应该去找他们。

old: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?
new: 确实是谁？谁又是=name=？我们怎敢将如此沉重的希望与恐惧寄托于如此渺小而遥远的身影？它能承受得住吗？

old: They persisted in their way. Mayhap the survivors lived to spawn before returning to slumber or dying of eld.
new: 他们坚持自己的方式。也许幸存者在返回沉睡或老死之前活了下来并繁衍后代。

old: Their descendants remain and thrive, but the progenitor Nephilim have been silent for some time. Some believe that they have followed =name= to the stars.
new: 他们的后代仍然存在并繁荣，但始祖尼菲lim已经沉默了一段时间。有些人认为他们已经跟随=name=前往星空。

old:
It begins in a time before the Freeholders, before the final Sultan was entombed, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Kings and Sultans laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.

				They so devoured one another’s history that little substance remained outside of their strongholds.
new:
它始于自由居民之前，在最后一位苏丹被埋葬之前，当时尖塔崛起，无人挑战亦无人登顶。那些致力于掏空我们世界的挖掘者早已离去，但国王和苏丹们却在他们留下的迷惘大地上宣称主权。即使他们的领地逐渐枯萎，他们依然坚守着。
        他们相互吞噬的历史如此之多，以至于在他们的要塞之外几乎没有任何实质内容。

old:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.

        Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.
new:
我被称作余烬、神灵、深裔和尼菲利之子。但这些都不是真正的我。
        我是谁在于我说了什么，做了什么。如果你仔细聆听，你会在我的话语间听到我的名字。

old:
When their works began, =name= had no connection to the Sultanate. The rule of these ancient leaders had ended, but not fully: a ghost of the last Sultan yet ruled over the spire, tormenting those on and under the ground with plagues. As =name= grew mighty and slew the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.

        Seeking freedom from its reign, =name= struck a compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to confront and banish the cerulean ghost.

        And so it proceeded.
new:
当他们的作品开始时，=name=与苏丹国没有任何联系。这些古老领袖的统治已经结束，但并未完全消失：最后一个苏丹的幽灵仍然统治着尖塔，用瘟疫折磨着地上和地下的生灵。随着=name=逐渐强大并击杀了肆虐的尼菲利姆，他们开始认识到他们共同冲突的根源。
        寻求摆脱其统治的自由，=name=与幸存的尼菲Lim达成协议，爬上尖塔顶端，去面对并驱逐那蔚蓝的幽灵。
        就这样继续进行。

old:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud’s leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might. Even the ancient plagueborn Nephilim fell before the hand of =name=.

        At the end of their reign, =name= coerced a false compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, the last remaining seat of the Sultanate’s power. There, by one means or another, they sealed the fate of the world below.

        The Plagues of the Gyre raged. Death swept Qud.
new:
当一切开始时，=name=与Qud的领导者们没有任何共享的螺旋，他们通过流血和恐怖来树立自己的名声。无数生命被他独自一人夺去，这一切都是为了满足对控制和力量的古老渴望。即使是古老的瘟疫之子尼菲利姆也倒在了=name=的手下。
        在其统治末期，=name=胁迫与幸存的尼菲Lim达成了一项虚假的契约，并登上了尖塔之巅，这是苏丹国权力最后的据点。在那里，通过某种方式，他们决定了下方世界的命运。
        旋涡的瘟疫肆虐，死亡席卷了Qud。

old: O? What.. am I cohering? Curious! To fetch my notebook. But, o...
new: O？怎么回事..我在凝聚什么？好奇怪！得去拿我的笔记本。但是，噢...

old: The Seraph spoke of a Great Machine that spanned galaxies, the motion of whose sails and gear trains directed the fluidic shifting of stars and cultures. But they spoke little of it, and little I know.
new: Seraph曾提到一台跨越星系的伟大机器，其帆和齿轮的运动引导着恒星与文化的流体般转变。但他们对此谈论甚少，我也知之甚少。
斯塔希布！斯塔希布！斯塔希布！

old:
Yes, that paper, twas mine. This racket of a Signal is mine, too, of sorts.

        It is my tolling bell.
new:
是的，那张纸是我的。这个信号的喧嚣也是我的，某种程度上说。
        是我的丧钟。

old: Barathrum, let us again talk about the past.
new: 巴拉瑟鲁姆，让我们再次谈论过去。

old: The Templar are defeated, but will they return in force?
new: 圣殿骑士被击败了，但他们是否会卷土重来？

old: Barathrum, you look pained. Are you well?
new: 巴拉瑟鲁姆，你看起来很痛苦。你还好吗？

old: By your guess, what awaits us where the Spindle breaks?
new: 根据你的猜测，在纺锤断裂之处等待我们的是什么？

old: I would like a moment, Barathrum.
new: 我想静一会儿，巴拉思鲁姆。

old:
{{emote|*Barathrum exhales with effort.*}}

        Let us sort our faculties before we reach the rim of our ascent. There is the edge of our journey still to lathe.
new:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆费力地呼气。*}}
        让我们在接近攀登的边缘前整理好我们的能力。我们旅程的尽头仍有待雕琢。

old: Svardym Mak's static? Yes, twas the Signal. My signal. My tolling bell.
new: 斯瓦迪姆·马克的静电？是的，那就是信号。我的信号。我敲响的钟声。

old:
{{emote|*Barathrum coughs and swallows.*}}

        To ready our world for the Coven's return, the Seraph, who would be called Resheph, became convinced that all higher life on the planet must... be purged. That it was our life and way of living that moved the Coven to set the injunction. The only way through was for a new life to obtain.
new:
{{emote|*巴拉萨姆咳嗽并吞咽。*}}
        为了迎接Coven的归来，那位被称为Resheph的Seraph确信，星球上所有的高级生命必须...被清除。他认为正是我们的生命和生活方式促使Coven设下了禁令。唯一的出路是让新的生命得以存续。

old: Barathrum, if the past has some relevance to this moment, I would ask you to share what you know.
new: 巴拉瑟姆，如果过去与此刻有关联，我希望你分享你知道的一切。

old:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses and frowns.*}}

        Do you know, =name=, the engine types that ask us to loose every pin and unhinge every cam to know them? Such an engine of culture we are encased in now, and I cannot speak to the workings of one gearset without disassembling them all. I meant not to tease, and soon, I promise, you will spy the next arc of our journey.
new:
{{emote|*巴拉萨姆停顿并皱眉。*}}
        你知道吗，=name=，那些要求我们松开每一颗销钉、拆下每一个凸轮才能了解它们的引擎类型？如今我们置身于这样的文化引擎中，我无法在不拆解所有齿轮组的情况下谈论其中任何一组的工作原理。我并非有意调侃，很快，我保证，你将窥见我们旅程的下一个弧度。

old: I asked Resheph that very question. But the seraphim transit an ethical manifold much different than our own.
new: 我问过雷斯弗那个问题。但炽天使穿越的伦理流形与我们自己的大不相同。

old:
{{emote|*Barathrum heaves a great sigh upon the moist air of the control pit.*}}
        {{emote|*Barathrum stumbles to the floor with paws to his face.*}}
new:
{{emote|*巴拉萨姆在控制坑的潮湿空气中发出一声沉重的叹息。*}}
        {{emote|*巴拉萨姆踉跄地倒在地上，爪子捂着脸。*}}

old: Only in the Shallows' dawnstirs did I let myself think it possible. And now...
new: 只有在浅滩的晨曦中，我才允许自己认为这是可能的。而现在...

old: Each of us is a sick animal in a darkling thicket. Each cursed with machinery to compress the clamber of echoes into bees, mothers, mountains, country. How many millions of snowsick years to sew a feeling substance into an agent of the world! A felt and machine animal, and in so doing, to stuff the whole of the world inside the agent (an inarguable document of its falsity), for agency is in its very definition the world in containment acting on itself...
new: 我们每个人都是黑暗灌木丛中的病态动物。每个人都被诅咒，用机械将回声的攀爬压缩成蜜蜂、母亲、山川、国家。需要多少百万个雪病之年才能把一种感受性的物质缝合成世界的代理人！一个有感知和机械的动物，这样做，便是将整个世界塞入代理人之中（这是其虚假性无可争议的证据），因为代理在其定义中就是包含着世界并作用于自身的……

old: Once the Seraph had become convinced of the Coven's return, they reified their authority and assumed a more material role in onworld matters. The decaying sultanate was a convenient tool.
new: 一旦塞拉芬确信女巫会已经归来，他们便重申了自己的权威，并在 worldly 事务中扮演了更为实质性的角色。日益衰败的苏丹国成了一个方便的工具。

old: I cannot say, =name=. But I know it's facile to believe a living heritage can be evanesced in one stroke. We are always downstream of a past violence.
new: 我无法说，=name=。但我知道，相信一个活生生的遗产可以在一击中消失是轻而易举的事。我们总是处于过去暴力的下游。

old:
Apprentice. So long since I've worn that title, but it feels right still.
        
        Yes, twas me at the machine speaker's side.
new:
学徒。自从我戴上那个头衔以来已经过去了很久，但感觉依旧合适。

        是的，我就是站在机器传声器旁边的人。
{{emote|*巴拉萨姆喃喃自语，难以听清。*}}

old:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

        O, =name=, our cursors draw together on Fate's phenomenic slide rule! You burn with speculation, and I- I molder in the coolness of knowing. I enter my dwarf phase.
new:
{{emote|*Barathrum 暂停.*}}
        啊，=name=，我们的光标在命运的现象滑尺上汇聚！你燃烧着好奇，而我——我在知晓的凉爽中腐朽。我进入了我的矮人阶段。

old: It is done, then. Have the explication you are owed.
new: 既然如此，你应得的解释如下。

old:
{{emote|*Barathrum shifts his weight, pauses, and flexes an arthritic paw.*}}

        I am sorry. Tis the acceleration, =name=. I am whirling and empty of breath. Steel yourself, and so shall I.
new:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆转移了重心，停顿了一下，然后弯曲了他那关节炎的爪子。*}}
        我很抱歉。是加速度的原因，=name=。我感到眩晕且喘不过气来。振作起来，我也会如此。

old:
Atop the implausible rise of the Spindle roosted a Seraph, one of the great machinic archons of the Eaters, and this being Rebekah served.

        In the short years before I arrived in Qud, the Seraph became convinced that something had changed in the cosmic order. That along the ecliptic of the Folk Clock, some uncounted peg had slid to a priming position, and that the Coven was set to imminently return.
new:
在不可思议的纺锤山巅栖息着一位天使，她是食者们的伟大机械统治者之一，而这位存在正是丽贝卡所侍奉的。
        在我来到Qud的短短几年之前，塞拉芬确信宇宙秩序发生了某种变化。他们认为，在民俗时钟的黄道上，某个未被计数的钉子已经滑到了启动位置，而魔女集会即将重新归来。

old:
And so, Resheph seeded the plagues and whorled them via waveform to a breathing gyre. Blights engineered to attack life whilst preserving the planet's artifacts of glass and chrome.

        Rebekah, dear tutor, betrayed Resheph's confidences and apprised me of the plan, so that I might help her dash it apart and save the peoples of our world.
new:
于是，雷斯弗将瘟疫播种，并通过波形将它们旋入一个呼吸的漩涡。这些灾害被设计成在攻击生命的同时，保留星球上的玻璃和铬制文物。
        亲爱的导师丽贝卡背叛了雷斯夫的信任，将计划告知了我，以便我能帮助她破坏这个计划，拯救我们世界的人民。

old: I asked for time. Give me time. To reform Qud, extinguish the hatefulness and needless warmaking, to lift our world across the eschaton and prepare it for the Coven's return...
new: 我请求时间。给我时间。去重塑Qud，熄灭仇恨与无谓的战争，将我们的世界带过末世并为女巫会的归来做好准备...

old: Barathrum, we're to rest the fate of Qud on a mere cub's tale?
new: 巴拉萨鲁姆，我们真的要把库德的命运寄托在一个小崽子的故事上吗？

old:
In the age of the covenate, a coterie of our urshiib ancestors took to the stars to ply their burning cores! Can you envision it??

        Ho, ho! I know a secret! Heh, heh! I know... there is a functioning starship atop the Spindle. We can take it, =name=! We launch ourselves into the deepness of the dusted cosmos and find the starshiib! You and I, ho ho!

        Starshiib!
new:
在盟约时代，我们的乌尔希布祖先中有一小群人踏上了星辰之旅，去操控他们炽热的核心！你能想象吗？？
        嘿，嘿！我知道一个秘密！呵呵，我知道...在纺锤顶端有一艘完好的星舰。我们可以去取，=name=! 我们可以将自己发射到尘埃宇宙的深处，寻找那艘星舰！你和我，哈哈！
        星舰！

old:
No... Qud is fractious, and no lasting peace has obtained. I tried... for decades on decades I tried our paws on the tiller, to shim together what blossomed in the wild...

        The restoration of machines, the federation of free sovranties, the nourishing rituals of salt and star, the sacred, the profane...
new:
不……Qud是分裂的，持久的和平从未实现。我尝试过……数十年来我一直尝试将我们的手放在舵轮上，去拼凑那些在荒野中绽放的东西……
        机器的复兴，自由主权国家的联盟，盐与星的滋养仪式，神圣的，世俗的...

old:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}

        Child. There is much more I would have liked to share. But... I am a puppet of my shame.
new:
{{emote|*巴拉萨姆的面容突然变得庄重。*}}
        孩子。我还有很多想分享的东西。但是...我是一个被羞耻操纵的木偶。

old: I am sorry, =name=. I am so proud of you! I wish... I wish it were I did not peel, like your model.
new: 我很抱歉，=name=。我为你感到非常骄傲！我希望...我希望我没有剥落，不像你的模型。

old: You see, =name=, when I, a young bruin, crossed the Homs Delta with my flood-fleeing clan and into the western reach of Qud, the plagues of the Gyre were already ascendant. We took root at our new hearth, in the chrome grottos where we urshiib find natural peace, and by the providence of my elders, I was able to study the tinkering craft.
new: 你看，=name=，当我，一个年轻的布鲁因，和我那逃避洪水的氏族穿越霍姆斯三角洲，来到库德的西部区域时，吉尔漩涡的瘟疫已经盛行。我们在新的家园扎根，在那些我们乌尔希布能找到自然平静的铬质洞穴中，并且凭借长辈们的恩赐，我得以学习修补工艺。

old:
In the late years I saw the writing on the wall. I turned us inward, retreated to my candle-dim study to angle at the project alone. A new plan... {{emote|*eeehw*}} was-

        {{emote|*Barathrum starts panting.*}}
new:
在暮年，我看到了墙上的字迹。我转向内心，退回到昏暗的烛光书房，独自钻研这个项目。一个新的计划... {{emote|*eeehw*}} 是-)
        {{emote|*巴拉萨姆开始喘气。*}}

old: Why ascend the Spindle then? For what purpose?
new: 为何要攀登纺锤？目的是什么？

old: And he was, of a sort. The cure for a plague is often too its cause. With one's paws on the dials and drum of power, history is a cloth to be loomspun.
new: 而他确实是，某种程度上。瘟疫的解药往往也是其病因。当一个人的爪子掌握了权力的表盘和鼓面时，历史就是一块可以被编织的布料。

old: I found a torn sheet of graph paper with a note about deceit. Was it yours?
new: 我找到了一张撕破的方格纸，上面有关于欺骗的笔记。这是你的吗？

old: Your crimeclothes? There was a codex about crimes and punishments near the bedroll in your study. What was it?
new: 你的罪衣？在你的书房床铺附近有一本关于罪行与惩罚的法典。那是什么？

old: The svardym Mak said he was born to a cacophony of static ringing his ears raw. Could it have been the signal?
new: Svardym Mak 说他出生时耳边充斥着刺耳的静电声。这会不会就是那个信号？

old: The Svardym Geeub mentioned a machine speaker and her ursine apprentice. Was that you?
new: The Svardym Geeub提到了一位机器发言人和她的熊学徒。那是你吗？

old: Rebekah was a healer. But the daughters of Exile, her acolytes, are tinkers. Why?
new: 丽贝卡曾是一位治疗师。但流放者之女，她的追随者们，却是修补匠。为什么会这样？

old:
O, deceit! The grueling gate I crossed on every tilt of glittering dusk. I slept in my crimeclothes and wept, did you hear?

        Or could you hear only the damnable static, like me, and speak naught to the machine that belches it out. Heal none of the wounds of its grievous heart, or mine own...

        O, oh... So much to bear.
new:
噢，欺骗！那道折磨人的大门，我在每个闪烁的黄昏都会跨越。我穿着犯罪的衣服入睡，哭泣，你听见了吗？
        或者你只能听到那该死的静电干扰，就像我一样，无法与那台机器交流。无法治愈它那痛苦的心灵，也无法治愈我自己的...
        啊，噢……有这么多要承受。

old:
She was a healer, yes. The wire cutter can perform the work of a scalpel; and the soldering iron, a suture.
        
        To take apart a history, and stitch something new...
new:
她是一名治疗师，没错。电线钳可以像手术刀一样工作；而焊铁则可以起到缝合线的作用。

        拆解一段历史，并缝合出新的...

old:
Through my work I caught the attention of a master machinist, unconventional of method, who took me under her wing and, in time, availed me of the orphic truth.

        She explained, as I've shared with you and the rest of the acolytes, that the world we know once belonged to a grand Coven of beings who spanned the stars. And that, acting on some inscrutable logic, they disappeared. That an injunction was placed on our world.

        This, you know. It is the truth I told, if only half. But Rebekah taught me more.
new:
通过我的工作，我引起了以为方法 unconventional 的大师级机械师的注意，她将我置于她的庇护之下，并最终让我了解了 orphic 的真相。
        她解释说，正如我与你和其他侍从分享的那样，我们所知的世界曾经属于一个跨越星辰的伟大巫师集会。并且，根据某种难以理解的逻辑，他们消失了。对我们这个世界下达了一个禁令。
        这，你知道。这是我所说的真相，即便只是一半。但雷贝卡教给我的远不止这些。

old: What would there be for the Coven to return to, if life on our world was purged?
new: 如果我们的世界上的生命被清除，Coven又有什么可以返回的呢？
为什么雷舍夫会成为苏丹？

old: Resheph is remembered as a healer.
How did the agreement play out?
Then you did not succeed, by Resheph's measure?
new: 那么按照雷斯帕的衡量，你并没有成功？

old:
After a storm of shrapnel words, the Seraph acceded to ten centuries.

        Ten centuries! An eyeblink on the scales of the Folk Clock but an eternity for us. So I believed.

        The rousing Signal would cease, the plagues of the Gyre would be reversed, to the extent they could; for even the potent archon had not full governance over what they had worked into being.
new:
在一阵弹片般的言辞风暴后，塞拉芬同意了十个世纪的请求。
        十个世纪！对于种族时钟而言仅是一瞬，但对于我们却是永恒。所以我相信。
        激励信号将会停止，回旋中的瘟疫将会被逆转，至少在某种程度上是这样；因为即使是强大的执政官也无法完全掌控他们所创造出来的一切。

old:
Then? Perhaps.. Perhaps the greater bodies whose agency I share the smaller cut from might share too the greater portion of my meal in blame.

        Winding Svy? Thou art devious in symbol shape like serpent Ba'al!
        Hinnom? For blooming alga thou crossed thy perch's back!
        Shiftless moon?
        Sun! Proud and idle, Sun! Silver father of the protoplanets! Claim mine selfhood and be done with it.

        {{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}
new:
然后？也许..也许那些我共享其代理的更大个体，会将我从较小个体那里削减的部分，同样视为我这顿餐食中更大的罪责来源。
        蜿蜒的斯维？你的符号形状像蛇神巴尔一样狡诈！
        希诺姆？为了绽放的藻类，你竟敢跨越你的栖息地！
        Shiftless moon?
        太阳！骄傲而慵懒的太阳！原行星们的银色父亲！宣告我的自我并结束这一切。
        {{emote|*巴拉萨鲁姆哭泣。*}}

old: If the signal sounds and the Gyre widens again, then you did not reach whatever watermark Resheph set?
new: 如果信号响起且漩涡再次扩大，那么你并未达到雷斯夫设定的任何水位？

{{emote|*巴拉萨姆呜咽着。*}}
        -什么？谁在那里？

{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}

new: 那本法典？一种慰藉，一本指南，一份账簿。我的罪行没有签署者，但心灵自有其记载。

We allied on the notion that the sultanate must be abolished for the future to flower. I was to execute the earthly plan, while Resheph continued preparations at the astronomical tier. To achieve a sort of bicameralism of action, Resheph insisted on reformatting their personality as a triumvirate, seeded from thin scans of the original archon, Rebekah, and myself.

        The art of mythmaking was employed to enshrine the Resheph persona. Thus- the healer, the Coiled Lamb, and perhaps unexpectedly, the Above.

我们同盟的信念是苏丹国必须被废除，未来才能繁荣。我负责执行 earthly
        plan，而Resheph则在天文层级继续准备。为了实现一种行动上的两院制，Resheph坚持将他们的个性重新格式化为三头政治，由原始执政官Rebekah和我自己的一些薄扫描数据衍生而来。
        神话创作的艺术被用来铭刻雷斯夫的形象。因此，治疗者、盘绕之羔羊，以及可能出乎意料地，天上之物。

new:
我失败了！我失败了！一千年太短，还需要——更多时间
        {{emote|*巴拉萨鲁姆哭泣。*}}

在自由领地之前，在升腾之前
        当尖塔孤独而坚固地崛起时
        国王和苏丹统治着空心之地
        互相吞噬
        按照他们认为合适的方式。

old:
Who, I?
				Only a fool, tra la,
				only a remnant scrap.

				Only left-behind,
				only madness,
				only an echoing gyre.
new:
谁，我？
        只有傻瓜，啦啦，
        only a remnant scrap.
        仅留下了
        only madness,
        only an echoing gyre.

old:
Ere the melting of everything,
				when the spire rose lonely strong,
				Creatures ruled the hollow land
				devouring one another
				as they saw fit.
new:
在一切融解之前，
        当尖塔孤独而坚固地崛起时
        生物统治着空心之地
        互相吞噬
        按照他们认为合适的方式。

old:
None hailed =name=
				and =name= hailed none
				but with word and blade
				deed and disregard
				they stood against old rule.

				To push back the Gyre,
				to spill of Nephil ichor
				they took to the spire
				and quieted the remnants.
new:
无人称颂 =name=
        并=name=向无 hailed
        但凭借言辞与利刃
        功绩与漠视
        他们反抗旧规则。
        为了击退漩涡，
        涅斐尔之血的溢出
        他们登上了尖塔
        并平息了残余。

old:
None hailed =name=
				and =name= hailed none
				but with word and blade
				deed and disregard
				they stood against their kind.

				To push back the Gyre,
				to spill of Nephil ichor
				they took to the spire
				and enacted a great betrayal.

				Death of impossible scale reigned
				and we Nervous Ones fell,
				and as the Gyre swallowed us
				we sang to the last.
new:
无人称颂 =name=
        并=name=向无 hailed
        但凭借言辞与利刃
        功绩与漠视
        他们与自己的同类对立。
        为了击退漩涡，
        涅斐尔之血的溢出
        他们登上了尖塔
        并实施了一场巨大的背叛。
        死亡以无法衡量的规模统治
        我们这些紧张的人倒下了，
        并当旋涡吞噬我们时
        我们唱到了最后。

old:
It begins in a time before the Limen and its vanguard, before the ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Reshephs laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.

        By the time of the last Resheph, little remained of their works, less of their glory.
new:
它开始于利门及其先锋之前，早在升华之前，那时尖塔崛起无人能敌亦无人能升。致力于掏空我们世界的挖掘者早已离去，但雷斯夫们占据了他们留下的迷惘之地。即使他们的领地逐渐枯萎，他们依然坚守着。
        到了最后一个雷斯夫时期，他们的功绩所剩无几，荣耀更是荡然无存。

old: What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?
new: 什么是利门？骑士团的边缘？

old:
Oh, yes. Never doubt this.

        Can one return? Hmm. There’s the rub.
new:
哦，是的。永远不要怀疑这一点。
        能返回吗？嗯。问题就在这里。

old:
The Freeholds of Qud, that web of folk-clusters, of committees and caucuses, syndicated slime-mold cities held in peace by mutual frustration and monumental effort.

        If you need detail, ask a Freeholder, but clear your day first.
new:
The Freeholds of Qud，那由民间集群、委员会和党团组成的网络，通过相互的挫败感和巨大的努力维持和平的联合体黏菌城市。
        如果你需要详细信息，去问一个自由持有者，但先清空你的一天。

old:
It begins in a time before =name='s ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but long had rulers laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.

        By the end of the time of Kings and Sultans, little remained of their works, less of their glory.
new:
它始于=name=崛起之前的时代，当时尖塔崛起且无人挑战或登顶。那些致力于掏空我们世界的挖掘者早已离去，但统治者们早已宣称对这片迷惘之地的主权。即使他们的领地逐渐萎缩，他们依然坚守着。
        到了国王和苏丹的时代末期，他们的功绩所剩无几，荣耀更是荡然无存。

old: Can one really travel the stars?

For centuries, we of listening inclination have kept sharp for some sign that =name= will return to the stars. Those of preaching inclination proclaim the imminent return of the starfarer, bearing tidings from parsecs forgotten and the last light of dying stars.

        All others have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it, waiting for the next great history.
new:
数世纪以来，我们这些善于倾听的人一直警觉地等待着=name=重返星空的迹象。那些倾向于宣讲的人则宣告星行者的即将归来，带着来自遗忘秒差距的消息和垂死恒星的最后一缕光芒。
        所有其他人都在日益减少的土地上和地下勉强维持着和谐，等待着下一个伟大的历史。

old:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud’s leaders, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. When they spoke, even the plagues of Qud listened.

        At the end of their reign, =name= made a compact with the Nephilim that they should never vex the creatures of Qud again. So done, they climbed to the top of the spire and boarded an ancient vessel, thereby to travel the star-dusted expanse.
new:
当一切开始时，=name=与Qud的领导者们没有任何共享的螺旋体，仅凭作品和联盟便成就了他们的名声。=name=所夺去和拯救的生命不计其数，只有部分被记录在案。当他们说话时，即使是Qud的瘟疫也会倾听。
        在其统治末期，=name=与尼菲利姆达成协议，他们将不再侵扰Qud的生物。完成后，他们爬上尖塔顶端，登上一艘古老的飞船，从而穿越星尘密布的广袤宇宙。

old:
Upon their return, =name= participated in the dissolution and federation of all power-concentrate. Allies of the new equalizer gathered and rose, forming the Quetzal Council and other, shorter-lived managing bodies.

        Since then, we have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it.
new:
在他们归来后，=name=参与了所有权力集中的解散与联邦建立。新均衡者的盟友们聚集起来，成立了奎扎尔议会及其他寿命较短的管理机构。
        从那时起，我们便在日渐减少的土地上及其下方，过着脆弱的和谐生活。

old:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives saved and otherwise changed by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. When they spoke, even the plagues of Qud listened.

        At the end of their reign, =name= made a compact with the Nephilim that they should never vex the creatures of Qud again. So done, they climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.
new:
当一切开始时，=name=与之前的雷斯夫家族没有共享螺旋，仅凭作品和联盟便成就了他们的名声。=name=拯救的生命以及改变的其他生命不计其数，只有部分被记录下来。当他们说话时，即使是库德的瘟疫也会倾听。
        在其统治末期，=name=与Nephilim达成协议，约定他们不再侵扰Qud的生物。完成此事后，他们爬上尖塔顶端，彻底终结了雷斯夫王朝，并从此消失无踪。

old:
They lived.

        Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber, to wake again when needed.
new:
他们活了下来。
        如今只是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦行带，他们以原本的模样生活着。他们的后代在Qud上和地下行走。也许最初的那些还活着。也许它们在沉睡，等待需要时再次苏醒。

old: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.
new: 谁？在命运和意志使他们变得重要之前，无足轻重。现在？无人知晓。

old:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.

        As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.
new:
我被称作继承者、神灵、尖塔之子、涅菲林格。这些名字都很贴切，但没有一个能完整或充分地描述我。
        正如你所见，我是过去涟漪汇聚成的现在力量。正如你所见，我是已完成的行动，也是对未完成行动的意图。

old:
I am history’s leftovers, an inheritor of nothing, a bit of marginalia in a burned tome.

        That I have persisted to witness this day leaves me in awe. It is extraordinary.
new:
我是历史的残渣，一个无物可继承的存在，在一本被焚毁的书中只配作为边缘注释。
        我得以见证这一天，令我感到敬畏。这太非凡了。

old: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?
new: 确实是谁？谁又是=name=？我们怎敢将如此沉重的希望与恐惧寄托于如此渺小而遥远的身影？它能承受得住吗？

old: Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. Perhaps in this very moment, a moss piglet drinks of its first water in an eon.
new: 每一个可能性都潜藏在最深的蜂巢洞穴和迷宫之中，即使是紧张的生命也顽强不屈。或许就在这一刻，一只苔藓小猪在一亿年中首次饮水。

old: I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.
new: 我以为神经者已经灭绝了。

old:
In time, animal and even plant rule waned as their numbers fell to disease, slaughter, and wasting. More resilient, simple life took up the complexity left behind by the former rulers of Qud.

        What few Nervous Ones remained passed our stories on to the new life that saw fit to seek our counsel, that you remember the collective fate of those gone. Will you have your own =name=, or have you evolved truly past those before?
new:
随着时间的推移，动物甚至植物的统治因疾病、屠杀和消耗而减弱。更加坚韧的简单生命形式接手了Qud前统治者留下的复杂性。
        少数剩余的紧张者将我们的故事传递给了那些认为有必要寻求我们建议的新生命，让你记住那些逝去者的集体命运。你将拥有自己的=name=，还是你已经真正进化到了超越前人的地步？

old: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. They died without title, or perhaps did not die at all. Tales abound, and thus far no one has stepped forth to renounce or affirm them.
new: 谁？在命运和意志使他们变得重要之前，他们无足轻重。他们没有头衔就死了，或者也许根本就没有死。传说 abound，到目前为止还没有人站出来否认或确认这些传说。

old:
They played their role so well, and lived in power for a time.

        If they had any illusion that they would be spared the fate =name= determined for life on Qud, it surely died before the great beings themselves. Mayhap they went to ground and survived. Mayhap their spawn persisted.
new:
他们扮演了自己的角色如此之好，并在权力中生活了一段时间。
        如果他们曾有任何幻想，认为自己可以逃脱=name=为Qud生命所决定的命运，那幻想必定在这些伟大生物之前就已破灭。也许他们躲了起来并存活了下来。也许他们的后代仍然存在。

old:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.

        As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.
new:
我被称作继承者、神灵、尖塔之子、涅菲林格。这些名字都很贴切，但没有一个能完整或充分地描述我。
        正如你所见，我是过去涟漪汇聚成的现在力量。正如你所见，我是已完成的行动，也是对未完成行动的意图。

old:
To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.

        Mayhap someone ought seek them.
new:
对我来说，它们只是故事。我并未试图去侵犯他们在仪式中如此珍视的边界。有些人说它们和其他凡人生物一样，是由一个外部的巫师集会所控制的。其他人则不相信它们是凡人，甚至有人认为那些神秘的陌生人与边境祭司完全没有关系。
        也许应该有人去找他们。

old: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?
new: 确实是谁？谁又是=name=？我们怎敢将如此沉重的希望与恐惧寄托于如此渺小而遥远的身影？它能承受得住吗？

old:
They lived.

        Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring may walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber. Mayhap they will rage again one day, to disrupt a stagnant world.
new:
他们活了下来。
        如今只是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦行带，它们以本真的生物形态生活着。它们后代的子孙可能在Qud的地上和地下行走。也许最初的那些还活着。也许它们正在沉睡。也许有一天它们会再次愤怒，打破这个停滞的世界。

old:
They lived.

        Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. It’s said that they ascended to the stars to find =name=, but it seems equally plausible that they may have returned to their slumber in the depths.
new:
他们活了下来。
        如今只是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦行带，它们以原本的生物形态生活着。它们后代的子孙在Qud上行走，在Qud下潜行。据说它们升入星空寻找=name=，但同样有可能的是，它们或许回到了深处的沉睡中。

old:
It begins in a time before the Freeholders, before the final Sultan was entombed, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Kings and Sultans laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.

        They so devoured one another’s history that little substance remained outside of their strongholds.
new:
它始于自由居民之前，在最后一位苏丹被埋葬之前，当时尖塔崛起，无人挑战亦无人登顶。那些致力于掏空我们世界的挖掘者早已离去，但国王和苏丹们却在他们留下的迷惘大地上宣称主权。即使他们的领地逐渐枯萎，他们依然坚守着。
        他们相互吞噬的历史如此之多，以至于在他们的要塞之外几乎没有什么实质内容留存。

old:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.

        As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.
new:
我被称作继承者、神灵、尖塔之子、涅菲林格。这些名字都很贴切，但没有一个能完整或充分地描述我。
        正如你所见，我是过去涟漪汇聚成的现在力量。正如你所见，我是已完成的行动，也是对未完成行动的意图。

old:
When their works began, =name= had no connection to the Sultanate. The rule of these ancient leaders had ended, but not fully: a ghost of the last Sultan yet ruled over the spire, tormenting those on and under the ground with plagues. As =name= grew mighty and challenged the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.

        Seeking freedom from the reign of the Sultan, =name= struck a compact with the Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to confront and banish the cerulean ghost.

        And so it proceeded.
new:
当他们的工作开始时，=name=与苏丹国没有任何联系。这些古老领袖的统治已经结束，但并未完全消失：最后一位苏丹的幽灵仍然统治着尖塔，用瘟疫折磨着地上和地下的生灵。随着=name=变得强大并挑战肆虐的尼菲利姆，他们开始认识到他们共同冲突的根源。
        寻求从苏丹统治下的自由，=name=与尼菲利姆达成协议，爬上尖塔顶端，去面对并驱逐苍蓝幽灵。
        就这样继续进行。

old:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud’s leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might.

        Perhaps hunger turned to malice, or the adoption of a greater principle, or simple boredom. Whatever the reason, =name= formed a fast alliance with the ancient plagueborn Nephilim, ascended the spire, and sealed the fate of the world below.

        The Plagues of the Gyre raged unchecked.
new:
当一切开始时，=name=与Qud的领导者们没有任何共享的螺旋体，他们通过流血和恐怖来建立自己的名声。无数生命被他独自一人夺去，这一切都是为了满足对控制和力量的古老渴望。
        也许饥饿转化为恶意，或者对更高原则的采纳，又或者只是单纯的无聊。无论原因是什么，=name=与古老的疫病之子尼菲Lim迅速结盟，登上了尖塔，并决定了下界世界的命运。
        旋涡的瘟疫肆虐 unchecked.

old:
[[{{C|Strength}}]]
Your strength score determines how much melee damage you do (by improving 
your armor penetration), your ability to resist forced movement, and your
carry capacity.

[[{{C|Agility}}]]
Your agility score determines your accuracy with both melee and ranged
weapons and your ability to dodge attacks.

[[{{C|Toughness}}]]
Your toughness score determines your number of hit points, your hit point
regeneration rate, and your ability to resist poison and disease.

[[{{C|Intelligence}}]]
Your intelligence score determines your number of skill points and your
ability to examine artifacts.

[[{{C|Willpower}}]]
Your willpower score modifies the cooldowns of your activated abilities,
determines your ability to resist mental attacks, and modifies your hit
point regeneration rate.

[[{{C|Ego}}]]
Your ego score determines the potency of your mental mutations, your
ability to haggle with merchants, and your ability to dominate the wills
of other living creatures.

[[{{C|Armor Value and Dodge Value (AV / DV)}}]]
Your armor value (AV) is a measurement of how well protected you are
against physical attacks that hit you. The higher your score, the less
likely an opponent's attack will do severe damage to you. Most characters
start with a base AV score of 0.

Your dodge value (DV) is a measurement of how likely you are to be hit by
physical attacks. The higher your score, the less likely an opponent's
attack will hit you. Your DV is modified by your Agility modifier. Most
characters start with a base DV of 6.

[[{{C|Mental Armor (MA)}}]]
Your mental armor (MA) is a measurement of how well protected you are
against mental attacks, much as your armor value is a measurement of how
well protected you are from physical attacks. The higher your score, the
less likely an opponent's mental attack will have a severe effect on you.
Your MA is modified by your Willpower modifier. Most characters start
with a base MA of 4.

[[{{C|Quickness (QN)}}]]
Your quickness score is a measurement of how quickly you perform each and
every action you take. Your base quickness score is 100. Note that there
are very few ways to augment this score.

[[{{C|Movement Speed (MS)}}]]
Your movement speed is a measurement of how quickly you walk or fly.
Your base movement speed is 100.

[[{{C|Temperature (T)}}]]
Your temperature is a measurement of how hot or cold you are. If you are
Cold, your quickness score is reduced by half. If you are Frozen, you are
unable to take physical actions. If you are Flaming, you take heat damage
every turn until you reduce your temperature.

[[{{C|Acid Resist}}]]
Your acid resist is a measurement of how much acid damage you ablate. Your
base acid resist score is 0. At 100, you are immune to acid damage.

[[{{C|Cold Resist}}]]
Your cold resist is a measurement of how much cold damage you ablate and how
insulated you are from effects that reduce your temperature. Your base cold
resist score is 0. At 100, you are immune to cold damage and your
temperature cannot be reduced.

[[{{C|Electrical Resist}}]]
Your electrical resist is a measurement of how much electrical damage you
ablate and how resistive you are to electric current. Your base electrical
resist score is 0. At 100, you are immune to electrical damage and you do
not conduct electricity.

[[{{C|Heat Resist}}]]
Your heat resist is a measurement of how much heat damage you ablate and how
insulated you are from effects that increase your temperature. Your base
heat resist score is 0. At 100, you are immune to heat damage and your
temperature cannot be increased.
new:
[[{{C|Strength}}]]
你的力量决定了你造成的近战伤害（通过提高 你的护甲穿透力），你抵抗强制移动的能力，以及你的

你的敏捷决定了你近战和远程的准确性和你躲避攻击的能力。

点再生率。

你的自我决定了你的心理突变的效力，与商人讨价还价的能力，以及你支配意志的能力其他生物的。

[[{{C|护甲值和闪避值 (AV / DV)}}]]
你的护甲值 (AV) 衡量的是你受到的保护程度，抵御对你的物理攻击。AV越高，对手对你造成伤害越低，大多数人物的AV初始值都是0。

你的闪避值 (DV) 衡量的是你被物理攻击击中的可能性。DV越高，对手击中你的可能性越低。DV 由你的敏捷修正值修改。
人物初始DV最大是6.

[[{{C|精神护甲 (MA)}}]]
精神护甲（MA）是衡量你抵御精神攻击能力（包括混乱、精神分裂和灵能武器）的指标，就像你的护甲值衡量你抵御物理攻击的能力一样。
MA越高，敌人的心灵攻击对你造成严重影响的可能性就越小。MA会受到意志力修正值的影响。大多数角色的基础MA为4。

[[{{C|速度 (QN)}}]]
你的速度值衡量你执行每一个动作的速度。你的基础敏捷值为100。请注意，增强这个值的方法非常少。

[[{{C|移动速度 (MS)}}]]
你的移动速度衡量你行走或飞行的速度。你的基础移动速度为100。

[[{{C|温度 (T)}}]]
你的温度衡量你有多热或多冷。如果你感到寒冷，你的敏捷值会减半。如果你被冻结，你将无法进行物理动作。
如果你着火了，你会在每回合受到热伤害，直到你的温度降低。

[[{{C|耐酸}}]]
你的酸性抗性衡量你抵御酸性伤害的能力。你的基础酸性抗性值为0。当达到100时，你对酸性伤害免疫。

[[{{C|耐寒}}]]
你的寒冷抗性衡量你抵御寒冷伤害的能力，以及你对降低温度效果的隔离程度。你的基础寒冷抗性值为0。
当达到100时，你对寒冷伤害免疫，并且温度无法被降低

[[{{C|耐电}}]]
你的电抗性衡量你抵御电击伤害的能力，以及你对电流的抗性。你的基础电抗性值为0。当达到100时，你对电击伤害免疫，并且不导电。

[[{{C|耐热}}]]
你的热抗性衡量你抵御热伤害的能力，以及你对增加温度效果的隔离程度。你的基础热抗性值为0。
当达到100时，你对热伤害免疫，并且温度无法被提升。

old:
Artifacts are items so technologically complex that few of Qud's denizens
understand them. An unidentified artifact will appear to you as a
"Weird Artifact". You may examine an artifact to try to identify it. If you
are successful, you will narrow down the possibilities of that artifact's
function (what was once a "club", for example, you may now identify as a
"rifle"). Eventually you may completely identify the artifact. Each time
you attempt to identify something and fail, however, there is a small
chance you will break it. Your chance of successfully identifying an
artifact is based on your intelligence score.
new:
遗物是技术复杂到古德的居民中少有人理解的物品。
一个未识别的遗物会被你显示为‘奇异遗物’。你可以检查一个遗物以尝试识别它。
如果成功，你将缩小该遗物功能的可能性（例如，曾经是‘棍棒’，现在你可以识别为‘步枪’）。最终你可以完全识别该遗物。
然而，每次你尝试识别物品而失败时，都有小概率会损坏它。成功识别遗物的机会取决于你的智力值。

old:
Tonics are chemical concoctions that enhance your mental and physical stats
in a variety of ways. They are artifacts, and so you must successfully
identify them to understand what they do. Ingesting one tonic while under
the effects of another is dangerous; for each new tonic you ingest, there is
a greater and greater chance that the tonics will react adversely to each
other. The higher your Toughness score is, the greater the chance that you
will be able to ingest multiple tonics without incurring undesired effects.

Tonics produce more potent effects in true kin than they do in mutated
humans. Also, as the body chemistry of mutants is inherently unstable,
there is a 5% chance that a tonic ingested by a mutant will instead produce
an undesired effect.

Tonics may be concocted with the Tinker skill. In addition to bits,
concocting a tonic often requires a natural ingredient.
new:
药剂是化学配方的混合物，可以以多种方式提升你的精神和身体属性。
它们是遗物，因此你必须成功识别它们才能了解它们的作用。
在服用一种药剂的同时再服用另一种药剂是危险的；每当你服用新的药剂时，药剂之间不良反应的可能性会增加。
你的耐力值越高，你能在不产生不良效果的情况下服用多种药剂的机会就越大。

药剂对真人的影响比对变异人的效果更强。此外，由于变异者的体内化学成分本质上不稳定，变异者服用药剂时
有5%的机会会产生不良效果。

药剂可以通过工匠技能调制。除了需要一些零件外，调制药剂通常还需要一种自然材料。

old:
Certain effects or abilities require creatures to make saving throws or face 
consequences. Saving throws each have an attribute and difficulty associated 
with them. To pass a saving throw, a base 1d20 is rolled and then your 
relevant attribute modifier is added. If that number meets or exceeds the 
difficulty, you pass. Otherwise you fail. Some saving throws against 
creature abilities add the creature's attribute modifier to the difficulty 
as well.
new:
某些效果或能力要求生物进行豁免检定或面临后果。
每个豁免检定都有一个属性和难度值。要通过豁免检定，你需要掷一个基础的1d20，然后
加上相关属性的修正值。如果这个数字达到或超过了难度值，则通过检定；
否则，检定失败。一些针对生物能力的豁免检定也会将生物的属性修正值加入到难度值中。

old: Historians of leisure divide all epochs into the following three ages: the span before ursine creatures evolve or civilizations rise to admire them, the span between ursine prominence and a civilization's capacity to fashion divans in their likeness, and thence the span until the civilization's fall.
new: 休闲历史学家将所有时代分为三个时期: 熊类生物进化或文明兴起之前的时代，熊类生物占据主导地位到文明有能力模仿它们制作沙发的时代，以及文明衰落之后的时代。

old: Clay was rounded and kilned to store oils and wine.

old: Wooden and chrome poles let weapons rest peacefully.

old: A furrowed metal plate is fit to the arch of the doorway, and a sliding panel sits recessed in the center. The panel is impressed with the mold of a key card.

old: Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.

old: Sine waves breaking on the glass lune encode the behavioral primitives of the enclave's mechanical children. The electron field sucks them through the antenna and into the aether.
new: 正弦波在玻璃月上破碎，编码了聚落机械子嗣的行为原语。 电子场将它们吸入天线并送入以太。

old: Clay was fired around steel and erected in the rib cage for structural support.

old: Branches of the living tree were resorbed and reformed into trunk knots. Then, hundreds of years later, the oiled saw of a gorge woodworker disarranged the arbor geometry and flattened it for civil use. That history remains cast in two dimensions, powdered with dust and scratched in pencil.
new: 这棵活树的枝条被重新吸收并重塑成树干结节。 数百年后，峡谷木匠的油锯打破了树木的几何结构，将其平整化以供民用。 那段历史如今仍以二维的形式存在，上面撒满了灰尘，用铅笔刻下了痕迹。

old: The halfgod kneels on hinds worked wide in old stone. Tiled polygons spill off the statue's base to evoke Qas's rightening of space, time, mountain, and village. Generations of moss skirt the beast's treecutter hooves.

old: Abandoned in a tucked-away hut on Bey Lah's outskirts, this enormous statue of hornsfel languishes under a layer of withered vegetation. It depicts a majestic deer with one hoof raised from the ground, its humanlike eyes judging its surroundings and finding them wanting. The metal plaque on the base of the statue hasn't fared well over the centuries, and the only glyphs you can make out are 'K', 'R', 'S', and 'H'.

old: It's worked from otherworldly limestone. The stone was quarried from a drift-world spinning about a darkling star whose weak luminescence didn't bleach the voidstuff from the rock's coral. Now it insulates its slumberer from the rays of materiality and conducts them to the psychic aether.
new: 它由异界的石灰岩制成。 这种石头采自一颗围绕昏暗恒星旋转的漂浮世界，那颗恒星微弱的光芒并未将虚空物质从岩石的珊瑚中漂白。 如今，它将沉睡者与物质世界的光线隔绝，并将其引导至心灵以太。

old: Stuffed with watervine chaff and glowcrow feathers, this buttoned pillow lets folk repose with crossed legs.
new: 填充了水藤碎屑和发光乌鸦羽毛，这款扣式坐垫让人们可以盘腿休憩。
向掘洞者舒格鲁斯致敬的神龛

old: Chiseled spines wreathe the sinuous worldeater, who dug the earthly caves that were peopled by late-stage troglodytes. The hundred-nine eyes of legend peer across time, and generations of moss skirt the beast's banded undergirth.
new: 雕刻的脊椎环绕着蜿蜒的世界吞噬者，它挖掘了被晚期穴居人居住的地底洞穴。 传说中的九十九只眼睛穿越时空，而数代苔藓则围绕着这头怪兽的环状腹部。

old: Smooth cerulean marble looks like holographic light annealed into solid rock. It's edged and cornered with gold.
new: 平滑的天蓝色大理石看起来像是全息光固化成的固体岩石。 边缘和角落镶嵌着金色。

old: Foam plush is arranged into gyri and sulci to mimic the brain maze.
new: 泡沫绒毛被排列成脑回和脑沟，以模仿大脑迷宫。

old: A wood storage box with a hinged lid and latch. Notches scratched on the surface hint at the full probability array of language, and also its absence.
new: 一个带有铰链盖和锁扣的木制储物箱。 表面刻有凹槽，暗示了语言的完整概率阵列及其缺失。

old: Magnetized innards digest electrical signals and belch out the waveform, while a diaphragm breaths dust onto a brass grill.
new: 磁化的内部结构消化电信号并发出波形，而振膜则将灰尘吹拂到黄铜网罩上。

old: The delphic countenace of the Tungsten King is frozen in chrome, cast to perfect specification.
new: 钨金国王的神谕般的面容被定格在铬合金中，铸造得完美无瑕。

old: Jointed wood and knit watervine make a movable wharf for the ass.
new: 铰接木架和编织水藤制成的可移动臀部支撑。

old: Surfaces of dull steel are cornered in brass and smudged with finger age. The lid is latched shut.
new: 暗淡的钢表面镶有黄铜边角，上面布满了手指的痕迹。 盖子紧闭。
看护者,可调节的,矫形的,治疗的,治愈者,恢复者

old: Hidden micro-reactors smash together particles, generate heat, and power the biotic machine apparatus that restores life to the wounded recliner.
new: 隐藏的微型反应堆撞击粒子，产生热量，为恢复伤者生命的生物机械装置提供动力。

old: Rail to rail panels are bulwarked by a crossbar for reinforcement of the in and out margin.
new: 从栏到栏的面板由横梁加固，以增强进出边缘的稳定性。

old: Cirrus clouds of neon stir inside a glass lune and beam light through the prefigured likeness of the sultan. A bleary shape thus hovers supine above the starless and gigantic black rock divan. The artist may have intended this to evoke a lightning storm over a dark plain or a lily on the pitch of a river: something to represent the bright and gaseous mind roaming over the inert body.
new: 霓虹色的卷云在玻璃新月内翻腾，光线透过预先雕刻的苏丹形象投射出来。 一个模糊的形状因此悬浮在无星的巨型黑色岩石卧榻之上。 艺术家可能意图以此唤起黑暗平原上的闪电风暴或河流之上的百合花: 某种代表明亮而气体般游荡的意识漫游在静止躯体之上的东西。

old: A burnished steel jacket hugs a smoldering fire pit. Scorchstrokes of many materials cake its sides.
new: 一层磨光的钢制外壳紧紧包裹着一个余烬未尽的火坑。 多种材料的烧痕覆盖在其侧面。

old: Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.
new: 翠绿色的植物叶片从古老的坩埚中蔓延而出，其上刻有铬合金的切口。 它们如同土壤中的近亲一样呼吸生长，但它们的生物数据被与不朽之种进行了基因重组。 即使周围的食物者逐渐腐烂，这些植物也不会死亡。

old: Tetraxenonoglass walls and convalesscent gel recreate the conditions of the amnion where reptile, bird, and mammal embryos are nurtured to whole life.
new: 四氙玻璃墙和康复凝胶重现了胚胎在羊膜中的环境，这里哺乳动物、鸟类和爬行动物的胚胎被培育成完整的生命。
治疗者,治愈师,恢复者,神奇

old: Sharp points of chrome are the vertices of this utilitarian light fixture. Brightness bursts from its edges and lights the world.
new: 铬制尖端构成了这个实用灯具的顶点。 光芒从其边缘迸发，照亮了世界。

old: A terracotta board has been painted with ochre and ground iron.
new: 一块陶土板上涂有赭石和研磨铁粉。

old: Here Shekhinah has been sculpted into permanence with magnificent cerulean marble. His body is chiseled to blessed perfection. His golden diadem crowns him Father among Fathers.
new: 在这里，谢基纳被雕琢成永恒，用宏伟的天蓝色大理石塑造。 他的身体被雕刻得完美无瑕。 金色的王冠使他成为父中之父。

old: A hunk of crude granite has been smoothed on top for metalworking and rounded at the side into a shaping horn.
new: 一块粗糙的花岗岩顶部被打磨平整用于金属加工，侧面被修圆成一个塑形角。

old: Sunrays are captured by photovoltaics across the foundation around a chrome cylinder, and the heat is used to pump water into pipes for dispersal.
new: 光子板捕捉到的阳光热量被用于推动水通过管道进行分配。
液压师,流动者,流体师,巧匠
淋巴的,流动的,补充者,沐浴者,向光性,光电的,丰富的

old: Metals cut by the cosine saw were fit-welded and put to steel frame. The lock stile is padded in chrome.
new: 由余弦锯切割的金属被精密焊接并安装到钢框架上。 锁框镀铬。

old: Clay was spun on the potter's wheel and shaped into waves, fired, and glazed into a ceremonial vessel. Two pictographs are panelled side-by-side: 'life' and 'drink'.
new: 陶土在陶轮上旋转成波浪状，烧制并上釉成仪式用器皿。 两个象形文字并排: ‘生命’和‘饮用’。

old: Stone was carved and shaped into a rough dome with square, even-spaced windows to let air flow. The small difference in temperature inside the dome causes dew to condense from air and accumulate in a catch basin below.
new: 石块被雕琢成一个粗糙的穹顶，穹顶上排列着方形且间距均匀的窗户，以便空气流通。 穹顶内部温度的微小差异使空气中的露水凝结，并在下方的集水槽中积聚。
干枯者,干燥者,咸涩者,渴求者
水生的,凝结的,带露的,补水者,灌溉者,湿润的

old: A metal locker that looks worn with age.
new: 一个看起来因年久而磨损的金属储物柜

old: Water ribbons climb bone-blanched marble columns in high relief. They mount the archivolt and snake between helical rings before a sharp turn upward on the keystone. Here becomes there.
new: 水流丝带攀爬着骨白色的大理石柱，在高浮雕中蜿蜒而上。 它们沿着拱肩盘旋，穿过螺旋环，最后在拱顶石处急剧向上转弯。 这里变为彼处。

old: A pair of retractible chrome panels are fit on oiled tracks.
new: 一对可伸缩的铬合金面板安装在涂油的轨道上。

old: Wooden and chrome poles let guns rest peacefully.
new: 木制和铬制的杆子让枪械得以安放。

old: Rubber lines the inner topology of a motorized barrel. A kettle of ebon carbide grit sits in the underchamber ready to abrade.
new: 橡胶衬里电机桶的内部结构。 一个装满黑色碳化硅磨料的罐子位于下腔，准备进行研磨。

old: Inside a metal chassis, amber glyphs ride the scanlines painted by a cathode ray. Frustum keys are arranged in quiet rows.
new: 金属外壳内，琥珀色的符文沿着阴极射线绘制的扫描线移动。 锥形键安静地排列成行。

old: Fine Wares from the Consortium of Phyta
Grease drips from an engine of bright chrome and stains the idlers. Pulley wheels are positioned at odd angles to churn flat rubber belts through space.
new: 润滑油从闪亮的铬合金引擎滴落，染污了惰轮。 滑轮以奇怪的角度布置，使平坦的橡胶带在空间中运转。

old: A fullerite hem surrounds a foam landing pad, and the above-head fretwork is braided into the once-familiar glyphs of recomposition and return symbology.
new: 富勒烯穹顶环绕着泡沫着陆垫，头顶上方的花纹编织成曾经熟悉的重组和回归符号。

old: Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.
new: 翠绿色的植物叶片从古老的坩埚中蔓延而出，其上刻有铬合金的切口。 它们如同土壤中的近亲一样呼吸生长，但它们的生物数据被与不朽之种进行了基因重组。 即使周围的食物者逐渐腐烂，这些植物也不会死亡。

old: Rectangle keys are arranged down the angled ladder to step upwise in pitch. Hanging on frame is a note mallet.
new: 矩形键沿倾斜的梯子排列，音高逐级升高。 框架上悬挂着一个音符槌。

old: Wax weeps from the stubborn candles, drips onto the sconces, forms a waxfall through the tiers of bronze.
new: 固执的蜡烛上滴下的蜡油，落在壁灯上，形成了一道道铜制层次间的蜡瀑。

old: Tracery on the fullerite hem is melted bright white and drips onto the cracked foam pad. Lily sprouts quicken in the cracks and push forth; life creeps outward.
new: 富勒烯边缘的纹饰熔成了明亮的白色，滴落在裂开的泡沫垫上。 裂缝中迅速长出百合幼苗，生命向外蔓延。

old: The biped form emerges out of a cocoon of wood and fiberglass.
new: 这具双足形态从木纤维和玻璃纤维制成的茧中脱颖而出。
雕塑家,帽商,裁缝师,盔甲匠
结构良好,美丽,公平,静止,诡异,栩栩如生

old: Sailcloth is fastened to brined wooden arms that rotate by windsong and turn the central shaft.
new: 帆布固定在腌制过的木质臂上，随风歌旋转，带动中央轴。
循环者,慷慨者,旋转者,叶片者

old: Perfect-cut chrome rotors are stacked along a generator shaft, and wide fin blades catch the fluid push and spin electric yarn.
new: 完美切割的铬合金转子沿发电机轴堆叠，宽大的鳍片叶片捕捉流体推力并旋转发电线圈。
水生的,奢华的,养育的,丰富的,补充者

old: Wood was precisely cut into drawers and set on brass rails to house clothes.
new: 木料被精确切割成抽屉，并安装在黄铜轨道上，用于存放衣物。

old: Barathrum's invention records time to the momentary tick by regulating its advance with a crown wheel. On learning of its utility, the water barons commissioned the assembly of dozens more in order to take precise measurements of their reservoirs at set moments of the day.
new: 巴拉特鲁姆的发明通过冠轮调节其前进，记录时间到每一刻的滴答声。 得知其用途后，水霸主们委托制作了数十个这样的钟表，以便在一天中的特定时刻精确测量他们的水库。

old: Knotted wood of good moisture content holds the weight of earth at right angles. Scorch marks and salt decorate the grooves.
new: 含水量适中的结节木材支撑着地面的重量，形成直角。 烧痕和盐晶装饰着凹槽。

old: Bits of tiny matter are smashed together behind the lune of a chrome cylinder, and the heat is used to pump electricity downgrid.
new: 微小的物质碎片在铬合金圆柱的月牙形内部被撞击融合，产生的热量用于向下输送电力。

old: Appliances,Energy Cells,Power Grids,the Depleted,the Jacked,the Power-Hungry,Tinkers
new: 装置,能源电池,电网,枯竭者,插件者,电能贪婪者,修补匠

old: A table scorched with the radial patterns of hot chemistry holds a phial rack and alembic.
new: 一张被热化学反应烧焦的桌子，上面摆放着药剂架和蒸馏器。

old: Stone asserts its importance by orienting toward the firmament, whence the oldest wisdom stirs.
new: 石头通过朝向苍穹彰显其重要性，那里是最古老的智慧苏醒之地。

old: Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.
new: 翠绿色的植物叶片从古老的坩埚中蔓延而出，其上刻有铬合金的切口。 它们如同土壤中的近亲一样呼吸生长，但它们的生物数据被与不朽之种进行了基因重组。 即使周围的食物者逐渐腐烂，这些植物也不会死亡。

old: Wood paddles black with wet-rot catch the force of the babbling brook and set the wheel to the slow motion of centuries.
new: 被湿腐染黑的木桨捕捉到潺潺小溪的力量，使水车缓缓转动，仿佛经历了数个世纪。
时钟机械,工程师,磨坊主

献给吉尔什·贝撒大的神龛

old: Slumping shoulders edge the valley of a cracked stone back, and two pairs of mated arms join at their hundred-knuckles in the stonecarver's depiction of the halfgod's quickening. Generations of moss skirt the beast's varicose legs.
new: 塌陷的肩膀勾勒出裂石背部的山谷，两对交缠的手臂在石匠雕刻的半神觉醒场景中以百指相接。 数代苔藓围绕着这兽物的静脉腿。

old: Clay was spun on the potter's wheel and shaped into waves, fired, and glazed into a traditional vessel.
new: 陶土在陶轮上旋转成波浪形状，烧制并上釉，制成传统的陶器。

old: Panes of polished glass were frosted dark and fit on a slide rail.
new: 抛光玻璃板被染成深色，安装在滑轨上。

old: Stoneware catches the tiny bit of moisture surrendered by the bone-dry air.
new: 陶器捕捉着骨干空气中微乎其微的湿气。
舒适,短腿,直背,结实,三腿

old: From the hands of a metalworker rods and strips erupted and cooled into shape.
new: 金属工匠手中，金属棒和条带迸发而出，冷却成形。

old: It's scratched on top where a pestle splintered the wood.
new: 桌面被杵棒划出了裂痕。
扁平的,有节的,平坦的,L形的,结实的,三足的,摇晃的

old: Convivia in the limen, the boundary between sun-baked Moghra'yi and the shade of the Spindle, involves the mulling of cider, holography, and the arrangement of klinai at right angles.
new: 在临界之地的欢聚，即太阳炙烤的莫格拉伊与纺锤树荫之间的边界，涉及苹果酒的调制、全息投影以及克林家具的垂直排列。

old: The wet paints of earth -- clay, slag, chrome, and dye -- slouch a half-idea with material weight. The transformation is arrested through indecision or neglect.
new: 湿润的泥土、黏土、炉渣、铬和染料——这些材料沉重地勾勒出一个半成型的想法。 由于犹豫或疏忽，这一转变过程被中断了。

old: During the enterprise of invention, you sometimes require the use of a shapeless gray foam. Or, at the very least, you might require it one day, and so some tinker prudently got ahead of the problem and invented the brass foaminator. Inscribed on the base: 'All the foam, none of the sadness at maybe one day needing foam and not having it'.
new: 在发明的过程中，你有时需要使用一种无定形的灰色泡沫。 或者至少有一天你会需要它，因此某个机智的修补匠提前解决了这个问题，发明了黄铜泡沫发生器。 底座上刻着: ‘所有的泡沫，没有因为有一天可能需要泡沫却没有而感到遗憾’。
舒适,颓废,享乐主义,懒惰,奢华,斜倚,柔软,纵情,妖艳

old: Plumpness in the cushion is gauged to the seated thinker, lancet arches press into the playful back, and claw-and-ball feet suggest a hidden life within the piece itself. This is a chair laden with meaning.
new: 坐垫的丰满度经过精心设计，适合思考者久坐；尖拱形靠背增添了趣味性，而爪球脚则暗示了这件家具内部隐藏的生命。 这是一把充满寓意的椅子。

old: Metal was braided into electromagnetic scaffolding, and through it the modulator molds the clay of the baseband and divulges the shape of the new signal.
new: 金属编织成电磁支架，通过它调制器塑造基带的黏土并揭示新信号的形状。

old: Heat from the salt sun evaporates brackish water. When the water condenses again, it's separated into its pure and impure elements: salt gloms on the still, while freshwater collects in the basin.
new: 盐太阳的热量蒸发了咸水。 当水再次凝结时，它被分离成纯净和不纯净的元素: 盐附着在蒸馏器上，而淡水则收集在水槽中。

new: 早期地球的温暖磷光被整齐地排列在木砖之中，如今它如同一颗微小的恒星般运作。

old: The statue of Bel wears its tremendous weight in polished marble. He wields his epochal aegis, storied for obstructing a swirling gas cloud in the starry dawn.
new: 贝尔的雕像用抛光大理石制成，承载着巨大的重量。 他手持史诗般的盾牌，传说中曾阻挡过星辉初现时的旋涡气体云。

old: Inside the scratched metal C a needle and a bobbin prepare to punch a pair of threads into a lockstitch. Initials are carved all around its pedestal.
new: 在划痕累累的金属外壳内，针和线轴准备将两根线缝合成锁式缝合。 基座周围刻满了各种首字母。

old: Wet clay sticks to a wheel and soldering board. It's flowered with diodes, circuits, vane pumps, and magnets.
new: 湿润的黏土粘附在轮子和焊接板上。 上面点缀着二极管、电路、叶片泵和磁铁。

old: Marble striations smear into melted pink rock slag; the ageless box lies open.
new: 大理石纹理在熔化的粉红色岩石渣中模糊；这口永恒的箱子敞开着。

old: Rust-caked spines line the interior of an iron sarcophagus. Dissatisfied with the caliber of earthly punishments, its deviser sought to deprave even the restful slumber of eternity.
new: 锈迹斑斑的脊椎排列在铁棺的内部。 设计者对尘世的惩罚不满意，甚至试图剥夺永恒安眠的宁静。

old: Historians of leisure divide all epochs into the following three ages: the span before ursine creatures evolve or civilizations rise to admire them, the span between ursine prominence and a civilization's capacity to fashion divans in their likeness, and thence the span until the civilization's fall.
new: 休闲历史学家将所有时代分为三个时期: 熊类生物进化或文明兴起之前的时代，熊类生物占据主导地位到文明有能力模仿它们制作沙发的时代，以及文明衰落之后的时代。

old: Bright tracery charts a life time of meaning through the black marble void of the door's surface. A family name is inscribed on a memorial plaque.
new: 明亮的纹饰在门面的黑色大理石上勾勒出一生的意义。 一块纪念铭牌上刻写着家族姓氏。

old: Metal slates partition the chrome carton into golden rectangles. Inside, artifacts await their planned abrasion and return to mineral form.
new: 金属板将铬合金箱分割成金色矩形。 内部，文物等待着它们预定的磨损，重新回归矿物形态。

old: At some moment in the door's past, an indweller unspooled their will to curiosity and cut an aperture for sight through the boundary.
new: 在某个时刻，门的过去中，一位居住者解开了他们对好奇心的意愿，在边界上切开了一道用于窥视的孔洞。

old: A elephant slab of gold-painted metal slumps out of its ancient doorframe. The handle is kept still by an ornate mechanical lock.
new: 一块巨大的金色金属板斜靠在古老的门框上。 把手被一个精美的机械锁固定着。

old: A sconce of wood and iron hangs lightless.
new: 一盏由木头和铁制成的壁灯悬挂在墙上，未点燃。

old: Glyphs inscribed into the ancient stone are refracted into the present.
new: 刻在古老石头上的符文折射到现代。

old: At some moment in the double door's past, an indweller unspooled their will to curiosity and cut an aperture for sight through the boundary.
new: 在这对门的某个时刻，一位居住者展开了他们的好奇心，在门上开了一扇观察孔。

old: Surfaces of dull steel are cornered in brass and smudged with finger age. The lid is latched shut.
new: 暗淡的钢表面镶有黄铜边角，上面布满了手指的痕迹。 盖子紧闭。

old: Glass lunes refract light and paint images in fictive angular size.
new: 玻璃透镜折射光线，呈现虚幻的视角图像。

old: Wired metal squares a cabinet of drawers and burners for toasting, pickling, and freeze-drying.
new: 布线金属方块组成的橱柜，配有抽屉和烤架，用于烘烤、腌制和冷冻干燥。

old: The box is wrought from chewed wire and dented iron.
new: 这个箱子由咬过的铁丝和凹陷的铁皮制成。

old: Glass was blown to a wide bowl and thin stem in the tradition of the grove-carpeted mountain lagynos. Were the style's first artisans working through the thick and ripe air of the musa wood? Did Spindle glitter dust their marvers and pipes?
new: 这瓶子按照林地覆盖的拉吉诺斯山的传统吹制而成，瓶身宽阔如碗，瓶颈纤细。 这种风格的首批匠人是否在木萨森林浓密而成熟的空气中工作？纺锤是否曾用闪耀的尘埃点缀他们的成形台和吹管？

old: Gas is pushed through a hose and ignited into flame. Dew gives texture to the hose barbs.
new: 气体通过软管被推送并点燃成火焰。 露水赋予了软管接头独特的质感。

old: Wooden and chrome poles let armor rest peacefully.
new: 木制和铬合金杆让护甲得以安放。

old: In high relief, folds and knots of sandy hued shapes crown the sapphire surface of the spherical model. The juxtaposition of scales, the proportion of sea to land, and the collective wisdom harnessed to devise such a thing make your head spin.
new: 在这个球形模型的蓝宝石表面上，沙色的形状以高浮雕的形式折叠和交织。 比例尺的对比、海洋与陆地的比例，以及创造这一奇迹所汇集的集体智慧，令人头晕目眩。

old: Guild furniture makers, conspiring in a bright workroom beneath the Eaters' sun, stretched a cushion to the precise size of two ardent lovers and set a pleasing mail diamond at its right angle. The claw-and-ball feet suggest movement.
new: 公会家具工匠们在食者之阳下明亮的工作室里密谋，将垫子拉伸到正好适合两位热恋情人的尺寸，并在直角处镶嵌了一颗令人愉悦的钻石。 爪球脚设计暗示了动感。

old: Teeth, shell, and bones were blackened into stasis by the earthy gunk.
new: 牙齿、贝壳和骨骼被泥土中的物质黑化成静止状态。

old: Marble blossoms on top as a spiraling volute. The column is splattered with paint.
new: 顶部绽放着大理石花朵，呈螺旋形涡卷。 柱身溅满了颜料。

old: Bone-grey ash sticks to the grooves of flat black di-rubber.
new: 骨灰色的灰烬粘附在扁平的黑色二橡胶凹槽上。

old: Slide drawers of galvanized metal are arranged in a cabinet as rectangles of assorted dimensions. Storage is fractal.
new: 镀锌金属制成的滑动抽屉按不同尺寸排列成矩形，存储空间呈分形结构。

old: Cirrus clouds of neon stir inside a glass lune and beam light through the prefigured likeness of the sultan. A bleary shape thus hovers supine above the starless and gigantic black rock divan. The artist may have intended this to evoke a lightning storm over a dark plain or a lily on the pitch of a river: something to represent the bright and gaseous mind roaming over the inert body.
new: 霓虹色的卷云在玻璃新月内翻腾，光线透过预先雕刻的苏丹形象投射出来。 一个模糊的形状因此悬浮在无星的巨型黑色岩石卧榻之上。 艺术家可能意图以此唤起黑暗平原上的闪电风暴或河流之上的百合花: 某种代表明亮而气体般游荡的意识漫游在静止躯体之上的东西。

old: Burnished bronze is burned to light-in-ceremony by hot coal.
new: 打磨光亮的青铜在仪式中被热煤点燃。

old: Marsh reed was handcrossed by warp and weft into a vessel for sheaf and other dry goods.
new: 沼泽芦苇通过手工经纬交织而成，用于装载麦捆和其他干燥物品。

old: The slate is touched with years of handprints and a ring of rust flakes off the top of the hinges. The door continues, though, its stubborn assertion of 'in' and 'out'.

old: Planks of wood are nailed together simply to form the austere seat.
new: 几块木板简单地钉在一起，形成了这把朴素的座椅。

old: Half-moon glass roofs the subterrarium and protects the corpse eaters, who have prospered inside. They are an arcology of gills.

old: A rectangle of neutrofoam imprinted with the human form hangs beneath an arch of glass. Across the foam at eye level, glyphs loop on an elliptical screen. Surgical machinery, obscured by blinding light, beetles out from the underside of an enclosing dome.

old: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the bright stone oven, and with it comes the smell of hot spine fruit jam and roasted tail.
new: 明亮的石炉中火苗噼啪作响，散发出温暖的气息，随之而来的是热腾腾的脊果果酱和烤尾肉的香味。

old: Features erupt from a stone canvas and shatter into a figure from the deep past. Hair, skin, brow, thigh: the details hatch a new emotion inside you, the sense of the strange-familiar. As you move about the petrified likeness, you wonder at how this Eater managed to incise themself into your spacetime braid.
new: 石质画布上涌现出的特征汇聚成一个来自远古的形体。 头发、皮肤、眉毛、大腿: 这些细节在你心中孵化出一种陌生而熟悉的感受。 当你绕着这尊石化的肖像移动时，不禁惊叹这位食者是如何将自己刻入了你的时空之网。

old: Brass bands frame an old iron box eaten red by air and rain.

old: Behind the pane of a bronzed frame are the programmable instruments of glassmaking: stove and blowpipe for hot work, oiler and wheel for cold.

old: Metalfoam is packed and plated into a colossal simulacrum of the bio-arm, where the heads of the biceps and triceps brachii gleam. Brass pinchers snap the kinesis out of their target.
new: 金属泡沫被压缩并制成巨大的生物臂模型，二头肌和三头肌的头部闪闪发光。 黄铜夹具从目标处夺走动能。

old: Clay was rounded and kilned to store oils and wine.
new: 陶土被塑形并烧制，用于储存油和酒。

old: Sharp points of chrome are the vertices of this utilitarian light fixture. Brightness bursts from its edges and lights the world.

old: Nisroch the star mason is depicted here straddling the earth with his mighty legs. He dons his favorite sash, whose folds are exquisitely worked in gold.

old: Nothing is in situ, everything is in motion, and the seated must prepare for the next moment where the memory of leisure is burned in neurotic effigy. The stool abides these truths.
