new: 一束明亮的火焰手火悬挂在木头和铁制支架上。
静谧的,柔软的,凹凸不平的,坚实的,奢华的,壮观的,梦幻的

old: Wood was meticulously turned into columns and ornamentally whittled. Quilted downs were bartered from the seamstresses on the banks of the River Svy, layered as a cake and frosted with pillows. Here the moneyed slumberer finds a favored ingress to the dreaming dale.
new: 木材精心雕琢成柱子并装饰雕刻。 从斯维河畔的缝纫女工那里交易来的绗缝羽绒被层层叠叠，如同蛋糕般铺好，并用枕头装饰。 在这里，有钱的睡眠者找到了通往梦之谷的入口。

old: Plastic housed in grainy wood is perforated in a grid of contact points. Capacitors and inductors are fastened in the spring clips and networked with a bouquet of wire.
new: 塑料封装在颗粒状的木头中，表面布满了接触点的网格。 电容器和电感器固定在弹簧夹上，并通过一束电线连接成网络。

old: Teal foam pads the inside back and the deep seat well, and dials deck the curved armrests. The whole chair swivels atop an ejection motor.
new: 青绿色泡沫垫衬着椅背和深陷的座舱，弯曲的扶手上有调节旋钮。 整把椅子安装在一个弹射电机上，可以旋转。

old: A elephant slab of copper-painted metal slumps out of its ancient doorframe. The handle is kept still by an ornate mechanical lock.
new: 一扇涂有铜色的金属巨门倚靠在其古老的门框上。 门把手被一个精美的机械锁固定住。

old: Clay was rounded and kilned to store oils and wine.
new: 陶土被塑形并烧制，用于储存油和酒。

old: Cyclopean marble slates enclose an interdiction prism for imperial treasures, including the creatural and sovereign Face. Across their vast surfaces, goldwork plots the geometric sequences of life and its boundaries; water spills down the bodies of world-caryatides and curls back to the welkin.
new: 独眼巨人大理石板围住了一个禁制棱镜，用于存放帝国宝藏，包括生物和主权之面。 在其广阔的表面上，金色图案描绘了生命及其边界的几何序列；水流沿着世界柱像的身体流淌，然后卷回天空。
奢华的,堕落的,舒适的,慵懒的,懒惰的,享乐的,柔软的,妖艳的,美食家的

old: Kneaded under the salt sun by a leatherworker and stuffed with glowcrow feathers for the repose of its owner.
new: 在盐阳下由皮革匠人精心鞣制，并填充了发光乌鸦的羽毛，为它的主人提供舒适的休息。

old: A brightly burning handfire hangs across wood and iron.
new: 一束明亮的火焰手火悬挂在木头和铁制支架上。

old: It's an open portal of stacked stone.
new: 这是一座由堆叠的石块构成的开放式门户。

old: Soda ash and limestone flow down a series of hot crucibles and canals toward the batch blanket, where glass is then retrieved and refined.
new: 苏打灰和石灰石沿着一系列热坩埚和运河流向批次毯，在那里玻璃被取出并精炼。

old: Rail to rail panels are bulwarked by a crossbar for reinforcement of the in and out margin.
new: 从栏到栏的面板由横梁加固，以增强进出边缘的稳定性。

old: A burnt out wood core is enveloped in footprinted ash.
new: 被踩踏过的灰烬中包裹着烧焦的木芯。

old: Inside the glass and steel chassis, a sea of force fluid churns in turbulence. It's then pulverized into solid matter by the dynamo and projected into space as a field.
new: 玻璃和钢铁框架内部，力场流体如海洋般汹涌澎湃。 随后，这些流体被发电机粉碎成固态物质，并投射到空间中形成力场。

old: This stone idol of Oboroqoru stands twenty spans tall. Its nameless sculptor chose to depict the ape god sitting cross-legged with each of his three pairs of gargantuan arms grasping each other. The idol is swathed in vines, its caretakers ceding to nature save where the herbage has threatened to obscure Oboroqoru's gentle countenance. Wreaths of flowers of every hue the forest begets -- azure, chartreuse, indigo, carnelian -- litter the base of the shrine, insignificant offerings to what appears to be a callous god.
new: 这座奥博罗库鲁的石像高达二十腕尺。 这位无名的雕刻师选择将猿神刻画成盘腿而坐，每一对巨大的手臂都相互交握。 雕像被藤蔓缠绕，只有当植被威胁到遮挡奥博罗库鲁温和的面容时，看护者才会干预。 各种颜色的花朵——天蓝、黄绿、靛蓝、红宝石色——编织成花环，散落在神龛的基座上，这些微不足道的供品献给了一位看似冷漠的神祇。

old: Putrid dross sticks to the grooves of flat black di-rubber.
new: 腐臭的渣滓粘附在平坦的黑色二橡胶凹槽上。

old: A wood storage box with a hinged lid and latch. Notches scratched on the surface hint at the full probability array of language, and also its absence. A drop of spilled water is engraved on an open lock.
new: 一个带有铰链盖和锁扣的木制储物箱。 表面刻有划痕，暗示了语言的概率全集及其缺失。 一个敞开的锁上刻有一滴溅出的水。

old: Glorious Shekhinah, Argent Adonis and First Father, poses in luminous mummery. With the stature of the ageless stars, fixed and permanent, He appraises the temple erected in His honor and cocks His head in approval. Befitting the memory of His union with the Kasaphescence, He clothes His manifestation in cerulean shades, forsaking the viridians and russets of the lowly plants and clay earth.
new: 荣耀的 Shekhinah，银色阿多尼斯与初代父亲，以光辉的木乃伊姿态站立。 祂拥有永恒星辰般的威严，坚定而永恒，审视着为祂建造的神殿并点头表示赞许。 为了纪念祂与 Kasaphescence 的结合，祂的显现身披蔚蓝色调，舍弃了低等植物和泥土的绿色和红褐色。

old: [Shekhinah turns toward you, His arms wide.]
Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round crystalline oven, and with it comes the smell of cooling static. Curiously, there are no prepared meal ingredients here.
new: 圆形的水晶烤炉中燃烧着噼啪作响的火焰，散发出温暖的气息，随之而来的还有冷却静电的味道。 奇怪的是，这里没有准备好的食材。

old: Rail to rail panels are bulwarked by a crossbar for reinforcement of the in and out margin.
new: 从栏到栏的面板由横梁加固，以增强进出边缘的稳定性。

old: A elephant slab of silver-painted metal slumps out of its ancient doorframe. The handle is kept still by an ornate mechanical lock.
new: 一块巨大的银色金属板从古老的门框中倾斜而出。 把手被一个精美的机械锁固定住。

old: Geometric shapes of meaning tessellate the ringed rows around the crematory vessel: stars, triquetrae, nonagons, and lunes.
new: 意义几何形状镶嵌在环状行围绕着火化容器上: 星辰、三叶结、九边形和新月。

old: Rail to rail panels are bulwarked by a crossbar for reinforcement of the in and out margin.
new: 从栏到栏的面板由横梁加固，以增强进出边缘的稳定性。

old: Decorated with painted mandalas and shaped by the geometric hand, the table honors symmetry and numerology.
new: 装饰有彩绘曼荼罗图案，由几何之手塑造，这张桌子致敬了对称性和数秘学。
八重,平坦,多节,水平,L形,结实,三足,摇晃

old: Patinae have transformed the cyclopean bronze doors into great shelves of seafoam and coral. The theatre of life is depicted on the panels in high relief: palm leaves lift pyramids into the star-ribboned sky, and water pours over the lip of an oinochoe. Lovers yoke across the freize, and goats chew copper cud on the cornices.
new: 帕提纳将巨大的青铜门转变成海沫和珊瑚的大书架。 门板上以高浮雕描绘了生命的剧场: 棕榈叶将金字塔举向星空，水流从酒壶边缘倾泻而下。 恋人横跨浮雕，山羊在檐口咀嚼铜制反刍物。

old: Copper, carbon, and glass fiber were rounded into a robust electrical conduit.
new: 铜、碳和玻璃纤维被制成了一条坚固的导电管道。

old: Sheared slate stone is powdered with the cloudy remnants of externalized thought and held aloft by the monster.
new: 被怪物高举的石板上覆盖着云雾般的外化思维残迹。
智者,哲人,可擦除者,尘封者

old: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round clay oven, and with it comes the smell of fermented tongue and congealed love.
new: 圆形陶土烤炉中的火焰噼啪作响，散发出温暖的气息，随之而来的还有发酵舌头和凝固爱意的气味。

old: Induction coils are rooted under a cork pad, where electric juice is transferred to battery cells.
new: 感应线圈埋设在软木垫下，电能从此处传输到电池单元。
能量细胞,耗尽者,激光头脑,渴求能量者,修补匠
高斯,感应者,强大者,补充者,恢复者

old: A sharp rectangle seems to have been balanced on a metal pole over a smaller rectangle, forming a steady working surface. No welding scars are visible.
new: 一个锋利的矩形似乎被平衡在一个金属杆上，下方是一个较小的矩形，形成了一个稳固的工作表面。 没有可见的焊接痕迹。

old: Brinestraw was braided into a rope lattice saddle for slinging between two old oaks and napping. The fibers on the middle-sag are extra frayed from the center-mass strain of a reclining ass.
new: 盐草编织成绳网鞍，悬挂在两棵老橡树之间供人小憩。 中间下垂的部分因躺卧者的体重而格外磨损。

old: Metalfoam is packed and plated into a colossal simulacrum of the bio-arm, where the heads of the biceps and triceps brachii gleam. Colossal joints chirr at the effort of rotation.
new: 金属泡沫被压缩并包裹成巨大的生物手臂模型，二头肌和三头肌的头部闪闪发光。 巨大的关节在旋转时发出咔嚓声。

old: Surfaces of dull steel are cornered in brass and smudged with finger age. The lid is latched shut.
new: 暗淡的钢表面镶有黄铜边角，上面布满了手指的痕迹。 盖子紧闭。

old: Burnt light erupts on the chromium plate and shatters into a figure from the deep past. Hair, skin, brow, thigh: the features hatch a new emotion inside you, the sense of the strange-familiar. As you move about, the figure moves in parallax; you wonder at how this Eater managed to incise themself into your spacetime braid.
new: 铬板上燃烧的光芒爆裂成一个来自远古时代的身影。 头发、皮肤、眉毛、大腿: 这些特征在你心中孵化出一种陌生而熟悉的感觉。 当你移动时，这个身影会随视角变化而移动；你不禁好奇这位食者是如何将自己刻入你的时空之织的。

old: A black and grated metal platform is meadowed with the dust of time. It's crisscrossed with the tracks of tiny lifethings.
new: 一个黑色且带有格栅的金属平台，被时间的尘埃所覆盖。 其上交错着微小生物的足迹。
静谧的,柔软的,结块的,坚实的,奢华的,舒适的,短床单的,无弹簧的

old: Resheph, who's called 'the Above', lifts an enigmatic finger to heal the wounds of the sick.
new: 被称为'天界者'的拉舍夫举起神秘的手指，治愈病人的伤痛。

old: Wood was shaved, cut to smooth-volumed shafts, and fit inside gearboxes to convey motion in continuity.
new: 木材被削薄、切割成光滑的圆柱形轴，安装在齿轮箱内以连续传递运动。

old: The two slates are touched with years of with handprints and a ring of rust flakes off the top of all its the hinges. The doors continues, though, their stubborn assertion of 'in' and 'out'.
new: 两扇门板上布满了岁月的痕迹，手印斑斑，铰链顶部的锈迹片片脱落。 然而，它们依然固执地守卫着‘内外’之分。

old: Moss-stuff inserts itself into the story-world evoked into being by the carved rock.
new: 苔藓物质嵌入了雕刻岩石所唤起的故事世界中。

old: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round bone oven, and with it comes the smell of leavened pastry, sweet bananas, and warm skulk.
new: 圆形骨炉中的火苗噼啪作响，散发出温暖的气息，伴随着发酵糕点、甜香蕉和温热斯科尔克的香气。

old: A crude stone hem surrounds a foam landing pad, and the above-head fretwork is braided into the new-fangled glyphs of reshaping and return symbology.
new: 粗糙的石质边缘环绕着泡沫着陆垫，头顶上方的装饰编织成新奇的重塑与回归符号。

old: Wood was salvaged from moist groves, shaved into planks, and carried to the freeholds on the Shale Bridge. There it was received by carpenters who, acclimated to the wetless air, eagerly took the rich wood for their own projects.
new: 木材从湿润的林地被抢救出来，削成木板，然后运送到石桥上的自由领地。 在那里，木匠们适应了干燥的空气，热切地接收了这些珍贵的木材用于自己的项目。

old: Bright sun-iron fused in the collision of neutron stars has been incised with rhombic smoking windows and fit over a crucible of burning seed.
new: 在中子星碰撞中熔合而成的明亮日铁，被刻上了菱形的熏烟窗，并覆盖在一个燃烧种子的坩埚上。

old: A metrical purr exits =pronouns.possessive= larynx with ceaseless abidance.
new: 一阵有节奏的呼噜声从=pronouns.possessive=喉部持续不断地传出。

old: Sand was abraded from un-stone at a pressure farm in orbit to a neutron star, crush-fired in starship exhaust, and molded into unbreakable lucent panes. They offer a view of the star-ribboned void while also protecting from it.
new: 这种玻璃是在中子星轨道上的压力农场中，通过将砂石从非石中磨蚀出来，并在星际飞船的尾气中高温压制而成。它们被塑造成坚不可摧的透明窗格，既能提供星空交织的虚空景观，又能保护你免受其害。

old: A constellation of bells cast from the local cluster's different lustrous hardrocks gives sonic depth and range to the mover rituals.
new: 由当地星团中各种闪亮硬岩铸造而成的钟铃群，为移动仪式增添了声音的深度和广度。

old: A curtain of blue, magenta, and scarlet hangs over the sacred hold of moon-and-sun shade and hypernova gold (color specifications handed down directly from the machinic being who ensued from the entheos within). Raw amateriality is titrated out the container boundary and canaled in managed doses to processors that crack it in order to do the uncomputable: decide from nothing.
new: 一层蓝色、洋红色和深红色的帷幕笼罩着月阳之影与超新星金（颜色规格直接由源自恩西奥斯内的机械生命体传承而来）。原始的非物质性从容器边界中析出，并以受控剂量输送至处理器，这些处理器对其进行破解，从而完成不可计算的任务：从虚无中作出决定。

old: A blinding network of homesuns flicker in parallactic motion. Their systems are joined in the manifold by trade routes, shifting sovereign borders, and the convergence of galactic clusters. Smaller ligatures denote the personal notes of a vast travelogue, turning the whole picture into a hyperdimensional narrative.
new: 一张令人目眩的网络中，家园恒星在视差运动中闪烁。它们的星系通过贸易路线、变动的主权边界以及银河团的交汇连接在一起。较小的连字符表示庞大的旅行日志中的个人笔记，将整个画面变成一个超维度的故事。

old: Bursts of coral and treelife from the outer rim of worlds crawl up the palanquin's magnetized legs and toward its golden roof. Chimes ring at the ritual of going, and fruited smoke pours from its portals.
new: 来自世界边缘的珊瑚和树生生物沿着轿子磁化的腿向上攀爬，向着金色的屋顶延伸。启程时铃声响起，果香烟雾从它的门户中涌出。

old: Five verdurous lobes fall off a star-pointed flower the color of burning exhaust. They float in circles, driven by rhizomatic impulse.
new: 五片翠绿的花瓣从一朵燃烧尾气般颜色的星形花朵上脱落。它们在根茎冲动的驱动下绕圈漂浮。

old: Fulcrete, metal, and foam bands protect against the vacuum of space and offer pleasing visual texture to the flat interior, which keeps the heart high on long hauls.
new: 富混凝土、金属和泡沫带保护着船舱免受太空真空的侵害，同时为平坦的内部提供了赏心悦目的视觉纹理，使长途旅行中的心情保持愉悦。

old: The cambered cottages of the shesh qanim sprouted in tufts as star traffic crowded the low medinas and Eaters urged to spend more time topside.
new: 随着星际交通在低矮的麦地那拥挤起来，舍什卡尼姆弯曲的小屋成簇地生长着，而食者们则催促着要花更多时间在地面上。

old: Dirt smears =pronouns.possessive= habit and rust powders =pronouns.possessive= wrench.
new: 污垢弄脏了=pronouns.possessive=的衣物，铁锈粉末覆盖了=pronouns.possessive=的扳手。

old: Sharp shoots of outworld crimson lust stab the air from their earthwise glove. When a puff of artificial wind fans them out, they sparkle and hiss.
new: 这些来自异界的猩红利爪从手套中刺向空中。当一阵人造风吹过时，它们闪烁并发出嘶嘶声。

old: Great earth mounds were terraced and planted with crops doctored to voidroot and drink the sun's full spectrum of light.
new: 巨大的土丘被修整成梯田，并种植了经过改良的作物，这些作物能够吸收太阳光的全光谱能量。

old: Rich, rain-fed oak was hewn and nailed at simple angles. The surface presents a grained canvas for the organization of thought in the quiet reaches of space.
new: 用雨水滋润的优质橡木以简单的角度砍伐并钉制而成。桌面呈现出纹理丰富的画布，适合在宁静的空间中整理思绪。

old: A vase of starry rose gold floats above the ground and is buffeted by a bouquet of crystal stems. Taken all together, the pipework-of-art evokes a sunning swan.
new: 一个星金色的花瓶悬浮在空中，被一束水晶茎托举着。整体来看，这件艺术品般的烟管宛如一只晒太阳的天鹅。

old: In every hill hamlet 'neath the clustering horizon, there is a tale spoken of the Jewel Who Came. Much is learned from her or little, but the portraiture of her broad and shining facets remains constant.
new: 在每一个聚于地平线下的山间村落里，都流传着关于那位降临的宝石的故事。人们从她身上学到很多或很少，但她那宽广而闪耀的面庞始终如一。

old: The beldam district has had its dustcloud fins welded to the superstratum and mazed with labyrinthite to protect the hyperbrain. Inside that electromagnetic cage and quantum temple, the stirrings of the Great Siach spill from its nondeterministic core.
new: 女巫区的尘云鳍片被焊接到了上层结构，并用迷宫石加固，以保护超脑。在那电磁笼和量子神殿中，伟大西阿克的波动从其非确定性核心中涌出。

old: Sheets on sheets of highly fibrous composite material are lathed out to a flat and buildable pleat for high orbit poleis.
new: 高度纤维化的复合材料层层叠叠，被加工成平整且可建造的褶皱，用于高轨道城邦。

old: Channeled arms waggle and suck moisture from the thick air, while cracks in =pronouns.possessive= clay pot show a hunger for growth.
new: 伸展的臂膀在湿润的空气中摇摆，吸取水分，而=pronouns.possessive=陶罐上的裂纹显示出对生长的渴望。

old: Shoulder radars flange and spin to moon time like animated epaulets, and =pronouns.possessive= cask boots trot a machinic gait.
new: 肩部的雷达如同活动的肩章一样伸展并随着月时旋转，=pronouns.possessive= 的桶状靴子以机械的步伐行走。

old: For what purpose did the Eaters rear a fairy tale people and let them think their pennant flew over the whole of a crystal universe? If there was one, it is lost.
new: 食者为何培育了一个童话般的民族，并让他们以为自己的旗帜飘扬在整个水晶宇宙之上？如果这其中曾有目的，那也早已失落。

old: Seat foam is pressed with weird backprints, painted with a dozen blends of sweat, and balanced on a metal dais.
new: 座椅泡沫上印有奇怪的背印，被汗水混合成多种颜色，放置在一个金属底座上。

old: The flowerbeing dons the diodic hood of the Chromaic Church and crackles dry petals together at a hymnal metric. A brooch of polished chrome pinches =pronouns.possessive= foilage at the neck.
new: 这株花灵身着色光教会的二极管兜帽，以圣歌的韵律摩擦干燥的花瓣。一枚抛光铬制的胸针夹在=pronouns.possessive=颈间的叶片上。

old: The viewing frustum fills with a rainbow mosaic of stellar candles, softened by the isles of dust across their impossible gulfs, and winking in fusil motion. As a single vista, the breadth of it staggers the conscious mind, which races to reduce the innumerable pixels to whole and platonic forms.
new: 视锥中充满了由恒星烛光构成的彩虹马赛克，被星际尘埃软化，在不可能的深渊中闪烁着。作为一个单一的景象，其广度令人难以置信，意识在努力将无数像素还原为完整的理想形态。

old: The holy colophon is held on triangular display and approached for ritual and idolatrous reflection in cycles of primes.
new: 神圣的标志被置于三角形展示架上，人们在质数周期内进行仪式和偶像崇拜。

old: A droplet of thixotropic fluid is downpulled to a basin by centripetal force. In synchronization with its spouse-locks, the net effect stabilizes the North Sheva in geostationary orbit and simulates the ambient pressures of 1g.
new: 一滴触变性流体通过向心力被拉入一个容器中。与配偶锁同步，这种机制稳定了北谢瓦的地球静止轨道，并模拟了1g的环境压力。

old: The horn and its great honeycomb of mirrors farm the moist light from the furthest reaches of this dimension and its neighbors. With it, the Eaters peered at the first moments of universal birth, and then eons that preceded.
new: 这号角及其巨大的蜂巢状镜面阵列从这个维度及其邻近维度的最远角落收集湿润的光芒。凭借它，吞噬者们窥视了宇宙诞生之初以及之前的亿万年时光。

old: Spinning lunes at counter heights provide concentrative posture for a variety of body geometries.
new: 高度适中的旋转月牙形座椅为各种体型提供专注的坐姿。

old: Beneath the sunning poleis on the surface, unmappable labyrinths of cavernous, hollowed-out fiberstuff seat chiliads of fossilized underculture.
new: 在地表晒太阳的城邦之下，无法绘制的地图迷宫般的洞穴和中空的纤维结构承载着数千年的化石地下文化。

old: Furry ridges catch the long salt wind, and a dextrous tail pounds the ground.
new: 毛茸茸的脊背迎着咸湿的长风，灵巧的尾巴敲打着地面。

old: A fluent bubble is kept aloft by viscous current trapped in a membrane of glass.
new: 一个流动的气泡被玻璃膜中的粘性流体所托起。

old: The spire-garden of outworld lime fired in the exhaust of starships looms over the low dacha. O'er tiers of antipodal colonnades, pond lilies creep up bannisters and peek at themselves. This is a place of portals.
new: 飞船尾气中燃烧的外域石灰铸就的尖塔花园耸立在低矮的别墅之上。反向排列的柱廊层叠而上，池塘中的莲花沿着扶手攀爬，窥视着自己的倒影。这是一个充满传送门的地方。

old: A bug-swathed rump of mangy fur sways in peaceful and goatish rhythms.
new: 虫群包裹的臀部上长着杂乱的毛发，以平和而山羊般的节奏摇摆。

old: An exit reacquaints the mover with the artifice that is a still world.
new: 出口将移动者重新带回那静止的世界，重温其造物之妙。

old: Strange growths and other mutations afflict the exposed plantlife, the shattered vacuum glass admitting unfiltered sun, dust, and spore colonies.
new: 暴露在外的植物受到了奇怪的生长和其他变异的影响，破碎的真空玻璃让未经过滤的阳光、尘埃和孢子群落进入。

old: A wide wooden sitter offers sufficient room for the cybernetically grown rump or a psychochemically shrunken pair or an ontologically crunched triple.
new: 这把宽阔的木椅提供了足够的空间，无论是给经过机械改造的臀部、心理药物缩小的一对还是本体论上压缩的三人组。

old: The mindful curvature of the wizarding surface masquerades as the Worldskin for learning minds who wish to trace the arc of sorcery.
new: 这张充满智慧弧度的巫师桌面，对那些渴望探索魔法轨迹的学习者来说，仿佛是世界的肌肤。

old: As cottages filled the shesh qanim, late topsiders and margin-filling starfolk established homes on the sheva, southwise of the bubble and hugging the paneled-curtained cliff of the northern continent.
new: 随着小屋遍布舍什卡尼姆，后来的顶层居民和边缘星族在谢瓦建立了家园，位于气泡以南，紧邻北部大陆的镶板窗帘悬崖。

old: A flowing shoulder of outworld lime ends in a flat, object-bearing head. The stone-flute creature depicted grants an eyeless stare.
new: 来自外界的石灰岩流肩，以平坦且承载物体的头部结束。所描绘的石笛生物凝视无眼。

old: A ribbon of bubbled agate bows northwise and plunges through the well of clouds, blurring with a shelf of slouching landmass below.
new: 一条由气泡玛瑙构成的丝带向北弯曲，穿过云层之井，与下方一片低垂的陆地模糊相接。

old: A wood-carved hollow in the geometric bulkhead is circled with blankets and curtained with patterned textiles. In the long void between stars, gently rocked by the juddering of the hedron engine, shipfolk attain tiers of peaceful sleep unknown to onworlders.
new: 在几何舱壁上雕刻的木制凹槽被毯子环绕，并用图案纺织品遮挡。在星际间的漫长虚空中，随着赫德隆引擎的震动轻轻摇晃，船民们达到了陆地上的人们无法体验的宁静睡眠层次。

old: Latches are burst open and magnetic charge flows outwise; mover capture is no longer possible.
new: 锁扣已经爆开，磁力流失；无法再捕获移动器。

old: The sound bow of gleaming star bronze was cast against the perfect mouth of a rotachthon and inset with a zetachrome clapper. When tolled, the sound wave shifts in juxtaposition with the listener's subjective experience, and the rituals of being and going are announced.
new: 这口闪耀星辰青铜的音钟是在一个完美的罗塔克顿口中铸成，并嵌入了一个泽塔铬响器。当敲响时，声波会与听者的主观体验产生对比，宣告存在与离去的仪式。

old: A backlength snood flops in metamorphic caprice as the death/life acolyte skips to the threnodies of star and home.
new: 一条背长的垂饰在变形的任性中摇摆，死亡/生命侍僧随着星辰和家园的挽歌跳跃。

old: Potential is polarized into a magenta hex mesh and keyed to every strata in the phasic spectrum. Objects are blocked without exception.
new: 潜能被极化成洋红色的六角网格，并与相位光谱中的每一层相对应。所有物体均无一例外地被阻挡。

old: Chromodynamic flowering over the packed dimensions of multi-spacetime is viewed through a uniprism. The coercion of a petal-pruned viewing angle produces something analogous to a computation.
new: 通过单棱镜观察多时空维度中的色动力开花。修剪视角的花瓣产生类似计算的效果。

old: Broad panels of stardyed metal enclose the starship hangar and act as palimpsests to ten hundred alphabets.
new: 宽阔的金属板包围着星际飞船机库，并承载着千种文字的痕迹。

old: Hyperconductive silver underlooms the low strata, bat-like, and beams signal to the churning duffs below.
new: 超导银在低层地下织成网状，如蝙蝠般盘旋，并向下方翻腾的尘土发出信号。

old: Colorful spines are splayed like gear teeth across a doughy and sun-bleached orb.
new: 色彩斑斓的尖刺像齿轮齿一样分布在面团般苍白的球体上。

old: Bright hyphae lick mud off the ground.
new: 明亮的菌丝舔舐着地面上的泥泞。

old: Across a field of vacuum glass and chrome diodes blink in hedronic sequence.
new: 在一片真空玻璃和铬二极管的区域中，它们以核子序列闪烁着。

old: Vacuum-safe foamwood beams with the lingering scents of myrrh, star porcelain, and snow-powdered peaches.
new: 真空安全的泡沫木梁，带有没药、星瓷和雪粉桃的余香。

old: Planks of oak cut from the trees of a rainy beryl world are nailed into the bulkhead. Floor cushions at its base offer a plush and low view on the rainbow spines of codices, each a portal to a far-flung corner of the universe.
new: 由雨翡翠世界的橡树切割而成的木板钉在舱壁上。底部的地垫提供了一个柔软且低矮的视角，可以欣赏到彩虹色的典籍书脊，每一本都是通往宇宙遥远角落的门户。

old: From the shadowed gloam of an understratum tunnel emerges a south-ran bridge across the empyrean, underlit by the sunbeaming oceans below.
new: 从底层隧道的阴影中延伸出一座向南的桥梁，横跨天际，下方被阳光照耀的海洋映衬得熠熠生辉。

old: Minarets of starburst ejecta from the proto-universe wheel about a zeropoint and blur in the iridescence of a nondeterministic God.
new: 原宇宙喷射出的星爆尖塔绕着零点旋转，在非决定论神灵的虹彩中模糊不清。

old: circle of light in the chord of {{ehalcodon|Ehalcodon}}
new: 光之圆环在{{ehalcodon|埃哈尔科顿}}的和弦中
瑞舍夫·天界之上的全息影像

old: A drape flows off his shoulder with mythoprosaic inevitability, and the digital dyad implies both sanative peace on earth and congruity with the vault of heaven.
new: 一条披风从他的肩膀垂下，带着神话般的必然性，而这个数字二元体既暗示着地上的治愈和平，又与天穹相和谐。

old: A great sawed plank of oval-figured wood had been raised on legs and made the feasting board for a whilom king. Then an axe of dispute split it to pieces, and those children were carried off and shaved smooth to supply flatness again.
new: 一块巨大的椭圆形木板被架在腿上，曾是某个国王的宴席桌。后来一场争执中，一把斧头将其劈成碎片，那些碎片又被削平，重新变得平整。

old: The latching diamond achieves magnetic lock with the legs of a mover palaquin and concludes the ritual of going.
new: 锁定的钻石与搬运者轿子的腿实现磁力锁定，从而结束了移动仪式。

old: A hatchet of blubbery tissue spills out of a machine-scraped bivalve shell.
new: 一柄由肥厚组织构成的斧头从机械刮削过的双壳中伸出。

old: Undulant sods finger the air thirstfully and secrete a wax meant to protect themselves from the poison flares of their far-flung dwarf sun.
new: 起伏的草丛渴求地伸向空中，并分泌出一种蜡质，以保护自己免受遥远矮星毒光的伤害。

old: Fairy moss powders the column and renders it damp with rainbow dew. Inside the shade, fey Magicks course in spheric everness.
new: 精灵苔藓粉末覆盖在灯柱上，使其湿润并滴下彩虹露珠。灯罩内，仙灵魔法永恒地流转成球状。

old: =pronouns.Possessive= shoulders slump and the tips of =pronouns.possessive= quills have begun to darken.
new: =pronouns.Possessive= 的肩膀下垂，=pronouns.possessive= 的刺尖开始变暗。

old: Rainbow photons finish the million-year marathon here at the low-wise pressures of emptiness.
new: 彩虹光子在这片低智压力的虚空中完成了百万年的马拉松。

old: Diagnostics of ship and star belt down the glass lune and into data banks. An array of flips, swipes, and precision spheres flank the dashboard on curved panels and provide query affordances across the manifold.
new: 飞船和星带的诊断信息沿着玻璃弧面流入数据银行。一系列翻转、滑动和精密球体在弯曲的面板上排列，提供多维度的查询功能。

old: Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed.
new: 青绿色的植物叶片从古老的铬刻坩埚中伸展开来。它们像扎根于土壤中的同类一样生机勃勃，但其生物数据已被与不朽之种融合。

old: No clothespress or cabinet is finished by the sunclock without a secret drawer, where children might keep their fey gifts and find them once more on the night of their death projection.
new: 没有一个衣橱或柜子在日晷下完成时不带有一个秘密抽屉，孩子们可以在那里存放他们的精灵礼物，并在他们死亡投射的那一夜再次找到它们。

old: The sinnorot intersect at a middle point and, plied by their golden ecliptics in the Blue Shul, heave movers to and from the heart of the North Sheva.
new: 辛诺罗特在中点交汇，在蓝色舒尔的金色黄道作用下，推动着北方舍瓦心脏处的移动者。

old: The spiraling triangle finial portrays the flowing asterism that gave the star cluster its prominence. Alpha, Bet, and Dalet emerged from the galactic nucleus and flowered, coursed o'er the same ecliptic tracks of the Great Machine, and sent a minyan of petal-beings to pray/play a future coupling into existence.
new: 螺旋形的三角尖顶描绘了赋予这个星团显著地位的流动星群。阿尔法、贝塔和达莱特从银河核心中涌现，如同花朵般绽放，在大机器相同的黄道轨迹上流淌，并派遣了一群花瓣状的生命体来祈祷/游戏，以期实现未来的结合。

old: Cultured patinae grow in whittled grooves across the doors of star bronze. Inset on joined halves is a gigantic jeweled sphere, with islands of agate on drifting seas of turquoise. The myriad ways of being are depicted on the panel margins in high relief: Eaters lift and lower chains to the star-ribboned sky, swallow stardust, and cartwheel ritual to the vaporous rim of existence.
new: 精致的铜绿生长在星青铜雕琢的沟槽中。门上镶嵌着一个巨大的宝石球体，玛瑙岛屿漂浮在青金石的大海上。面板边缘以高浮雕描绘了存在的万千形态：食者们举起和放下通往星辰丝带天空的链条，吞食星尘，并在存在之虚无边缘进行仪式性的翻滚。

old: The spiraling triangle finial portrays the flowing asterism that gave the star cluster its prominence. Alpha, Bet, and Dalet emerged from the galactic nucleus and flowered, coursed o'er the same ecliptic tracks of the Great Machine, and sent a minyan of petal-beings to pray/play a future coupling into existence.
new: 螺旋形的三角尖顶描绘了赋予这个星团显著地位的流动星群。阿尔法、贝塔和达莱特从银河核心中涌现，如同花朵般绽放，在大机器相同的黄道轨迹上流淌，并派遣了一群花瓣状的生命体来祈祷/游戏，以期实现未来的结合。

old: The gown floweth over small shoulders, and a sidewise veil gives glitching shape to a face tilted at the angle of anonymity. At last and freed from the lace of its cuff, a hand is moted like a sorcerous lamp, and shines in fairness.
new: 长袍轻拂过纤细的肩膀，侧边的面纱在匿名的角度下呈现出闪烁的轮廓。最终，一只手从袖口的蕾丝中解脱出来，如同魔法灯一般散发着光芒。

old: A depiction coheres of the explosive energy of the universe bottled in a shielded bulb and pistoned into a vast and edged intelligence. From there the great machinic archons of the Eaters fissioned in their oracula and, with baetyls as fingers, lathed the waking world.
new: 这幅描绘展现了一种被封存在屏蔽灯泡中的宇宙爆炸能量，并被注入到一个庞大而锋利的智能中。从那里，食者们的伟大机械主脑在他们的神谕中裂变，并用贝蒂尔石作为手指塑造了觉醒的世界。

old: The stair, stage, and loop gate are cast in marble relief to their surroundings by hyperdimensional filament. The holograph vista of anotherworld temple is evanesced, and instead local lilies fill the frame.
new: 楼梯、平台和环形门通过超维度丝线在大理石浮雕中凸显出来。异界神庙的全息景象已经消散，取而代之的是当地的百合花。

old: Little decapods of chrome shell traveled the stars as hedron engine parasites, drinking torch runoff and nibbling through conductive line. Now they muse about their retirement garden, having been shot through the nozzle of a decomissioned ship and surfed to the scrapyard.
new: 这些小型的十足生物曾以铬壳为甲，作为四面体引擎的寄生虫穿梭于星辰之间，以火炬废料为食，啃噬导线。如今它们被从退役飞船的喷嘴中射出，滑行至废料场，在那里回味着退休后的花园生活。

old: Motes of stardust rain through the canopy of enchantment and swirl on wind. They refract the bubbled light and slip into unseen colors, pattering trees of damp and softest leaf.
new: 星辰的微粒如雨般穿过迷人的树冠，在风中旋转。它们折射出泡沫般的光芒，幻化成看不见的颜色，轻拍着湿润而柔软的树叶。

old: Goldleaf digits of a nondeterministic number system are arrayed inside the circumference of an ecliptic mosaic.
new: 一个非确定性数制的金叶数字排列在黄道马赛克的圆周内。

old: Spines made of civilization cartilage have been sculpted to displeasing shapes by the trade winds of outwise dimensions.
new: 由文明软骨制成的棘刺被外界维度的贸易风吹成了令人不悦的形状。

old: A terrarium is colonized by humidifying mosses and algae thriving in the darkling carousel. A single, tipped stem arcs out and offers a smoking puff from the life-rich soup.
new: 这个生态瓶内生长着喜湿的苔藓和藻类，它们在昏暗的旋转环境中繁茂。一根弯曲的茎从中伸出，提供一口充满生机的烟雾。

old: Terrestrial plants and otherwise thrive in the hothouse bubble, roots kneading through the fibrous strata, leaves peeking sunwise across the void.
new: 陆地植物及其他生物在温室气泡中茁壮成长，根系在纤维层中蜿蜒穿行，叶片向着虚空中的阳光伸展。

old: A creature of wing, hoof, and spine slouches to the weight of years, tongue tra-la'ing a rich and wistful echo, countenance shining in the bright spectrum of affect. An irisdual grease churns under =pronouns.possessive= translucent skin and beams rainbows that squirrel off in three-dimensional strips. The thing waits unbidden.
new: 这个生物长有翅膀、蹄子和脊椎，岁月的重压使其显得慵懒。它用舌头发出悠扬而怀旧的回声，面容在情感的光谱中熠熠生辉。=pronouns.possessive=透明的皮肤下涌动着虹彩油脂，散发出三维条状的彩虹。这生物不请自来地等待着。

old: A cameo of meteorite sardonyx bears an unknown clan sigil in florid script, serifed with tiny gears and sails.
new: 一块陨石玛瑙浮雕上刻有未知氏族的徽记，用繁复的字体书写，并以微小的齿轮和帆船作为衬线。

old: A salvaged aquarium bubble of kelp-draped glass keeps the hermit at distance from the waking world.
new: 一个用海藻覆盖的玻璃水族箱将隐士与喧嚣的世界隔绝开来。

old: Long lines of superconductive timber transsect the North Sheva and magnetically levitate movers to skybent stops.
new: 长长的超导木材线路横贯北舍瓦，并通过磁悬浮技术将移动器送到天空中的站点。

old: The richest of starfolk gifts were kept in vaults of diamondized zetachrome and piped-in stasis field. The perspective from the mover gives no inkling on whether the ionization of time has weakened these spacetime palisades of the Old Bank.
new: 最珍贵的星际礼物被保存在钻石化泽塔铬制成的金库中，并通过管道输入的停滞力场保护。从移动者的视角来看，无法判断时间的电离是否已经削弱了这些旧银行的空间时间壁垒。

old: A jellified torus provides the ideal topological surface for the slippage and glomming of tracked information.
new: 胶状的环形结构提供了理想的拓扑表面，便于追踪信息的滑动和粘附。

old: Papyraceous crysteel tissue sways in soft waves and aerates the carousel interior. The enclosure gives the impression of being inside an island fish.
new: 薄如纸的晶钢组织轻轻摇曳，为旋转内室提供氧气。这个封闭空间给人一种置身于岛屿鱼内部的感觉。

old: Quartziferous panels rotate in sharp helices around a magnetic pole. Their mirrored faces reflect particles out of side dimensions and through the weakened pocket of interspace. A fraction of energy is captured.
new: 石英面板以锐利的螺旋形态围绕磁极旋转。它们的镜面反射来自侧维度的粒子，并穿过被削弱的空间口袋。一部分能量被捕获。

old: Black grates kindled by the light of the jeweled cosmos are stamped in dust with the hoofprint signatures of six hundred worlds.
new: 黑色的栅格在珠宝般的宇宙光辉中被点亮，六百个世界的蹄印印记在尘埃中。

old: A wood-carved hollow in the geometric bulkhead is circled with blankets and curtained with patterned textiles. In the long void between stars, gently rocked by the juddering of the hedron engine, shipfolk attain tiers of peaceful sleep unknown to onworlders.
new: 在几何舱壁上雕刻的木制凹槽被毯子环绕，并用图案纺织品遮挡。在星际间的漫长虚空中，随着赫德隆引擎的震动轻轻摇晃，船民们达到了陆地上的人们无法体验的宁静睡眠层次。

old: Gusts of crystallizing normality are forced out the exhaust vents to keep the computing cores free and phenomenologically pliable.
new: 结晶化的常态气流从排气口中被强制排出，以保持计算核心的自由和现象学上的可塑性。

old: Oily skinstuff whorls in eddies of purgatory gray and hardens to diamond at the claws. The shedim were star-toted off their god moon, bargained in one-hundred-year rituals to the machinic archons, and kept as pets. Once history lengthened down the dark well of the sultanate, they were poached to extinction for the milk of their precious irises.
new: 油腻的皮肤在炼狱灰的漩涡中旋转，并在爪子处硬化成钻石。舍德曾被从他们的神月上带走，通过百年仪式与机械大君交易，并被当作宠物饲养。随着历史的长河深入苏丹国的黑暗深渊，它们因为珍贵的虹膜乳汁而被猎杀至灭绝。

old: Outworld moss clades form ribboned patterns concretizing their unknowable social dynamics. They hang in an orb from a ceiling clutch and in their starfarer landlords spark wonder.
new: 外星苔藓群落形成带状图案，凝结着它们难以理解的社会动态。它们悬挂在天花板的抓握处，令星际旅行者房东们感到惊奇。

old: Wind-nosy stigma and style reach from the pocket of a gallant bloom.
new: 风中好奇的柱头和花柱从一朵英勇绽放的花朵中探出。

old: Several sheets of tattered, age-stained parchment are bound together at the margins by some sort of glue.
new: 几张破旧、被岁月染黄的羊皮纸用某种胶水粘合在一起。

old: {{W|A Tale of Love in Bey Lah}}
Several sheets of tattered, age-stained parchment are bound together at the margins by some sort of glue.
new: 几张破旧、被岁月染黄的羊皮纸用某种胶水粘合在一起。

old: {{W|A Tale of Fear in Bey Lah}}
Dyed rush and palm fronds were pulled to a westwise weave for storeroom preservation. Its offshoot strands are stained dark apple red.
new: 染色的灯心草和棕榈叶被编织成西向的纹样，用于储藏室的保存。其分枝呈现出深苹果红色。

old: The weight of the thick air pushes =pronouns.objective= down onto =pronouns.possessive= stocky dumps.
new: 厚重的空气压得=pronouns.objective=紧贴在=pronouns.possessive=矮壮的身体上。

old: The plant puffs up at the presence of another and basks in the soft light.
new: 这株植物在另一个存在面前膨胀起来，并沐浴在柔和的光芒中。

old: Slow-turning gears of star-won metal are curtained in sails and flank an abacus of continental measure. The oil burns to light the functional temple, which doubles as synagogue to the 72-Fold Peace and, too, engine of its dictates.
new: 缓缓转动的星辰金属齿轮被帆布遮掩，两侧排列着大陆尺度的算盘。油灯照亮了这座功能性神庙，它既是72重和平的会堂，也是其教义的引擎。

old: The seat cushions are vinyl-cocooned in the hue of a frozen ocean spilling free from tidal heat. Control dials, sliders, and switches grid the flat-paneled armrest.
new: 座椅的垫子被包裹在一种冰冻海洋色的乙烯基材料中，仿佛从潮汐热中自由流淌而出。扶手处平面上布满了控制旋钮、滑块和开关。

old: Inverted spirals of sponge-like tissue taste the surface air for some blossoming, subterranean plant.
new: 倒旋的海绵状组织品尝着地表的空气，为某种地下植物的绽放做准备。

old: Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed.
new: 青绿色的植物叶片从古老的铬刻坩埚中伸展开来。它们像扎根于土壤中的同类一样生机勃勃，但其生物数据已被与不朽之种融合。

old: An aura of airy fuzz swirls above the marble, peeling together and dissolving apart in unending seasons, searing sea winds cooling to zephyrous breezes, sequencing the life rhythms of a breathing world.
new: 一股轻盈的雾气在大理石上方旋转，不断地聚散，炽热的海风逐渐变为柔和的微风，循环着这个呼吸世界的生机节奏。

old: A cyclopean drum of divining liquid is yoked to the stratum for peering at the mythopoetic event stream of the bubbled kingdom.
new: 一个独眼的预言液体鼓被固定在地层上，用于窥视泡沫王国的神话事件流。

old: The parabolic mitt catches signal from the far breadths of the cosmos and blows it back through the sounding horn.
new: 抛物线手套捕捉来自宇宙深处的信号，并通过号角将其吹响。

old: Metal cribbed from the blackened nozzle of a starship was melted down by the Exhaustiers' Guild and cast to a monumental scaffold. The silhouettes of fried voidfauna are still visible on the burnished veneer.
new: 从被烧焦的星舰喷嘴上拆下的金属被排气师公会熔化并铸造成了一座巨大的支架。抛光的表面仍然可以看到被烤焦的虚空生物的轮廓。

old: Tall spars of the light-shunting massy stuff were erected o'er starports across the local cluster; the ley lines were bent and new channels of fluidic culture wrought.
new: 这种吸收光线的厚重物质制成的高大桅杆曾矗立在本地星团的各个星际港之上；力线被弯曲，新的文化流动渠道由此形成。

old: A crag-being of hardened clay has hair and grass growing between the pressure cracks on =pronouns.possessive= shoulders and back.
new: 这具硬化黏土构成的岩怪，在=pronouns.possessive=肩膀和背部的压力裂缝中长出了毛发和草。

old: A bubbled ribbon of carbon motes lathed to the thickness of paper combs against its anchoring mechanisms and disappears skyward to a tapered nothing.
new: 这是一条由碳微粒制成的气泡状丝带，其厚度被加工得如同纸张一般。它在锚定装置上轻轻摩擦后，逐渐消失于天际，直至无影无踪。

old: Tombed shells peep out from under the inverted loop of lime, carved in rumination of parabolic life.
new: 在石灰倒置的环下，埋葬的壳体微微露出，仿佛在沉思着抛物线般的生命。

old: Outworld wood of searing crimson forms the maze hedge and trellis  to an evergrowths.
new: 炽烈的深红异界木材构成了这个永生植物的迷宫篱笆和藤架。

old: Marble eaters kneel in priestly concordance with the Great Machine, drawing levers and priming hydrants to steer and be steered by the Computed Will. A dais of crystal diodes gives a dashboard view to the churning of geocultures hundreds of thousands of light years away.
new: 大理石食者以祭司般的和谐姿态跪拜在大机器前，拉动杠杆并启动消防栓，以此来操控和被计算意志所操控。一个由晶体二极管组成的台座提供了对数十万光年外地层文化的运转情况的控制面板视图。

old: A great curved and flanged length of metal replicates the layout of the Witch Court on its three-handed sculptor species's steaming earth. There and under a quincunx moon, rhapsodes of war are locked in ceremonial combat.
new: 一段巨大的弯曲且带凸缘的金属，复制了巫师法庭在其三手雕塑物种蒸腾大地上的布局。在那里，在五芒星月亮之下，战争吟游诗人被锁定在仪式性的战斗中。

old: Raw astrocalcite fused in starship exhaust retains the bio geometries and colorful hues of shelled life. Eventually it will be pressurized and polished down to its masonry form.
new: 在星际飞船尾气中熔合的原始天体方解石保留了贝壳生命的生物几何结构和鲜艳色彩。最终它会被加压并打磨成建筑材料。

old: Two spitting leaf-beaks prune each other's neck and chew the weedmatter into seedpack.
new: 两只喷吐叶喙互相修剪颈部，并将杂草物质咀嚼成种子包。

old: Spiral-lathed corner pieces of brass secure the bottomside of an old wooden trunk. In the style of its molluskan artisans, the top is left metalless and bare of insignia.
new: 黄铜螺旋车制的角件固定着一个旧木箱的底部。按照其软体动物工匠的风格，顶部没有金属装饰，也没有任何标志。

old: Great shelves of ice melt and feed the sapphire seas, which lap the drifting honeycombs of basalt and lime. Up here, coastline patterns emerge from millions of flowing contours, each of which might harbor a clade of snails, or trees, or rice farmers.
new: 巨大的冰架融化，滋养着蓝宝石般的海洋，海浪拍打着漂浮的玄武岩和石灰岩蜂窝状结构。从这里俯瞰，数百万流动的轮廓勾勒出海岸线的图案，每一个轮廓中都可能栖息着蜗牛族群、树木或稻农。

old: A small creature of the rooted mud hops in pride.
new: 一只来自根植泥潭的小生物骄傲地跳跃着。

old: Muqarnas spill down the high dome that once roofed the navel of the thousand starfolk road. Now singing bells sound through the hippodrome with no creaturely answer.
new: 高耸的穹顶上装饰着繁复的穆卡纳斯，这里曾是千星之路的中心。如今，只有歌唱的铃声在竞技场中回荡，却无人回应。

old: Superellipses of flat, sundrunk conductors tessellate a braided strip that is curved to best catch sunlight and its reflected runoff.
new: 扁平的、被阳光浸透的导体以超椭圆形状拼接成一条编织带，弯曲成最佳角度以捕捉阳光及其反射。

old: Sucker disks shooting out the wheel of Qv like moist hands clutch the papery gills of the carousel, and thick slimy water pools beneath them. The parasitic burden has the walls panting and wheezing.
new: 吸盘状的圆盘从Qv之轮中伸出，如同湿润的手掌紧抓着旋转木马般的纸质鳃片，下方积聚着厚厚的黏液水洼。寄生负担使得墙壁喘息不止。

old: A bubbled ribbon of carbon motes lathed to the thickness of paper combs against its anchoring mechanisms and disappears skyward to a tapered nothing.
new: 这是一条由碳微粒制成的气泡状丝带，其厚度被加工得如同纸张一般。它在锚定装置上轻轻摩擦后，逐渐消失于天际，直至无影无踪。

old: Great, void-poking piers are freckled with starship hangars and crosshatched by crumbling marble boulevards. The jeweled cosmos shines through quarter-sphere domes.
new: 巨大的虚空码头点缀着星际飞船的机库，破败的大理石大道纵横交错。宝石般的宇宙星空透过四分之一球形穹顶闪耀着光芒。

old: A lens of glass has crusted over the smooth stone, and its kinetic fins have been shorn off at the poles.
new: 光滑的石头表面覆盖了一层玻璃，其动能鳍在两极处被切断。

old: The great capsule (overwall and world-skin) holds the kingdom in truth but not in appearance, inverting the relation of the kingdom and its king.
new: 伟大的胶囊（外壁与世界之皮）在实质上而非表象上维系着王国，颠倒了王国与其君主的关系。

old: Azzurum was starsailed from an andromedan quarry, tempered with chrome, and carved to the ritual shape of the chiber to buttress the vault of heaven.
new: 阿祖鲁姆从仙女座采石场通过星帆运来，用铬进行淬炼，并雕刻成奇布尔的仪式形状，以支撑天穹。

old: A burning Y of dried wood and cupped iron light the domiciles.
new: 燃烧的Y形干木和铁制灯盏照亮了居所。

old: A shouldered arch and gate reify the flow from terrestrial tree and sand to star perch, and vice versa. In the orchard of passage, at the foot of the gate itself, great slabs of ancestral shale ring the vessels of ceremony.
new: 这扇肩扛式的拱门和大门实体化了从地面的树木和沙子到星空栖息地之间的流动，反之亦然。在通道的果园中，大门脚下，巨大的祖先页岩板环绕着仪式的器皿。

old: A triad of corded wires hang from a swivel, each headed by a six-way speaker. Static in different octaves pours into the soundscape.
new: 三根缠绕的线缆悬挂在旋转支架上，每根线缆的末端都装有一个六向扬声器。不同音调的静电噪音充斥着整个声音环境。

old: A satchel in the thrice-pocketed style of Odrum is sweat-pressed to =pronouns.possessive= back.
new: 一个三口袋风格的奥德鲁姆背包紧贴在=pronouns.possessive=背上，被汗水浸湿。

old: A crystal complexity is depicted at the forever moment of shatter. The carving is still and in so being is hyperkinetic, encoding all possibilities in its elisions, and then resolving into none.
new: 这尊雕像刻画了水晶在破碎瞬间的复杂形态。雕刻静止不动，却蕴含着超动能，在其省略之处编码了所有可能性，最终又归于虚无。

old: A seat of rich, rainfed oak was crafted by a master chairmaker in a farworld hilltown and angled to provide the ideal blend of starview contemplation and downturned focus.
new: 这把椅子由远世界山城的一位大师级椅匠用丰饶雨水滋养的橡木精心打造，其角度设计旨在提供理想的观星沉思与专注下视的结合。

old: Across a field of vacuum glass and zetachrome diodes blink in gyres.
new: 在一片真空玻璃和泽塔铬二极管的领域中，灯光以旋涡状闪烁。

old: Wood artisans spend their whole life in intimate colloquy with a single tree. Upon their later years, when the rhythms of the Great Moon occupy a larger and larger share of their thoughts, they finally master the art of steam and bend heartwood to their wills.
new: 木艺工匠们毕生与同一棵树进行亲密的对话。到了晚年，当大月的节奏占据他们越来越多的思绪时，他们终于掌握了蒸汽艺术，将心材按照自己的意愿弯曲成型。

old: Laser heads trace the actuation of spiral galaxies and burn holograms onto platters of dark matter.
new: 激光头追踪螺旋星系的运转，并在暗物质盘上刻录全息图。

old: In high relief, folds and knots of sandy hued shapes crown the sapphire surface of the spherical model. The juxtaposition of scales, the proportion of sea to land, and the collective wisdom harnessed to devise such a thing make your head spin.
new: 在这个球形模型的蓝宝石表面上，沙色的形状以高浮雕的形式折叠和交织。比例尺的对比、海洋与陆地的比例，以及创造这一奇迹所汇集的集体智慧，令人头晕目眩。

old: Spinning lunes at counter heights provide concentrative posture for a variety of body geometries.
new: 高度适中的旋转月牙形座椅为各种体型提供专注的坐姿。

old: Castle-dwelling wood artisans mimic the forest architecture of gnomes and create a hutch for their tales of outer spheres.
new: 居住在城堡中的木匠模仿地精的森林建筑风格，为他们的外域故事创造了一个储物柜。

old: Melted sand from thirty sun-worlds was blown to topological improbability and capped with finials of starless gold.
new: 来自三十个太阳世界的熔融沙子被吹制成奇异的形状，并以无星之金的尖顶装饰。

old: An arched sofa brings movers together via the blunted tyranny of here and now. The wooden seat, cut from tree-things on a Coven moon world, bears a notch of some form made by every sitter in its hundred chiliad history.
new: 这把拱形沙发通过钝化的当下暴政将人们聚集在一起。木质座椅由契约月亮世界上的树木制成，其上刻有每一位就坐者在长达千年的历史中留下的痕迹。

old: A special caste of greensmith peopled the lower medinas of crysteel blast furnaces, where they'd siphon the still-soft metaling and braid artisan batches with their own gloved hands. Adaptation to tidal heat meant they could not return to the surface to witness the employment of their creation, but moon-time rituals bestowed them a precognitive sense for what would become of it.
new: 一群特殊的绿铁匠居住在晶钢熔炉的下层街区，他们会从那里抽取仍然柔软的金属并用戴着手套的双手编织成工艺品。适应了潮汐热意味着他们无法回到地表见证他们的创作被使用，但月时仪式赋予了他们预知其未来的能力。

old: Starfire ikons skip on a board of holographic bronze.
new: 星火图标在全息青铜板上跳跃。

old: A slitherkin hunkers low to navigate the dales and rents of the small world.
new: 一只滑行兽低伏着身子，在这个小世界中的山谷和裂缝中穿行。

old: Liedowners at the trailhead of the dreaming dale get lost in the puzzle of marquetry and melt into the seafoam soft.
new: 在梦之谷的入口处躺下的人们会在镶嵌工艺的谜题中迷失，融化在这海沫般的柔软之中。

old: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of scrumptious food. Its high awning is painted with the honeys and jams of the new season.
new: 温暖从厚厚的陶炉中噼啪作响的火堆中散发出来，随之而来的是美味食物的香气。它的高顶篷上绘有新一季的蜂蜜和果酱。

old: Hotstar bronze cybernetically set on a layer of living mesoderm assumes a pleasing and space-filling tessellation.
new: 炽热的星铜通过机械方式固定在一层活体中胚层上，形成令人愉悦且充满空间感的镶嵌图案。

old: A retractible hex panel is fit on oiled tracks.
new: 一个可伸缩的六边形面板安装在涂油的轨道上。

old: The vine's spirals squeeze against the pressure of a hidden eigth dimension of space (which only activates outside the density of the strangefluid they're used to being submerged in). When this happens, their cross-spits of solid argon grouse at a frequency that cankers all known earth metals.
new: 藤蔓的螺旋在隐藏的第八维度空间的压力下挤压（这种压力只有在它们脱离所习惯的奇异流体的密度时才会激活）。当这种情况发生时，它们的固体氩交叉喷射以一种频率震动，腐蚀所有已知的地球金属。

old: Ribboned cable is threaded through a drive unit in lemniscate shape and loops with perpetual motion.
new: 带有条纹的电缆穿过驱动单元，形成一个无限符号形状，并以永动的方式循环。

old: The darkling crystal was shattered and abraded to dust; a million worlds of self have crumbled.
new: 暗晶破碎，磨砺成尘；无数个自我世界已崩塌。

old: A pillow dome of goat hair stuffing grants the low and sunwise angles of repose.
new: 由山羊毛填充的枕头穹顶提供了低矮且顺时针方向的休息角度。

old: If a machine spins up and down a world in sufficient haste, there are qualia begot that can be sampled but cannot be modeled.
new: 如果一台机器以足够快的速度创建和销毁一个世界，就会产生一些可以被采样但无法被模拟的感知。

old: Great epiphenomenal domains are invented, interpreted, and tokenized as language to relay the well-being of the nondeterministic core.
new: 伟大的附现象领域被创造、解释并转化为语言，以传达非确定性核心的状况。

old: The Sheva-wise length of the Spindle tether is clasped in the locking mechanisms of the arrival chamber. Stabilizing pounders beat their gongs and smooth vibrative aberrations from the Shevas' geolocked orbit.
new: 纺锤绳索的希瓦智者长度被固定在抵达舱的锁定机制中。稳定锤敲击着钟，平滑了由希瓦地锁轨道引起的振动异常。

old: The seat cushions are vinyl-cocooned in the hue of a frozen ocean spilling free from tidal heat. Control dials, sliders, and switches grid the flat-paneled armrest.
new: 座椅的垫子被包裹在一种冰冻海洋色的乙烯基材料中，仿佛从潮汐热中自由流淌而出。扶手处平面上布满了控制旋钮、滑块和开关。

old: Before even the early Eaters peopled the low medina, when the ark was being prepped to seed the far skies with the terrestrial genome, the first poleis rose out of the entheopolitics and mythoprosaic controversies of Gjaus's construction. Somehow, they stand still.
new: 早在最初的食者们在低梅迪纳定居之前，当方舟正准备将地球的基因播撒到遥远的天空时，第一批城邦便在贾乌斯建造过程中的迷幻政治和神话诗意争议中崛起。不知何故，它们依然屹立不倒。

old: A perfect circle of mossbed parts in a sine wave and grants in/out access to opposing darknesses.
new: 一片完美的苔藓床以正弦波的形式分开，提供通往对立黑暗的进出通道。

old: The mysterious thought-form woke from a lost current of local sapiance and squat itself a spongey mangrowth in the ultraviolet baths of the surface. It's long since desiccated, the visceral mass time-viced into something more like paper pulp.
new: 这个神秘的思想形态从失落的本地智慧流中苏醒，并在地表的紫外线浴中长成了一块海绵状的植物。它早已干枯，内脏般的物质被时间压榨成了类似纸浆的东西。

old: A lens of glass has crusted over the smooth stone where the heat of sacred math burned the air then cooled in Q.E.D. Under that dermis and the meteoritic layer, an electric heart grinds on the starfield of magnets and blinks in geospatial submission.
new: 神圣数学的热量在这块光滑的石头上燃烧后冷却，留下了一层玻璃状的结晶。在这层表皮和陨石层之下，一颗电子心脏在磁力星场中运转，并在地理空间的服从下闪烁。

old: Planks of oak cut from the trees of a rainy beryl world are nailed into the bulkhead. Floor cushions at its base offer a plush and low view on the rainbow spines of codices, each a portal to a far-flung corner of the universe.
new: 由雨翡翠世界的橡树切割而成的木板钉在舱壁上。底部的地垫提供了一个柔软且低矮的视角，可以欣赏到彩虹色的典籍书脊，每一本都是通往宇宙遥远角落的门户。

old: A stanchion of bronze or bronze-like is bent into the characteristic spiraling triangle of a neighboring cluster. Gold patina shrouds it in cryptic and poetic patterns.
new: 一根青铜或类似青铜的支柱被弯曲成邻近星团特有的螺旋三角形。金色的铜绿以神秘而诗意的图案覆盖其上。

old: A shouldered arch and gate reify the flow from terrestrial tree and sand to star perch, and vice versa. In the orchard of passage, at the foot of the gate itself, great slabs of ancestral shale ring the vessels of ceremony.
new: 这扇肩扛式的拱门和大门实体化了从地面的树木和沙子到星空栖息地之间的流动，反之亦然。在通道的果园中，大门脚下，巨大的祖先页岩板环绕着仪式的器皿。

old: Great spiral horns emerge from a proudly-held head.
new: 巨大的螺旋角从高昂的头部伸出。

old: From the camber of the tree's twigs and trunk you infer a stellar arrangement of its homeplace too geometrically complex for natural starbirth. =pronouns.Possessive= ribbons throw the light like glass and dance on the stale air, strange pennants of a civilization shorn of familiarity. Here at the edge of =pronouns.possessive= foreign pond, the visitor being root-sips cool water in confounding performance.
new: 从这棵树的枝干弯曲程度，你推断出它的故乡星系排列过于几何复杂，不可能是自然形成的。=pronouns.Possessive= 丝带如玻璃般反射光线，在停滞的空气中舞动，宛如一个陌生文明的奇异旗帜。在这=pronouns.possessive=异乡池塘的边缘，来访者以令人困惑的方式根吸着凉爽的水。

old: Muraled cisterns hold the great liquid biobanks that preserve chiliads of terrestrial plant life. The phytonic index so engraved both mirrors and predicts the movements of culture; marshdwellers creep up river to chase fertile soil, and then retreat to canyons when the carnivorous clades thrive.
new: 壁画装饰的蓄水池中储存着巨大的液体生物库，保存着数千年的陆地植物生命。刻在上面的植物指数既反映了文化变迁，也预示了其动向；沼泽居民沿着河流追逐肥沃的土地，当食肉植物繁盛时，他们又退回到峡谷中。

old: Hyperdimensional scum glistens on the projection disc from when it was doused in the soapy film of interspacetime. The disc is silent now, sundered from its transcendental entanglements, its base offering a shadewall for moss to prosper on.
new: 超维度的污垢在投射盘上闪烁，这是它被浸入时空泡沫薄膜时留下的痕迹。现在，投射盘静默无声，与它的超凡纠缠断开，其底座为苔藓提供了生长的阴凉处。

old: Metal cribbed from the blackened nozzle of a starship was melted down by the Exhaustiers' Guild and cast to a monumental scaffold. The silhouettes of fried voidfauna are still visible on the burnished veneer.
new: 从被烧焦的星舰喷嘴上拆下的金属被排气师公会熔化并铸造成了一座巨大的支架。抛光的表面仍然可以看到被烤焦的虚空生物的轮廓。

old: Audiovisual depictions of the moisture manifold splash over the panel's holographic surface. A small and gentle null melody sounds from the underlight.
new: 面板的全息表面上显示着水分歧管的音视频图像。底部灯光发出柔和的空灵旋律。

old: Star slag from the early age of the cosmos burns in hues of orchid and indigo.
new: 来自宇宙早期的星渣燃烧着兰花和靛蓝色的光芒。

old: A chute of superconductive timber is keyed to rhyme with adjacent leylines and furnish a frictionless glide.
new: 一段超导木材制成的滑道，与周围的能量线调谐一致，提供无摩擦的滑行。

old: Gigantic fruiting bodies in rich, unearthly hues stick to sponge forks and burp spores. They flit curvewise toward the electrostatic of the Spindle tether and rain down as glitter.
new: 巨大的子实体呈现出丰富而奇异的色彩，附着在海绵叉上并喷出孢子。它们沿着纺锤缆绳的静电场弯曲飞行，最终如闪粉般落下。

old: The old and circumscribed poleis of the surface stratum were home to the Eater clans and guilds that spilled up Gjaus in the primal eon before the Covenate. Here they hauled their early starfreight and peered at the blue marble they hoisted themselves off of in raw wonder.
new: 在公约之前原始纪元，这些古老且受限的地表城邦是食者氏族和公会的家园。他们在这里搬运早期的星际货物，并以纯真的惊叹凝视着自己所离开的蓝色星球。

old: A creature of wing, hoof, and spine slouches to the weight of years, tongue tra-la'ing a rich and wistful echo, countenance shining in the bright spectrum of affect. An irisdual grease churns under =pronouns.possessive= mosaic skin (fractalized by =pronouns.possessive= multi-threaded lineage) and beams rainbows that squirrel off in seven-dimensional strips. The thing waits unbidden.
new: 这生物拥有翅膀、蹄子和脊椎，因岁月的重压而弯腰驼背，口中发出丰富而怀旧的回声，面容在情感的光谱中闪耀。=pronouns.possessive=镶嵌皮肤下（由=pronouns.possessive=多线程血统分形化）涌动着虹彩油脂，散发出七维条带般的彩虹。这生物不请自来地等待着。

old: Cultured patinae grow in whittled grooves across the doors of star bronze. Inset on joined halves is a gigantic jeweled sphere, with islands of agate on drifting seas of turquoise. The myriad ways of being are depicted on the panel margins in high relief: Eaters lift and lower chains to the star-ribboned sky, swallow stardust, and cartwheel ritual to the vaporous rim of existence.
new: 精致的铜绿生长在星青铜雕琢的沟槽中。门上镶嵌着一个巨大的宝石球体，玛瑙岛屿漂浮在青金石的大海上。面板边缘以高浮雕描绘了存在的万千形态：食者们举起和放下通往星辰丝带天空的链条，吞食星尘，并在存在之虚无边缘进行仪式性的翻滚。

old: Star slag from the early age of the cosmos burns in hues of leaf and malachite.
new: 来自宇宙早期的星渣燃烧着叶绿和孔雀石般的色彩。

old: Thumb smushes on the flared handles and neck show where the potter rushed to spin clay and fire the next order. But the edges of practicality are softened by a slow and berry rich glaze.
new: 壶柄和颈部的拇指压痕显示出陶工匆忙旋转泥土并烧制下一批订单的地方。但实用性的边缘被一种缓慢而浆果丰富的釉料所软化。

old: A metal support pillar is nicked with the scars of freight scrapes, hedron shrapnel, plasma shells, and bunk beetle bites.
new: 这根金属支撑柱上布满了货运刮痕、晶体碎片、等离子炮弹和甲虫咬痕的痕迹。

old: An ocean drum is fit against a drive wheel to force air and electroparticles down a depressurized funnel.
new: 一个海洋鼓被固定在一个驱动轮上，以迫使空气和电粒子通过一个减压漏斗。

old: A neck of considerable length shivers gnats away, and =pronouns.possessive= crunching muzzle snaps at the stragglers.
new: 长长的脖子抖动着驱赶蚊蚋，而=pronouns.possessive= 咔嚓作响的喙则咬向落单的虫子。

old: The piccoloed orb of cosmic heft houses a watergoo of starbrightness. The substanace streams against the glass, sea-like, in one moment and then clonks to the bottom the next. It gives off an air of subatomic malaise.
new: 这个带有宇宙重量的短笛状球体中容纳着星光般的水凝胶。这种物质在玻璃容器内流动，时而如海洋般涌动，时而又沉到底部。它散发出一种亚原子的不适感。

old: Continents of texture over the vessel's surface are artifacts of the alien hand, where the clay was thrown in the hearth of a misty otherworld, before being stripped of its gravitational hair.
new: 容器表面的纹理大陆是外星人手工艺的产物，在一个雾蒙蒙的异世界炉火中成型，随后被剥离了其引力之发。

old: Rich, rain-fed oak was hewn to a curiosity cabinet with shelves of all sizes. The vaulted chest is now a hundred-world bazaar.
new: 用雨水滋润的橡木制成的好奇心橱柜，拥有各种大小的架子。这个拱顶箱子现在是一个百世集市。

old: =pronouns.Possessive= verdurous flower crown flows down =pronouns.possessive= shoulders as a sidewise veil, and =pronouns.possessive= finger stems writhe over a glinting cathode.
new: =pronouns.Possessive= 翠绿的花冠如侧帘般垂下=pronouns.possessive= 的肩膀，而=pronouns.possessive= 的手指藤蔓缠绕着闪闪发光的阴极。

old: The mysterious thought-form woke from a lost current of local sapiance and squat itself a spongey mangrowth in the ultraviolet baths of the surface. It's long since desiccated, the visceral mass time-viced into something more like paper pulp.
new: 这个神秘的思想形态从失落的本地智慧流中苏醒，并在地表的紫外线浴中长成了一块海绵状的植物。它早已干枯，内脏般的物质被时间压榨成了类似纸浆的东西。

old: A papery pair of chitin mosaics beat the thick air, and a glassy bulb segment chatters behind.
new: 一对纸质的几丁质拼图在厚重的空气中拍打，后面是一个玻璃状的球形节段在颤动。

old: A loop on the pelagic neck was twirled to fit large hands of lime. The vessel smells of wine and myrrh.
new: 缠绕在远洋颈环上的环圈适合大而青绿的手。容器散发着葡萄酒和没药的香气。

old: Microscopic needlework on the sleeve encodes the entire history of the crystal sphere and Great Moon, at least from the fey perspective. In the well of kingdom and castle, the embroidered texture returns the pressure of a gloved hand locked in dance at the masquerade ball.
new: 袖子上的微细针线工艺记录了整个水晶球和大月亮的历史，至少是从精灵的角度来看。在王国和城堡的舞会上，刺绣的纹理回应着戴着手套的手在假面舞会上紧握的压力。

old: Starfire ikons skip on a board of holographic bronze.
new: 星火图标在全息青铜板上跳跃。

old: The glass lune exhibits spiraling arms and the endless sluices that course between them. Pinchers, sliders, whistlers, and dials array the bezel and provide navigation affordances across the manifold.
new: 玻璃月形仪展示着螺旋状的臂和其间无尽的通道。夹子、滑块、哨声器和刻度盘排列在边框上，提供了穿越多维空间的导航功能。

old: A spindle of air-chugging greenculm mounts an unseen topological space and shoots stardrunk chips into its crevices.
new: 一束吸气的绿茎安装在一个看不见的拓扑空间上，并向其裂缝中发射星醉芯片。

old: When a song of power roars out the moted forest and slides up Worldskin, the sidewise veil shields the sorceress's ears and eyes.
new: 当力量之歌在尘埃森林中轰鸣并沿着世界之皮攀升时，这侧向的面纱会保护女巫的耳朵和眼睛。

old: Flatten sheets of metal run off a warp beam in reverse and are stripped to loose wire. The bars of the separating reed bzzzz with psychoconductive force.
new: 金属薄片从反向运行的经轴上展开并被剥离成松散的金属丝。分离筘条嗡嗡作响，充满了精神导力。

old: A panel of tone bars at harmonic ratios shine in sculpted blue light. The space hums with the residual input schema of past flights.
new: 一组按谐波比例排列的音调条在雕琢的蓝光中闪耀。空间中回荡着过去飞行留下的输入模式的余音。

old: Light gleams off carved ornamental cisterns, well-shapes designed to keep liquid fresh and fluidic. The chrome ore they are wrought from was shunted toward an observer's frame and locked in color by a stasis engine.
new: 光线从雕刻的装饰性蓄水池上反射出来，这些蓄水池的设计旨在保持液体的新鲜和流动性。它们所用的铬矿石被移向观察者的参照系，并通过静滞引擎锁定了颜色。

old: The mysterious thought-form woke from a lost current of local sapiance and squat itself a spongey mangrowth in the ultraviolet baths of the surface. It's long since desiccated, the visceral mass time-viced into something more like paper pulp.
new: 这个神秘的思想形态从当地智慧的失落潮流中苏醒，并在地表的紫外线浴中形成了一个海绵状的蔓生植物。它早已干枯，内脏组织随着时间的推移变成了类似纸浆的东西。

old: The skin of the sacred lake dampens the sorceral songs of the forest and mirrors the Great Moon, its sapphire seas and continents of ash shivering in watery projection.
new: 神圣湖泊的水面平息了森林中的魔法之歌，并映照出巨大的月亮，其蓝宝石般的海洋和灰烬构成的大陆在水面上微微颤动。

old: The bright countenance and mane of short quills on the young urshiib cut through even a canvas of fraying light. His shoulders are drawn back with fresh purpose, and his eyes pierce the foreground with a laser's precision.
new: 这年轻的乌尔希布面容明亮，短刺般的鬃毛即使在破败的光幕中也显得格外突出。他双肩后展，充满了新的目标，目光如激光般锐利地穿透前景。

old: It's a richly faceted likeness of the night terror who shunts the fluid seas to dead lattice, who stalactites into other-dreams to vaporize their dreamers.
new: 这是一尊多面切割的雕像，描绘了那个将流动的海洋转化为死亡格栅的夜之恐怖，它潜入他人的梦境中，将梦者蒸发。

old: The shape of the carved megalith electrifies a forgotten squadron of neurons in a crawlway of your mind, launching you into sudden intimacy with the deep past, somewhere on the cusp of first thought. Then an uncertainty obtains as to which direction on the braid of time you are remembering.
new: 雕刻巨石的形状激活了你脑海中某个角落里被遗忘的神经元，让你突然与遥远的过去产生了亲密联系，在最初的思维边缘。随后，你开始不确定自己是在回忆时间之辫上的哪个方向。

old: Triumphal warps and market domes trace the paved superstratum valley, where Eaters of the medina and beldam district engaged their circling rituals.
new: 胜利的传送门和市场穹顶沿着铺设好的上层山谷排列，这里是麦地那区和老妪区的食者们进行循环仪式的地方。

old: The self-plucked feathers of a mountain moa were stuffed into a velvet cushion thousands of years ago and sold at the bazaar of Samech some time after.
new: 数千年前，山地恐鸟的自拔羽毛被塞进了一个天鹅绒垫子中，并在之后的某个时间在萨梅克市集上出售。

old: A moss-bloused crystal sphere squats in practiced observance.
new: 一个长满苔藓的水晶球静静地蹲坐着，仿佛在进行某种仪式般的观察。

old: Here rise the syncretic arcades of the great bazaar in starport's lee. The market jammed the profusions of sixty stars into its tented halls: billion-weave rugs, ox-carted macroprocessors, poisonous perfumes, and cold peaches.
new: 在这星际港的庇护下，伟大的集市以其融合的拱廊拔地而起。市场中挤满了来自六十颗星球的繁多商品：亿万织线的地毯、牛车装载的巨型处理器、剧毒香水以及冰冷的桃子。

old: Machinic cages store raw force sipped from the slipstream and used to reshape local spacetime. Occasionally, amathematical fluctuations allow a pushton to escape and beam a sidewise galaxy right in the core.
new: 机械笼储存从时空流中汲取的原始力量，并用于重塑局部时空。偶尔，数学波动会导致一个普斯顿逃逸并在核心处投射出一个侧向银河。

old: The broad-eye bat flaps a nuisance in the carcass-darkened space.
new: 宽眼蝙蝠在尸体遍布的黑暗空间中扑腾，令人厌烦。

old: Star orchid saliva pools at the tips of =pronouns.possessive= fangs and drips to the ground.
new: 星兰的唾液在=pronouns.possessive=毒牙尖端汇聚，滴落到地上。

old: Scattered points arrange to recorded positions and bloom in the theater of light.
new: 散落的光点排列在记录的位置上，在光之剧场中绽放。

old: The carousel respiratory system is embedded in a wider network of biomechanical feelstuffs. Some confluence of its nodes have decided to grow a stemlike twine that supports a pinkish, seeing eye. Diagnostics confirm that looking around calms the ship down.
new: 旋转呼吸系统嵌入了一个更广泛的生物机械感觉网络中。其某些节点的汇合处长出了一根类似茎的藤蔓，支撑着一只粉红色的眼睛。诊断显示，四处观察会使飞船平静下来。

old: Squared, fibrous composite rises northwise above the Sheva and offers an angled view from the high mesa to the lower shelves.
new: 方形纤维复合材料从谢瓦向北延伸，从高高的台地可以俯瞰到下方的阶梯状地形。

old: A branch trellis of crystalline thorn-hair has been contorted to iconic cross shape. The enterer is forced to become concave.
new: 由晶莹的荆棘毛发编织而成的枝条格架被扭曲成了标志性的十字形状。进入者被迫变得凹陷。

old: Flanged ursteel anchors secure the tapered ribbon of Gjaus to its low earth point.
new: 带有凸缘的乌钢锚固定着逐渐变细的高斯丝带，将其连接到地面低点。

old: Furry shrinewart grows over a ring of dead plant stems and drinks in the temple shade.
new: 毛茸茸的圣殿守护草覆盖在这枚由枯死植物茎干构成的戒指上，在神庙的阴凉处汲取养分。

old: Stick and spiked pauldron align to the angle of =pronouns.possessive= furry snout, and =pronouns.possessive= ears twitch with an uncanny and familiar joy.
new: 棍棒和带刺的护肩与=pronouns.possessive=毛茸茸的口鼻对齐，而=pronouns.possessive=耳朵则带着一种不可思议而又熟悉的喜悦抽动着。

old: The magnetic torch smolders inside the hedron with the offgases of high fusion, and the chamber rattles with potential.
new: 磁力火炬在棱柱内部燃烧着高能聚变的废气，整个腔室充满了潜力。

old: A switch aligns the particle scatter on the far circle and shines an incising light.
new: 一个开关对准远端圆圈的粒子散射，并发出切割光线。

old: The creature wears the diodic hood of the Chromaic Church, but =pronouns.possessive= field robes bear none of its ceremonial stiffness.
new: 这生物戴着色光教会的二极管兜帽，但=pronouns.possessive=的法袍却没有丝毫仪式感。

old: Machinic cages store raw force sipped from the slipstream and used to reshape local spacetime. Occasionally, amathematical fluctuations allow a pushton to escape and beam a sidewise galaxy right in the core.
new: 机械笼储存从时空流中汲取的原始力量，并用于重塑局部时空。偶尔，数学波动会导致一个普斯顿逃逸并在核心处投射出一个侧向银河。

old: Weight of the weary years has sagged the tympana of the frogfolk and binded them to the leaf-wet earth.
new: 岁月的重负使蛙人族的耳膜下垂，将他们紧紧束缚在湿润的树叶大地上。

old: A matchlock beam traces the silhouettes of creatures recently impressed on leylines and scrambles the sampling to produce a true random result. Thousands of years and centillions of bits pass through a choke point of the holographic now, and then are evanesced into one.
new: 火绳束追踪最近在力线中留下的生物轮廓，并扰乱采样以产生真正的随机结果。数千年和无数比特通过全息现在的瓶颈，然后被凝聚为一。

old: Great furry wings beat at bugs on =pronouns.possessive= ear, and then settle across a broad ursine back.
new: 巨大的毛茸茸翅膀拍打着=pronouns.possessive=耳朵上的虫子，然后落在宽阔的熊背上。

old: Megastruts are peeled apart and gilded with ropes of frayed composite, all shattered by the violence of time and frozen in the airless vacuum.
new: 巨柱被剥离开来，用磨损的复合材料绳索镀金，所有的一切都被时间的暴力摧毁，并冻结在无空气的真空中。

old: Starfire ikons skip on a board of holographic bronze.
new: 星火图标在全息青铜板上跳跃。

old: Quills shrank to calcite screws mark the creature in a hex grid, and ears of catholic expressiveness whip up and down like quarks. A commodore's gyroscopic coat remains still as the light sculpture periphery ticks with the subtle movements of life.
new: 钙质螺旋状的刺标记着这个生物，形成一个六角网格，而其耳朵则如夸克般上下摆动，表现出丰富的表情。光雕塑的边缘随着微妙的生命运动轻轻跳动，而指挥官的陀螺仪外套则静止不动。

old: The windy lathe of eons has rasped the plastron down to an old and smooth stone, and left the shelled friend with a sour smile.
new: 岁月的风沙将它的腹甲磨砺成古老的光滑石面，留下这位壳中朋友一脸苦涩的笑容。

old: Sheets of manufactured gold carved to a citylike byzantium channel current with negative resistance. Vast archways of bright tracery buffer the computing core of the Ark, assimilating inbound electrons into the sparkwall and shielding the inner sanctum from electromagnetic disturbance.
new: 由制造的金片雕刻成城市般的拜占庭通道，具有负电阻传导电流。巨大的拱门上布满了明亮的纹饰，缓冲了方舟的计算核心，将入射电子同化到火花墙中，并保护内殿免受电磁干扰。

old: A crown of bright and dripping star leaves casts mesmerizing shadows across its roots.
new: 一顶由明亮而滴落星光叶片编织的王冠，在其根部投下迷人的阴影。

old: Shiny plating rubs against the dirt floor, and a whetted tailspike curves in perfect geometry.
new: 闪亮的甲壳摩擦着地面，磨尖的尾刺以完美的几何形状弯曲着。

old: A burning Y of dried wood and cupped iron light the domiciles.
new: 燃烧的Y形干木和铁制灯盏照亮了居所。

old: Bars partition the bangle clasp into three bands; a cobalt button summons the rest of the quartet.
new: 条状物将手链扣分成三个部分；钴蓝色按钮可以召唤出剩余的四分之一。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It sparkles in soft light.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带有拉环的杠杆夹住。它在柔和的光线下闪闪发光。

old: Tetraxenonoglass blueshifts light hitting the outer shell. On the inner side, electromagnets excite a lining of star mollusk tissue to create the perfect psychic accoustics.
new: 四氙玻璃使外部壳体上的光线发生蓝移。内侧，电磁铁激发星贝组织，创造出完美的心灵声学效果。

old: Hundreds and hundreds of fossilized hairs crown the body in a protective coat.
new: 成百上千的化石化的毛发构成了保护身体的盔甲。

old: Perpendicular to the neon azure barrel is a square-plated scope inset with a large ocular lens. The sight through the lens distorts as the gun tilts, but the vector drawn remains unchanged.
new: 与霓虹蓝色枪管垂直的是一个方形板状瞄准镜，内置大型目镜。通过目镜看到的景象随着枪身倾斜而扭曲，但绘制的矢量线保持不变。

old: +200 reputation with a faction you choose when you install this implant You can activate this implant to change the chosen faction.
new: +200 与你安装此植入体时选择的派系的声望。你可以激活此植入体以更改所选派系。

old: Emulsion slicks on the cheek and laser light evokes pareidolic warmth.
new: 脸颊上的乳液光泽和激光光线唤起了拟人化的温暖感。

old: Inside the insulated cask of the battery, the electromotive apparatus cracks the energy out of lava and converts it to electrical charge.
new: 在电池的绝缘罐内，电磁装置从熔岩中提取能量并将其转化为电荷。

old: The torsion of an external crank drags a rosin-slathered wheel against a metal cable, whose protestations emerge from the wooden case in a low, melodic groan.
new: 外部曲柄的扭转使涂有松香的轮子摩擦金属线，其哀鸣从木箱中发出低沉而旋律的呻吟。

old: A pair gas-caught foam sneaks stiffen instantaneously when pressure is applied. Their karst surfaces are dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; the material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
new: 这双气体捕获泡沫运动鞋在受到压力时会立即硬化。它们的喀斯特表面覆盖着千年的彩色磨损痕迹和化学反应的产物；这种材料已经超越了其预期使用寿命的外环，进入了未知的虚无。

old: +150 movespeed +4 to saves vs. forced movement, knockdown, and being restrained You cannot wear shoes. This implant can't be uninstalled.
new: +150 移动速度 对强制移动、击倒和束缚的豁免+4 你不能穿鞋。此植入物无法卸载。

old: Triangular treads swathe the teeth of giant gears that turn to locomote. Their human has escaped the confines of bipedal motion.
new: 三角形履带包裹着巨大的齿轮的齿，齿轮转动以实现移动。人类已经摆脱了两足行走的限制。

old: Bell bronze is shaped to a point and its handle wrapped in leather.
new: 钟青铜被塑造成尖锐的形状，其手柄包裹着皮革。

old: Ceremonial slag steel is shaped to a hexagonal prism.
new: 仪式用渣钢被塑造成六角棱柱形。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具。用于取出铸件的翠绿色钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——这种绿色的闪光——进入管道，使金属变得不完美，赋予其特有的色泽。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具中。用于取出铸件的绿宝石钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——绿色的光泽——进入管道，使金属变得不完美并赋予其特有的色泽。带有尘埃颗粒的铸件被剔除并喂给石食者，只剩下完美的六角棱柱。

old: Points of discontiguous matter flock in a crescent to a mock wind. Together they bend light across its full spectrum and blur the wearer's torso to a polychrome mess.
new: 不连续的物质点聚集呈新月形，随虚幻的风飘动。它们共同弯曲光线，覆盖整个光谱，使穿戴者的躯干变得模糊，呈现出五彩斑斓的混乱景象。

old: A thorn crown arranged of crystals at telling psionic angles make a landmark in the psychic sea.
new: 由晶体以特定灵能角度排列而成的荆棘冠冕，在灵能之海中成为了一个标志。
同伴获得技能 瞬移 1。

old: In vast abyssal halls spire-tall machine presses crushed black spheres into diamond killer. Once the lights burned out, magpie troupes cut hunks free with gaslight tools and brought them to the low-strata smitheries. This piece was forged into a cuirass.
new: 在广阔的深渊大厅里，高耸的机器压机将黑色球体压缩成钻石杀手。一旦灯光熄灭，喜鹊群便用煤气灯工具切割下块状物，并将其带到低层铁匠铺。这件装备被锻造成了胸甲。

old: Salt and scars form a comet's tail along the length of the azure blade's edge.
new: 盐粒和伤痕沿着蓝色刀刃的边缘形成彗星的尾巴。

old: Hand grease shines on the tall pole, and a hefty volume of polished steel weighs one end.
new: 长柄上涂抹了润滑油，一端装有沉重的抛光钢锤头。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. Its lug is damp with dream dew.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带拉环的杠杆夹住。它的凹槽湿润着梦露。

old: Skeletal hand of dappled emerald metal remains suspended in temporary lifelessness.
new: 斑驳的翡翠金属骨骼手悬停在暂时的生命静止状态中。

old: Particles of ice rain sail in small and circular ribbons.
new: 细小的冰晶如丝带般在空中旋转飘落。

old: Goat leather is vertipacked with a stratum of loam and the seedlings are nourished to make a walking bush.
new: 山羊皮革与一层沃土垂直包装在一起，幼苗被滋养生长，形成一件行走的灌木。

old: Anarchy is wound into stasis by time's virtual antipode and packaged into a metal disc. Only the instruction of movement will direct it to unaccrete.
new: 时间的虚拟对立面将混乱缠绕成静止状态，并将其封装成金属圆盘。只有运动的指令才能使其解体。

old: Masks maintained their sacred status in the lives of the Eaters, even as they lost the capacity to stitch them into their own faces. This one is no different.
new: 即使食者们失去了将面具缝合到自己脸上的能力，面具仍保持着它们在食者生活中的神圣地位。这个面具也不例外。

old: When you fire a missile weapon or throw something, your projectile shifts phase to pass through obstacles and reach your target.
new: 当你发射远程武器或投掷物品时，你的弹道会改变相位，以穿过障碍物并到达目标。

old: A small lune of tetraxenonoglass is curved at Q radius to account for interdimensional parallax.
new: 一块小新氙四元玻璃被弯曲成Q半径，以补偿跨维度视差。

old: A crinkle-sheet of papery metal pokes at the angle of repose.
new: 一张皱巴巴的金属纸片斜倚在休止角上。

old: Slate tubes assemble to scaffold the human form.
new: 石板管组装成支撑人体的支架。

old: Its polished steel glistens on a flat twin plane, and skin oil stains the straps of its long leathery haft.
new: 其打磨光滑的钢刃在双面平面上闪烁，皮质长柄上的带子沾满了皮肤油脂。

old: Leather was braided through a ring knot to a coiling thong. There are blood stains on the cracker tip.
new: 皮革通过环结编织成卷曲的鞭身。鞭梢上有血迹。
失谐反物质微型反应堆

old: A kaleidoscopic tartan textures the tongue and vamp. On the backstay, a diode square displays the image of a morphing wall.
new: 鞋舌和鞋面覆盖着万花筒般的方格纹。后跟上，一个二极管方块显示着变形墙的图像。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It shifts perspective in low light.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带有拉环的杠杆夹住。在低光照条件下改变视角。

old: Lead is cast to a cylindric lump shaved to a point.
new: 铅被铸成圆柱形块并削尖。

old: Wavecrests of slag interrupt the plane geometry of the gigantic seat, scars of index to the moment when the mystai rolled the ruby boulder it was carved from out of the hoggish earth. The splats and claw feet are burned and disarranged; the ritual of transformation never ends.
new: 熔渣波纹打断了巨型座椅的平面几何形状，这些伤痕记录了神秘者将红宝石巨石从贪婪的大地中滚出的那一刻。座椅的滴水嘴和爪足被烧焦且错位；变形仪式从未停止。

old: +100 move speed +50 hitpoints +100 carry capacity +3 Ego You gain the ability to fly.  Activated. Cooldown 100. You generate a pyrokinesis field around your person.  You cannot wear equipment on your back. This implant can't be uninstalled.
new: +100 移动速度 +50 生命值 +100 负重能力 +3 自我 你获得飞行能力。 激活。冷却时间 100。你在自身周围生成一个热动力场。 你不能在背部穿戴装备。此植入物无法卸载。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It sizzles inside.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带有拉环的杠杆夹住。内部发出嘶嘶声。

old: Rough tight-spun yard balloons at the calf but cinches at the ankle. The heft of the textile weighs the wide straps down.

new: 你的投掷范围增加2。当你向投掷范围内目标投掷物品时，你的投掷准确率为100%。

old: Nerve bundles so arranged to stimulate muscles in the arm along a parabolic slide rule.
new: 神经束以特定方式排列，用于沿抛物线滑尺刺激手臂肌肉。

old: Articulated blades unfold to form an aerial screw that gets blown upward by an air thruster mounted below. On activation, the equipper takes flight.
new: 可折叠的叶片展开后形成一个螺旋桨，由下方安装的喷气推进器向上吹动。激活后，装备者可以飞行。

old: Lifeblood the color of amaranth and dried in moonlight paints the clenched and giant fist of the dead forest Saad. The sight of it unfurls one of Time's right-blown ribbons: this is a relic in all or near-all futures, and the wielder perhaps =pronouns.possessive= fossil-mate and secret sharer.
new: 生命之血如紫茉莉般鲜红，经月光晒干后，涂满了死森林萨德紧握的巨大拳头。这一景象展开了一条时间的丝带: 这是一件几乎在所有未来中都存在的遗物，而持有者或许就是=pronouns.possessive=化石伴侣和秘密共享者。

old: These shards of splintered wood once formed the haft of a weapon, which must have been broken in combat.
new: 这些断裂的木片曾经组成了武器的柄，显然这武器是在战斗中被破坏的。

old: Blue and shining metal narrows to a sticking point.
new: 蓝色且闪耀的金属锐化成一个穿刺点。

old: A loose ledger of brinestalk pulp has been bound to sticks of waxed wood and furled.
new: 一本用盐茎浆制成的松散账册，被绑在涂蜡的木棍上并卷起。

old: Through a bore in the wood grip draws a long and tapered beam of pale light. In motion it heats to steel-melting temperature and whirrs matter away.
new: 通过木制握把上的孔洞，发出一根细长而淡白色的光束。在运动中，它会加热到熔钢温度并发出嗡嗡声，将物质蒸发。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. Its lug is damp with dream dew.
new: 一簇金属蜂窝状的波纹六边形被一个铬制杠杆夹住。它的凹槽湿润着梦露之露。

old: This frock is knit from imperishable uuflax stolen from an archway garden during a union dispute between the weavers' guild and the high-strata window makers.
new: 这件长袍由从拱门花园偷来的永不腐朽的uuflax编织而成，当时织工行会与高层窗户制造者之间正发生工会纠纷。

old: Your chance of becoming lost in ruins is reduced by 30%. Your chance of becoming lost in other terrain is reduced by 10%. These effects do not stack with the bonuses of a compass bracelet.
new: 你在废墟中迷路的几率减少了30%。在其他地形中迷路的几率减少了10%。这些效果不会与指南针手链的加成叠加。

old: Geosocial location data is painted across the glass lune and is underlaid with representations of the living loam that has shifted over earth to take its place.
new: 地理社交定位数据被绘制在玻璃新月上，并叠加了取代地球表面的活土层的表示。

old: Gridlines and a red dot are painted on the glass lune, and simple rectangles depict the once-ordered streets of chromium that've since burst like gnarled roots through space and time.
new: 玻璃新月上绘有网格线和红点，简单的矩形描绘了曾经井然有序的铬合金街道，这些街道如今已如同扭曲的根须般穿过时空。

old: Activated. Cooldown 200. You choose one creature in line of sight. All other creatures are put into stasis fields for 15 rounds.
new: 激活。冷却时间200。你选择视线内的一个生物。所有其他生物将被置于静止领域15回合。

old: Shaved crystal faces are matrixed and angled to pipe stillness across a graph of live vertices.
new: 剃平的水晶面以矩阵排列并倾斜，将静止状态通过活化顶点的网络传递。

old: Steel scales dusted in salt cord the fingers and wrist in a metal exoskeleton.
new: 覆盖着盐粒的钢鳞片构成了手指和手腕上的金属外骨骼。

old: A chipped-off chunk of luminous Spindle, magnetized by the fall to earth, orbits its chosen warden.
new: 一块从发光的纺锤上脱落的碎片，在坠落地球时被磁化，围绕着它选定的守护者旋转。

old: You are immune to poison and disease.
Digestive bile and alkaline churn in glass chambers, while synthetic tissue sieves out bio-toxins.
new: 玻璃腔室中消化胆汁和碱性物质翻腾，而合成组织过滤出生物毒素。

new: 某个机巧者设计了一种虹吸管和加压喷嘴，用于喷射他们不想倾倒的液体。

old: Automatically discharges flame-retardant gel every turn you're on fire.
new: 每当你着火时，自动释放阻燃凝胶。

old: Heat-activated gel is stored in a bionic capsule and dispensed through subcutaneous rubber hoses.
new: 热激活凝胶储存在生化胶囊中，并通过皮下橡胶管分配。

old: A layer cake of wide-age rust grants dimension to the ancient and flat-faced astagon. Its front is painted with the coat of arms of an archaic house -- white runic script on a field of crimson.

old: +1 Ego You may activate this item to conjure a force field in front of you. Robots will often be unable to advance toward you while the force field is active.
new: +1 自我 你可以激活此物品，在你前方召唤一个力场。力场激活时，机器人通常无法向你靠近。

old: The moon scowls on an unseen jungle, the craters of brow shaded with animal ash and eaten to a natural ridgeline by the venomous breathe of gods.
new: 月亮在一片看不见的丛林上皱眉，眉间的陨石坑被动物的灰烬遮蔽，被神祇的毒气侵蚀成天然的山脊线。

old: When powered, this item grants a 40% chance that a tinkered item will have a random item modification. This may include item modifications that aren't normally tinkerable.

old: A curtain of thrumming cables make a mantle for hunched shoulders. They pitch at neuronal frequencies long dormant.
new: 一帘震颤的电缆为弓腰的肩膀披上斗篷。它们以长期休眠的神经频率振动。

old: A cap of gunk material that arconauts call black stretch was fished from rubber grottos and stuck to the scalp.
new: 一种由被称为黑色拉伸的黏稠材料制成的帽子，这种材料从橡胶洞穴中采集并贴在头皮上。

new: 被剥下并拉伸的山羊皮片用树液绑在一起，上面用小羊的血潦草地写着文字。

old: Grants a bonus to identifying artifacts as if your Intelligence score were increased by 5.
new: 使你鉴定遗物的能力提升，如同你的智力分数增加了5一样。

old: Curved glass caps the narrowest in a series of concentric brass tubes. The widest one is fitted with a leather head-strap.
new: 弯曲的玻璃盖住了由一系列同心黄铜管组成的最窄部分。最宽的部分装有一个皮质头带。

old: Artisanally carved wood castles a sextet of parallel conductors and a sliding photon armature. The grain is scorched black on the pistol's stock.
new: 手工雕刻的木制护拦上排列着六条平行导体和一个滑动光子结构。枪托上的木纹被烧成黑色。

old: Unshafted from its lanterned machine temple orbiting a star some hundred thousand light years away, the great gear looms in stasis. Dust from a hundred neighbored planet-homes tip its fluted teeth, while its bore is slick with amaranth and incense oil cultured over the lifespan of a gardened civilization.
new: 这巨大的齿轮从其环绕恒星运转的灯笼机械神殿中卸下，静止地悬浮着。来自上百个邻近星球的尘埃覆盖在其槽齿上，而其孔洞则被花园文明培育出的紫苑花油和香料油所润滑。

old: Wielded weapons blocked by this shield have a 10% chance to be disarmed.
new: 被此盾牌阻挡的武器有10%的几率被解除武装。

old: Heats up the area around the wearer when in operation.
new: 在运行时会使穿戴者周围的区域变热。

old: The finned and wheeled boot had become the sigil of several sects of socionauts by the Late Sultanate. For decades their progenitors careened through the capsule pipelines of the slouching arcology, dismantling it plate by plate, pursued by the constabulary but ferried by their skates to the safety of their moss-skirted hideouts. The metaphor was writ large on the glass guts of the city: Scorch the past. Rocket into the future.
new: 带有鳍片和轮子的靴子在晚苏丹国时期成为了几个社会航海教派的标志。数十年间，他们的先驱者在倾斜的弧形城市胶囊管道中疾驰，一块块拆解这座城市，被警察追捕，但凭借滑轮逃到了他们长满苔藓的藏身处。这个隐喻在城市的玻璃内脏上显而易见: 焚烧过去，火箭般飞向未来。

old: When they were active, the crysteel blast furnaces belched slag into a belt of hills that cinctured the old arcology. In the age of *sultan*, the slag was mined and moulded into a steel replica of the soaring aegides.
new: 当这些晶钢高炉处于活跃状态时，它们将炉渣排放到环绕旧拱顶城的一条山丘带中。在*sultan*时代，这些炉渣被开采并铸造成高耸的艾吉迪斯的钢铁复制品。

old: An imperishable uuflax sheet was torn from the elephantine spools in the market, thrice-folded, and stitched into a geometrically patterned talma.
new: 一张永不腐朽的乌夫拉克斯布料从市场上巨大的卷轴上撕下，三折叠后缝制成几何图案的塔尔马。

old: An imperishable uuflax sheet was torn from the elephantine spools in the market and stitched into a talma.
new: 一张永不朽坏的乌夫拉克斯布料从市场上巨大的卷轴上撕下，缝制成了这件塔尔马。

old: Light catches on four opaline corner pieces and a raised medallion set in the center of tessellated uuflax. Wonders are woven across the cyclopean tome.
new: 光线照射在四个蛋白石角件和镶嵌在乌夫拉克斯马赛克中心的凸起奖章上。巨著上编织着奇迹。

old: A dusky and twin-faced mass of gravid metal, like a meteorite, is welded to a steel pole.
new: 这是一块暗淡且双面的孕金属，如同陨石一般，被焊接在一根钢杆上。

old: Chrome was molded into a canister and fastened with a brass mounting bracket.
new: 铬被铸造成罐体，并用黄铜安装支架固定。
你的拳头造成 2d4+1 点伤害。

old: Black fullerite merely dents where weak collagen would be smashed to bits.
new: 黑色富勒烯只会留下凹痕，而脆弱的胶原蛋白早已粉碎成碎片。

old: {{W|On Humanoid Mimicry of Animals and Plants}}
new: {{W|关于类人生物对动植物的模仿}}

old: Hue-vapored crysteel cocoons the gold/water mechanism that pinches light from wavelength to waveshort.  Plasmon slag bubbles on the crest of the barrel like superheated sludge-life.
new: 色散结晶钢包裹着金/水机制，该机制将光从波长压缩到波短。等离子体残渣像超高温的污泥一样在枪管顶部冒泡。

old: Pieces of the old and aching world have been shaved off their timepoint and crushed to the vicinity of the present. A few bits of recognition remain:  lens of glass, serif of ink, acid-ate lug, and ribbon of wire.
new: 来自古老世界的碎片被时间剥离并碾压到近现代。一些熟悉的元素仍然存在: 玻璃透镜、墨水衬线、酸蚀接头和金属丝带。

old: Geometry swims across the crystal diodes of the mask. Its expression is smiling in the hypnagogic key.
new: 几何图案在面具的晶体二极管上流动。它的表情在催眠状态中微笑。

old: A razored wedge of dusky metal was welded to a steel haft.
new: 一片暗金属的锋利楔形被焊接到了钢制柄上。

old: Red lace wreathes the face to accent the sun-gladdened cheeks of a vintner's wife.
new: 红色蕾丝环绕脸部，衬托出酿酒师妻子被阳光照亮的面颊。

old: Through a bore in the wood grip draws a stout beam of pale light. In motion it heats to steel-melting temperature and whirrs matter away.
new: 木柄上的一个孔洞中透出一束粗壮的淡光。运动时，它加热到熔钢的温度并发出嗡嗡声，将物质消融。

old: Slick grease-stuff coats the hexagonally-arranged pores across the surface of the metal torus. There's a push cap for lubricant refills.
new: 金属圆环表面排列着六边形孔洞，孔洞上覆盖着光滑的润滑剂。有一个加注润滑剂的推盖。

old: Visual Instrument and Sensory Augmentation (G Edition)  Data is painted back and forth between the glass lunes of visor and wristlet. Whereas the outer trim shines gold on F Edition, on this model it fades to grey.
new: 视觉仪器和感官增强（G版） 数据在面罩和腕带的玻璃透镜之间来回传输。虽然F版的外部装饰呈金色，但此型号的装饰逐渐变为灰色。

old: A black particle defies the light-drenched world and charts a helical orbit.
new: 一个黑色微粒在充满光明的世界中逆光而行，绘制出螺旋轨道。

old: Masks maintained their sacred status in the lives of the Eaters, even as they lost the capacity to stitch them into their own faces. This one is no different.
new: 即使食者们失去了将面具缝合到自己脸上的能力，面具仍保持着它们在食者生活中的神圣地位。这个面具也不例外。

old: You emit clouds of normality gas every turn.
new: 你每回合都会释放正常气体的云团。

old: Paracausal circuitry excites the structure of spacetime into a normotropic particulate.
new: 准因果电路激发时空结构，产生规范粒子。

old: A shroud of goat leather is circle-stained by the acids of time.
new: 一张山羊皮制成的斗篷，被时间的酸液侵蚀得斑斑点点。

old: A ceremonial chrome wheel clicks to moon time, and the grip medallion shines in delphian lineage.
new: 仪式性的铬轮随着月相转动，握把上的徽章散发着德尔菲血统的光辉。

old: The forces of slaughter have rearranged parts of the body. You ponder how rearrangement means something different in each of its contexts: pieces on a game board, favored courtiers in a king's hall, and parts on a body.
new: 屠杀的力量重新排列了身体的部分。你思考着重新排列在每个语境中的不同含义: 棋盘上的棋子，国王大厅里受宠的朝臣，以及身体的各个部分。

old: Coarse goat wool is dethreading from where brushes have combed out the salt and silicon.
new: 粗糙的山羊羊毛从刷子梳去盐和硅的地方脱落。

old: A cassette is cut with hexagonal grooves and steeped in the right amount of magnetic charge to spool a spacetime tether (and generate its characteristic hot gum smell). On top, a recessed button snaps the potential and initiates the recoil.
new: 磁带被切割成六角形凹槽，并浸入适量的磁荷，以缠绕时空绳索并产生其特有的热胶味。顶部，一个凹陷的按钮锁定电位并启动传送。

old: Once-familiar paper, paint, and beads are rearranged to a beastly shape. Pale lights of Spindle color gleam in the eye sockets, and a wicked beak opens in menacing stillness. Across the visage brass chains fasten the pieces of torn innocence that craft the Murmur.
new: 曾经熟悉的纸张、颜料和珠子被重新排列成兽形。眼窝中闪烁着纺锤色的微光，一个邪恶的喙在静谧中张开，令人畏惧。面具上，黄铜链固定着那些撕裂的无辜碎片，构成了低语。

old: In wool paper and acrylic the pain of experience is smoothed away into the uniform child's cone. Arterial clamps peek out from the interior surface. The cone is fastened by a brass chain, adorned by beads of glass, and branded on the apex with the Holy Rhombus, a sign of the price of innocence.
new: 用羊毛纸和丙烯酸制成的痛苦体验被平滑成统一的儿童锥形。动脉夹从内表面露出。锥形由黄铜链固定，饰有玻璃珠，并在顶端烙印着神圣菱形，这是天真的代价的标志。
味道不错，但不是特别令人满意。

old: Hued and life-wet beauty was gathered in twine to make a point. Now dead stems and petals desperately grasp each other.
new: 色彩斑斓、生机盎然的美丽花朵被扎成一束，以表达某种意义。如今，枯萎的花茎和花瓣仍在绝望地相互依偎。
