old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with pictorals of withering plants.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带拉环的杠杆夹住。其表面刻有植物枯萎的图案。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. The lever is buoyed by a multidirectional spring-loaded mechanism.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带有拉环的杠杆夹住。杠杆由一个多方向弹簧加载机制支撑。

old: A ribbon of leather is looped through the hilt of a bright blade.
new: 一条皮革带穿过明亮刀刃的柄部。

old: A folded triangle pouch of burlap was impregnated with vinewood sap to absorb noxious vapor.
new: 一个折叠的三角布袋浸透了藤木树脂，用以吸收有毒蒸汽。

old: Coarse fur is cut from the thickset pelt of an ogre ape into a tam with earflaps.
new: 粗糙的毛皮从一只壮硕的巨魔猿的厚皮上切割下来，制成了一顶带有耳罩的无边便帽。

old: A silvery flowing cloth moves with the lightness of fabric and then hardens in stillness or under the pressure of contact. A light patina is starting to form on the stitch.
new: 一种银色的流动布料，轻盈如织物般飘动，静止或受压时则硬化。缝线处开始形成一层淡淡的锈迹。

old: Behind the muzzle, a glass-bound nimbus of unstable spacetime curls around an astral tether. The trigger mechanism cuts the tether and out-vacuums the anomaly to the free world.
new: 枪口后方，一个被玻璃束缚的不稳定时空光环围绕着一条星界绳索。触发机制切断绳索，将异常现象从真空状态释放到自由世界。

old: The manifold fibers are colorful and have a touching texture like no other fabric. A molecular weft was pulled through shrinking warps on a fractal loom.
new: 多维纤维色彩斑斓，触感独特，无与伦比。分子纬线在分形织机上通过收缩的经线编织而成。

old: You feel unusually amorous for about half a day, during which time you'll fall in love with the first thing you look at. If you inject someone else, they'll fall in love with you and follow you around for 3000-3600 rounds. There's a 1% failure rate for every level higher they are than you.
new: 你感到异常地充满爱意，持续大约半天的时间，在这段时间里，你会爱上你看到的第一样东西。如果你给其他人注射，他们会爱上你并跟随你3000-3600回合。每比你高一个等级，失败率增加1%。

old: This crude hammer is the kind used to strike rivet sets and punches when leatherworking.
new: 这把粗糙的锤子用于皮革制作时敲打铆钉和冲孔。

old: Far from the soaring aegides of earlier periods, this concave ward was merely bent and polished on a municipal lathe.
new: 远不及早期那些高耸的护盾，这个凹面盾牌只是在市政车床上弯曲并抛光而成。

old: Rough and itchy flax was coarsely threaded, cut to shape, and cinched by a hemp rope.
new: 粗糙的亚麻布被粗略地编织、裁剪成形，并用麻绳束紧。

old: Platinum stitch on a field of salt white brings recognition only to the mirage-trained eyes of the Issachari. The banner has been sewn into a scarlet collar.
new: 在盐白色的背景下，铂金缝线只有经过幻象训练的伊萨查里之眼才能辨认。这面旗帜被缝制成了一个猩红色的项圈。

old: Soft fur is cut from the alabaster pelt of an albino ape into a broad-shouldered cloak.
new: 柔软的毛皮从白化猿的象牙色皮毛上裁剪下来，制成了一件宽肩斗篷。

old: Gloved prosthetic hands attach to the ends of articulating rods. The control mechanism is housed in a false spine box.
new: 带手套的假肢手连接在可伸缩的杆端。控制机制位于一个假脊柱盒内。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具中。用于取出铸件的绿宝石钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——绿色的光泽——进入管道，使金属变得不完美并赋予其特有的色泽。带有尘埃颗粒的铸件被剔除并喂给石食者，只剩下完美的六角棱柱。

old: The shadows of tiny nebulae are crushed into the contours of a small stone.
new: 微小星云的阴影被碾压进了这颗小石头的轮廓中。

old: You gain access to every schematic for a single class of artifacts.
new: 你获得了某一类遗物的所有图纸。

old: Encoded on this chip are the schematics for a whole class of mid-tier artifacts.
new: 这块芯片上编码了一整类中等级别的神器的设计图。

old: In wool paper and acrylic the pain of experience is smoothed away into the aspect of a child. Neuronal clamps peek out from the concave interior surface. The mask is fastened by a brass chain, adorned by beads of glass, and branded on the forehead with the Holy Rhombus, a sign of the price of innocence.
new: 用羊毛纸和丙烯酸制成，将经历的痛苦平滑成孩童的模样。神经夹从凹面内部探出。面具由黄铜链固定，饰有玻璃珠，并在额头上烙印着神圣菱形，这是天真的代价的标志。

old: Rubber insulation that diamond-tiled the high pneumatic ducts was cut free at midnight and ferried to a coven of tailors, who then stitched a pair of mittens.
new: 橡胶绝缘材料曾铺设在高压气管上，午夜时分被割下并送往一群裁缝，他们将其缝制成了一副手套。

old: The coverboard of this ancient and hefty tome is faded to the average hue of ten thousand families of dust and skin oils.
new: 这本古老而厚重的书的封面已经褪色成一万种尘埃和皮肤油脂的平均色调。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具中。用于取出铸件的绿宝石钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——绿色的光泽——进入管道，使金属变得不完美并赋予其特有的色泽。带有尘埃颗粒的铸件被剔除并喂给石食者，只剩下完美的六角棱柱。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. The lever is buoyed by a multidirectional spring-loaded mechanism.
new: 一片金属蜂窝状结构被一个镀铬杠杆夹住。杠杆由一个多向弹簧加载机制支撑。

old: Cloth in the sunbanning hue of salt sight is folded snug to the fit of head and neck.
new: 盐视的晒色布料紧密地贴合头部和颈部。

old: A shining jewel, container for gigantic melancholies and gigantic mirths alike, is beset inside a strapped sandal of sheyd leather.
new: 一颗闪耀的宝石，既是巨大忧伤也是巨大欢乐的容器，被镶嵌在一条由sheyd皮革制成的绑带凉鞋中。

old: You detect nearby robots without having to see them.
new: 你可以在不看到它们的情况下检测到附近的机器人。

old: Small distortions in the electromagnetic field caused by machine folk are visible to this sensor.
new: 这种传感器可以检测到由机械族引起的电磁场微小扭曲。

old: As long as you have worn this item for at least 100 rounds, you sprint at thrice your movement speed.
new: 只要你穿戴此物品至少100回合，你的冲刺速度将是移动速度的三倍。

old: Some clever tinker has fused a spring-loaded tendon around each boot to mimic the gait of a large, sprinting bird.
new: 某个聪明的工匠在每只靴子上都安装了弹簧驱动的肌腱，以模仿大型奔跑鸟类的步伐。

old: In vast abyssal halls spire-tall machine presses crushed black spheres into diamond killer. Once the lights burned out, magpie troupes cut hunks free with gaslight tools and brought them to the low-strata smitheries. This piece was forged into a pair of sabatons.
new: 在广阔的深渊大厅中，高耸的机械压机将黑色球体压制成钻石杀手。一旦灯光熄灭，喜鹊群便用煤气灯工具切割下块状物，并将其带到低层的铁匠铺。这块材料被锻造成了这双护腿。

old: Wet scales lay in flat tessellation.
new: 湿润的鳞片平铺成镶嵌图案。

old: Soft meat slips off the pin bones.
The stone-dented metal of aging dusk wraps the brain in a second skull.
new: 黄昏的岁月在金属上留下了石痕，这第二层颅骨包裹着大脑。

old: A wide and razored edge of matte and starless alloy lengthens from point to welded shaft of steel.
new: 从剑尖到焊接的钢柄，这把剑拥有宽广而锋利的边缘，由一种无光泽且无星点的合金制成。

old: A razor edge of dense and dusky metal zigzags in shape. Its face is matte and starless.
new: 由致密而昏暗的金属制成的锋利边缘呈锯齿状。其表面哑光且无星。

old: Perch fish leather was worn by fishworkers in the earlier sultanate, but by the time of *sultan* it was prized by gentlefolk. This pair is exquisitely crafted.
new: 鱼人皮革曾被早期苏丹国的渔工穿着，但到了*sultan*时期，它成为了贵族的珍品。这一对极为精致。

old: A cuirass of gas-caught foam stiffens instantaneously when pressure is applied. Its karst surface is dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; the material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
new: 一件由气体捕获泡沫制成的胸甲，在受到压力时会瞬间硬化。其喀斯特表面覆盖着千年的彩色磨损痕迹及其产生的化学反应；这种材料已经超出了预期的使用寿命，进入了未知的虚无之中。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It purrs with a distinctive crackle.            &C4d100+20 damage to structural objects.           &C4d10+8 damage to non-structural objects.
new: 由波纹六边形金属片组成的鱼群状结构被一个镀铬杠杆夹住。它发出特有的噼啪声。&C4d100+20 损伤对结构物体。&C4d10+8 损伤对非结构物体。

old: Electrodes shine on the lattice across the uuflax weave. Sleeves, widened in fashion, display the gold and cyan heraldic circuitry.
new: 电极在uuflax编织的网格上闪耀。袖子按照时尚加宽，展示出金色和青色的纹章电路。

old: A bolt of stretchy, spun fabric was cut to a bodysuit for sneaking.
new: 一段伸缩性极强的编织布料被裁剪成紧身衣，用于潜行。

old: Three carbon steel barrels fit together into an arc-edged triangle of luminous ritualism. They pinch the mirror point inside.
new: 三个碳钢炮管组合成一个弧形边缘的三角形，散发着仪式般的光辉。它们夹住了内部的焦点。

old: A goat's bladder is knotted at the bottom and suspended by a strap of intestine.
new: 山羊的膀胱在底部打结，并由一根肠带悬吊。

old: Expert rifling grooved its carbon steel barrel to helical precision. Smudges are printed on the scope glass.
new: 碳钢枪管上的膛线经过精密加工，呈现出螺旋状的精确度。瞄准镜镜片上留有污迹。

old: An imperishable uuflax sheet was torn from the elephantine spools in the market, thrice-folded, and stitched into a geometrically patterned talma.
new: 一张永不腐朽的乌夫拉克斯布料从市场上巨大的卷轴上撕下，三折叠后缝制成几何图案的塔尔马。

old: The luster of the azure edge fades to shadow at the beard of the bit, and a backspike balances the whole bladed volume.
new: 蓝色刃缘的光泽在斧刃底部逐渐消逝成阴影，而背部的尖刺则平衡了整个刀片的体积。

old: Black acrylic grips are run through with hairline cracks from where nervous and sweat-damp hands squeezed the precision out of their shot.
new: 黑色亚克力握把上布满了因紧张和汗水浸湿的手指紧握而产生的细微裂纹。

old: A toboggan repels above the ground and gently rocks on an ethereal wave. It's encircled by a corona of wafting dust.
new: 一个雪橇在地面上方排斥并轻轻摇晃在虚无的波浪上。它被一圈飘动的尘埃光环所环绕。

old: A starless, triangular prism of black glass holds still.
new: 一个无星的黑色玻璃三棱镜静止不动。

old: The ankle is cinched by a leather strap and goldleaf buckle; crushed plant matter soils the soles.
new: 脚踝被皮革带和金叶扣固定；鞋底沾满了碾碎的植物残渣。

old: Its torso is downside up and sprouts a bouquet of crumpled legs.
new: 它的躯干倒置，长出一束皱巴巴的腿。

old: Crunching through the exoskeleton gives way to soft meat that dissolves on your tongue.
new: 咬碎外骨骼后，柔软的肉会在你的舌头上溶解。

old: Prism-studded skin was shorn from a dead monkey and sawed into a cloak.
new: 从一只死去的猴子身上剥下的棱镜镶嵌的皮肤，被裁剪成了一件斗篷。

old: An empty shell lies cracked across its spiral and tinctured in dried mucus.
new: 一个空壳裂开在其螺旋上，沾满了干涸的黏液。

old: You crunch the shell to pieces and your mouth fills with hot slime.
new: 你把贝壳咬成碎片，嘴里充满了滚烫的粘液。

old: Pink slime kneads the inner wall of a glass bottle and starts to take the shape of what's on the other side.
new: 粉红色的黏液在玻璃瓶的内壁上揉搓，开始呈现出另一边物体的形状。

old: A narrow shaft fletched with bird feather is capped by a head of zetachrome.
new: 一根细长的箭杆，尾部装饰着鸟羽，箭头由泽塔铬制成。

old: The glass lune is showered in information across the electromagnetic channels.
new: 玻璃弯月上布满了电磁频段的信息。

old: Bright steel was moulded to a crescent for scything the rough hides of watervine.
new: 明亮的钢被塑造成新月形，用于切割水藤粗糙的表皮。

old: This leather bracer is striated with streaks of dried body-salt, the marks of heavy use.
new: 这副皮革护腕上布满了干涸的体盐条纹，显露出其频繁使用的痕迹。

old: You gain an additional left and right missile weapon slot. You cannot wear equipment on your back.
new: 你获得了一个额外的左右远程武器插槽。你不能在背部装备任何物品。

old: The back-mounted gun rack of polished chrome has two slots for pistols to sit over each shoulder or for a single rifle to sit over the shoulder of choice.
new: 后背安装的镀铬枪架有两个插槽，可以分别放置在两侧肩部的手枪，或者根据选择放置在单侧肩部的步枪。
来自{{great machine|伟大机器}}的仪表

old: Berate, Intimidate, and Menacing Stare also confuse per Confusion rank 10.
new: 斥责、恐吓和威胁的目光也会使目标困惑，效果等同于困惑等级10。

old: Prism-studded skin was shorn from a dead monkey and sawed into a hat.
new: 从一只死去的猴子身上剥下的棱镜镶嵌的皮肤被裁剪成了一顶帽子。

old: It's a gnarled, acacia staff set with a small orb of primordial amber.
new: 这是一根扭曲的金合欢木杖，顶部镶嵌着一颗原始琥珀小球。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's etched with pictorals of withering fungi.
new: 一簇金属六边形被一个铬制杠杆夹紧。其上刻有枯萎真菌的图案。

old: A chipped-off chunk of luminous Spindle, magnetized by the fall to earth, orbits its chosen warden.
new: 一块从发光的纺锤上脱落的碎片，在坠落地球时被磁化，围绕着它选定的守护者旋转。

old: An earthen pot of Svy mud fired in a marsh oven captures a few handfuls from the soil sea and contains them in a bubble world.
new: 一个由斯维泥制成的陶罐，在沼泽炉中烧制而成，捕捉了几捧来自土壤海洋的泥土，将其封存在一个微型世界中。

old: The craftsmanship of this pistol worked in brass and chrome is breathtaking: grips of kingswood call the palm to an airless wrap, the hammer is contoured to the thumb by the microinch, and the sight draws the eye down the barrel like the slipping of silk. It's engraved all around with withered ivy, and the muzzle is kissed in blood.
new: 这把手枪的工艺令人叹为观止: 黄铜和铬制成的枪身精美绝伦，国王木制成的手柄让人握感舒适，锤子经过微米级的精细打磨，准星如同丝绸般引导视线沿着枪管滑下。枪身上雕刻着枯萎的常春藤，枪口处似乎还残留着血迹。

old: +1 Ego Critical hits scored with this weapon get an extra +4 bonus to penetration rolls. When this weapons fires a shot with its last round of ammo, the shot has perfect aim and is guaranteed to score a critical hit.
new: +1 Ego 使用这把武器造成的暴击额外获得+4穿透加成。当这把武器使用最后一发弹药射击时，射击将完美命中并必定造成暴击。

old: The new flesh is as ghost film, cloaking none of the machinery of life.
new: 新生的肉体如同幽灵般的薄膜，丝毫不能遮掩生命机制的运作。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具。用于取出铸件的翠绿色钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——这种绿色的闪光——进入管道，使金属变得不完美，赋予其特有的色泽。

old: The tick of a firing pin against steel makes the fauna start. A chrome sight eases the arc of the parabola.
new: 击针敲击钢铁的声音令动物惊慌。铬合金瞄准镜使抛物线更加平滑。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It purrs with a distinctive crackle.            &C2d100+20 damage to structural objects.           &C2d10+4 damage to non-structural objects.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带有拉环的杠杆夹住。它发出独特的噼啪声。&C2d100+20 对结构物体的伤害。&C2d10+4 对非结构物体的伤害。

old: A spiral crank closes a chrome-encased circuit and ejects charge through two contact tips. Smoke twirls through their yellow glow.
new: 一个螺旋曲柄闭合了镀铬外壳中的电路，并通过两个接触端子释放电荷。烟雾在它们的黄色光芒中旋绕。

old: You gain an additional Back equipment slot.
new: 你获得了一个额外的背部装备槽。

old: Carbide mounting rods scaffold a gyroscopic shelf designed for extra baggage.
new: 碳化物安装杆支撑着一个陀螺仪设计的架子，用于额外的行李。
SPRAY-A-BRAIN: 如果这些墙壁会说话...

old: Chrome-brass rings and swarths of leather are precisely cut from a tinker's stencil, but the real signature is on the glass: a scatter of speck-sized fractures from the high salt gales.
new: 铬黄铜环和皮革条精确地从修补匠的模板上裁剪下来，但真正的标志在于玻璃上: 高盐风造成的微小裂纹散落其上。

old: On the wrist mount, echo-shaped models in three dimensions expose the structural irregularities of simple inanimate objects nearby.
new: 在腕部装置上，三维回声模型揭示了附近简单无生命物体的结构不规则性。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's etched with stop symbology.
new: 一簇金属六边形波纹被一个铬制杠杆夹紧。其表面刻有停止符号。

old: Across Moghra'yi, wood was hewn from the trunk of a boreal titan and shaved into a stick by practitioners of the foreign art. They shaped one end of the bark into an oaken knot.
new: 在莫格拉伊，工匠们从北方巨树的树干上砍下木头，削成一根棍子。他们将一端的树皮塑造成橡木结节。

old: Ceremonial bell iron is shaped to a wide hexagonal prism.
new: 仪式钟铁被塑造成一个宽大的六角棱柱。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's cold to the touch.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带拉环的杠杆夹住。摸起来很冷。

old: Metal frames are mounted on treads to protect against wheel-cramming detritus.
new: 金属框架安装在踏板上，以防止轮子被杂物卡住。
食用后恢复生命值并造成混乱。

old: A warm tingling washes over you.
new: 一股温暖的刺痛感袭遍全身。

old: Lichen sticks in the winding grooves of woodshed, shimmering and smelling of spice.
new: 地衣附着在蜿蜒的木纹上，闪烁着香料般的光芒。

old: A chrome chain wraps around a self-winding flywheel and is spotted with grease dew. One long barrel is nicked with steel scarring.
new: 镀铬链条缠绕在自动旋转的飞轮上，上面点缀着油脂露珠。一根长枪管上布满了钢痕。

old: Impurities in the stone mother verdant things, the pattern of life repeated on a smaller scale.
new: 石头中的杂质孕育了翠绿的生命，生命之纹在更小的尺度上重复。

old: Failed psychic attacks against you cause the attacker to hemorrhage.
new: 对你的失败的精神攻击会使攻击者出血。

old: Airy thoughtstuff was deposited by the pressure of the material realm into a jellified substance and curled into a cirlet. It's bejeweled with crystalline microlife, symbiotes hatched in the thick of the psychic sea.
new: 虚幻的思想物质被物质界的压迫沉积成凝胶状物质，并卷曲成一个环圈。它镶嵌着结晶微生命，这些共生体在心灵海洋的深处孵化。

old: Far too gooey for your taste.
new: 太粘了，不适合你的口味。

old: Tissue was mineralized while it grew and then snapped off the tree of living things to become an artifact of life. It was then stewed in burnt peat and turned to a hard goo.
new: 组织在其生长过程中矿化，然后从生命之树上断裂，成为生命的遗物。随后，它在烧焦的泥炭中炖煮，变成了坚硬的黏稠物。

old: In vast abyssal halls spire-tall machine presses crushed black spheres into diamond killer. Once the lights burned out, magpie troupes cut hunks free with gaslight tools and brought them to the low-strata smitheries. This piece was forged into a pair of gauntlets.
new: 在广阔的深渊大厅中，高耸的机器压机将黑色球体压缩成钻石杀手。当灯光熄灭后，八哥群用煤气灯工具切割下块状物并将其带到低层铁匠铺。这块材料被锻造成为一副护手。

old: Shining jewels are scattered across the contours of a galactic visage, and edges drawn between them sketch the outline of a sashed Fool. Far away at the chrome crest, beads of bright and searing light suggest the shape of a medial ewer, and beyond its spout, a vast and timeful structure. The inside of the mask is ribboned with burnt tracery from where it was molded on a gallium lathe, then dyed with the milked irises of shedim and set to dry in a pool of warm static.
new: 银河面容上散落着闪耀的宝石，它们之间的线条勾勒出一个系带愚者的轮廓。在远处的铬合金顶点，明亮炽热的光点暗示着一个中轴水罐的形状，而水罐的出水口之外，则是一个广阔而悠久的结构。面具内部布满了被镓车床塑形后留下的烧焦痕迹，然后用从谢迪姆身上提取的乳状虹膜染色，并在温暖的静电池中晾干。

old:
+1 to all mutation levels
+6 to cybernetics license tier
new:
+1 至所有变异等级
+6 所有赛博插件许可等级

old: The black bellows of the earth are etched into a red egg. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
new: 大地的黑色呼吸被雕刻成红色的卵石。所有的粗糙边缘都被打磨得闪闪发光。

old: When powered, this container can have neutron flux safely poured into it from any source, and neutron flux may be safely poured from this container into other suitable containers.
new: 当通电时，这个容器可以从任何来源安全地接收中子流，并且可以从中子流安全地倒入其他合适的容器。

old: Magnetic glass spike-warps the placid ferrofluids contained within.
new: 磁性玻璃尖刺扭曲了内部平静的铁磁流体。
眩晕气体手雷 Mk I

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. Its cap is lined with sharp edges.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带拉环的杠杆夹住。其盖子边缘锋利。

old: A chalky white cap of rice lattice sucks the salt from liquid volumes. The letter 'H' is etched on its face.
new: 一个米白色的多孔帽状物，能够从液体中吸取盐分。其表面刻有一个字母'H'。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. Its lug is damp with dream dew.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并夹在一个快速释放杠杆上。它的凸耳上沾满了梦露。

old: A limpid fuel pump exposes ribbons of oil slick, and behind it a voltage gauge ticks. The slanted heat shield is scorched black.
new: 透明的燃料泵露出油膜般的条纹，其后电压表滴答作响。倾斜的隔热板被烧得漆黑。

old: Ceremonial bell iron is shaped to a blade's edge.
new: 仪式铃铁被塑造成刀刃的形状。

old: A jug of aluminum has been sheathed in an olive green cloth for waterkeeping.
new: 一个铝制水壶被橄榄绿布包裹，用于储水。

old: Burning rubies, carnelians, and garnets are arranged as a warm and giving sun. Diminutive rocky orbs pass by in the near space of the visage, and in the far space a prism of freight lengthens into a wider void. The inside of the mask is ribboned with burnt tracery from where it was molded on a gallium lathe, then dyed with the milked irises of shedim and set to dry in a pool of warm static.
new: 燃烧的红宝石、红玉髓和石榴石排列成一个温暖而慷慨的太阳。微小的岩石球体在面容附近的太空中掠过，而在远处，一束货运棱镜延伸成更广阔的虚空。面具内部布满了烧灼的痕迹，这些痕迹是在镓车床上铸造后，用挤出的谢迪姆虹膜染色，并在温暖的静电池中晾干形成的。

old: A thousand sunrays are refracted through the prism of a small stone. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
new: 千缕阳光透过这小石的棱镜折射而出。所有粗糙的边缘都已被打磨得熠熠生辉。

old: Sleek spiral barrels of matrixed metal cradle an enormous cylinder of ionic gas. On fire the mixture is hyperpressurized into shot and sent to explode at sight's end.
new: 光滑的螺旋金属炮管环抱着一个巨大的离子气体圆筒。点燃后，混合物被超高压缩成弹丸，射向视野的尽头爆炸。

old: A spiral crank closes a chrome-encased circuit and ejects immense amounts of charge through two contact tips. Smoke twirls through their white-hot glow.
new: 螺旋曲柄闭合一个铬壳电路，并通过两个接触尖端释放大量电荷。烟雾在它们的白炽光芒中旋转。

old: Ceremonial slag steel is shaped to a spiraled barrel.
new: 仪式用渣钢被塑造成螺旋形枪管。

old: Inside the small cask, liquid salt transfers ions to the cathode and produces spark.
new: 在小桶内部，液态盐将离子传输到阴极并产生火花。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with the crossbones of danger.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带有拉环的杠杆夹住。其上刻有危险的骷髅交叉骨标志。

old: Whenever you perform the water ritual with a new creature, you gain an extra 25 reputation. If you install this implant after you treat with a creature for the first time, you gain 25 reputation the next time you treat with them. Reputation costs in the water ritual are reduced by 20%. You may Proselytize one additional creature. Compute power on the local lattice increases this implant's effectiveness.
new: 每当你与新的生物进行水之仪式时，你将额外获得25点声望。如果你在首次治疗某个生物之后安装此植入物，你下次治疗它们时将获得25点声望。水之仪式的声望消耗减少20%。你可以多劝化一个生物。本地晶格上的计算能力会增强此植入物的效果。

old: Around a central processor, neural grafts attach to the brain lobes responsible for the feeling of social warmth.
new: 围绕中央处理器，神经移植连接到负责社交温暖感的大脑区域。

old: The shaft widens to a rigid polygon of azure metal. Nicks and scores tally on its surface.
new: 锤柄扩展成一个坚固的蓝色金属多边形。其表面布满了划痕和刻痕。

old: Reds and oranges swirl in the bulbous arrowhead. Ignition is a notch away.
new: 红橙色在箭头的膨大部分旋涡般交织。点燃只需轻轻一拨。

old: Bone fractals burst from the dome in broad and stunning display.
new: 骨质分形从穹顶上爆发出壮观的景象

old: It's worm silk gauze spooled about a wood rod and suited to staunch bleeding.
new: 它是用蠕虫丝制成的纱布，缠绕在木杆上，适合止血。

old: A hood of gas-caught foam stiffens instantaneously when pressure is applied. Its karst surface is dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; the material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
new: 这顶由气体捕获泡沫制成的兜帽在受到压力时会立即硬化。其喀斯特表面覆盖着千年的彩色磨损痕迹以及这些磨损产生的化学反应；这种材料已经超越了其预期寿命的外环，进入了未知的虚空。

old: Jasper rocks break on the edges of the mask and hem in a pale sea of milky quartz. The Spindle bisects the wide Face, and symmetry blooms beneath it. The inside of the mask is ribboned with burnt tracery from where it was molded on a gallium lathe, then dyed with the milked irises of shedim and set to dry in a pool of warm static.
new: 玉髓岩在面具边缘断裂，形成一片淡色的乳白色石英海。纺锤将宽阔的面孔一分为二，对称的图案在其下方绽放。面具内部布满了被镓车床塑形后留下的烧焦痕迹，然后用从舍迪姆眼中挤出的乳白色虹膜染色，并在温暖的静电池中晾干。

old: Duration: 10 rounds You recover 0.6 hit points per level (minimum 3) each round. At the end of the tenth round, you are purged of all short-term, biological debuffs and you regrow up to one severed appendage.
new: 持续时间: 10回合 每回合恢复0.6点生命值（最低3点）。在第十回合结束时，你将清除所有短期生物减益效果，并且可以再生一个被切断的肢体。
{{Y|刻印数据盘}}[带有{{m|Q女孩的}}指令编码]

old: Wool was dyed in a bath of dreadroot and iron salt, and then woven to warm broad shoulders.
new: 羊毛在恐惧根和铁盐的染液中浸染，然后编织成宽大的肩部。

old: A flat beak for spooning mud draws out the lower face.
new: 一个扁平的喙状物，用于舀取泥浆，拉长了下颌。

old: Perch fish nursed in the aquarium silos of a vacated sector were netted and skinned into strips. Those strips were tanned with chrome and stitched into this vest.
new: 曾在废弃区的水族馆孵化槽中养育的石鲈鱼被网捕并剥皮成条。这些鱼皮经过铬鞣处理，缝制成了这件背心。

old: Salt and scars form a comet's tail along the azure blade edge.
new: 盐粒和伤痕沿着蓝色刀刃边缘形成彗星的尾巴。

old: Minarets of shale dust hue, crushed snail, and sparking marble wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a rainbow of mineral.
new: 由页岩尘埃、碾碎的蜗牛壳和闪烁的大理石轮围绕着零点旋转，形成彩虹般的矿物虹彩。

old: circle of light in the chord of {{shugruith|Shugruith}}
new: 在{{shugruith|舒格鲁斯}}和弦中的光圈

old: A block of bright steel was sharpened to an edge.
new: 一块明亮的钢被磨成锋利的刃。

old: A dome of iron and hardened pulp contains its own source of illumination.
new: 由铁和硬化纸浆制成的圆顶头盔，内置光源。

old: You gain access to the precise hit point, armor, and dodge values of robotic creatures, biological creatures, and structures. You automatically identify artifacts. Staircases and other up/down map transitions are always revealed to you.
new: 你能够获取机器人生物、有机生物和建筑的精确生命值、护甲值和闪避值。你自动识别遗物。楼梯和其他上下地图过渡始终对你可见。

old: A minuscule graphene array that processes optical data against the final ontological and phenomenological ledger.
new: 一个微小的石墨烯阵列，用于处理光学数据并对照最终的本体论和现象学记录。

old: Latches onto metal objects for 8-12 rounds.
new: 附着在金属物体上持续8-12回合。

old: Bands of aquamarine lodestone tori wrap around the hitting part of a hefty, double-fisted truncheon. On the bottom handle there's a slot for a battery to juice the magnets.
new: 海蓝宝石磁石环围绕着沉重的双握棍的打击部分。底部手柄上有一个插槽，用于安装电池以激活磁铁。

old: A ribbon of azzurum runs through the hilt and pilots the outer arc of phantom steel. The blade's edge blurs into the script of a dead stanza.
new: 一条阿祖鲁姆丝带贯穿柄部，引导着幻影钢的外弧。刀刃的边缘模糊成了一段死文字的字迹。

old: Silver wire cinches a feathery cut of skin from the ghostly yeshyr, hunted in the orchard ruins north of Odrum. They are fastened by a smoking pearl.
new: 银线束紧了来自幽灵般的叶夏尔的羽毛状皮肤，这种生物在奥德鲁姆北部的果园废墟中被猎杀。它们由一颗烟熏珍珠固定。

old: The reedy guts of an ivy tangle were ripped out, laced, and gilded with an embroidered sash.
new: 从常春藤丛中撕扯出的芦苇状茎蔓被编织并用刺绣腰带装饰。

old: A saw-toothed bladestick of bleached chitin is still stuck to by the gore bits of a dead salthopper's last meal.
new: 这是一根带有锯齿的刀棍，由漂白的几丁质制成，上面还粘着一只死去的盐跳虫最后一餐的残渣。

old: {{W|Blood and Fear: On the Life Cycle of Lah}}
new: {{W|血与恐惧: 拉的生命循环}}

old: Offworld goldleaf spirals on the starpath.
new: 星途上的异界金叶螺旋

old: Shorn from the back of a sacred lemur, the hair is laced in a prophet braid.
new: 从神圣的狐猴背部剪下的毛发，编织成先知辫。

old: An armlength of time-tortured metal is punched through with screwing iron for extra torque.
new: 一段历经时光摧残的金属，穿插着螺纹铁以增加扭矩。

old: Thick and diamond-hard headbone with three horn holes functions as the jumbo head of a bludgeon. A long shaft of shining steel was driven through the maw and welded inside.
new: 厚实且坚硬如钻石的头骨上有三个角孔，作为钝器的巨大头部。一根长长的闪亮钢杆穿过嘴巴并焊接在内部。

old: Fronds are splayed out in a waxy imitation of life. It looks hard and greasy up close, but as you back away its edges burn into softness and it performs the tree function.
new: 叶片呈蜡质状展开，模仿着生命的形态。近距离观察时，它显得坚硬且油腻，但当你退后时，它的边缘变得柔和，履行了树木的功能。

old: Though it is approximately the size and heft of a human infant, this shiny black device's shape is more akin to a fetus torn early from the womb. Its surface is slick and warm, with a pale pulse breathing somewhere underneath its pitch-black skin. At the end of its tail is an orifice studded with hooked teeth, eternally questing for an anchor point that it never finds.
new: 尽管它的大小和重量与人类婴儿相当，这个闪亮的黑色装置的形状更像是一个从子宫中过早撕裂的胎儿。它的表面光滑而温暖，淡色的脉动在它漆黑的皮肤下呼吸。在其尾端有一个布满钩状牙齿的孔洞，不断寻找着永远无法找到的锚点。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具中。用于取出铸件的绿宝石钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——绿色的光泽——进入管道，使金属变得不完美并赋予其特有的色泽。带有尘埃颗粒的铸件被剔除并喂给石食者，只剩下完美的六角棱柱。

old: It's a large piece of rock, older than every idea.
new: 这是一块比所有想法都要古老的巨岩。

old: When powered, this item greatly increases the chance of identifying artifacts and recovering additional bits when you disassemble artifacts. When unpowered, it functions as a basic toolkit, mildly increasing the chance of recovering additional bits.
new: 当开启电源时，此物品会大幅提高识别遗物和拆解遗物时回收额外部件的几率。未开启电源时，它作为一个基本工具箱，略微增加回收额外部件的几率。

old: An array of tinkering utensils clang against carbide: voltmeter, polyjack, soldering knife, ion shield, circuitboard, and three spare vacuum tubes.
new: 一套精密工具碰撞着碳化物: 电压表、多用途扳手、烙铁刀、离子护盾、电路板和三根备用真空管。

old: A pair of bone extrusions trenched with grooves race to a symmetrical point above the head.
new: 一对带有沟槽的骨质突起对称地延伸到头部上方。

old: An imperishable uuflax sheet was torn from the elephantine spools in the market, twice-folded, and stitched into a geometrically patterned talma.
new: 一张永不朽坏的乌夫拉克斯布料从市场上巨大的卷轴上撕下，对折两次，缝制成几何图案的塔尔玛。

old: A whole new arm fabricated from graphene and neutrafoam. Its pylon awaits engagement.
new: 由石墨烯和中性泡沫制成的全新手臂。其连接柱等待激活。

old: Astragals demarcate the phasic slits along the frustum's length. Noise is sucked out of time in expectancy of cross-plane fusion.
new: 星界加尔沿着棱锥的长度标出相位裂隙。噪音被吸出时间，预示着跨平面融合。

old: Dead sponge was heaped into hexagonal prisms at Maqqom and ferried through canals to vault-shadowed kurna. There it was washed clean and spongeworked into a bonnet.
new: 死亡海绵被堆成六角棱柱，在马科姆堆积并通过运河运送到拱顶阴影下的库尔纳。在那里，它被清洗干净并加工成头盔。

old: Minarets of raw bile hue, blackrot, and poison jade wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a rainbow of malady.
new: 苦胆色的尖塔、黑腐和毒玉围绕着一个零点旋转，模糊成虹彩般的病态之虹。

old: circle of light in the chord of {{agolgot|Agolgot}}
new: 在{{agolgot|阿戈尔戈特}}和弦中的光之圆环

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with a picture of an eye.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。外壳上刻有一个眼睛的图案。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's hot to the touch.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带拉环的杠杆夹住。摸起来很热。

old: Bright metal is polished to a ghost shine. Streaks of shaded blue show where the blade was carbon-folded on the forge.
new: 明亮的金属被打磨得如同幽灵般的光芒。刀刃上蓝色的条纹显示了在铁砧上进行碳折叠的痕迹。

old: The sun beams on soapstone with cheeks made high and proud of ochre and teeth. The shadow of a noon canopy bespeaks a treeline thicker with leaflife than any on the plateau or at all north of Moghra'yi.
new: 太阳在皂石上投射出高傲而自豪的赭色脸颊和牙齿。正午树冠的阴影预示着这里的树叶比高原上或莫格拉伊以北任何地方都要茂密。

old: The forces of slaughter have rearranged parts of the body. You ponder how rearrangement means something different in each of its contexts: pieces on a game board, favored courtiers in a king's hall, and parts on a body.
new: 屠杀的力量重新排列了身体的部分。你思考着重新排列在每个语境中的不同含义: 棋盘上的棋子，国王大厅里受宠的朝臣，以及身体的各个部分。

old: It spent millions of years tucked into the folds of earthly sediment. Then it was cracked from its cocoon, a brilliant butterfly.
new: 它在地球沉积层的褶皱中度过了数百万年。然后它从茧中破壳而出，宛如一只灿烂的蝴蝶。

old: A thousand-thread coverture is given its candescent hue by the bluing ore and the harsh light of the Great Desert's foreign and eastern shelf.
new: 千丝斗篷由蓝化矿石和大沙漠东侧异域高原的强烈光线赋予其炽热的色彩。

old: Skin-tight gloves of a conducting mesh jolt the hands into high performance.
new: 紧贴皮肤的导电手套，能激发双手进入高性能状态。

old: A leather shirt is mantled with sewn-in loops of steel.
new: 一件皮质上衣缝制了钢环。

old: Tubes of known purpose splay at welded joints and support a plank for sitting.
new: 用于特定目的的管材在焊接接头处分叉，支撑着一块坐板。

old: The growth hex of time has sculpted sharp bonestuff in corkscrew tension.
new: 时间的生长六边形将尖锐的骨质材料塑造成螺旋状的张力。

old: Here lies a humanoid who'd have never guessed their torso would shelter dust from the gills of tiny mushrooms, but should have.
new: 这里躺着一个类人生物，他们从未想过自己的躯体会成为微小蘑菇鳃部尘埃的庇护所，但他们本应有所预料。

old: It's a shifting minichart of lifesign voltages picked up in the heat and sound signatures of nearby fauna.
new: 这是一张不断变化的微型生命信号图，通过附近动物的热能和声音特征捕捉到的生命电压。

old: Fine pages of lined parchment are bound into a algebraic codex.
new: 精美的直线羊皮纸页装订成一本代数典籍。

old: {{W|On the Origins and Nature of the Dark Calculus}}
new: {{W|论黑暗微积分的起源与本质}}

old: This large-print volume is made of hand-pulped and pressed brinestalk paper. Its cover is preserved with resin.
new: 这本大字版书籍由手工打浆压制的盐茎纸制成。其封面用树脂保存。

old: Particulate from the eons-sheared shale sticks in the fibers of goat wool. They make red freckles on the garment.
new: 来自远古时代被风化的页岩微粒粘附在山羊毛织物上，使衣物上出现了红色斑点。

old: A calcerous shell was chopped off at the tip. Its whorls impress the eye with pleasing geometry before swerving to uncomfortable and dizzying disharmony.
new: 一个钙质外壳被削去了顶端。它的螺旋纹路起初以悦目的几何形状吸引眼球，随后却转向令人不安和眩晕的不和谐。

old: Inside the insulated cask of the battery, the electromotive apparatus cracks the energy out of oil and converts it to electrical charge.
new: 在电池绝缘罐内，电动力装置从油中裂解出能量并将其转换为电荷。

old: Wool of many colors was horse-bought from the dromads and sourced beyond the Pale Sea and its great pan of salt. Once the Issachar spun it to yarn on the wheel, a marsh dweller hand-knotted the tzitzit.
new: 多色羊毛从驼龙那里用马匹交易而来，源自苍白之海及其广阔的盐滩之外。一旦伊萨查尔人将其纺成纱线，沼泽居民便手工打结了流苏。

old: Soft fur is cut from the alabaster pelt of an albino ape into thick-fingered gloves.
new: 柔软的毛皮从白化猿的象牙色皮毛上裁剪下来，制成厚实的手指手套。

old: Billets of shaved dogwood contour to the breasts, waist, and thigh. The husk is beetle-eaten.
new: 剥下的山狗木片贴合胸部、腰部和大腿。外壳已被甲虫侵蚀。

old: Its polished steel glistens on a flat plane, and skin oil stains the straps of its leathery haft. The pommel is capped with a glittering opal.
new: 它的抛光钢面在平面上闪耀，皮质柄上的油渍斑斑。柄尾镶嵌着一颗闪耀的蛋白石。

old: Tally marks on the bottom of the chest's lid account for its contents: dried lah petals, vinewafers, and waterskins.
new: 箱子盖底下的刻痕记录了其内容物: 干燥的拉花瓣、藤饼和水袋。

old: Mitts of gunk material that arconauts call black stretch was fished from rubber grottos and tailored to hand.
new: 由宇航员称为黑弹胶的粘稠材料制成的手套，这种材料是从橡胶洞穴中打捞出来的，并精心裁制而成。

old: A cube with a mere four corners. Facet pictographs for sun-up, mid-day, sun-down, and mid-night insist on a new division of days. It's carved with fanciful depictions of broken clocks.
new: 一个仅有四个角的立方体。其面上刻有日出、正午、日落和午夜的象形图案，主张一种新的时间划分方式。它还雕刻着一些奇特的破损钟表图案。

old: Wax from the hives of Odrum is mixed in dye and moulded to the shape of styli. Together in the box they sample the iridescence of the world and offer the tools to expand it.
new: 奥德鲁姆蜂巢的蜂蜡与染料混合，塑造成笔尖的形状。盒中的它们捕捉了世界的虹彩，并提供了扩展它的工具。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. Its lug is ringed with dial ticks.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带拉环的杠杆夹住。它的凸耳上环绕着刻度标记。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具中。用于取出铸件的绿宝石钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——绿色的光泽——进入管道，使金属变得不完美并赋予其特有的色泽。带有尘埃颗粒的铸件被剔除并喂给石食者，只剩下完美的六角棱柱。

old: A gargantuan slab of burned and rolled chrome was unjointed from an earth-mover. It shadows its monstrous wielder like a starsail.
new: 一块巨大的烧焦并轧制的铬合金板从一台地球移动机上拆下。它像星帆一样遮蔽了其庞大的持有者。

old: Wet clay dresses the edge and dirt cakes the hilt.
new: 湿润的黏土包裹着刀刃，而刀柄上则覆盖着泥土。

old: Channel grooves are cut into the gloves' static-dried palms in the impossible patterns of leyline geometry. The fingers articulate at intersecting radials and spin the latent into being.
new: 手套的静电干燥掌心上刻有莱线几何学的不可能图案。手指在相交的径向线上活动，将潜在的力量转化为现实。

old:
Requires 1 dram of neutron flux to function.
Very tiny chance each round neutron flux is consumed.
+10 psychic glimmer
new:
需要 1 剂量的中子流才能运作。
每回合有极小的概率消耗中子流。
+10 心灵光辉

old: Skeletal coral was torn off its reef-home and chewed to a cutting edge.
new: 骨骼珊瑚从其礁石家园上被撕下并磨成锋利的边缘。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with the crossbones of danger.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。其表面刻有危险的骷髅标志。

old: A corm of bell bronze is screw-fitted to a scarred wooden shaft.
new: 一个钟形青铜块螺旋固定在一根伤痕累累的木柄上。

old: A long slate rod flares out at the collar to hold capacitors and a concussive corm.
new: 一根长石板杆在手柄处膨胀，用于容纳电容器和震荡球茎

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具。用于取出铸件的翠绿色钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——这种绿色的闪光——进入管道，使金属变得不完美，赋予其特有的色泽。

old: Rubber insulation that diamond-tiled the high pneumatic ducts was cut free at midnight and ferried to a coven of tailors, who then stitched a tam.
new: 橡胶绝缘材料曾铺设在高大的气动管道上，午夜时分被切割下来，送往一群裁缝手中，他们将其缝制成一顶帽子。

old: Pits mark the length of the blade like craters on an iron edge-world.
new: 剑刃上布满了坑洞，如同铁质边缘世界的陨石坑。

old: A voluminous tome whose pages are bound between two slabs of waxed wood.
new: 一部厚重的巨著，其书页被夹在两块涂蜡木板之间。

old: A length of raw space was kineticized and sharpened to a point.
new: 一段原始空间被动能化并磨尖成刀刃。

old: Copper was crushed into a nugget and picked from its natural deposit. It's bisected by a scratch.
new: 铜被压制成块并从其天然矿床中取出。它被一道划痕一分为二。

old: Duration: 41-50 rounds +100 heat resistance You cannot be frozen. Heat damage you deal is increased by 25%. -50 cold resistance +10 Quickness Your temperature cannot be increased by external heat sources. You must move around to avoid combusting and losing the effects of this tonic.
new: 持续时间: 41-50 回合 +100 耐热性 你不会被冻结。你造成的热伤害增加 25%。-50 冷抗性 +10 敏捷 你的温度不会因外部热源而升高。你必须移动以避免燃烧并失去这种药剂的效果。

old: You gain either a permanent +1 bonus to a random attribute or one mutation point.
new: 你将获得一个随机属性的永久+1加成或一个突变点.

old: Iron wormwags out of its halite stub of a hilt.
new: 铁质蠕虫从其石盐制成的短柄中蜿蜒而出。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with stop symbology.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带有拉环的杠杆夹住。上面刻有停止符号。

old: A fractal lattice of dermal applique conducts the inner glow to the outer world.
new: 一种分形晶格的皮肤贴片将内在的光辉传导到外部世界。

old: Coarse fur is cut from the thickset pelt of an ogre ape into wide-fingered gloves, and giant knuckles sawed to points stick through.
new: 粗糙的毛皮从一只壮硕的巨魔猿皮上切割下来，制成宽大的指套手套，巨大的指关节被削尖后穿透而出。

old: A narrow shaft fletched with bird feather is capped by a crysteel head.
new: 一支细长的箭杆，用鸟羽装饰，箭头由晶体钢制成。

old: Hot fire on soapstone bleeds into damp night at a twilight terminus drawn in blood. The mask wearer assumes this and all dualities.
new: 热火在皂石上渗入潮湿的夜晚，在血色黄昏的尽头交汇。佩戴此面具者将承担这一切二元性。

old: Volcanic glass was fished from Fuming God Sea and chipped to shape along the Icepyres.
new: 从喷烟神海中捞取的火山玻璃，在冰焰山脉上被精心打磨成形。

old: What was once merely a carbide axe is now a florid work of art. Curling wires wind around the haft of the weapon as the creeping vine of a rose plant; modules and battery housing are mounted on the flat of its blade where the blossom might rest.
new: 曾经只是一把碳化物斧头，如今却成了一件华丽的艺术品。缠绕在武器柄上的电线如同玫瑰植物的蔓延藤蔓；模块和电池组安装在刀片的平面上，宛如花朵安息之处。

old: A long slate rod flares out at the collar to hold capacitors and an electrified corm for searing liturgy to memory.
new: 一根长石板杆在领口处扩展，用于容纳电容器和带电的球茎，以将炽热的祷文铭刻在记忆中。

old: The broad and tall aegis is a halved kite of sunbeam and starless dusk, and painted across her sword-nicked plane is the Holy Rhombus of the Temple.
new: 宽大的艾吉斯如同被切半的风筝，一面是阳光，一面是无星的黄昏，其剑痕斑斑的平面上绘有圣殿的神圣菱形。

old: You gain access to the precise hit point, armor, and dodge values of biological creatures.
new: 你可以访问生物生物的精确命中点、护甲和闪避值。

old: A minuscule graphene array that processes optical data against a repository of organic lifeforms.
new: 一个微型石墨烯阵列，用于处理光学数据并与有机生命体数据库进行比对。

old: A voluminous tome whose pages are bound between two slabs of waxed wood.
new: 一部厚重的巨著，其书页被夹在两块涂蜡木板之间。
{{W|穿过莫格拉'伊，第一卷: 分裂之地}}

old: Rubber insulation that diamond-tiled the high pneumatic ducts was cut free at midnight and ferried to a coven of tailors, who then stitched a pair of pantofles.
new: 橡胶绝缘材料曾覆盖在高大的气动管道上，午夜时分被切割下来，送往一群裁缝手中，他们将其缝制成了一双软鞋。

old: Skeletal hand of cobalt blue metal remains suspended in temporary lifelessness.
new: 钴蓝色金属制成的骷髅手暂时悬停在无生命的状态中。

old: Here lies the metallic husk of a defunct waydroid. It's been stripped of its valuables: copper wire, LED lights, and chrome bearings. It beeps and whirs no longer.
new: 这里躺着一个失效的向导机器人的金属外壳。它的有价值部件已被剥离: 铜线、LED灯和铬轴承。它不再发出哔哔声和嗡嗡声。

old: There is spotted dazzle on the cut hide that brings its bounded strider to pantherine selfhood.
new: 切割的皮毛上有着斑点状的光芒，使穿戴者仿佛化身为豹，展现出豹子般的自我。

old: Brinestalk was scythed from its marsh home and dried in the high salt sun. Its top is spiraled into a crook.
new: 盐沼柳从其沼泽家园中被收割，并在高盐分的阳光下晒干。其顶部盘旋成一个弯钩。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具中。用于取出铸件的绿宝石钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——绿色的光泽——进入管道，使金属变得不完美并赋予其特有的色泽。带有尘埃颗粒的铸件被剔除并喂给石食者，只剩下完美的六角棱柱。

old: A snow white trapezoid of fine ape fur, prized for its beauty and warmth.
new: 一块雪白的优质猿毛，因其美丽和保暖性而备受珍视。

old: Light flecks break themselves on the silver moat and rush back to their place of origin. The signifier becomes the signified; the simulacrum is realized.
new: 光斑在银色护城河上破碎，又疾速返回它们的起源之地。符号成为所指；拟象得以实现。

old: A thousand sunrays are refracted through the prism of a small stone.
new: 千缕阳光透过这颗小石的棱镜折射而出。

old: Interlinked plates of wafery carbide tessellate into a subcutaneous sheet.
new: 薄片状碳化物相互连接，形成一层皮下护甲。

old: +100 move speed +50 hitpoints +100 carry capacity +3 Ego You gain the ability to fly.  Activated. Cooldown 100. You sunder spacetime, teleporting to a random location in Qud.  You cannot wear equipment on your back. This implant can't be uninstalled.
new: +100 移动速度 +50 生命值 +100 负重 +3 自我 你获得飞行能力。 激活。冷却时间 100。 你撕裂时空，传送到库德的随机位置。 你不能在背部装备任何物品。此植入物无法卸载。

old: Across the whole of its wide splat and planar armrests, hairlines partition the chair and its vibrant stones into clusters of galaxies. Their fractal patterns at microscale put them beyond the skillwork of now-fossilized carpenters; they must be the scars of leylines.
new: 在整个宽大的椅背和平面扶手上，细线将椅子及其鲜艳的宝石分隔成星系般的簇群。它们在微观尺度上的分形图案超出了现已化石化的木匠的技艺；这些一定是魔力线的痕迹。

old: You gain a skill whose cost is between 0 and 50 SP.
new: 你获得了一项技能，其消耗在0到50点SP之间。

old: Encoded on this chip are the neural patterns of a particular skill.
new: 这种芯片编码了特定技能的神经模式。

old: A warded stave of burnished bronze waits to unturn the right lock.
new: 一把带有纹饰的青铜法杖，等待着开启正确的锁。

old: Half battle axe and half vinereaper, the ancestral tool called Yal evokes the struggle between the hindren cultivators and the cruelty of a harsh winter. A biting cold radiates off the curved blade.
new: 半战斧半藤收割机，这把名为亚尔的祖传工具唤起了后裔耕种者与严冬残酷斗争的记忆。弯曲的刀刃散发着刺骨的寒气。

old: The hoops sport rhombic facets that reflect light at wavelengths between plum and quartz.
new: 这些环形物具有菱形切面，反射出介于李子色和石英色之间的光线。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with a bouquet of explosive arrows and it rattles under its own weight.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。其表面刻有一束爆炸箭矢的图案，自身重量下还会发出响声。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具中。用于取出铸件的绿宝石钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——绿色的光泽——进入管道，使金属变得不完美并赋予其特有的色泽。带有尘埃颗粒的铸件被剔除并喂给石食者，只剩下完美的六角棱柱。

old: A machine of spiraling gear trains and canals of copper has been meticulously tooled onto the coverboard of the Mechanimist torah.
new: 一台由螺旋齿轮组和铜质运河组成的精密机械装置被精心雕刻在了机械师托拉的封面板上。
{{W|《卡尼卡利姆颂歌，第十七至第二十四节》}}

old: Duration: 5 rounds You recover 0.6 hit points per level (minimum 3) each round.
new: 持续时间: 5 回合 每回合恢复 0.6 生命值（最低 3）

old: You rebuke robots as if you were 5 levels higher.
new: 你斥责机器人时，如同你的等级高出了5级。

old: Between the multipronged sticktool and cipherbox, one can interface with all available robotic ports.
new: 通过多叉棍工具和密码盒，可以与所有可用的机器人端口进行交互。

old: Magnets on the string nocks hum and a slender curve of metal hums back. The air crackles as fingers approach the arrow rest.
new: 弦上的磁铁发出嗡嗡声，一弯细长的金属也回应着。手指靠近箭架时，空气噼啪作响。

old: A glossy foil clasp was pried off the glass guts of the polis and etched as jewelry.
new: 从波利斯的玻璃内脏中撬下的一块光亮箔片，被雕刻成珠宝。

old: Several sheets of tattered, age-stained parchment are bound together at the margins by some sort of glue.
new: 几张破旧、被岁月染黄的羊皮纸用某种胶水粘合在一起。

old: A coded rectangle of paper metal can be slid through lock mechanisms to open some types of doors.
new: 一种编码的纸金属矩形，可以滑入锁机制中打开某些类型的门。

old: Bright metal spills out the leather fuzz hilt along the killer's recurve.
new: 明亮的金属从皮革绒手柄中溢出，沿着杀手的反曲刃流淌。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It sparkles in soft light.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放的杠杆上。在柔和的光线下闪闪发光。

old: Early Eaters had enlarged their skulls for cosmetic reasons. By the time of *sultan*, the high minaret dwellers took to wearing them as helms. This one is exquisitely decorated.
new: 早期食者为了美容而扩大了他们的头骨。到了*sultan*时代，高层尖塔居民开始将它们用作头盔。这个头盔装饰精美。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It sizzles and swells inside.
new: 由波纹六边形金属板组成的壳体被一个铬制杠杆固定。内部发出嘶嘶声并不断膨胀。

old: Fire has poached the light from this body. Its stillness writhes against the changing soil.
new: 火焰已将这具尸体的光芒烤干。它的静止在变幻的土壤中显得格外刺眼。

old: The pistol is engraved with watervine hemp and encircled in saltstone. On the grip is an image of a nomad and knight in saltstone. The knight is striking down the nomad.
new: 手枪上雕刻着水藤麻，并用盐石环绕。握把上刻有一幅盐石制成的游牧民和骑士的图像，骑士正在击倒游牧民。

old: Skeletal hand of jet black metal remains suspended in temporary lifelessness.
new: 由纯黑金属构成的骷髅手悬停在暂时的生命静止状态中。

old: You gain an additional Floating Nearby equipment slot.
new: 你获得了一个额外的悬浮附近装备槽。

old: Laminated metal is bound as concentric spheres, softening magnetic eddies and powering near-field orbits.
new: 层压金属以同心球的形式包裹，减弱磁场涡流并为近地轨道提供动力。

old: This large-print volume is made of hand-pulped and pressed brinestalk paper. Its cover preserved with resin.
new: 这本大开本的书籍由手工捣碎和压制的盐茎纸制成，封面用树脂保存。

old: A silver shekel was stamped with the vine-swathed scales of the bazaar.
new: 一枚银色舍克尔上刻有被藤蔓缠绕的市场天平。

old: A chipped-off chunk of luminous Spindle, magnetized by the fall to earth, orbits its chosen warden.
new: 一块从发光的纺锤上脱落的碎片，在坠落地球时被磁化，围绕着它选定的守护者旋转。

old: A wax-weeping fungus has encased the appendage in a lucent cast. Body heat melts the innermost layer, and a thick, waxy milk sloshes against its hardened prison.
new: 一种渗出蜡液的真菌将附肢包裹在一个透明的壳中。体温融化了最内层，而浓稠的蜡质乳液则在硬化的囚笼内晃动。

old: A fractal lattice of dermal applique conducts the inner glow to the outer world.
new: 一种分形晶格的皮肤贴片将内在的光辉传导到外部世界。

old: A mat of coarse and golden hair is splattered with blood in two shades.
new: 一层粗糙的金色毛发上溅满了两种颜色的血迹。

old: +300 reputation with a faction you choose at installation time
new: +300 与安装时选择的阵营的声望

old: Meticulously detailed modeling software and instructions for facial reformation allow the host to assume the visage of choice, forever obsoleting masks.
new: 精心设计的建模软件和面部重塑指令使宿主能够永久性地选择自己想要的面容，从而彻底淘汰面具。

old: A voluminous tome whose pages are bound between two slabs of waxed wood.
new: 一部厚重的巨著，其书页被夹在两块涂蜡木板之间。
{{W|穿越莫格拉伊，第二卷: 雅典瑞奇}}

old: Ceremonial slag steel is shaped to an short point.
new: 仪式用渣钢被塑造成短尖。

old: Million-year-old earth rock decays inside the battery box, where the pinged out gamma particles are routed through a junction diode and stored for explosive power use.
new: 数百万年前的地球岩石在电池盒内衰变，其中的伽马粒子通过结二极管被引导并储存，用于爆炸性能量释放。

old: Staircases and other up/down map transitions are always revealed to you.
new: 楼梯和其他上下地图转换始终对你可见。

old: Near the Fuming God Sea, where seawater crashes into sunrock and erupts into mephitic vapor, a labyrinth of volcanic grottos form a dimensionless space where the utility of sight wanes. For the children of the deep, new senses wax in its stead.
new: 在沸腾神海附近，海水撞击日岩并爆发成恶臭蒸汽，形成一个无尽的空间迷宫。在这里，视觉的作用逐渐减弱，而深海之子的新感官则逐渐增强。

old: From deep as stratum 29, this cape was knit from trash; a thousand years of history now draped across the ass.
new: 来自深层第29层，这件斗篷由垃圾编织而成；千年历史如今披在了屁股上。

old: A cord of gold wire fished from the computing guts of the underearth lace the shoe-tailored leather of a dead boar.
new: 从地下深处的计算核心中取出的金线编织而成，这双靴子由已故野猪的定制皮革制成。

old: Glass arches cut and fished from the trash sea have been paired by palette and cored into beads. They've been hung on a dried strand of goat gut and bartered up and down the River Svy.
new: 从垃圾海中切割和打捞出的玻璃拱门，按色调配对并制成珠子。它们被串在干燥的山羊肠线上，在斯维河上下交易。

old: It's a hermetic cask, hose, and nozzle. Inscribed are the words: 'in case of dimensional emergency, spray'.
new: 这是一个密封的罐子、软管和喷嘴。上面刻着: '如遇维度紧急情况，请喷洒'。

old: When equipped and powered, this item grants a bonus to identifying artifacts as if your Intelligence score were increased by 2.
new: 当装备并激活时，此物品会使你鉴定遗物的能力提升，如同你的智力增加了2点。

old: Diodes burn their cyan light through an atmosphere of glass curved around a metal link.
new: 二极管在弯曲的玻璃大气中发出青色光芒，环绕着金属链环。

old: A different glyph for 'life' is light-etched on each of its shining chrome segments.
new: 每个闪亮的铬合金段上都刻有不同的‘生命’符号。

old: Focus-ringed binoculars read the tells of infrared light and produce a textured picture of eye-warm greens.
new: 带有聚焦环的双筒望远镜读取红外光的信号，并生成一幅温暖绿色的纹理图像。

old: Dried blood paints the tip and shaft of the wooden arrow, but its colorful fletching remains pristine.
new: 干涸的血液涂满了木制箭矢的箭头和箭身，但其多彩的羽毛仍然完好无损。

old: A blue kite flaunts the hieroglyphs of tooth and claw.
new: 一面蓝色的风筝盾上炫耀着齿爪的象形文字。

old: You gain access to every schematic for a single class of artifacts.
new: 你获得了某一类遗物的所有图纸。

old: Encoded on this chip are the schematics for a whole class of high-tier artifacts.
new: 这芯片上编码了一整类高级神器的设计图。

old: A bowed lune is cracked from where it was smashed off the gallium lathe. The shedim had no eyes left to color the dim and final Face, and it lay too long discarded in a pool of warm static. The sultanate is broken.
new: 一个弯月形的面庞因被砸下镓车床而破裂。舍迪姆已经没有眼睛来为这昏暗而最终的面庞上色，它被遗弃在温暖的静电池中太久。苏丹国已经破碎。

old: Wide airfoil fin-flaps beat at the wind.
new: 宽大的翼面鳍片拍打着风。

old: Scutes are arranged like stony pikes around the apron of the shoe. Light reflects off the enamel shine.
new: 鞋围上排列着像石制长矛的鳞片。光线在釉质表面反射。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It sizzles and swells inside.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带有拉环的杠杆夹住。内部发出嘶嘶声并膨胀。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with pictorals of withering plants.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。其表面刻有植物枯萎的图案。

old: The black bellows of the earth are etched into red polish.
new: 大地的黑色呼吸被刻入红色抛光中。

old: Pits mark the blade like craters on an iron edge-world.
new: 刀刃上布满了如同铁质边缘世界上的陨石坑般的凹痕。

old: Carved and stained olive wood houses the steel teeth that grind irregularities from cooking salt.
new: 雕刻并染色的橄榄木包裹着钢制齿刃，用于研磨烹饪盐中的不规则颗粒。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's hot to the touch.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。摸起来很热。

old: Hair of unknown origin sticks to the diamond pattern on nylon hip and shoulder straps. Zippered and buttoned pouches allow for the lugging of all the underearth tools one needs.
new: 未知来源的头发粘在尼龙臀带和肩带的菱形图案上。拉链和扣子口袋可以携带所有地下所需的工具。

old: This patch of furry skin is painted with dried blood.
new: 这块毛茸茸的皮肤上涂满了干涸的血液。

old: Grease wets the arming handle and streaks down the wide missile chute toward a welded shoulder rest.
new: 润滑油润湿了装弹手柄，并沿着宽大的导弹通道流向焊接在肩托上的部位。

old: A phosphorescent opal-like fits in the palm of a hand and glows with the light of auroras absorbed chiliads ago.
new: 一种类似蛋白石的发光物，可以握在手中，散发着数千年前吸收的极光之光。

old: Movement puts the birds stitched into the soft pleats of cloth into stuttery animation.
new: 移动时，缝制在柔软褶皱布料中的鸟儿会断断续续地动起来。

old: Force is pushed across bronze spines through an improbable series of flapping motions, whereupon parasols pop open to catch the mercurial wind.
new: 力量通过一系列不可思议的拍打动作传递到青铜脊骨上，随后伞状装置展开，捕捉那变幻莫测的风。

old: A bright chrome clasp was pried off the glass guts of the polis and etched as jewelry.
new: 一个明亮的铬合金扣环从波利斯的玻璃内脏中撬下，并被雕刻成珠宝。
你的拳头造成 3d4 伤害。

old: Dappled crysteel merely dents where weak collagen would be smashed to bits.
new: 斑驳的水晶钢只会留下凹痕，而脆弱的胶原蛋白早已粉碎成碎片。

old: Minarets of auroral gas, electrified emerald, and fused metals wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a rainbow of plasma.
new: 星气色的尖塔、带电的绿宝石和熔融金属围绕着零点旋转，形成彩虹般的等离子体虹彩。

old: circle of light in the chord of {{rermadon|Rermadon}}
new: 在{{rermadon|瑞马顿}}和弦中的光圈

old: The microscopic cartridge synthesizes dopamine at a rapid rate and floods the neural pathways in motivational bliss.
new: 微型墨盒以极快的速度合成多巴胺，并使神经通路充满激励的愉悦。

old: A rifled prism refracts and refocuses light to tunnel things toward its wielder. Sophists call it a 'here ray'.
new: 一种带有膛线的棱镜，可以折射并重新聚焦光线，将物体拉向持握者。学者们称其为‘归位射线’。

old: Its shelled torso is downside up and sprouts a bouquet of crumpled legs.
new: 它的壳状躯体倒置，长出一束皱巴巴的腿。

old: Masks maintained their sacred status in the lives of the Eaters, even as they lost the capacity to stitch them into their own faces. This one is no different.
new: 即使食者们失去了将面具缝合到自己脸上的能力，面具仍保持着它们在食者生活中的神圣地位。这个面具也不例外。

old: A handful of pellets are encased in a thick wax-paper and plastic shell.
new: 一束弹丸被封装在厚实的蜡纸和塑料壳中。

old: Activated. Cooldown 100. Creates up to 6 contiguous squares of stasis field that last for about 5 rounds.
new: 激活。冷却时间100。生成最多6个连续的静止力场方块，持续约5回合。

old: Crystals involute along angles of stillness.
new: 晶体沿着静止的角度内卷。

old: Steel bands bearing their prying scars have been riveted to a pair of pleated boar leather boots.
new: 带有撬痕的钢带被铆接在一双褶皱的野猪皮靴上。

old: You gain the ability to see in the dark.
new: 你获得了在黑暗中视物的能力。

old: Nerve-packed retina scatters incoming radiation and bends light so the irises turn jade.
new: 神经密集的视网膜散射入射辐射并弯曲光线，使虹膜变为翠绿色。

old: The photovoltaic cube bakes with the warm of the High Salt Sun and stores it as quickened juice.
new: 光伏立方体在高盐太阳的温暖下烘烤，并将其储存为加速汁液。

old: A second skull was raised as a cone from a sheet of desulfurized metal. Tiny initials are scratched in.
new: 第二颗头骨从脱硫金属板上被制成锥形。上面刻有微小的首字母。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具中。用于取出铸件的绿宝石钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——绿色的光泽——进入管道，使金属变得不完美并赋予其特有的色泽。带有尘埃颗粒的铸件被剔除并喂给石食者，只剩下完美的六角棱柱。

old: Ceremonial slag steel is shaped to an axe edge.
new: 仪式用渣钢被打造成斧刃。

old: Splayed feet and cracked legs are tucked under a flattened body.
new: 扁平的身体下蜷缩着张开的脚和裂开的腿。

old: Ceremonial slag steel is shaped to a wide hexagonal prism.
new: 仪式用渣钢被塑造成一个宽六角棱柱。

old: A warded stave of bright silver waits to unturn the right lock.
new: 一根带有护符的亮银权杖等待着开启正确的锁。

old: Iron fragments mottle its cankered surfaces.
new: 铁碎片斑驳其锈蚀的表面

old: A torso-length lens haloed in refraction waves is suspended in mid air.
new: 一具悬浮在半空中的躯干长度透镜，周围环绕着折射波纹。

old: It's a volume of waxstuff, secreted by plants and cooled into a block.
new: 这是一种由植物分泌并冷却成块的蜡状物质。

old: Poking out of a pool of coral resin are the unbleached bones of a human adult. Its remains have seeded a grove of otherworldly shrooms.
new: 从珊瑚树脂池中露出的是一个成年女性的未漂白骨骼。它的遗骸孕育了一片异界的蘑菇林。

old: A dense mesh of dilated tetraglass tubes convey coolant and antifreeze over the keg-mail's jumbo compressors. Blower motors drone a low hum, and condenser and evaporator coils spin out the shoulders like grandfather trees above the insulation shrub.
new: 密集的膨胀四玻璃管网输送冷却液和防冻液到桶甲的巨大压缩机上。鼓风机电机发出低沉的嗡嗡声，冷凝器和蒸发器线圈像祖父树一样从绝缘灌木上方旋转而出。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. Its lug is ringed with dial ticks.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。其拉环周围刻有刻度标记。

old: Neutralizes one damage source that would cause a lethal amount of damage or deal at least 50% of your max HP. This implant is destroyed in the process.
new: 中和一个会导致致命伤害或至少造成你最大生命值50%伤害的伤害来源。此植入物在此过程中会被摧毁。

old: A contoured, plasteel body-plate absorbs impact shock and disintegrates into the bloodstream.
new: 一块贴合身体的塑钢护甲，能够吸收冲击并分解进入血液。

old: Leaves grow over a domed layer of wearable topsoil.
new: 叶子覆盖在可穿戴的圆顶表土层上。

old: Activated. Cooldown 50. You teleport to any explored space on the map.
new: 激活。冷却时间50。你将传送到地图上的任意已探索地点。

old: The flux inside this milliscopic cask can fold space on just a large enough scale to shunt a human chassis nearby. Nonlinear circuitry calculates all possible outcomes and discards those that land the host outside the target area.
new: 这个微小罐内的通量能够在足够大的尺度上折叠空间，以便将附近的人体转移。非线性电路计算所有可能的结果，并排除那些将宿主转移到目标区域之外的情况。

old: Fine pages of lined parchment are bound into a algebraic codex.
new: 精美的直线羊皮纸页装订成一本代数典籍。

old: When charged, this weapon's penetration value is equal to the defender's armor value.
new: 当充能时，这把武器的穿透值等于防御者的护甲值。

old: A long, matte blade of ionic plastifer sits on a finger-rest hilt. When charged it blurs in high-width motion and jostles its material obstacles out of the way.
new: 一把长而哑光的离子塑钢刀刃固定在带有指托的刀柄上。当充电时，它会在高频率运动中模糊，并将物质障碍物震开。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's etched with the crossbones of danger.
new: 一个金属蜂巢状的六角形被一个镀铬杠杆夹住。其上刻有危险的骷髅标志。

old: Cerata pendulate on the cape like prism grass of a windy meadow. They mirror rich hues in cerulean, ruby, star orchid, and void; together they shine to resplendent effect.
new: 斗篷上的触角像风中的棱镜草一样摇曳。它们反射出丰富的色彩，包括天蓝色、红宝石色、星兰色和虚空色；这些颜色共同闪耀出辉煌的效果。

old: Mellified skin is sutured to colorful uuflax in a psychotomimetic likeness to the Eater idols in the age of *sultan*.
new: 蜜浸皮肤被缝合到五彩斑斓的uuflax上，形成一种类似*sultan*时代食者偶像的精神错乱形象

old: Hyperdense metal in meteor black was superheated and banged to the shoulder and chest shapes.
new: 超密金属呈陨石黑，经过高温加热并锤打成肩部和胸部的形状。

old: Minarets of force potential, lustreless chrome, and greyscale wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a hexagonal rainbow.
new: 力场尖塔、无光泽的铬合金和灰度轮盘围绕着零点旋转，模糊成六角彩虹的虹彩。

old: circle of light in the chord of {{qas|Qas}}
new: 在{{qas|卡斯}}和弦中的光之圆环

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with a bouquet of outward-facing arrows.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带拉环的杠杆夹住。其表面刻有一束向外指向的箭头。

old: A clump of brassy metal was tumbled free of its host rock.
new: 一块黄铜色的金属从其母岩中脱落。

old: A clump of metal shines in the starbright hue.
new: 一块金属在星光下闪耀。

old: Through a bore in the wood grip draws a crinkled beam of pale light. In motion it heats to steel-melting temperature and whirrs matter away.
new: 通过木制握把上的孔洞射出一道扭曲的淡光。在运动中，它加热至熔钢温度并发出嗡嗡声，将物质消融。

old: An ocean drum of unknown zircon cleans itself of dust down to the mote by electrostatic cancelling. The center cross affords a wielder's grip.
new: 未知锆石制成的海洋鼓，通过静电清除尘埃至微粒级别。中央十字形结构提供了握持的手柄。

old: Who's preserved the skins and innards of this still one? Was it the dry air of Moghra'yi? Or the doting persistence of human ritual? Does it matter?
new: 是谁保存了这具尸体的皮肤和内脏？是莫格拉伊的干燥空气吗？还是人类仪式的精心坚持？这重要吗？

old: A blooming kitesail of extrasolar flax is knitted on battens to catch the poison air of some faraway swamp planetoid and power an ecumenical cycle. Its clews are stitched with syncretic plethora from across the dreaming gamut.
new: 一簇盛开的外太阳系亚麻风筝帆被编织在桁条上，捕捉某个遥远沼泽小行星的毒气，为一个普世循环提供动力。它的索具缝合了来自梦境谱系的各种融合物。

old: Minarets of dazzle paint, abyssal shine, and subconscious fuzz wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a rainbow of stupor.
new: 眩目的画柱、深渊之光和量子模糊围绕着零点旋转，形成虹彩般的迷幻之轮。

old: circle of light in the chord of {{qon|Qon}}

Tiny glyphs are inscribed on each exterior face of the handheld box. Though contrarians still puzzle over their meaning, most of Qud's prominent linguist cults have converged on a single interpretation: 'For When Both Nature and Architects Have Failed You'. One brass pull ring separates you from the promise of those words.
new: 手持盒子的每个外表面都刻有微小的符文。尽管仍有持异议者对这些符文的意义感到困惑，但库德大多数著名的语言学教派已达成一致解读: '当自然与建筑师皆失效之时'。一个黄铜拉环将你与这些话语的承诺隔开。

old: Scratches checker the length of edged bell bronze, and skin oil dampens the leather grip.
new: 剑刃上布满了划痕，青铜的边缘显得斑驳，皮革握把因皮肤油脂而变得湿润。

old: For the purpose of determining your accuracy with ranged attacks, your agility is treated as if it were 6 points higher.
new: 为了确定你使用远程攻击的准确性，你的敏捷被视为提高了6点。

old: Chrome clasps fasten arm joints to emulate the stillness of unlife.
new: 铬合金夹具固定臂关节，模拟非生命的静止状态。

old: A paper steel disc has been stamped with the profile of Barathrum the Old.
new: 一张钢纸圆盘上印有古老巴拉瑟鲁的肖像。

old: Minarets of viscus hue, hair/nail flax, and bloodclot ruby wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a rainbow of lifeslush.
new: 黏液色的尖塔、发/指甲纤维和血块红宝石围绕着零点旋转，在虹彩中模糊成生命浆液的彩虹。

old: While the steeple fires raged below, brave arconauts sank into the glowing depths to retrieve valuables. When their corpses were found, the sand in their pockets had been blown into glass beads. Sometime after, those beads were strung into a bracelet.
new: 当尖塔之火在下方熊熊燃烧时，勇敢的阿科诺特人潜入发光的深处，以寻回珍贵物品。当他们的尸体被发现时，口袋里的沙子已被吹成了玻璃珠。后来，这些珠子被串成了一条手链。

old: Its head is a shard of grinded metal, pointed on one end and flat on the other. Dust is stuck in its hairline nicks and shines across the opalescent spectrum of rock possibility.
new: 它的头部是一块磨过的金属碎片，一端尖锐，另一端扁平。细微的划痕中沾满了尘土，在岩石可能性的珍珠般光谱上闪烁。

old: A loose ledger of vellum has been rolled, bound to umbilici, and sealed with the wax mark of the master maker.
new: 一张松散的羊皮纸卷轴，用脐带绑紧，并用大师制造者的蜡封印记密封。

old: Tissue was mineralized while it grew and then snapped off the tree of living things to become an artifact of life.
new: 组织在其生长过程中矿化，然后从生命之树上断裂，成为生命的遗物。

old: A transmitter discoid beeps out staccato noise to create interference across short-range frequency bands.
new: 一个发射圆盘发出断断续续的蜂鸣声，以在短程频段内制造干扰。

old:
+1 to all mutation levels
+6 to cybernetics license tier
new:
+1 所有突变等级
+6 所有插件层阶
你开手枪的速度提高了25%。

old: Neuronically charged tissue sheaths transmit the will faster than what cell biology had achieved.
new: 神经充电组织鞘传递意志的速度超过了细胞生物学所达到的水平。

old: A fluted visor is satcheled in strands of tungsten filament. Two antennae coil out the temples in robotic likeness.
new: 一个凹槽状的面罩被钨丝束固定。两根天线从两侧的太阳穴处向外盘旋，呈现出机械般的形态。

old: Duration: 18-22 rounds You are immune to confusing attacks. Your activated mental mutations cool down twice as quickly.
new: 持续时间: 18-22 回合 你对混乱攻击免疫。你的激活精神变异冷却速度加快一倍。

old: A tin-slender clip hangs off the ceremonial chrome magazine well.
new: 一个细长的锡夹挂在仪式用的铬合金弹匣座上。

old: A sheet of loose leaf is divided by coordinate lines in cyan. It seems to have been torn from a binder.
new: 一张散页纸被青色的坐标线分割开来。似乎是从一个活页夹中撕下来的。

old: Black acrylic grips are paired off the sides of ceremonial chrome magazine well.
new: 黑色亚克力握把与仪式性的铬合金弹匣槽两侧相配。

old: Oceans reflecting the skies of a thousand fractal worlds are tucked into a geometric volume.
new: 千变万化的分形世界天空映照在几何体的海洋中

old: It's a sizeable piece of rock, older than every symbol.
new: 这是一块巨大的岩石，比任何符号都要古老。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with pictorals of withering fungi.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。其表面刻有枯萎真菌的图案。

old: Cerata pendulate on the shoe tips like the Beetle Moon curled through fog. They mirror rich hues in cerulean, ruby, star orchid, and void; together they shine to resplendent effect.
new: 鞋尖上的角状物如同雾中的甲虫月般卷曲。它们反射出天蓝色、红宝石色、星兰色和虚空色的丰富色调，共同闪耀出辉煌的效果。

old: Scratches checker the broad length of edged bell bronze, and skin oil dampens the double-handed leather grip.
new: 宽阔的刃面上布满了划痕，青铜剑身显得古朴而沉重，双手握持的皮革剑柄因皮肤油脂而略显湿润。

old: A dial clicks at right intervals on the metal wrist, and mercurial silver courses through tubework along the plastifer sleeve.
new: 金属手镯上的旋钮定时发出咔哒声，水银般的银色液体在塑料袖管中的管道中流动。

old: Leather gloves are steeled by extruded wire meticulously curled into hundreds of chain links.
new: 皮革手套通过精心卷曲成数百个链环的拉伸铁丝加固。

old: Dead sponge was heaped into hexagonal prisms at Maqqom and ferried through canals to vault-shadowed kurna. There it was washed clean and spongeworked into a blouse.
new: 死亡海绵在马克康被堆成六角棱柱，通过运河运送到拱顶阴影下的库尔纳。在那里，它被清洗干净并加工成一件上衣。

old: Boiled goat leather was cut to a cuirass and fit with straps and iron buckles. It smells of beeswax.
new: 煮过的山羊皮被裁剪成胸甲，并配有皮带和铁扣。它散发着蜂蜡的气味。

old: You gain either a permanent +2 bonus to a random attribute or two mutation points.
new: 你将获得一个随机属性的永久+2加成或两个突变点数。

old: A tube of tetraxenonoglass glass glitters inside with opaline syrup.
new: 一根四氙玻璃管内闪烁着蛋白石般的糖浆。

old: Boar hide was brined, limed, and put in a tanning drum. It was cut and fitted into an apron, and now it's a brown canvas for knife scars and tong burns.
new: 野猪皮经过腌制、石灰处理并放入鞣革鼓中。切割和缝制成围裙后，现在它成了刀痕和夹钳烫伤的棕色画布。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It sizzles and swells inside.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。内部发出嘶嘶声并膨胀。

old: A beak thins to a long point for pecking through shell and bone.
new: 一只长喙逐渐变细，形成一个锐利的尖端，用于啄穿壳和骨头。

old: The blood is still wet. Never had you regarded wetness as a sort of clock, until now.
new: 血液尚未干涸。直到此刻，你才意识到湿润也是一种时间的流逝。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's etched with a bouquet of outward-facing arrows.
new: 一个由波纹六边形组成的金属壳被一个镀铬杠杆夹住。其表面刻有一束向外的箭头。

old: A chrome and quartz-dusted honeycomb mounts the viewing plane and threatens obliteration to all. Bar weldings bend to its gigantic weight, and rocketheads peak out of hexagonal hive.
new: 铬合金和石英粉饰的蜂巢状结构矗立在观察平面上，对所有生物构成毁灭性的威胁。巨大的重量使金属焊接处弯曲，六角形蜂巢中露出火箭头。

old: Fullerene finger extensors splay like fashionable court nails. Their girths are shrunk or unshrunk to task requirements by minuscule servos embedded in the webbing.
new: 富勒烯手指伸展如同时尚宫廷指甲。它们的粗细通过嵌入指蹼中的微小伺服电机根据任务需求进行调整。

old: Your weapons' percentage-based effects are 3X as likely to occur, including the base chance for critical hits.
new: 你的武器基于百分比的效果发生的几率提高3倍，包括暴击的基础几率。

old: Ring magnets form a cylindric mace-head to bash against objects and syphon their electron juice into a battery slotted on the shaft.
new: 环形磁铁形成一个圆柱形的重锤头，可以敲击物体并虹吸其电子汁液到手柄上的电池中。

old: On hit, this weapon drains electrical charge from its target and their equipment and transfers it to a slotted energy cell.
new: 命中时，这把武器会从目标及其装备中吸取电荷，并将其转移到插槽中的能量电池。

old: Ceremonial bell iron is shaped to a short point.
new: 仪式铃铁被塑造成短尖形状。

old: A goat's bladder is knotted at the bottom and suspended by a strap of intestine.
new: 山羊的膀胱在底部打结，并由一根肠带悬吊。

old: A glass lens encages a magnetized needle and sits inside a leather wristband.
new: 玻璃镜片内固定着一根磁化指针，镶嵌在皮革手环中。

old: Ceremonial slag steel is shaped to a barrel and grooved with helical precision.
new: 仪式用渣钢被塑造成圆筒形，并以螺旋精度刻出沟槽。

old: Blood sieved of chunky pieces sloshes around a cannister of tetraxenonoglass. Vacuum pressure sucks air in through the barrel, and slits on the slide stop vent a metronomic belch.
new: 过滤掉块状物的血液在四氙玻璃罐中晃动。真空压力通过枪管吸入空气，滑动停止通风口发出有节奏的咕噜声。

old: The effects of tonics last twice as long.
new: 药剂的效果持续时间延长一倍。

old: Three catheters imprint the skin from underneath.
new: 三根导管从皮肤下印出。

old: In vast abyssal halls spire-tall machine presses crushed black spheres into diamond killer. Once the lights burned out, magpie troupes cut hunks free with gaslight tools and brought them to the low-strata smitheries. This piece was cut and fitted to a plastic hauberk.
new: 在广阔的深渊大厅中，高耸的机械压机将黑色球体压制成钻石杀手。一旦灯光熄灭，喜鹊群便用煤气灯工具切割下块状物，并将其带到低层的铁匠铺。这块碎片被切割并安装到一件塑料锁子甲上。

old: Ur-metal strips on the soles are magnetized by bosonic coils, producing a continuous ribbon of negative-mass bubbles that repel the wearer upward.
new: 鞋底上的铀金属条带被玻色子线圈磁化，产生一条连续的负质量气泡带，使穿戴者向上排斥。

old: Early period Eaters modded their genes to grow ur-filament hair. Later, once that technology was lost, graverobbers sheared it from their cadaverous scalps. In the time of *sultan*, it was called finery. This vest was knit from the stuff.
new: 早期的食者通过基因改造长出了原始纤维毛发。后来，当这项技术失传后，盗墓者从他们枯槁的头皮上剪下了这种毛发。在*sultan*时代，这被称为华服。这件背心就是用这种材料编织而成的。

old: Sharp points are run through with bright and brilliant amethyst and sapphire. The colors remain but smolder to heather in their dying light. The chime is grave-still.
new: 尖锐的棱角贯穿明亮耀眼的紫水晶和蓝宝石。色彩依旧，但在即将消逝的光芒中变得暗淡如薰衣草色。风铃静止不动，如同墓地般沉寂。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's hot to the touch.
new: 一个由波纹六边形组成的金属簇被铬制杠杆夹紧。它摸起来很热。

old: Inside the insulated cask of the battery, the electromotive apparatus cracks the energy out of blood and converts it to electrical charge.
new: 在电池绝缘罐内部，电磁装置从血液中提取能量并将其转化为电荷。

old: Upset guts were turned outward and exposed to rot in the stale air.
new: 翻涌的内脏被暴露在陈旧的空气中腐烂。

old: The manifold fibers are colorful and have a touching texture like no other fabric. A molecular weft was pulled through shrinking warps on a fractal loom.
new: 多维纤维色彩斑斓，触感独特，无与伦比。分子纬线在分形织机上通过收缩的经线编织而成。

old: A steel kite flaunts the hieroglyphs of tooth and claw.
new: 一面钢制盾牌上装饰着牙与爪的象形文字。

old: Iron lines unfold into a head of six flanges.
new: 铁线展开成六棱的头部。

old: The crown is crushed by wear into a hundred papery creases, and the brim is stained in the fractal signatures of sweat and salt.
new: 帽顶因长期佩戴而压出了无数纸般的褶皱，帽檐上斑驳地印着汗渍和盐痕的分形图案。

old: Paper made of brinestalk pulp is covered in a shaky ink scrawl. It looks like it's been crumpled and uncrumpled many times.
new: 由盐茎浆制成的纸张上覆盖着颤抖的墨迹。看起来这张纸已经被揉皱和展开过很多次了。

old: A chipped-off chunk of luminous Spindle, magnetized by the fall to earth, orbits its chosen warden.
new: 一块从发光的纺锤上脱落的碎片，在坠落地球时被磁化，围绕着它选定的守护者旋转。

old: A slotted back satchel heavy with core metal weighs the shoulders down. Stenciled on the side is a pictograph of a drill pointing down into the earth.
new: 一个带有插槽的后背包，装满了核心金属，压在肩上。包的一侧印有一个钻头向下指向地面的图示。

old: Boar leather vamps are scuffed with little fissures sparking in wind-rasped quartz.
new: 野猪皮鞋面布满了细微裂纹，在风蚀石英上闪烁。

old: This cloak was knit from strands ur-filament hair robbed from the graves of early Eaters.
new: 这件斗篷是由从早期食者的墓地中抢来的原始纤维头发编织而成的。

old: An wood-carved jewel box opens to a photographic plate and light beamer. Slit in the crystal around the edge is a verse chosen from the rhombic torah.
new: 一个木刻珠宝盒，打开后可见一张照片板和光束发射器。水晶边缘的缝隙中刻有一句选自菱形托拉的经文。

old: Ink is jetted into and under the skin canvas by a needle and rotary motor.
new: 墨水通过针头和旋转电机喷射到皮肤表面及其下方。

old: The air swims around the axe's triangular head like the heat off the high salt sun. Such a weapon of war seems a strange fit for an agrarian people like the hindren, but it serves to illustrate how cornered prey might react over long time scales.
new: 斧头的三角形头部周围空气如同高盐太阳下的热浪般波动。对于像hindren这样的农业民族来说，这种战争武器似乎有些格格不入，但它很好地说明了被困猎物在长时间尺度下可能会如何反应。

old: A razored edge of matte and starless alloy lengthens from point to welded shaft of steel.
new: 从尖端到焊接的钢制剑柄，这把剑的刃缘如同没有星光的合金般暗淡而锋利。

old: Tiny glyphs are inscribed on each exterior face of the handheld box.
new: 手持盒子的每个外表面都刻有微小的符文。

old: From welt to shank under the ink-smudged boot, a thin plate of magnetized nickel force-welds the wearer to the iron loam.
new: 从鞋跟到鞋底，这双沾满墨迹的靴子内部有一块薄薄的磁化镍板，将穿着者牢牢吸附在铁质土壤上。

old: Reduces the action cost of applying injectors by 80%. Can be loaded with up to 8 injectors, which the medassist module AI will automatically apply when appropriate (at its own discretion) for no action cost.
new: 将注射器的行动成本降低80%。可以装载多达8个注射器，医疗辅助模块AI将在适当的时候（根据其判断）自动使用，无需消耗行动点数。

old: Stents and pneumatic applicators are hardwired to an intelligent control unit that dictates the injection of protean dyes into the veins.
new: 支架和气动注射器硬连接到一个智能控制单元，该单元负责将变形染料注入静脉。

old: A length of brinestalk is wrapped in oil-sodden cloth.
new: 一段盐茎被包裹在浸油的布料中。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with a boquet of inward-facing arrows.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带有拉环的杠杆夹住。其表面刻有一束向内的箭头。

old: A narrow shaft fletched with bird feather is capped by a head of folded carbide.
new: 一根细长的箭杆，用鸟羽装饰，箭头由折叠碳化物制成。

old: Thick and plated bonestuff curves to its host shape.
new: 厚实且呈板状的骨质材料弯曲以适应其宿主的形状。

old: Cloth was dyed in a bath of dicalyptus leaves and iron shavings to achieve a chromish luster and then tailored to a ruffled shoulder-skirt.
new: 布料在二叶树叶子和铁屑的染液中染色，以达到铬色光泽，然后裁剪成波浪形肩裙。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with a picture of an eye.
new: 一个铸铁球体被杠杆夹住，杠杆上有一个拉环。球体上刻有一个眼睛的图案。

old: Bright and wide metal is polished to a ghost shine. Streaks of shaded blue show where the large blade was carbon-folded on the forge.
new: 明亮宽大的金属被磨得如同幽灵般的光泽。刀刃上蓝色的条纹显示了在铁砧上折叠碳化物的痕迹。
眩晕毒气手雷 Mk III

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. Its cap is lined with sharp edges.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。其盖子边缘锋利。

old: Here lies a waydroid in unknowing slumber. Might a willing tinker give it life again?
new: 这里躺着一个不知晓沉睡的向导机器人。或许一位乐于助人的技工能再次赋予它生命？

old: The long shaft widens to a rigid and symmetric polygon of azure metal. Nicks and scores tally on its two heads.
new: 长柄扩展成一个坚固对称的蓝色金属多边形。其两个头部布满了划痕和刻痕。

old: Beautiful ribbons of leaf are etched along the edges of the broad and oiled blade. The pine handle is carved with its name: Difucila.
new: 宽大的油润刀刃上雕刻着美丽的叶状花纹。松木手柄上刻着它的名字: Difucila。

old: Calligraphs are incised in uneven rows and columns that meander across the quarter and back stay of the boot. Their character mass appears to orbit a central statement: "The path is contracted." The rest of the script is etched in a variety of signs and styles that offer competing and composite interpretations of the cryptic proclamation.
new: 书法图案以错落有致的行列蜿蜒于靴子的侧面和后跟。这些字符似乎围绕着一个中心声明: "道路被压缩。" 其余的文字则以多种符号和风格刻写，提供了对这一神秘宣言的相互竞争和综合解释。

old: A scratchy kirtle was taken to a pocket seamstress and accoutered for cave delving and trinket fishing.
new: 一件粗糙的长袍被送到一位专门制作口袋的裁缝那里，经过改造后适合洞穴探险和小饰品打捞。

old: A corm of polished steel is blown out of a combat-pecked rod.
new: 一根经过战斗磨砺的钢棍，其头部被打磨得光滑如 Corm。

old: A pig sinew bow string is notched behind a brinestalk rail narrowed for a dart to fit.
new: 用猪筋制成的弓弦固定在盐茎导轨后方，导轨被收窄以便飞镖能够准确装填。

old: Offworld goldleaf spirals on the starpath.
new: 星途上的异界金叶螺旋

old: An imperishable uuflax sheet was torn from the elephantine spools in the market, twice-folded, and stitched into a geometrically patterned talma.
new: 一张永不朽坏的乌夫拉克斯布料从市场上巨大的卷轴上撕下，对折两次，缝制成几何图案的塔尔玛。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with stop symbology.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。其表面刻有停止符号。

old: {{W|Modulo Moon Stair and the Tree of Life}}
Grants night vision. You can see two spaces beyond the first occluding object in your line of sight.
new: 提供夜视能力。你可以在视线范围内看到第一个遮挡物后两个单位的距离。

old: Ring-molds on the laminated metal frame collect ambient sensory data and use it to augment the viewing frustum.
new: 金属框架上的环形模具收集环境传感器数据，并用于增强视野范围。

old: The long edge is bright and polished.
Damp leather wraps the wood haft up to a sharpened bit of bell bronze.
new: 湿润的皮革包裹着木柄，直至锋利的钟青铜刃部。

old: Bees crawl over the back-mounted slatted rack. A few more dart around nearby.
new: 蜜蜂爬满了背上的框架。附近还有几只在飞舞。

old: Blinding light shines off the slick and stretchy suit of vulcanized sap and creates a postpartum amniotic sac.
new: 刺眼的光芒从这光滑且有弹性的橡胶套装上反射出来，仿佛一个刚出生的婴儿的羊膜囊。

old: Boartooth beads on the ancient charm are worn to nubs by the cartilage of time, but the flexing cable that holds them together is as strong as the day it was woven. Dangling from the bracelet is a figurine of a deer, carved from a mysterious substance that cracks light like crystal but weighs like metal, producing a shaded lifelikeness elsewhere unseen.
new: 古旧的幸运符上，野猪牙珠已被时间的软骨磨平，但将它们串在一起的弹性缆绳依然坚如初织之日。手链上悬挂着一只鹿的雕像，雕刻材料神秘莫测，既像水晶般裂光，又重若金属，营造出一种前所未见的真实阴影。

old: Wearer may take any action while sprinting at no additional penalty.
new: 穿戴者在冲刺时可以采取任何行动而不会受到额外惩罚。

old: A ribbed cable of tangent needle points squeezes the limb and quickens its biomatter beyond expectation.
new: 一条带有肋状纹路的电缆，由相切的针尖组成，挤压肢体并使其生物物质以超乎预期的速度加速。

old: You gain a skill whose cost is between 51 and 150 SP.
new: 你获得了一项技能，其消耗介于51到150点SP之间。

old: Encoded on this chip are the neural patterns of a particular skill.
new: 这种芯片编码了特定技能的神经模式。

old: Ceremonial bell iron is shaped to an axe edge.
new: 仪式铃铁被塑造成斧头的刃形。

old: This waterskin is filled to the brim and sealed with wax, as if from a merchant's stores.
new: 这个水囊装得满满的，并用蜡密封，仿佛来自商人的仓库。

old: Only a great saltback could leave a print the size of a hot spring.
new: 只有伟大的盐背生物才能留下如此巨大的印记，如同温泉般大小。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It sparkles in soft light.
new: 由波纹六边形组成的金属群被一个铬制杠杆固定。在柔和的光线下闪烁。

old: It's a robotic eye lidded by a furcate chassis and embellished with antenna lashes. A minuscule barrel pokes out from its pupil and vibrates. The inner lid is articulated, allowing the drone to scan for incoming projectiles and shoot them down with laser light.
new: 这是一只机械眼睛，由分叉的底盘覆盖，并装饰有天线睫毛。从它的瞳孔中伸出一个微小的炮管并震动。内部的眼睑可以活动，使无人机能够扫描来袭的弹药并用激光将其击落。

old: The ancient bronze coin has a square cut from its center. Time has furnished it with a seafoam patina.
new: 这枚古老的青铜硬币中心被切出了一个方形。时间赋予了它一层海泡绿的铜锈。

old: Rubber tubes worm their way through salvaged elastyne filted with filters to recover wastewater from the overworked body.
new: 橡胶管蜿蜒穿过回收的弹性纤维过滤器，从过度劳累的身体中回收废水。

old: A coarse flax waist is cinched with a watervine hemp rope.
new: 粗犷的亚麻腰带用一条水藤麻绳束紧。

old: Air circulates and the sheet-standard breathes; the edges of the red diamond shrink and lengthen. Blood courses through the arteries of time and into the tissue of the new flesh.
new: 空气循环，布旗呼吸；红色菱形的边缘收缩又伸展。时间的动脉中血液流淌，注入新肉体的组织。

old: Toothed imperfections in the crystal are the biting cuts of a secret key.
new: 水晶上的齿状缺陷是秘密钥匙的咬痕。

old: You cannot be forced to move by physical means.
new: 你不能被物理手段强制移动。

old: The crocheted leaf and moss-mass that carpets the hot-smoking yurts of goatfolk has been sewn to a leather collar, giving its wearer the appearance of a creeping bush.
new: 这种编织的叶子和苔藓块原本铺在山羊人热气腾腾的尤尔特帐篷里，现在被缝制到皮革项圈上，让佩戴者看起来像一丛爬行的灌木。

old: Its fine white sheep's wool creases are soiled with the sticky loess of the broad-shouldered world.
new: 其细腻的白色羊羊毛褶皱沾满了宽阔世界的黏土。

old: Quickened dreamstuff swells to tidal forces and electrifies the membrane of the rondure. It gives off smoke in marble.
new: 加速的梦境物质膨胀至潮汐力，并使圆环的膜带电。它散发出大理石般的烟雾。

old: Schrodinger page from the {{K|Annals of Qud}}

Nary a scholar knows who composes the Annals of Qud or when the chronicling began. But the Quantivists devised a way to entangle their own pages with the offical ledger, allowing them to insert themselves into the histories in a favorable light. A few such pages remain.
new: 几乎没有学者知道Qud年鉴的编纂者是谁，或者编纂工作始于何时。但量子主义者发明了一种方法，可以将他们自己的页面与官方记录纠缠在一起，使他们能够以有利的方式将自己写入历史。如今，这样的页面已所剩无几。

old: Broken scales lay in flat tessellation.
new: 破碎的鳞片平铺成镶嵌图案。

old: Chewing through its scales is like biting rock. The meat is lean but filling.
new: 咀嚼它的鳞片就像咬石头一样。肉很瘦但是很饱。

old: Provides a small amount of cooling.
Miniature airfoil blades spin on the circular face and blow gentle air.
new: 微型翼片在圆形面上旋转，吹出轻柔的风。

old: Carbon fiber shoots out of two electrodermal contact pads.
new: 碳纤维从两个电皮接触垫中伸出。

old: A wheel of dogthorn cut with hill-clan sigilwork is secured to the arm by a leather strap.
new: 一块带有山族图腾的狗刺轮，通过皮革带固定在手臂上。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具。用于取出铸件的翠绿色钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——这种绿色的闪光——进入管道，使金属变得不完美，赋予其特有的色泽。

old: Gaseous coolant billows through a chiffon tube, putting dew on the wide and planar barrel chrome. It spills out onto the air from a ice-chipped muzzle.
new: 气体冷却剂在细薄的管中涌动，在宽大的平面枪管上凝结成露珠。它从布满冰碴的枪口喷出，弥漫在空气中。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with a boquet of inward-facing arrows.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。其表面刻有一束向内的箭头。

old: A chipped-off chunk of Spindle, magnetized by the fall to earth, orbits its chosen warden.
new: 一块从纺锤星上脱落的碎片，在坠落地球时被磁化，围绕着它选定的守护者轨道运行。

old: Nicked folding metal of dull azure is hand-cut and stitched to a pair of undergloves made from padded goat leather.
new: 暗蓝色的折叠金属被手工切割并缝制到一对填充山羊皮制成的内衬手套上。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具。用于取出铸件的翠绿色钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——这种绿色的闪光——进入管道，使金属变得不完美，赋予其特有的色泽。

old: There's dried blood in the salted furrows of this patch of watervine.
new: 这片水藤丛的盐渍沟壑中凝结着干涸的血迹。
