old: The leather bracer frays where it was ripped open.
new: 皮革护腕在被撕开的地方已经磨损。

old: Silver was melted and cast to a perfect sphere in isomorphic veneration of the Kasaphescence.
new: 银被熔化并铸造成一个完美的球体，以同形敬仰卡萨菲斯肯斯。
你的拳头造成 2d3 伤害。

old: Blue carbide merely dents where weak collagen would be smashed to bits.
new: 蓝色碳化物只会留下凹痕，而脆弱的胶原蛋白早已粉碎成碎片。

old: Tiny spore-motes flutter down from the fleshy gills that twitch on the striated skin. Trapped inside are another thousand spores waiting to be jostled free.
new: 细小的孢子从颤动的肉质鳃上飘落，这些鳃位于条纹状的皮肤上。里面还困着成千上万的孢子，等待被摇晃出来。

old: Neutrafoam ropes are banded and bundled into a fluted column.
new: Neutrafoam绳索被绑成束，形成一个凹槽柱。
来自{{great machine|伟大机器}}的法兰

old: A gigantic whorl lip snapped off the driving wheel of culture, fell out of its star vault's orbit, and, through the eroded methods of time, arrived here. Astroexotic spores lash its metasteel underrim, pilgrims from a hot fungal core biding time between now and some mystifying future point.
new: 一个巨大的涡旋唇从文化的驱动轮上断裂，脱离了其星穹轨道，经过时间的侵蚀，最终到达这里。来自炽热真菌核心的天外来种孢子缠绕在其超钢下缘，这些朝圣者正在等待某个神秘的未来时刻。

old: This black slab of metal has been burnished clean of any symbol that may once have emblazoned its matte surface.
new: 这块黑色金属板已经被磨光，任何曾经铭刻在其哑光表面的符号都已消失。

old: It hurled through the void impacted in a black rock and slammed, shining and free, on our world.
new: 它穿越虚空，撞击在一块黑岩上，闪耀而自由地降临我们的世界。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with pictorals of withering fungi.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带有拉环的杠杆夹住。其表面刻有枯萎的真菌图案。

old: An aerosol can blown full of foaminating caulk.
new: 装满发泡密封胶的气雾罐

old: A narrow shaft fletched with bird feather is capped by a carbide head.
new: 一根细长的箭杆，用鸟羽装饰，箭头由碳化物制成。

old: An ursteel casket pens in the magnetic field that holds positrons in suspension. When a current is formed, the paired particles annihilate and send the full force of universal rupture through a channel and to a device.
new: 一个乌尔钢棺材封闭了维持正电子悬浮的磁场。当电流形成时，成对的粒子湮灭，并将宇宙破裂的全部力量通过通道传递到设备中。

old: A small mound of wet hair and rotting flesh puts a bump in the ground.
new: 一小堆湿漉漉的头发和腐烂的肉使地面鼓起一个小包。

old: It's the hoary, bowing horn of a wizened mangoat, wind-etched and gilded with scarlet tassels.
new: 这是一只老迈芒果羊的苍老、低垂的角，风蚀斑驳，缀以猩红流苏。

old: Nutwood stock parts were unscrewed in favor of starless metal. A greased pump slides shot to the chamber with minimal friction.
new: 胡桃木枪托部件被拆下，换成了无星金属。涂了润滑油的泵动作顺畅，子弹几乎毫无阻力地滑入枪膛。

old: Your Jump range is increased by 4 spaces.
new: 你的跳跃范围增加了4格。

old: Compressed gas drives piston rods into musculature powdered with graphite dust and sends the jumper soaring.
new: 压缩气体驱动涂有石墨粉的肌肉活塞杆，使跳跃者腾空而起。

old: Far from the soaring aegides of earlier periods, this concave ward was merely bent and polished on a municipal lathe.
new: 远不及早期那些高耸的护盾，这个凹面盾牌只是在市政车床上弯曲并抛光而成。

old: A leather wrap for the skull is stitched in the brimless style for those who prefer fitting into cracks over shading the jeweled eye.
new: 这顶无边沿的皮革头套专为那些更喜欢钻进裂缝而不是遮挡宝石之眼的人设计。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具。用于取出铸件的翠绿色钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——这种绿色的闪光——进入管道，使金属变得不完美，赋予其特有的色泽。

old: A broad tube of pipeline copper is a makeshift gorget. It's splashed in patterns of worm blood and sea rust.
new: 一段宽大的管道铜制成的临时喉甲。上面溅有虫血和海锈的图案。

old: Rubber insulation that diamond-tiled the high pneumatic ducts was cut free at midnight and ferried to a coven of tailors, who then stitched a bodice.
new: 橡胶绝缘材料曾铺设在高压气管上，午夜时分被切割下来，送往一群裁缝手中，他们将其缝制成一件紧身衣。

old: Ceremonial bell iron is shaped to a wide blade's edge.
new: 仪式铃铁被塑造成宽刃的形状。

old: Matter was crushed, burned, and granulated into a soft powder.
new: 物质被碾碎、焚烧并研磨成细腻的粉末。

old: {{W|Disquisition on the Malady of the Mimic}}
You can interact with both in-phase and out-of-phase objects and creatures.
new: 你可以与同相和异相的物体及生物互动。

old: Inverted tops balance the microstructure of a control unit housed in a bionic disk. Inside, the phases of reality are overlayed and projected outward.
new: 倒置的顶端平衡了安装在仿生圆盘中的控制单元的微结构。内部，现实的相位被叠加并投射出去。

old: A swath of gunk material that arconauts call black stretch was fished from rubber grottos and stuck to the feet.
new: 一种从橡胶洞穴中提取并粘贴在脚上的黑色拉伸材料，宇航员称之为黑弹胶。

old: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with a zigzag.
new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带有拉环的杠杆夹住。其表面刻有锯齿形图案。

old: A glossy foil clasp was pried off the glass guts of the polis and etched as jewelry.
new: 从波利斯的玻璃内脏中撬下的一块光亮箔片，被雕刻成珠宝。

old: Impurities in the stone mother verdant things, the pattern of life repeated on a smaller scale. It's rough edges have been polished to shine.
new: 石中的杂质孕育了翠绿的生命，生命之纹在更小的尺度上重演。它的粗糙边缘已被打磨得熠熠生辉。

old: A warded stave of polished chrome waits to unturn the right lock.
new: 一根经过抛光的铬制权杖，等待着开启正确的锁。

old: A hideous beak cants over the brain cavity and shades the face in the frightening light of a dim and aching sun.
new: 一个可怕的喙覆盖在脑腔上，在昏暗而刺眼的阳光下投下阴影，使这张脸显得更加恐怖。

old: Cables purled together form the barrel of a blastgun that fires along the cambered electromagnetic field lines.
new: 多股电缆编织成形，构成了这门沿弯曲电磁场线发射的爆能炮的枪管。

old: A voluminous tome whose pages are bound between two slabs of waxed wood.
new: 一部厚重的巨著，其书页被夹在两块涂蜡木板之间。

old: {{W|Across Moghra'yi, Vol. III: Oth, the Free City}}
new: {{W|穿越莫格拉伊，第三卷: 自由之城奥斯}}

old: Leather scraps were cut from a wider swath for some unknown leatherworking project.
new: 这些皮革碎片是从更大的皮革块上裁剪下来的，用于某个未知的皮革工艺项目。

old: Dead sponge was heaped into hexagonal prisms at Maqqom and ferried through canals to vault-shadowed kurna. There it was washed clean and spongeworked into a pair of gloves.
new: 死海绵被堆成六角棱柱，在马科姆堆积并通过运河运送到拱顶阴影下的库尔纳。在那里，它们被清洗干净并加工成一副手套。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. old: A shiny mesh of linked loops that were sourced from the steel heart of the trash sea.
new: 由垃圾海深处的钢铁之心打造的闪亮环环相扣的网状护甲。

old: An old ropeworking ritual was used to weave a back-worn net of fibrous and supportive straps.
new: 一种古老的绳艺仪式编织而成的背负网，由纤维和支撑带制成。

old: A warded stave of burning gold copper waits to unturn the right lock.
new: 一把带有防护符的燃烧金铜杖等待着开启正确的锁。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's etched with pictorals of withering plants.
new: 一簇金属波纹六边形被一个铬制杠杆夹住。其上刻有植物枯萎的图案。

old: Spaded palms and long claws are shaped to loosen earth and shovel it away.
new: 铲形手掌和长爪设计用于松土并将其铲除。

old: A calcerous shell was whittled to a hoop dress. Its whorls impress the eye with pleasing geometry before swerving to uncomfortable and dizzying disharmony.
new: 一个钙质外壳被雕琢成环状裙。其螺旋纹路起初以悦目的几何形状吸引眼球，随后却转向令人不适的眩晕不和谐。

old: Wrested from the liminal tiers of a shale-toppled spire, this animal skull was handed over to an etcher for decoration.
new: 这具动物头骨从一座被页岩倾覆的边缘层级尖塔中夺来，随后交给了一位雕刻师进行装饰。

old: The edge is bright and polished.
A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's etched with a picture of an eye.
new: 由波纹六边形组成的金属壳被一个铬制杠杆固定。上面刻有一个眼睛图案。

old: A hundredth-generation canyoner cut goat hide to the modeling shape of a bone hand that stuck out their workshop wall of ancient lime.
new: 一位百代峡谷居民用山羊皮裁剪成了一只骨头手的形状，这只手从他们工作室的古老石灰墙上伸出。

old: Particles blip off a probabilistic core and appear traced across discrete shells of energy.
new: 粒子从概率核心闪烁而出，在能量的离散壳层上留下轨迹。

old: Tapered lobes of cross-dimensional fungus flesh tap a center growth to the sequence of the prime numbers. Inside, sporelife readies for puffing.
new: 锥形的跨维度真菌肉质叶片轻触中央生长体，遵循着质数序列。内部，孢子生命正准备喷发。

old: You gain access to every schematic for a single class of artifacts.
new: 你获得了某一类遗物的所有图纸。

old: Encoded on this chip are the schematics for a whole class of low-tier artifacts.
new: 这个芯片上编码了一整类低级伪物的设计图。
攻击 MA 而不是 AV。

old: Broken crystal narrows to a hateful razor at the shard seams. It cracked at the resonance curvature of anguish, and fell out of its host rock as a shattered promise.
new: 破碎的水晶在裂片处锐化成仇恨的剃刀。它在痛苦的共鸣曲率下裂开，从宿主岩石中坠落，如同破碎的誓言。

old: Bright azure metal edges out into two elegant half-circles bound to a long steel shaft.
new: 明亮的天蓝色金属边缘形成两个优雅的半圆，固定在长钢柄上。

old: This simple arm brace is crafted from boiled boar leather and tied on with braided lace. The strips of protective hide are designed to redirect glancing blows to the arm and protect poor archers from their own errant bowstrings.
new: 这简单的臂甲由煮过的野猪皮制成，并用编织的蕾丝固定。保护性的皮条设计用于将擦伤的打击转向手臂，并保护射箭技术不佳的射手免受自己的弓弦误伤。

old: Crisp pages of goatskin vellum are bound into a codex.
new: 羊皮纸页被装订成册，质地脆硬。

old: A tension spring shoves a firing pin to bang a barrel of gas and eject a cabled grapnel; then a winch winds it back.
new: 张力弹簧推动击针撞击气罐，弹射出带缆绳的抓钩；然后绞盘将其收回。

old: An imperishable uuflax sheet was torn from the elephantine spools in the market and sewn into a headdress.
new: 一张永不朽烂的乌夫拉克斯布料从市场上巨大的卷轴上撕下，缝制成了一顶头饰。

old: This item doesn't need to be equipped for its effects to be active.
new: 此物品无需装备即可生效。

old: A cross-section of trash reef has been whittled to the shape of a star. Chiliads of life-things, rocks, and ersatz matter ribbon its arms: a mosaic of polyps, a bouquet of kelp, burned glass, minted chrome, nebula shell, iris milk, and stray photonic fuzz peeled from a decaying hologram.

new: 碳钢在锯短的枪口上闪闪发光。带有凹痕的枪托与肩膀成直角。

old: Ceremonial slag steel is shaped to a smoothbore barrel.
new: 仪式用的渣钢被塑造成平滑的枪管。

old: A loop of polished steel was stamp-cut from a toppled metal press and fit with a holding bar.
new: 一段抛光的钢片从倒下的金属冲压机上冲裁下来，并装上了握把。

new: 铁制钩爪被固定在残余的腿肢上，为佩戴者提供一种笨拙的、刮擦式的移动方式。

old: Shining stitch in the style of circuitry forks down the shoulder fabric.
new: 电路风格的闪亮缝线沿着肩部织物延伸。

new: 一个铸铁球体被一个带拉环的杠杆夹住。外壳上刻有格子图案。

new: 这本大开本的书籍由手工捣碎和压制的盐茎纸制成，封面用树脂保存。

new: 一个明亮的铬合金扣环从波利斯的玻璃内脏中撬下，并被雕刻成珠宝。

new: 一个由铬制杠杆固定的六角蜂窝状金属壳。内部发出嘶嘶声。

old: It spent millions of years tucked into the folds of earthly sediment. Then it was cracked from its cocoon, a brilliant butterfly. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
new: 它在地球沉积层的褶皱中度过了数百万年。然后它从茧中破壳而出，如同一只璀璨的蝴蝶。所有粗糙的边缘都被打磨得闪闪发光。

old: Chiliads of glitz are stuck to the naked folk carved in relief of the aureate seat. They people that gilded hill, their bodies conjugate to each other in every way geometry allows, spilling out from the crest and down the scroll arms that once upheld the quivering limbs of a high priest to lust.
new: 无数的闪光物粘附在金色宝座上雕刻的裸体人物上。他们密布在这镀金的小丘上，身体以几何学允许的所有方式相互连接，从顶峰倾泻而下，沿着曾经支撑着高祭司颤抖肢体的卷曲扶手，流淌出欲望的痕迹。

old: Nicked folding metal of dull azure is shaped to the pectorial lunes and stitched to an undergarment of padded goat leather.
new: 暗蓝色的刻痕折叠金属被塑形为胸甲，并缝制在垫有山羊皮的内衣上。

old: Salt and scars form a comet's tail along the broad length of the azure blade's edge.
new: 盐晶和伤痕沿着湛蓝剑刃的宽阔边缘形成彗星的尾巴。

old: They're petal-shaded arks of nectarous secrets.
new: 它们是花瓣遮蔽的蜜汁秘密之舟。

new: 激活。冷却时间100。你在接下来的10轮内获得+40速度，然后在接下来的10轮内变得迟缓（-10速度）。

old: Perch fish leather boots, finest make. They were either stolen from the crypt of an older Eater or fashioned by a cordwainer to look like it.
new: 栖鱼皮靴，上等制作。它们要么是从某个古老食尸者的墓穴中偷来的，要么是由制鞋匠精心制作而成，外观仿若出自墓穴。

old: Ceremonial slag steel is shaped to a broad axe edge.
new: 仪式用渣钢被塑造成宽斧刃。

old: The pearly carapace rounds about a handspur and can be employed to deflect melee blows.
new: 珍珠般的甲壳围绕着手刺，可以用来格挡近战攻击。

old: A phosphorescent opal-like fits in the palm of a hand and glows with the light of auroras absorbed chiliads ago. It floats about preternaturally.
new: 一颗磷光闪烁、类似蛋白石的小球，掌心大小，散发着数千年前吸收的极光之光。它超自然地漂浮着。

old: Ceremonial slag steel is shaped to a sawed off barrel.
new: 仪式用渣钢被塑造成锯短的枪管。

old: To ritualize the passage to Brightsheol or another thin place, several ornaments were interred: coin, manikin, locket, and pipe.
new: 为了仪式化通往光明谢奥尔或其他灵界的过程，随葬了几个装饰品: 硬币、小雕像、吊坠和烟斗。

old: A narrow shaft fletched with bird feather is capped by a wooden head.
new: 一根细长的箭杆，用鸟羽装饰，箭头由木头制成。

old: Activated. Cooldown 100. You teleport to a random, explored space on the map.
new: 激活。冷却时间100。你传送到地图上的一个随机已探索位置。

old: The flux inside this milliscopic cask can fold space on just a large enough scale to shunt a human chassis nearby.
new: 这个微小容器内的通量可以在足够大的尺度上折叠空间，从而将附近的人体框架传送。

old: A candle quartz blossom spreads light across the color spectrum and concentrates it in pails of petals.
new: 烛石花绽放出覆盖整个光谱的光芒，并将其集中在花瓣的桶中。

old: You can tinker and repair in combat at the action cost of one turn. Reduces the action cost of other tinker skills by 40%. Grants a bonus to identifying artifacts as if your Intelligence score were increased by 8. +10% chance to recover bits from disassembling artifacts.
new: 你可以在战斗中以消耗一个回合的代价修理和改装。其他改装技能的动作成本减少40%。鉴定遗物时，如同你的智力提高了8点一样获得加成。从拆解遗物中回收零件的概率提高10%。

old: A dozen armatures and manipulators splay out from a metal brace that fuses to the metacarpals.
new: 一打机械臂和操作器从一个与掌骨融合的金属支架上展开。

old: The chaff of the yuckwheat stem tastes even worse than the stem itself, and it has no medicinal value, so it's no wonder someone threw it away.
new: 恶心麦的茎秆外壳比茎本身更难吃，而且没有任何药用价值，难怪有人把它扔掉了。

old: On the countenance, ribbons of alabaster cloud circumscribe a lapis sea and forests of jade. At the median of it all, a Spindle pierces the outer rondure and disappears beyond the composition. A second obstructed spire, what must be the Spindle's shadow, soaks up the light thrown off by the southern sky of crystal white. The inside of the mask is ribboned with burnt tracery from where it was molded on a gallium lathe, then dyed with the milked irises of shedim and set to dry in a pool of warm static.
new: 在这面容上，白垩色的云带环绕着蓝宝石般的海洋和翡翠森林。在这一切的中心，一根纺锤穿透了外缘并消失在构图之外。第二根被遮挡的尖塔，应该是纺锤的影子，吸收了来自南方水晶白天空的光芒。面具内部布满了烧焦的痕迹，这些痕迹是在镓车床上成型后，用从舍迪姆身上提取的乳白色鸢尾花染色，并在温暖的静电池中干燥而成。

old: A narrow shaft fletched with bird feather is capped by a steel head.
new: 一支细长的箭杆，用鸟羽装饰，箭头由钢制成。

old: A pneumatic tube is driven under a ratchet and through a giant drill head. Crenulated air pockets allow for vibrative absorption to create a cascade of pressure, while stabilizing backstraps protect the wielder's contact points from unsafe joggling.
new: 气动管在棘轮下驱动并通过巨大的钻头。锯齿状的气囊允许振动吸收，形成压力级联，而稳定的后带则保护使用者的接触点免受不安全的震动。

old: A wearable square is modeled on the bricklayer's mortar board and decorated with a colored tassel.
new: 这顶可穿戴的方形帽子模仿了砖瓦匠的抹刀板，并装饰有彩色流苏。

old: Spinning the stannic cuboid about any of its axes of rotation generates a pinch of resistance. A wrist strap and gyroscopic frame enable the cell to absorb and store its wearer's kinetic energy.
new: 围绕其任何旋转轴旋转锡制立方体时会产生轻微的阻力。腕带和陀螺仪框架使细胞能够吸收并储存佩戴者的动能。

old: You take half damage from poison.
A girdle of ribboned muscle squeezes the wrist and wets it with a burning grease.
new: 一条带状肌肉束紧紧地缠绕着手腕，并用燃烧的油脂将其湿润。

old: A quivering bleb of static lengthens its dimensions excitably like an anxious life-thing.
new: 一个颤抖的静电力泡，像一个焦虑的生命体一样兴奋地拉长它的维度。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. The lever is buoyed by a multidirectional spring-loaded mechanism.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。杠杆由一个多方向弹簧加载机制支撑。

old: A narrow shaft fletched with bird feather is capped by a fullerite head.
new: 一根细长的箭杆，用鸟羽装饰，箭头由富勒体制成。

old: A cord extruded from metal ore conducts current when laid together.
new: 从金属矿石中挤出的导线，铺设在一起时可传导电流。

old: A smudged and salted chrome wheel clicks to moon time. Just above a brinestalk hand panel, the grip medallion shines in delphian lineage.
new: 沾满污渍和盐分的铬合金转轮随着月光的节奏咔嚓作响。握把上的饰章在靠近盐茎控制面板的位置闪耀着德尔菲亚血统的光芒。

old: Two almonds of glass sit in wireframe cups and resharpen the world's edges.
new: 两片玻璃透镜镶嵌在金属框中，重新锐化了世界的轮廓。

old: Planate chutes conduct the myoelectric force and push the body through water.
new: 植物滑道传导肌电力量，推动身体穿过水面。

old: The diaphanous dermis throws the circulatory, muscular, and nervous networks into silhouetted relief.
new: 半透明的皮肤将循环系统、肌肉和神经网络的轮廓清晰地展现出来。

old: A nutwood forestock hangs underneath the chrome rib and, when pumped, erupts into ecstatic clicking.
new: 一根坚果木前托挂在镀铬枪管下方，当拉动时，会发出狂喜的咔嗒声。

old: Ions were spun into a euhedral disc on a spinning wheel, and aquamarine was heat-set on the inner ring by deepsea steam.
new: 离子在旋转轮上被纺成一个完美的圆盘，深海蒸汽将海蓝宝石热固在内环上。

old: This weapon increases the base penetration of its ammo by 4. This weapon increases the damage die of its ammo by 4. This weapon increases the damage bonus of its ammo by 1.
new: 这把武器将其弹药的基础穿透力提高4。这把武器将其弹药的伤害骰增加4。这把武器将其弹药的伤害加成增加1。

old: Servos click on the wheeling groves and a miniature air turbine exaggerates the pull of the bowstring.
new: 伺服器在旋转的树林中咔嗒作响，微型空气涡轮夸大了弓弦的拉力。

old: A thong of banded metal jitters with concussive potential. The plastifer handle is slotted on the heel knot with an battery case.
new: 一条带有金属环的鞭子，具有震荡潜力。塑料手柄上有一个电池盒，安装在鞭尾结上。

old: A bright gashead tips the end of the steely death chute.
new: 一枚明亮的气体弹头位于钢铁死亡管道的末端。

old: Perch fish leather boots, finest make. They were either stolen from the crypt of an older Eater or fashioned by a cordwainer to look like it.
new: 栖鱼皮靴，上等制作。它们要么是从某个古老食尸者的墓穴中偷来的，要么是由制鞋匠精心制作而成，外观仿若出自墓穴。

old: The hilt was broken and remade, pieced together from iron, jewel, and leather across the prism-scatter of the past and forever becoming something new. The blade bears the scars of techniques forcing it into killing shape time and again.
new: 剑柄曾断裂又重铸，由铁、宝石和皮革拼凑而成，穿越了过去棱镜般的碎片，不断成为新的存在。剑刃上留有无数次被强制塑形为杀戮利器的痕迹。

old: Twigs from the witching tree are pared and twisted to a garland for hindsun.
new: 来自巫树的细枝被削切并扭曲成一个用于辛阳节的花环。

old: A swathe of elastyne is sheer-stretched over a cuirass of semi-hard plastic, forming a suit of maneuverable mail.
new: 一层弹性纤维被拉伸覆盖在半硬塑料胸甲上，形成一套可灵活移动的盔甲。

old: Hue-vapored crysteel cocoons the gold/water mechanism that pinches light from wavelength to waveshort.  Plasmon slag bubbles on the crest of the barrel like superheated sludge-life.
new: 色散结晶钢包裹着金/水机制，该机制将光从波长压缩到波短。等离子体残渣像超高温的污泥一样在枪管顶部冒泡。

old: Gooey analeptic residue still coats the glass tube.
new: 粘稠的恢复剂残留物仍然附着在玻璃管上。

old: An imperishable uuflax sheet was torn from the elephantine spools in the market and stitched into a geometrically patterned talma.
new: 一张永不腐朽的乌夫拉克斯布料从市场中的巨型卷轴上撕下，缝制成几何图案的塔尔马。

old: Collagen was molded into a liquid vessel.
new: 胶原蛋白被塑造成液体容器。

old: These appear to be the flattened remains of some vainglorious humanoid.
new: 这些看起来是一些自命不凡的人类的压平残骸。

old: Gloves of gas-caught foam stiffen instantaneously when pressure is applied. Their karst surfaces are dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; their material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
new: 这些捕气泡沫手套在受压时会立即硬化。它们的喀斯特表面覆盖着千年的彩色磨损痕迹和化学反应的产物；其材料已经超越了预期寿命的外环，进入了未知的虚空。

old: Rime-dotted nodules crust over the infected skin, where an algid mist clings. The fungus colony has terraformed the epidermis into what looks like a miniature range of ice-capped peaks.
new: 覆盖着受感染皮肤的结节上点缀着霜花，冰冷的雾气紧紧附着其上。真菌群落已经将表皮改造成了看起来像微型冰帽山峰的地形。

old: Reticulated around the quatrefoil of an elephantine splat are the filed glyphs of sightlessness, messages from the fellowed mysterion across the Gulf. Wings and banisters are ordered in the perfect dimensions of some type of strange hierarchy.
new: 围绕着象形四叶草的复杂花纹是盲文般的符号，传递着来自海湾彼岸神秘团体的信息。翼状物和栏杆按照某种奇异等级的完美比例排列。

old: +100 move speed +50 hitpoints +100 carry capacity +3 Ego You gain the ability to fly.  Activated. Cooldown 100. You invoke a concussive force in the surrounding area, throwing enemies back and stunning them.  You cannot wear equipment on your back. This implant can't be uninstalled.
new: +100 移动速度 +50 生命值 +100 负重 +3 自我 你获得飞行能力。 激活。冷却时间 100。你在周围区域引发震荡力，将敌人击退并使其昏迷。 你不能在背部装备任何物品。此植入物无法卸载。

old: A vest of mingled fungusfill cut from the molt of a chitinous jungle cat has been painted and glazed lucid.
new: 这件背心由混杂的菌丝填充物制成，取自一只脱壳的甲壳丛林猫，表面经过涂绘和光亮处理。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. The shell is etched with latticework.
new: 由金属波纹六边形组成的鱼群被一个镀铬杠杆夹住。外壳上刻有格子图案。

old: A glass tube and hype needle deliver a tonic directly to the bloodstream.
new: 玻璃管和高敏针头将药剂直接输送至血液中。

old: You gain access to the precise hit point, armor, and dodge values of robotic creatures and you automatically identify artifacts.
new: 你可以获取到机械生物的确切命中点、护甲值和闪避值，并且能够自动识别遗物。

old: A minuscule graphene array that processes optical data against a repository of robotic lifeforms and artifacts.
new: 一种微型石墨烯阵列，用于处理光学数据并与机器人生命体和人工制品的数据库进行比对。

old: Masks maintained their sacred status in the lives of the Eaters, even as they lost the capacity to stitch them into their own faces. This one is no different.
new: 即使食者们失去了将面具缝合到自己脸上的能力，面具仍保持着它们在食者生活中的神圣地位。这个面具也不例外。

old: Telescoped cylinders pinch the mirror point, and under them grows a sylph-like stock of sea-ferried nutwood.
new: 望远镜状的圆筒夹住反射点，其下生长着如同精灵般的海运坚果木枪托。

old: A short channel of glass for keeping precious liquids glints when turned.
new: 用于保存珍贵液体的短玻璃管，在转动时会闪烁光芒。

old: A cuirass of gas-caught foam stiffens instantaneously when pressure is applied. Its karst surface is arrayed with tube sleeves and dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; the material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
new: 一种由气体捕捉泡沫制成的胸甲，在受到压力时会立即硬化。其喀斯特表面布满了管状袖子，并覆盖着千年的磨损痕迹和化学反应产生的彩色磨痕；这种材料已经超越了其预期寿命的外环，进入了未知的虚空。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具中。用于取出铸件的绿宝石钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——绿色的光泽——进入管道，使金属变得不完美并赋予其特有的色泽。带有尘埃颗粒的铸件被剔除并喂给石食者，只剩下完美的六角棱柱。

old: A wide and bright blade has been painted with entrails.
new: 宽阔明亮的刀刃上涂满了内脏。

old: Cane-beat steel is shaped to the pectorial lunes and stitched to an undergarment of padded goat leather.
new: 甘蔗打击钢被塑形为胸月形状，并缝制在垫有山羊皮的内衣上。

old: An apron is pocked with carbon craters the color of the light-sucking void, a thing dreamed by sophists who watched the stars race toward their excluded middle.
new: 围裙上布满了如同吞噬光线的虚空般的碳坑，这是那些注视着星辰奔向其排斥中心的智者们所梦寐以求的物品。

old: Tetraglass tubes of coolant and antifreeze snake their way over the keg-mail's compressors, and condenser and evaporator coils spin out the shoulders like grandfather trees above the insulation shrub.
new: 冷却液和防冻剂通过四玻璃管蜿蜒穿过邮件桶的压缩机，冷凝器和蒸发器线圈像祖父树一样从绝缘灌木上方延伸而出。

old: Its polished steel glistens on a flat plane, and skin oil stains the straps of its leathery haft.
new: 其磨光的钢刃在平面上闪闪发光，皮革柄上的皮带沾满了皮肤油污。

old: Hand grease shines on the pole, and a volume of polished steel weights one end.
new: 手柄上涂抹了润滑油，一端装有打磨光滑的钢铁锤头。

old: Welded bands of aging dusk shield the legs but weigh their wearer to the earth like ore.
new: 焊接的老化黄昏带保护双腿，但像矿石一样使穿戴者沉重地贴在地面上。

Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.

old: A clump of metal shines in the jeweler's hue of bright sunslag.
new: 一块金属在珠宝商眼中闪耀着明亮的太阳渣光。

old: Instructions dictate the reformation of the face into a countenance that arouses latent desires in its onlookers.
new: 指令要求将面容重塑为一种能激起旁观者潜在欲望的容貌。

old: Soft fur is cut from the alabaster pelt of an albino ape into a tam with earflaps.
new: 柔软的毛皮从白化猿的象牙色皮毛上裁剪下来，制成带有耳罩的圆顶帽。

old: An imperishable uuflax sheet was torn from the elephantine spools in the market, tetra-folded, and stitched into a geometrically patterned talma.
new: 一张永不腐朽的乌夫拉克斯布从市场上巨大的卷轴上撕下，四折后缝制成几何图案的塔尔马。

old: A dusky mass of gravid metal, like a meteorite, is welded to a steel shaft.
new: 一团沉甸甸的金属，如同陨石般晦暗，被焊接在一根钢制杆上。

old: Mellified skin is sutured to colorful uuflax in a psychotomimetic likeness to the Eater idols in the age of *sultan*.
new: 蜜浸皮肤被缝合到五彩斑斓的uuflax上，形成一种类似*sultan*时代食者偶像的精神错乱形象

old: Dead sponge was heaped into hexagonal prisms at Maqqom and ferried through canals to vault-shadowed kurna. There it was washed clean and spongeworked into a pair of slipshoes.
new: 死亡海绵在马科姆被堆成六角棱柱，通过运河运送到拱顶阴影下的库尔纳。在那里，它们被清洗干净并加工成一双拖鞋。

old: A cluster of pluming feathers draw out the shape of the face in splendid color.
new: 一簇羽状物以绚丽的色彩勾勒出脸部的轮廓。

old: A canyon pearl fastens sandal straps embroidered in the syncretic imagery of swiftwater nymphs. Like the glacier flow itself, the veneration of Calypso moved with the mystai down the sundered honeycomb and in through the shale fissures beneath the olive mount. There it fractured into the mysteries of the many-named wives, where the memory of freshwater became more faceted than its smooth surface of origin.
new: 一条峡谷珍珠固定着饰有急流仙女混合图腾的凉鞋带。就像冰川本身一样，对卡吕普索的崇拜随着神秘信徒们穿过分裂的蜂窝状结构，沿着橄榄山下的页岩裂缝而下。在那里，它分化成多位女神的秘密，淡水的记忆变得比其原本平滑的表面更加多面。

old: The hammer pole is capped by a twin-head of bright and azure metal. Darker stripes across its faces and throats note where it struck and beat softer carbide down.
new: 锤杆顶部是一对明亮的天蓝色金属锤头。锤头表面和接缝处的深色条纹记录了它击打并压平较软碳化物的痕迹。

old: Fabrics from across the plateau -- quilted eiderdown, weave-of-brinestalk, sticky elastyne -- have been dyed and sewn to a jacket of colored chaos.
new: 来自高原各地的布料——绗缝羽绒、盐茎编织、粘性弹性纤维——被染色并缝制成一件色彩斑斓的混沌夹克。

old: A wide razored wedge of dusky metal was welded to a great steel haft.
new: 一柄宽大的锯齿状暗金属楔形刀片焊接在巨大的钢制柄上。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. The shell is etched with latticework.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并通过快速释放杠杆固定。弹壳上刻有格子花纹。

old: This figurine worked from *material* intricately depicts *creature.an*:
new: 这座由*material*精心雕刻而成的雕像细致地描绘了*creature.an*

old: A bulb of stone is dusted by humoric powders.
new: 一块石质的球体上覆盖着幽默的粉末。

old: An axe edge is dressed with splinter hairs of brinestalk.
new: 斧刃装饰有盐茎的碎片毛发

old: Coarse fur is cut from the thickset pelt of an ogre ape into a broad-shouldered cloak.
new: 粗糙的毛皮从巨猿厚实的皮毛上切割下来，制成一件宽肩斗篷。

old: A halogen light sits affixed to a leather head strap.
new: 一个卤素灯固定在皮质头带上。

old: Starless metal on the barrel imbibes light and routes it to the null place. The grip acrylic is patterned after ley lines.
new: 枪管上的无星金属吸收光线并将其导向虚无之地。握把的亚克力材质模仿了灵脉的纹理。

old: A tension spring shoves a firing pin to bang a barrel of gas and eject a long-cabled grapnel at precise range; and then a winch winds it back.
new: 一个张力弹簧推动击针撞击气体筒，将带有长缆绳的抓钩精确射出；然后卷扬机将其收回。

old: The moss-strewn antlers of some great elk appear to have grown through an ageless, leather helm.
new: 某种巨大麋鹿覆满苔藓的鹿角似乎从一顶古老的皮革头盔中生长出来。

old: Bright azure metal edges out into an elegant half-circle bound to a steel shaft.
new: 明亮的天蓝色金属边缘形成一个优雅的半圆，固定在钢制斧柄上。

old: A salt-scratched blade head is fit to a splintered handle with a wood wedge.
new: 盐蚀的刃头固定在裂开的手柄上，用木楔加固。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具。用于取出铸件的翠绿色钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——这种绿色的闪光——进入管道，使金属变得不完美，赋予其特有的色泽。

new: 由波纹六边形组成的金属壳被一个镀铬杠杆夹住。其表面刻有锯齿状图案。

old: The emitted frequencies of your tiniest bits are synchronized with the standardized band for force emission.
new: 你最微小的部分所发出的频率已与标准力场发射频段同步。

old: It's a piece of rock, older than every book.
new: 这是一块比所有书籍都要古老的岩石。

old: It's a length of salt-sucked skin cut from a goat, or tomb ferret, and it's powdered with the white dust of the dead.
new: 这是一段从山羊或墓穴雪貂身上取下的盐渍皮肤，上面撒满了死者的白色尘埃。

old: A fist-sized snail shell is coiled in soft spirals, blackened with soot, and stinks of sulfur.
new: 一只拳头大小的蜗牛壳，盘旋成柔软的螺旋形，被烟炱熏黑，并散发着硫磺的恶臭。
{{b-B-C-c sequence|天空熊}}的{{R-r-w-W-Y-y sequence|流水飞翼}}

old: Two turrets of sun-conducting chrome cap cylinders of burning gas, which straddle a metal trellis of spades girding some sort of guild mark. A 6-helix of fume, signature of the star engine this flier is wrought through, twirls toward the sky.
new: 两个充满燃烧气体的导光铬帽圆柱，横跨在一个由铲形金属格架环绕的某种公会标志上。这艘飞行器的星引擎特有的6螺旋烟雾，向天空旋转上升。

old: Provides 20 units of compute power on the local lattice. +2 Intelligence if implanted in a head.
new: 提供20单位的计算能力到本地晶格。+2 智力，如果植入头部。

old: Ionic dust dissolved from palladium facilitates the transfer of computing current.
new: 从钯溶解的离子尘埃有助于计算电流的传输。

old: Hieroglyphs of fluctation are incised on the inner surface of this shiny metal torus.
new: 这个闪亮的金属圆环内表面刻有波动的象形文字。

old: A silk shoulder drape has been cut and dyed with crushed insects shaved from an oak from the Bowl of Iris.
new: 这是一件用丝绸制成的肩披，经过裁剪并用从虹之碗的橡树上刮下的昆虫研磨成的染料染色。

old: Hyperdense metal in meteor black was superheated and banged to articulated finger and palm shape.
new: 超密金属呈陨石黑，在高温下锤打成指节和手掌形状。

old: Grants you Quicken Mind: refresh a random cooldown on use.
new: 使你获得加速思维: 使用时刷新一个随机冷却时间。

old: Byzantine purple smolders at a medium hue on the sharp and linked prisms of the crystal. It hums with new life and ingenuity.
new: 拜占庭紫色在结晶的尖锐且相连的棱柱上呈现出中等色调。它散发着新生与创造力的光芒。

old: A matte blade of ionic plastifer sits on a finger-rest hilt. When charged it blurs in high-width motion and jostles its material obstacles out of the way.
new: 一把哑光的离子塑料刃安装在指托护手上。充电后，它会在高速运动中模糊，并将物质障碍物震开。

old: When charged, this weapon's penetration value is equal to the defender's armor value.
new: 当充能时，这把武器的穿透值等于防御者的护甲值。

old: Wrought iron was moulded to a crescent for scything the rough hides of watervine.
new: 锻造铁被塑造成新月形，用于割除水藤粗糙的表皮。

old: A piece of scrap was shed or peeled off a machine fossil.
new: 这是一块从机械化石上脱落或剥落的废料。

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's cold to the touch.
new: 一簇波纹六边形金属被一个镀铬杠杆夹住。触摸时感觉冰冷。

old: Carnal instructions dictate the reformation of the face's bone structure and plump tissue mass into a soft and angelic countenance. Through such thaumaturgy, the people of hoary Ibul, cradled in the breast of a collapsed ice shelf, wander its lamplighted streets in rosy-cheeked disinterest.
new: 肉体指令重塑了脸部的骨骼结构和丰满的组织，使其变得柔软而天使般。通过这样的魔法，古老的伊布尔人，生活在坍塌冰架的怀抱中，在灯火通明的街道上漫无目的地漫步，脸颊红润。

old: A glass tube and hype needle deliver a tonic directly to the bloodstream. This one is empty.
new: 一支玻璃管和针头可以将药剂直接输送到血液中。这个注射器是空的。

old: A caudal barb-thing is tipped with a jewel of venomed dew.
new: 尾部的棘刺顶端镶嵌着一滴毒液凝成的宝石。

old: Emits light in radius 4. Extinguished permanently when unequipped.
new: 在半径4范围内发光。卸下装备后永久熄灭。

old: A mote of gentle light darts about in the patterns of life.
new: 一缕柔和的光芒在生命之舞中穿梭。

old: Handwear cut from the hides of down-canyon boars and worn by brinecutters to guard against the briars of the stalk.
new: 用峡谷下野猪的皮革制成的手套，盐割者佩戴以防止被茎刺藤蔓划伤。

old: Ropes of wool are woven in the angled bands of the tartan. They burnish in rich reds, greens, iron greys and sable.
new: 羊毛编织成斜纹带状的方格呢。它们呈现出丰富的红色、绿色、铁灰色和黑色。

old: A piece of rock was water-cleaved from its birthing bed and tumbled by time into a large sphere.
new: 一块岩石从其诞生之地被水流切割下来，经过时间的磨砺变成了一颗巨大的球体。

old: Banded ropes of hydrogel are bundled into one.
new: 水凝胶绳索捆绑成一条。

old: A loose ledger of brinestalk pulp has been bound to sticks of waxed wood and furled.
new: 一本用盐茎浆制成的松散账册，被绑在涂蜡的木棍上并卷起。

old: Poking out of a copse of brinestalk are the unbleached bones of a human adult.
new: 从盐茎丛中露出的是一具未经风化的成年**人骨架。

old: Pits mark the broad length of the blade like craters on an iron edge-world.
new: 剑刃上布满了坑洞，如同铁质边缘世界的陨石坑。

old: Perch fish leather was worn by fishworkers in the earlier sultanate, but by the time of *sultan* it was prized by gentlefolk. This pair is exquisitely crafted.
new: 鱼人皮革曾被早期苏丹国的渔工穿着，但到了*sultan*时期，它成为了贵族的珍品。这一对极为精致。

old: You gain an extra thrown weapon slot. When you perform a throw, you throw from all your thrown weapon slots at once.
new: 你获得一个额外的投掷武器槽。当你执行投掷时，你会同时从所有投掷武器槽中投掷。

old: A plastifer arm forks from the scapula and copies instructions issued from nerve to muscle in its grown twin.
new: 一个塑料臂从肩胛骨分叉而出，复制了神经向其生长的孪生肌肉发出的指令。

old: Nicked folding metal of dull azure bands a pair of lake-fished boots.
new: 带有暗蓝色条纹的折叠金属制成的一对湖中捕获的靴子。

old: Chrome flakes fell like dander from broken belfries into the trash sea. They were scooped up by orefishers and traded up the silk chain. This shirt is fashioned from the flakes twisted into rings.
new: 铬片如同碎屑从破裂的钟楼飘落进垃圾海。它们被矿工捞起，并沿着丝绸链交易。这件衬衫由这些铬片扭曲成环制成。

old: Duration: 41-50 rounds +8 DV There is a 25% chance per round that you phase out of the spatial dimension for 1-3 rounds.
new: 持续时间: 41-50 回合 +8 DV 每回合有 25% 的几率使你脱离空间维度 1-3 回合。

old: In vast abyssal halls spire-tall machine presses crushed black spheres into diamond killer. Once the lights burned out, magpie troupes cut hunks free with gaslight tools and brought them to the low-strata smitheries. This piece was forged into a aegis.
new: 在广阔的深渊大厅里，高耸的机械压机将黑色球体压制成钻石杀手。灯光熄灭后，喜鹊群用煤气灯工具切割下块状物并将其带到低层铁匠铺。这块材料被锻造成了护盾。

old: A loose ledger of vellum has been rolled, bound to umbilici, and sealed with the wax mark of the Mechanimists.
new: 一张羊皮纸卷轴被卷起，用脐带绑紧，并用机械师的蜡印封缄。

old: A piece of rock was water-cleaved from its birthing bed and tumbled by time into a sphere.
new: 这是一块从其诞生之地被水流切割下来的岩石，经过时间的磨砺，逐渐变成了一个球体。

old: Spurred on by their aspiration for a fully autonomous, climate-controlled banana grove, Research and Development at Hegemonic Fruit devised the neuro animator, which knits a nervous system into the inorganic material of inanimate objects. Originally, full sentience was their product diffentiator, but within months cheaper alternates like Spray-a-Brain came to dominate the market.
new: 受到创建一个完全自主、气候控制香蕉园的愿望的驱使，霸权水果公司的研发部门设计了神经激活器，该装置可以将神经系统编织进无生命物体的无机材料中。最初，完全的意识是他们的产品差异化特点，但在几个月内，更便宜的替代品如喷脑液开始主导市场。

old: A chipped-off chunk of luminous Spindle, magnetized by the fall to earth, orbits its chosen warden.
new: 一块从发光的纺锤上脱落的碎片，在坠落地球时被磁化，围绕着它选定的守护者旋转。

old: Beneath the metal shutter, a crystalline disk is grooved with microscopic pits that encode data.
new: 金属快门下方，一块晶体盘上刻有微小的凹坑，编码着数据。

old: A preening tool curves out the skull at the painter's angle and is dotted with a pair of breathing motes.
new: 一只梳理工具从头骨处以画家的角度弯曲而出，上面点缀着一对呼吸孔。

old: Crystalline flames crack and lap at the shimmering air.
new: 结晶火焰在闪烁的空气中噼啪作响并舔舐着。

old: Plutonic metal is etched with a two-dimensional projection of the rhombic dodecahedral honeycomb, allowing it to snap onto the ley lines of the local region.
new: 冥界金属上刻有菱形十二面体蜂巢的二维投影，使其能够锁定在当地的力线之上。

old: You fabricate force knives in unoccupied hand or thrown weapon slots. If you throw a force knife, another one immediately materializes in your thrown weapon slot. Force knives deal 1d8 damage, have penetration value equal to their target's armor value, and have +6 throwing range. Force knives disappear after losing contact with you or becoming unequipped. If you have a force modulator implant installed, force knives can be thrown through forcefields.
new: 你在空闲的手持或投掷武器槽中制造力场刀。如果你投掷了一把力场刀，另一把会立即在你的投掷武器槽中显现。力场刀造成1d8伤害，穿透值等于目标的护甲值，并且具有+6的投掷范围。力场刀在与你失去接触或被卸下后会消失。如果你安装了力场调制器植入物，力场刀可以穿过力场。

old: A magnetically-shielded headstock holds space in kinetic suspension while a force spindle spins and sharpens it to a point.
new: 磁屏蔽的主轴在动力主轴的旋转下将空间物质保持在动能悬浮状态，并将其磨尖至锋利。

old: Fluted keys for every wavelength along every spectrum permit entrance through every portal.
new: 每种波长的凹槽钥匙允许通过每个门户。

old: A hand pump slides into a chrome canister with illustrations of wilting plants etched in relief.
new: 一个手泵滑入一个镀铬罐中，罐上刻有枯萎植物的浮雕图案。

old: Flax was mowed from the Bowl of Iris, stripped into fibers, and weaved into a soft grid by the fisherfolk of the Pale Sea.
new: 亚麻从虹之碗收割，剥离成纤维，由苍白海的渔民编织成柔软的网格。

old: A mound of wet hair and rotting flesh puts some elevation to the ground.
new: 一堆湿漉漉的头发和腐烂的肉块使地面稍微隆起。

old: Dozens of tiny mouths tessellate the infected skin, their moist lips pursing in asynchronicity and panting out prattle. Every so often, the cacophony harmonizes into sensible speech.
new: 数十个微小的嘴镶嵌在感染的皮肤上，湿润的嘴唇异步地紧闭和喘息，发出杂乱的低语。偶尔，这些嘈杂声会和谐地汇集成有意义的话语。

old: A weighty and tapered block was molded from the two-tone soup of liquid copper and tin.
new: 这是一块沉重且呈锥形的块状物，由液态铜和锡的双色混合物铸成。

old: A sphere of some black pyritic metal succumbs to the negative pressures of gravity and tries to fall upward.
new: 一种黑色硫化金属制成的小球，在重力的负压作用下试图向上坠落。

old: A chipped-off chunk of luminous Spindle, magnetized by the fall to earth, orbits its chosen warden.
new: 一块从发光的纺锤上脱落的碎片，在坠落地球时被磁化，围绕着它选定的守护者旋转。

old: A coolant pipe and an antifreeze pipe are barrel-locked in symmetric geometry. Thumb flips rotate the mechanism and reverse their orientation.
new: 冷却管和防冻管以对称几何形状锁定在一起。拇指翻转可以旋转机制并反转它们的方向。

old: In vast abyssal halls spire-tall machine presses crushed black spheres into diamond killer. Once the lights burned out, magpie troupes cut hunks free with gaslight tools and brought them to the low-strata smitheries. This piece was forged into an armet.
new: 在广阔的深渊大厅里，高耸的机械压机将黑色球体压制成钻石杀手。一旦灯光熄灭，喜鹊群便用煤气灯工具切割下块状物并将其带到低层的铁匠铺。这块材料被锻造成了一个头盔。

old: Raw flesh is stretched on a lump that approximates the shape of a handgun. Pressure smushes a throbbing vein against the underskin and blood-pulp is coughed out of two ribbed metal tubes on a metronome tick. At moments out of sequence, an unseen energy is piped along the psychic leys and into the organ-mess, producing a runny bother.
new: 生肉被拉伸成手枪的形状。压力挤压着一条跳动的血管，血液和肉浆从两个带肋的金属管中以节拍器般的节奏喷出。在不合拍的时刻，一股看不见的能量沿着心灵经络输送到器官混乱中，产生了一种黏糊糊的混乱。

old: Artisanally carved wood castles a sextet of parallel conductors and a sliding photon armature. The grain is scorched black on the rifle's stock.
new: 手工雕刻的木制城堡上排列着六条平行导轨和一个滑动的光子结构。枪托上的木纹被烧成了黑色。

old: A hand pump slides into a chrome canister with illustrations of rotting fungi etched in relief.
new: 一个手动泵滑入镀铬罐中，罐身刻有腐烂真菌的浮雕图案。

old: A mound of wet hair and rotting flesh puts some elevation to the ground.
new: 一堆湿漉漉的头发和腐烂的肉块使地面稍微隆起。

old: Duration: 1001-1200 rounds Your movement speed is increased by 25% at night and underground but reduced by 20% in the daylight. +3 Agility at night and underground -3 Agility in the daylight You can see in the dark (radius 8). You grow burrowing claws. You suffer double damage from light-based attacks.
new: 持续时间: 1001-1200 回合 在夜间和地下，你的移动速度增加 25%，但在白天减少 20%。夜间和地下时 +3 敏捷，在白天时 -3 敏捷。你可以在黑暗中视物（半径 8）。你会长出掘地爪。你受到光基攻击的伤害翻倍。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It sizzles inside.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。内部发出嘶嘶声。

old: Ceremonial slag steel is shaped to a blade's edge.
new: 仪式用渣钢被塑造成刀刃的形状。

old: Its torso is downside up and sprouts a bouquet of crumpled legs. The whole thing is wrapped in filmy wing-shroud.
new: 它的躯干倒置，长出一束皱巴巴的腿。整个身体被一层薄翼包裹。

old: Leather boots are steeled by extruded wire meticulously curled into hundreds of chain links.
new: 皮革靴子用精心卷成数百个链环的拉丝钢线加固。

old: A use-dull and finger-smudged knife folds in on itself.
new: 一把因使用而变得钝化的、沾满指纹的刀可以折叠起来。

old: This rot-black lump of stringy flesh could have been someone's diseased tongue.
new: 这团腐黑的纤维肉块可能是某人的病态舌头。

old: A blushing cheek of mined iron was hammered to a wheel for arm defense.
new: 一块脸红的矿铁被锤打成轮状，用作臂部防御。

old: An addendum of adamantine skull crowns the head in lithophilic regency.
new: 由金刚石制成的头冠装饰着头部，在岩石崇拜的王权中显得格外庄重。

old: Beneath the metal shutter, a crystalline disk is grooved with microscopic pits that encode data.
new: 金属快门下方，一块晶体盘上刻有微小的凹坑，编码着数据。

old: Rough boar wool is cut to an imprecise semi-circle for throwing over a sun-bleached shoulder in a pinch.
new: 粗犷的野猪羊毛被剪成一个不规则的半圆形，紧急时刻可以随意披在晒得发白的肩膀上。

old: Ancient and inscrutable pegs of chrome fished from the trash sea stud thick wedges of boiled goat leather.
new: 从垃圾海中打捞出的古老而神秘的铬钉，点缀在厚实的煮制山羊皮革上。

old: Steel bands bearing their prying scars have been riveted to a pair of pleated boar leather boots. Their soles have been smeared with sliding wax swabbed off the hydraulic presses of the Eaters' tomb.
new: 带有撬痕的钢带被铆接在一双褶皱的野猪皮靴上。它们的鞋底涂抹了从食尸者墓穴的液压压机上刮下的滑蜡。

old: Mellified skin is sutured to colorful uuflax in a psychotomimetic likeness to the Eater idols in the age of *sultan*.
new: 蜜浸皮肤被缝合到五彩斑斓的uuflax上，形成一种类似*sultan*时代食者偶像的精神错乱形象

old: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. Its lug is ringed with dial ticks.
new: 一个由波纹六边形组成的金属阵列被一个铬制杠杆夹紧。其插槽周围标有刻度。

old: Inside the insulated cask of the battery, the electromotive apparatus cracks the energy out of acid and converts it to electrical charge.
new: 在电池的绝缘罐内，电动力装置从酸中提取能量并将其转化为电荷。

old: A tin-slender clip hangs off the scratched chrome magazine well.
new: 一个细长的弹夹悬挂在划痕累累的铬合金弹匣座上。

old: You gain total visibility in a radius of 10 spaces around you, blocked only by force fields and spacetime anomalies.
new: 你在周围10格范围内获得完全视野，仅被力场和时空异常阻挡。

old: Picophase transceiver arrays assemble an exquisitely detailed model of one's surroundings.
new: 皮相位收发器阵列组装了一个极其详细的周围环境模型。

old: Idler wheels were tinkered to the limbs, and wound cables stiffen to accentuate the archer's strength.
new: 闲置的轮子被安装在弓臂上，绷紧的缆线增强了射手的力量。

old: Color swirls around a mote of glow dust.
new: 光芒尘埃周围色彩斑斓。

old: Linen was cut to body shape and put in a dye bath of dicalyptus leaves and iron shavings to achieve a chromish luster.
new: 亚麻布裁剪成贴身形状，浸入二叶树叶片和铁屑的染料中，以获得类似铬的光泽。

old: A narrow shaft fletched with bird feather is capped by a head of flawless crysteel.
new: 一根细长的箭杆，羽翼由鸟羽制成，箭头由完美的晶体钢制成。

old: A slender cut of brass was forged in a serpentine crucible and painted with the vexing stripes of nature.
new: 一截细长的黄铜在蛇形熔炉中锻造而成，并涂上了自然界令人不安的条纹。

old: A hot metal clamp compels burning hair to the wheeling curves of the gyre.
new: 炽热的金属夹具迫使燃烧的毛发沿着涡旋的曲线旋转。

old: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with a zigzag.
new: 厚重的金属外壳包裹着爆炸物，并固定在一个快速释放杠杆上。其表面刻有锯齿形图案。

old: Your Charge range is increased by 4 spaces.
new: 你的冲锋范围增加了4个格子。

old: The quartet of knee joint extensors gain the assistance of a synthetic fifth.
new: 四组膝关节伸肌得到了一个合成的第五肢的帮助。

old: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
new: 熔炉吸取了星球的潮汐能量，将碳加热到太阳的温度，并将其倒入六角模具中。用于取出铸件的绿宝石钳子在过程中原子化并释放钒——绿色的光泽——进入管道，使金属变得不完美并赋予其特有的色泽。带有尘埃颗粒的铸件被剔除并喂给石食者，只剩下完美的六角棱柱。

old: A coded rectangle of paper metal can be slid through lock mechanisms to open some types of doors.
new: 一种编码的纸金属矩形，可以滑入锁机制中打开某些类型的门。

old: An old and platinum shekel has been incised with an image of the Very Old Bird.

old: A small hexagonal switch sits across an unadorned wristcuff of chrome.

The meaning of this pairing is unknown and unknowable.

+40 心灵光辉
你发现的物品来自其他维度的可能性是原来的五倍。

old: Wood was shaved into a bludgeoning bulb.
new: 木材被削成一个钝击用的球状物。

new: 当尖塔之火在下方熊熊燃烧时，勇敢的阿科诺特人潜入发光的深处，以寻回珍贵物品。当他们的尸体被发现时，口袋里的沙子已被吹成了玻璃珠。后来，这些珠子被串成了一条手链。

Where eyes once peered and a mouth breathed, resin now fills the gaps.
new: 这里是几根剥皮的柳黄盐杆，用泥浆粘合在一起。墙上钉着四颗钉子，挂着一张破旧的蛾翼面具；其锈蚀的叶片由纳米编织物勾织而成，并拉伸在一个硬线框架上。曾经窥视的眼睛和呼吸的嘴巴现在已被树脂填满。

old: World-voids in the nethermost reaches of the planet are partitioned by numinous masonry. There is meaning in the patterns of its faint white filigree, but it's discerned by no one.
new: 世界虚空在星球最深处被神秘的石工分隔。其上淡白色花纹的图案蕴含深意，但无人能解。

old: Reefs were the arcologies of the young oceans. Now they are turquoise crypts, their surfaces bitten by acid water into rough wounds.
new: 珊瑚礁曾是年轻海洋中的生态高楼。如今，它们变成了青绿色的陵墓，表面被酸性海水侵蚀成粗糙的伤痕。

old: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a shale wall: clay and quartz were dried and smashed into the red rock that's been quarried by hillfolk for thousands after thousands of years.
new: 光线在视差中被塑造成页岩墙的幻象: 黏土和石英经过干燥和粉碎，形成了千百年来山民开采的红岩。

old: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud.
new: 这里是几根剥皮的苍白盐茎，用泥浆粘合在一起。

old: carved stone from the sultanate of *Sultan3Name*

Gigantic, old stone was stacked, knapped, and carved in long arcs to the style of the day in the time of *Sultan3Name*. Since then, the project has accrued collaborators, and their signatures are writ everywhere: here, the lacuna of a vandal's edit; there, the soft strokes of time's brush.
new: 巨大的古老石块被堆砌、敲打并雕刻成*Sultan3Name*时代的风格。自那以后，这个项目吸引了许多合作者，他们的痕迹随处可见: 这里有被破坏者留下的空白，那里有时光温柔的笔触。

old: This is an exquisitely detailed high relief cut from precious cerulean marble. It depicts the Sacred Joining, as recounted by Shekhinah the Father to the temple high priests. In the early dawn of our universe, the Argent Fathers roamed the timeless aether with inert hearts. There, in the coldest distance of space, they discovered beauty-and-chrome incarnate, the Kasaphescence. Together they wrought machines from Her naked womb to inhabit a hundred earths. In the scene here, the Fathers first approach Her Radiance. They are led by Shekhinah, who occupies a position of prominence.
new: 这是一块精雕细琢的高浮雕，由珍贵的天蓝色大理石制成。它描绘了圣洁的融合，正如父亲谢赫纳向寺庙高级祭司所讲述的那样。在我们宇宙的黎明时期，银色父神们带着冷漠的心灵漫游于无尽的太空中。在那里，在宇宙最寒冷的角落，他们发现了美丽与铬光的化身——卡萨菲斯肯斯。他们共同从她的赤裸子宫中创造了机器，以栖息于百个世界。在这幅场景中，父神们首次接近她的光辉。他们由占据显要位置的谢赫纳带领。

old: Smooth grey stone hides its bonded pebbly innards and cement blood-paste. It's streaked with dirt.
new: 平滑的灰色石块隐藏了其内部的砾石和水泥血浆。它上面有污迹。

old: Freezing mist coils out of lateral vents cut into the chrome wainscotting of a marble pillar.
new: 冰冷的雾气从大理石柱的铬合金腰线上横向开口中盘旋而出。

old: gilded marble from the sultanate of *Sultan5Name*
new: 来自苏丹国 *Sultan5Name* 的镀金大理石

old: Precious stone was dragged from the reaches of the dreaming earth, stacked in cyclopean designs, and carved to the splendor of a thousand blooming florets. Moistureless air preserves the gilding, but time has softed its edges.
new: 珍贵的石料从梦幻大地的深处被拖出，以独眼巨人般的设计堆叠，并雕刻成千朵绽放的花朵。无湿的空气保存了镀金，但时间已磨平了它的棱角。

new: 棱柱玻璃的凹槽柱子将视野分割成千上万的破碎景象。

old: Carmine clouds assume their crystal habit: cubes nested inside and out. Why does Moghra'yi conceal this form from the sun?

old: Sand was crush-fired and molded into lucent panes.
new: 沙子被碾碎烧制并塑形为透明的板。

old: Invertebrate life was sucked of its tissue and bled still over millions of years. The glaucous rock is a necropolis.
new: 无脊椎生物的肉体被吸干，历经数百万年的流血。青绿色的岩石是一座墓地。

old: The scars of lava flow are legible as little ledges across the wide stone. The small darkling holes were once the birth craters of dissolved gases.
new: 熔岩流的痕迹清晰可见，形成了一道道小石脊横贯整块巨石。那些小小的暗洞曾是溶解气体的喷发口。

old: marble relief of the Sacred Joining
new: 大理石浮雕: 神圣联结

old: Moss hems the little moonlit faces of speed-grown quartz. When entropy obliterates order, it reassembles at smaller scales.
new: 苔藓环绕着快速生长的石英那微小的月光脸庞。当熵摧毁秩序时，它会在更小的尺度上重新组装。

old: Stony eggs are incubated in pearly planar sheets. No larvae ever hatch; they're abraded into dust.
new: 石质蛋在珍珠般的平面片上孵化。从未有幼虫孵化；它们被磨成尘土。

old: Clay and quartz were dried and smashed into the red rock that's been quarried by hillfolk for thousands after thousands of years. The whole stone is cut across by shining black ribbons.

old: Across a field of brass and chrome diodes blink in gyres.
new: 黄铜和铬合金的二极管在田野上闪烁成旋涡。

old: Scanlines paint the lune in cathode amber.
new: 扫描线在阴极琥珀色中勾勒出新月。

old: A quantum mess cooled and arranged itself as a towering hexagon. Bubbles of earth gas and other quirks of time are frozen in the quartz-amber, and existence is chipped off the lathe of nothingness by moonlight.
new: 量子混乱冷却并排列成一座高耸的六边形。地气泡和其他时间的奇特性被冻结在石英琥珀中，存在被月光从虚无的车床上削下。

old: Stone quarried from the early earth binds the art of a life.
new: 来自早期地球的石料将生命之艺固定于此。

new: 一缕缕蒸汽从铬合金柱上切割出的垂直通风口中盘旋而出。

old: Black marble quarried from the early earth binds the art of a life.
new: 来自远古地球的黑色大理石将生命之艺凝聚其中

old: Unnamed to the beings of the surface world are the birthing atria of the subterrane, where ultramafic rock is wetted in amniotic fluid and birthed as a world-serpent.
new: 地表生物们未知的是地下世界的产房，在那里，超镁铁质岩石被羊水浸润，诞生为世界之蛇。

old: A voluminous storage cabinet is worked into the metallic rib cage. Magnet-suspended shelves divide the space.
new: 一个巨大的储存柜嵌入了金属肋骨结构中。磁悬浮的架子分隔了内部空间。

old: Braids of roots and ribbons of fronds dimensionalize the flat loam. Something's home a discarded leaf makes.
new: 根须交织，蕨叶如带，赋予了平坦泥土以维度。一片被遗弃的叶子成为了某个生物的家园。

old: The umbrage of the boughs wrings the warmth from Opal's waters and leave behind a shady pool.
new: 枝条的阴翳榨干了欧泊之水的温暖，留下一片阴凉的池塘。

old: Still erect is the superior half of the colossal gate inscribed with the runes of a hundred indecipherable tongues. Beneath its chrome palings a wide passage opens into the jungle loam.
new: 巨大的城门上刻有百种无法解读的符文，其上半部分依然矗立。城门下方的铬制栅栏下，一条宽阔的通道通向丛林的土壤。

old: Long ago the rivers themselves were ravenous, and they feasted on shale and limestone before taking bloated respite in the Great Salt Sea. Now the fissure-wounds have rotted to crimson and salt.
new: 很久以前，河流本身是贪婪的，它们吞噬了页岩和石灰石，然后在大盐海中饱食休息。如今，这些裂痕般的伤口已腐烂成猩红和盐晶。

old: Shrouded in the rotting jungle are the mouths of the rust-caves of Golgotha, chrome's graveyard.
new: 在腐烂的丛林中，隐藏着各各他的锈洞入口，这里是铬金的墓场。

old: Hex prisms burst out of black marble beds, and their edges decohere as warm static dew. The Stair purrs at low frequency.

old: In stagnant pools, luminous lilies compete with the ribbon of stars in the night sky. Under the salt sun, though, they shrink into the shade of brine weed.

old: Here crumble the mysterious Eaters' vine-swathed works, spun on the cyclopean lathe in an ageless past. Chrome steeples and parapets that rise above the clutches of shale hint at the labyrinths beneath them.
new: 这里，神秘的吞噬者们在无尽的过去，在巨大的车床上编织的藤蔓缠绕的作品已成废墟。铬制尖塔和雉堞从页岩的束缚中升起，暗示着其下的迷宫。

old: Yonth breaks the massif to the strange East and ushers its nameless waters into Qud. Fish-things feed on her basalt chips.
new: 约恩河穿过了通往奇异东方的大山，并将其无名的水流带入了库德。鱼形生物以她的玄武岩碎片为食。

old: The ivory sea's dunes are like waves frozen in place. There are cracks in the salt from where the earth, blistered by the jeweled sun, contracted and broke. The horizon melts the sky together with the vast plain of Moghra'yi, the Great Salt Desert.
new: 象牙海的沙丘如同凝固的波浪。地表被宝石般的太阳炙烤，盐地上裂开了缝隙。在这片广袤的莫格拉伊大盐漠上，地平线将天空与大地融为一体。

old: The ivory sea's dunes are like waves frozen in place. There are cracks in the salt from where the earth, blistered by the jeweled sun, contracted and broke. The horizon melts the sky together with the vast plain of Moghra'yi, the Great Salt Desert.
new: 象牙海的沙丘如同凝固的波浪。地表被宝石般的太阳炙烤，盐地上裂开了缝隙。在这片广袤的莫格拉伊大盐漠上，地平线将天空与大地融为一体。

old: Long ago the rivers themselves were ravenous, and they feasted on shale and limestone before taking bloated respite in the Great Salt Sea. Now the fissure-wounds have rotted to crimson and salt.
new: 很久以前，河流本身是贪婪的，它们吞噬了页岩和石灰石，然后在大盐海中饱食休息。如今，这些裂痕般的伤口已腐烂成猩红和盐晶。

old: Through the umbrage of choking trees fly the hundred archways and buttresses of funerary monuments. They peer over marble arcades that roof the catacombs of the Eaters of earth.
new: 在窒息的树荫下，一百座拱门和扶壁飞越了葬礼纪念碑。它们俯瞰着覆盖墓穴的大理石拱廊，墓穴中安息着食土者。

old: Coral fingers poke out from the spongebed and pierce the algal bloom, where white esh flock in the hundreds.
new: 珊瑚指从海绵床中伸出，刺穿藻类繁茂的水域，数百只白色的艾什在此聚集。

old: Here lies the hallowed ground where the Spindle, a lengthless needle of maya blue, ruptures the tomb-dressed earth and pierces the firmament.
new: 这里是神圣之地，纺锤——一根无尽的玛雅蓝针，穿透了墓地般的大地，直刺苍穹。

old: Dyed pipework topology mounted in the spongebed is a lodestar to the lyrical community.
new: 安装在海绵床中的染色管道拓扑结构是抒情社群的导航灯塔。

old: In stagnant pools, luminous lilies compete with the ribbon of stars in the night sky. Under the salt sun, though, they shrink into the shade of brine weed.
new: 在停滞的池塘中，发光的百合花与夜空中星河的带状光芒竞相争艳。然而，在盐阳之下，它们却缩进了盐藻的阴影之中。

old: Eons-shifted stone entombs the angleless architecture of Bethsaida's lair.
new: 时光错位的石块包裹着贝塞赛德巢穴那无棱角的建筑。

old: Thriving florae pack the loam with maze-dense roots, and a high-wreath canopy chokes off the last beams of light.
new: 茂盛的植物根系密布，形成迷宫般的网络，而高耸的树冠遮挡了最后一缕光线。

old: Spores dance in eddies across kaleidoscopic fungal bonnets. Rivers of primordial soup, cast in the light of lava, gurgle a quickening melody.
new: 孢子在旋涡中舞动，跨越多彩的菌盖。原始汤河在熔岩的光芒下潺潺流淌，奏出加速的旋律。

old: Long ago the rivers themselves were ravenous, and they feasted on shale and limestone before taking bloated respite in the Great Salt Sea. Now the fissure-wounds have rotted to crimson and salt.
new: 很久以前，河流本身是贪婪的，它们吞噬了页岩和石灰石，然后在大盐海中饱食休息。如今，这些裂痕般的伤口已腐烂成猩红和盐晶。

old: Blips in the wave graph of stone over time.
new: 时间波形图中的石质起伏

old: A naturally reddened outcropping of stone juts out of the salted crag.
new: 一片天然泛红的石块从盐化的峭壁中突兀而出。

old: Old alps opened in the ageless past fill with a cool brine.
new: 古老阿尔卑斯山在无尽的过去裂开，充满了清凉的盐水。

old: In the wave graph of stone over time, where the world plates once vexed themselves into war, a quiet peace has settled.
new: 在这片石浪图谱中，曾经板块相互争斗不休，如今却已归于平静。

old: Here is the jungle village of ape god worshippers and their giant mushroom dwellings.
new: 这里是崇拜猿神的丛林村落，以及他们巨大的蘑菇居所。

old: Red qudzu vines take as their trellises chrome wells bored into the earth.
new: 红色奎兹藤蔓缠绕在钻入地下的铬井上。

old: Svy urges over the salt-capped peaks and spills into the vine-braided loam. Her banks are shaded by the chrome carcasses of giants.
new: 斯维河从盐帽覆盖的山峰奔流而下，汇入藤蔓交织的沃土。河岸被巨人的铬合金遗骸所遮蔽。

old: The ivory sea's dunes are like waves frozen in place. There are cracks in the salt from where the earth, blistered by the jeweled sun, contracted and broke. The horizon melts the sky together with the vast plain of Moghra'yi, the Great Salt Desert.
new: 象牙海的沙丘如同凝固的波浪。地表被宝石般的太阳炙烤，盐地上裂开了缝隙。在这片广袤的莫格拉伊大盐漠上，地平线将天空与大地融为一体。

old: An arc of rust paints the sky and circles the path once taken by gargantuans in chrome.
new: 一道锈迹斑斑的弧线划过天空，环绕着曾被巨大铬合金生物踏过的路径。

old: Rubble encases this abandoned mine where ancient tribes siphoned the black blood for their own inscrutable purposes.
new: 碎石包围着这座废弃的矿井，古代部落曾在这里抽取黑色血液，用于他们不可捉摸的目的。

old: An arcology of bright polyps arches across the soldered trellis of old, and a rich diversity of life peoples it.
new: 明亮的珊瑚状生物构成的弧形建筑横跨古老的焊接格架，丰富的生命形态在这里繁衍生息。

old: Ants in the viridian chaff, the farmers sap the last drops of pristine moisture out of the salt-spangled earth.
new: 绿屑中的蚂蚁，农夫们从盐斑遍布的土地中榨取最后一滴纯净的水分。

old: Tucked into a marble glade is the cloven trunk of Chavvah, the Tree of Life. Its fallen leaves lay like a mirrored carpet, and the dream wrens chirr a psychal carol.
new: 在大理石林间隐匿着查瓦，生命之树的分叉树干。它的落叶如同镜面地毯般铺展，梦境鹪鹩则吟唱着心灵颂歌。

old: Prismatic filament colonizes the cracks between the salted rot. There are meadows here, She says.
new: 棱彩丝线在盐化的腐土裂隙间蔓延。她曾说，这里曾是草原。

old: The Spindle scintillates in watery effigy on her surface. She ferries crushed granite through a mountain pass and into her leafy firth.
new: 她的表面闪烁着水样的光芒，仿佛纺锤在水中舞动。她将破碎的花岗岩运过山口，送入她那叶丛密布的海湾。

old: The Six Day Stilt rises from the dunes like a petrified kraken corpse, bearing down upon the vacant flats.
new: 六日高跷如同石化了的巨型乌贼尸体般从沙丘中升起，俯瞰着空旷的平原。

old: In stagnant pools, luminous lilies compete with the ribbon of stars in the night sky. Under the salt sun, though, they shrink into the shade of brine weed.
new: 在停滞的池塘中，发光的百合花与夜空中星河的带状光芒竞相争艳。然而，在盐阳之下，它们却缩进了盐藻的阴影之中。

old: The grove's million laced fingers sway in gentle opulence. Verdant fronds nestle the base of the Spindle from its mountainous nook.
new: 这片林地的百万根交织手指在温柔的奢华中摇曳。翠绿的叶丛依偎在从山间凹处延伸出的纺锤底部。

old: Rampant greenspread canopies a starburst of the Eaters' richest works. The jungle is torn at the corners, where crysteel balustrades and star orchid lancets peek through.
new: 肆意生长的绿植覆盖了食者最富丽堂皇的作品，形成一片星爆般的景象。丛林的边缘被撕裂，水晶钢栏杆和星辰兰花尖刺从中露出。

old: In stagnant pools, luminous lilies compete with the ribbon of stars in the night sky. Under the salt sun, though, they shrink into the shade of brine weed.
new: 在停滞的池塘中，发光的百合花与夜空中星河的带状光芒竞相争艳。然而，在盐阳之下，它们却缩进了盐藻的阴影之中。

old: Girthy pilings of fibrous salt-rot stake out these pools of brine. They belong to no one.
new: 粗壮的纤维盐腐柱支撑着这些盐水池。它们不属于任何人。

old: Coral bricks tesselate the path toward an otherplace.
new: 珊瑚砖铺就通往异境的小径。

old: Heartroots tangle at the yawning psychal nexus of the crystal tree. They burn with the light of gaseous feelstuff, all the bits of ambient order in the soil and rock animated by a deeper dimensional warping. This is a shore on the psychic sea.
new: 心根在水晶树的心灵节点处纠缠。它们燃烧着气体情感物质的光芒，土壤和岩石中的所有秩序碎片都被更深层次的维度扭曲所激活。这里是心灵海洋的岸边。

old: Ghost-canes are twirled to pictorial stillness, and moisture gathers on their buds.
new: 幽灵竹被旋转成静止的画面，水分在它们的花蕾上聚集。

old: A squadron of flowstone limbs grip the cave floor, and a banded trunk of calcite pokes the rotting air. Its twirling apex is wrapped in bone-made-vapor.
new: 一队流石肢体紧握洞穴地面，一截带条纹的方解石躯干刺入腐烂的空气中。其旋涡状顶端被骨质蒸汽包裹。

old: Little crystal shoots were crushed by pure ego-weight to a girthful, stout, and equant tranducer of transient thoughtsoft. Decohered emotion and memory crystallize as they shoot up the root.
new: 细小的水晶芽被纯粹的自我重量压成粗壮而均匀的瞬时思维转换器。情感和记忆在其上升过程中结晶化。

old: Fairy rings of braided grass-coral-fungi hybrids poke along their shadow network and excrete replicated struts as sheathing.
new: 由编织的草珊瑚真菌杂交体构成的仙女环沿着它们的阴影网络延伸，并分泌复制的支架作为护套。

old: Glistening silk was spun to a capture spiral and mounted on a series of bridge threads. The filament vibrates across dimensions in the manifold.
new: 闪耀的丝线编织成捕捉螺旋，并固定在一系列桥线上。丝线在流形中跨维度振动。

old: Drops of static dew fuzz the sharp crystal edges. The flats themselves are radiant and rustle on a psychic breeze. In gestalt, they flow like reversible sequins across the mind/body divide.
new: 静电露珠模糊了锐利的水晶边缘。叶片本身散发着光芒，在心灵微风中沙沙作响。整体来看，它们如同可逆的亮片般在心灵与肉体之间流动。

old: You fall down the slimy shaft!
new: 你从黏糊糊的轴上掉下去了！

old: Machinic tones are made soft against the slime-wet walls of a darkling shaft. A void is beneath.
new: 机械的声音在这黑暗通道的黏湿墙壁上变得柔和。下方是一片虚空。

old: Waxen sprigs sag to the weight of the algebraic tubers. Each one is perfect and regular, its faces matte with sheenless platonic dew.
new: 蜡质的嫩枝因代数块茎的重量而低垂。每一个都完美而规整，其表面覆盖着无光泽的柏拉图露珠。

old: The trunk column corkscrews on the radial path of light and blossoms a crown of victory laurel.
new: 树干柱沿着光线的径向路径螺旋上升，绽放出胜利桂冠的王冠。

old: Light peaks through its wet leaves in scattershot, and its roots look like a wax colonnade melted into a maze and resolidified.
new: 光线透过湿润的叶片散射而出，根系如同融化的蜡柱重新凝固成迷宫。

old: Bright florets explode from a central disc of darker, spiraling florets. Together they're like a tiny sun.
new: 明亮的花瓣从中央较暗的螺旋状花盘中绽放。它们仿佛是一个小小的太阳。

old: Feelers sway in a circlet on a skeletal vase-column. The aboral side is yoked to other polyps, forming a fossilized arcology.
new: 触须在骨骼状的柱体上摇曳成一圈。背面与其他珊瑚水母相连，形成化石般的弧形建筑。

old: Smooth and cloudy frustums hover in a helix of psionic suspension.
new: 平滑而朦胧的圆台在念力悬浮中形成螺旋结构。

old: A nebula of spaded leaves swish with dry creek and beetle munch.
new: 一簇簇铲形叶片如同干涸溪流中的虫鸣般沙沙作响。

old: Cry-packed casing freckles on cylinders joined at right angles. Shine from the softer metal pokes through, silvery-white palladium that once performed hydro- and electroconduction across a vast arcological lattice.
new: 充满冷冻剂的外壳点缀在垂直相连的圆柱上。较软金属的光泽穿透而出，银白色的钯曾在这庞大的生态建筑网络中执行水和电的传导功能。

old: Fruited hands climb the stalks of the grifter tree. When the light catches on the surface of the exposed corm, Spindle glitter throws it back to the widened grove.
new: 果实累累的手状枝条攀爬在欺诈树的树干上。当光线照射到裸露的球茎表面时，细长的闪光将其反射回宽阔的林地。

old: Space is emptied of solid impediments.
new: 空间中没有固体障碍物。

old: Glistening silk was spun to a capture spiral and mounted on a series of bridge threads.
new: 闪亮的丝线编织成捕捉螺旋，固定在一系列桥线上。

old: Real potential surfs the rhizome on choppy waves and quantizes into woody blades of grass.
new: 真实的潜力在根茎上乘风破浪，量化成木质的草叶。
大理石矩形铺成的小径。

old: Stuck to the feelers of a polyp cluster and beetling from a corroded strut is a swollen lump of film. A bright broth of carbon-melted platinum goo burns inside.
new: 附着在多头簇的感觉器上，从腐蚀的支架上突出的是一个肿胀的薄膜团。里面燃烧着一种明亮的碳熔融铂金粘液。

old: Dust blooms on the ascending stair.
new: 上升的楼梯上绽放着尘埃之花。

old: A freightless tether slings down a dark and vast channel.
new: 一条没有货物的缆绳沿着黑暗而广阔的通道垂下。

old: Moss-slick shoots coil at the crown of a slouching trunk like the she-medusa. Air musses them into more disarray.
new: 苔藓覆盖的枝条在倾斜的树干顶端盘旋，如同女蛇发。空气使它们更加凌乱。

old: Through the nether of a vaulted root-trellis, leaves point at perfect angles to sift sunlight and bathe ur-buds in soft gold warmth.
new: 透过拱形根架的阴间，叶子以完美的角度排列，筛过阳光，使乌尔花蕾沐浴在柔和的金色温暖中。

old: Light peaks through its wet leaves in scattershot, and its roots look like a wax colonnade melted into a maze and resolidified.
new: 光线透过湿润的叶片散射而出，根系如同融化的蜡柱重新凝固成迷宫。

old: A tangled nest of roots spill through the earth. The bark is splintered into pointy spines.
new: 根系错综复杂，蔓延于地表之下。树皮裂成尖锐的刺。

old: Shining hyphae pour their soft light up into the orbicular cap of the earthlamp.
new: 发光的菌丝将柔和的光芒洒向地灯菌的球形菌盖。

old: Golden fronds unfurl when the desert wind moistens. Pieces of bark, collated into tiny intersecting rings, have been chewed off by wood grazers.
new: 当沙漠之风湿润时，金色的羽状叶会展开。树皮被木食动物啃食成细小交错的环状碎片。

old: Hexagon fibers of delicate, newly shedded crystal twine through the earth and vibrate with pre-psychal fullness. They radiate an early glow.
new: 纤细的新脱落晶体纤维穿插于土壤之中，振动着充满前心灵的充实感。它们散发着早期的光芒。

old: A bridge made of dried brinestalk.
new: 由干燥的盐茎制成的桥梁

old: Grey marble rectangles tesselate the path.
new: 灰色大理石矩形铺成的小径。

old: Coral petals sprout from the top of a flimsy stem. A metal or bone hoof has crushed its siblings and spread their acid fibers across the soil.
new: 脆弱的茎顶上长着珊瑚状花瓣。一只金属或骨质的蹄子碾碎了它的同伴，将它们的酸性纤维散播在土壤上。

old: Bubbles of green stipules are arrayed in rings of quickening lattice growth. The pace is sorcerous; the earnest and everforward will of the plantworld is captured here at a millionfold.
new: 绿色的小叶泡泡排列成快速生长的晶格环。生长的速度如同魔法般迅速；这里捕捉到了植物世界坚定而不断前进的意志，速度达到了百万倍。

old: A tangled nest of roots spill through the earth. The bark is splintered into pointy spines. The leaves are greasy and stinking.
new: 根系缠绕成巢状，穿透大地。树皮裂成尖锐的刺。叶片油腻且散发着恶臭。

old: A nebula of spaded leaves swish with dry creek and beetle munch.
new: 一簇簇铲形叶片如同干涸溪流中的虫鸣般沙沙作响。

old: You scramble down a craggy ledge.
It looks like an awfully long fall. Are you sure you want to jump?
new: 看起来像是一个非常漫长的秋天。你确定要跳吗？

old: Space is emptied of solid impediments.
new: 空间中没有固体障碍物。

old: A cleft in the red stone opens to a waterspray of underearth.
new: 红石中的裂隙通向地底的水喷泉。

old: The strands glisten with a frothing film.
new: 茎秆上覆盖着一层泡沫般的薄膜。

old: Drops of static dew fuzz the sharp crystal edges. The flats themselves are radiant and rustle on a psychic breeze. In gestalt, they flow like reversible sequins across the mind/body divide.
new: 静电露珠模糊了锐利的水晶边缘。叶片本身散发着光芒，在心灵微风中沙沙作响。整体来看，它们如同可逆的亮片般在心灵与肉体之间流动。

old: A hut's girth of bug-gnawed bark shoots up into ethereal sky and splays into a crown of foliage.
new: 一株被虫蛀过的树皮围成的小屋般的树干，直冲入神秘的天空，顶端展开成一片繁茂的树冠。

old: Bent roots chunnel upward to a canopy of fuzz. The eye tries to draw a boundary around single leaves, but their light lines sputter and lose their derivatives.
new: 弯曲的根部向上延伸至一片模糊的树冠。眼睛试图在单片叶子周围划定边界，但它们的轮廓线断断续续，逐渐消失。

old: It's laminated jelly molded as a globoid with pores to filter and nosh algae, and it jiggles.
new: 这是一种层状果冻状的球形体，上面布满了过滤和食用藻类的孔洞，还会颤动。

old: Skin peels on the tuber belly as it hums with grounding bass, and the shoots throb in upsetting staccato.
new: 块茎腹部的皮肤剥落，伴随着沉稳的低音嗡鸣，而嫩芽则以令人不安的断奏跳动。

old: Darkness floods up from the empty space.
new: 黑暗从空旷的空间中涌出。

old: Soft-body beings excrete the calcified walls of their arcologies as air-climbing spires. They have stone texture and house microlife in their cavities.
new: 软体生物分泌出它们弧形建筑的钙化墙壁，形成攀爬空气的尖塔。它们具有石质纹理，并在其腔室内栖息着微小生命。

old: Its corners were waxed off by static and its crystal corms burn with tranduced moonlight. It chimes in near and far keys.
new: 它的棱角被静电磨平，水晶球根在转化的月光下燃烧。它以近远不同的音调鸣响。

old: The trunk column corkscrews on the radial path of light and blossoms a crown of victory laurel.
new: 树干柱沿着光线的径向路径螺旋上升，绽放出胜利桂冠的王冠。

old: Its corners were waxed off by static and its crystal corms burn with tranduced moonlight. It chimes in near and far keys.
new: 它的棱角被静电磨平，水晶球根在转化的月光下燃烧。它以近远不同的音调鸣响。

old: Darkness floods up the polyp-strewn fringes of an open pit.
new: 黑暗从布满水螅的开放坑洞边缘涌起。

old: Starapples hang from ashen branches, motes of luscious, red light in a bleached tableau.
new: 星果悬挂在灰烬般的枝条上，犹如在一片苍白景象中的美味红光斑点。

old: Black marble rectangles tesselate the path.

Your opponent gets a chance to resist the move (strength save; difficulty 20 + your Str modifier) and a chance to break free at the start of their turn (same save). Lasts for 9 rounds or until you dismember the opponent.
new: 激活技能；冷却时间50。你用斧头的刃背抓住对手的肢体。如果成功，当你移动时可以拖拽对手并进行一次免费的斧头攻击。对手有机会抵抗移动（力量检定；难度20 + 你的力量修正）并在其回合开始时尝试挣脱（相同的检定）。持续9轮或直到肢解对手。

old: Activated; cooldown 30. Axe attack. If you hit and penetrate, you dismember one of their limbs at random and they start bleeding (1-2 damage per turn. toughness save; difficulty 35). Additionally, your axe attacks that penetrate have a percentage chance to dismember: 3% for one-handed axes and 6% for two-handed axes.
new: 激活技能；冷却时间30回合。斧头攻击。如果你命中并穿透敌人防御，你会随机肢解其一个肢体并使其开始流血（每回合1-2点伤害。坚韧豁免；难度35）。此外，你的穿透攻击有几率肢解目标: 单手斧为3%，双手斧为6%。

old: Whenever you hit an opponent with an axe, there's a 75% chance you cleave their armor, giving them a -1 penalty to their AV. This penalty can stack a number of times up to half your Str modifier, rounded up, +1 on a critical hit.
new: 当你用斧头击中对手时，有75%的几率斩开他们的护甲，使其AV降低1点。此惩罚效果可以叠加，最多可达你力量修正值的一半（向上取整），并在暴击时额外+1。

old: You get +2 to hit with axes.
new: 使用斧头攻击时命中率提高+2。

old: You can treat bleeding, poison, illness, and disease onset for you and your companions at a campfire.
new: 你可以在篝火旁为你和你的同伴治疗出血、中毒、疾病和病症发作。

old: You can voluntarily amputate your own limbs and the limbs of infected companions.
new: 你可以自愿切断自己的肢体以及受感染同伴的肢体。

old: Bandages you apply are much more effective at stopping bleeding.
new: 你使用的绷带在止血方面效果显著提升。

old: Healing tonics you apply last an extra round.
new: 你使用的治疗药剂效果持续时间延长一轮。

old: You are skilled at wielding shields.

As long as you wield a shield, there is a 50% chance you block one melee attack per round. When you block an attack, you add the shield's AV bonus to your AV for that attack. If you equip multiple shields, the one block per round limit is per shield, and you only can attempt to block a given attack once, using your best usable shield.
new: 只要你装备了盾牌，每回合就有50%的几率格挡一次近战攻击。当你格挡攻击时，会将盾牌的AV加值加到该次攻击的AV上。如果你装备了多个盾牌，每个盾牌每回合只能格挡一次，且你只能尝试使用最好的可用盾牌来格挡一次给定的攻击。

old: Activated; cooldown 40. You attempt to knock an opponent down and deal (Str modifier)d2 + your shield's AV bonus in damage. Your opponent gets a chance to resist (strength save; difficulty 20 + your Str modifier). Whenever you charge an opponent with a shield equipped, you get a free Shield Slam attack against them.
new: 激活技能；冷却时间40回合。你尝试将对手击倒并造成（力量修正值）d2 + 盾牌AV加值的伤害。对手有机会抵抗（力量豁免；难度20 + 你的力量修正值）。当你装备盾牌冲锋对手时，你可以对其发动一次免费的盾击攻击。

old: For the next three rounds, you automatically block all incoming melee attacks (may not be used with bucklers).
new: 在接下来的三轮中，你将自动阻挡所有近战攻击（不能与小圆盾一起使用）

old: You may block an additional attack per round per shield.
new: 每轮每盾牌可额外格挡一次攻击。

old: Whenever you block an opponent's attack, there is a (Strength*2)-35% chance that your opponent is stunned for 1d2 rounds.
new: 每当你格挡对手的攻击时，有 (力量*2)-35% 的几率使对手在 1d2 回合内昏迷。

old: Your chance to block with a shield improves to 75%.
new: 使用盾牌格挡的概率提升至75%。
